Key.Russian: Вероятность осадков составляет около 70 процентов, поэтому, будьте готовы к этому.
Key.German: Die Niederschlagswahrscheinlichkeit beträgt etwa 70 %, also könnt ihr euch auf Regen einstellen.
Key.Czech: Pravděpodobnost srážek se pohybuje kolem 70 procent, tak se radši připravte.
Key.English: Probability of precipitation is around the 70 percent mark, so, y'know, do be prepared for that.
Key.Portuguese: A probabilidade de precipitação é de cerca de 70%. Portanto, esteja preparado para isso.
Key.Korean: 강수 확률은 70%정도니까 미리 대비하시는 게 좋을 것 같습니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 降水概率约为 70%，因此，请做好防雨准备。
Key.Japanese: 降水確率は 70%です。今日は傘を持ってお出かけください。
Key.Turkish: Yağış olasılığı yüzde 70 civarında; hazırlıklı olsanız iyi olur.

Container.name: 026_am_radio_broadcast_forecast_rain_b
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: There's a possibility of rain, at 35 percent.
Key.Chinese: 有可能會下雨，降雨機率 35%。
Key.French: Le risque de pluie est estimé à 35 %.
Key.Spanish: Hay probabilidad de lluvias, alrededor de un 35 por ciento.
Key.Italian: Le probabilità di pioggia sono al 35%.
Key.Polish: Mamy 35% szans na opady deszczu.szans na opady deszczu.
Key.German: Die Regenwahrscheinlichkeit beträgt etwa 35 %.
Key.Czech: Šance, že bude pršet, je kolem 35 procent.
Key.English: There's a possibility of rain, at 35 percent.
Key.Portuguese: Há possibilidade de chuva, cerca de 35%.
Key.Japanese: 降水確率は 35%です。

Container.name: 025_am_radio_broadcast_forecast_rain_a
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: Chance of rain is low, somewhere between 10 and 15 percent.
Key.Chinese: 降雨機率低，大約在 10 到 15% 之間。
Key.French: Le risque de pluie est faible, entre 10 et 15 %.
Key.Spanish: Hay poca probabilidad de lluvias, entre un 10 y un 15 por ciento.
Key.Italian: Basse probabilità di pioggia, comprese tra il 10% e il 15%.
Key.Polish: Szanse na deszcz są niskie, od 10 do 15 procent.
Key.Russian: Вероятность дождя низкая, где-то между 10 и 15 процентами.
Key.German: Die Regenwahrscheinlichkeit ist niedrig: etwa zwischen 10 und 15 %.
Key.Czech: Pravděpodobnost deště je nízká, zhruba 10 až 15 procent.
Key.English: Chance of rain is low, somewhere between 10 and 15 percent.
Key.Portuguese: A probabilidade de chuva é baixa, algo entre 10 e 15%.
Key.Korean: 비가 내릴 확률은 10%에서 15% 정도로 낮은 편입니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 降雨概率不大，大约在 10% 到 15% 之间。
Key.Japanese: 降水確率は低く、10～15%でしょう。
Key.Turkish: Yağmur ihtimali düşük, yüzde 10 ila 15 arasında.

Container.name: 024_am_radio_broadcast_forecast_cloud_staying
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: Our forecast has another front moving in - cloudy skies, I'm afraid, and, it may be here awhile.
Key.Chinese: 我們的天氣預報顯示，又有個鋒面將至－－恐怕這一陣子都會是陰天。
Key.French: Selon nos prévisions, un front nuageux s'annonce et ça risque malheureusement de durer.
Key.Spanish: En el pronóstico tenemos un nuevo frente en camino: me temo que habrá cielos nubosos para rato.
Key.Italian: Secondo le nostre previsioni sta arrivando un altro fronte che porterà nuvole, e temo che potrebbe restare così per un po’.
Key.Polish: Według naszej prognozy zbliża się kolejny front – musimy się liczyć przez pewien czas z pochmurnym niebem.
Key.Russian: По нашим прогнозам на нас движется еще одни фронт. Похоже, что погода будет облачной довольно долго.
Key.German: Unsere Wettervorhersage rechnet mit einer weiteren Wolkendecke. Das könnte eine Weile dauern.
Key.Czech: Předpověď hlásí, že se blíží fronta a spolu s ní bohužel mraky, které nějakou dobu vydrží.
Key.English: Our forecast has another front moving in - cloudy skies, I'm afraid, and, it may be here awhile.
Key.Portuguese: Nossa previsão aponta outro bloco de nuvens avançando. Receio que o céu deve permanecer nublado por algum tempo.
Key.Korean: 일기예보에 따르면 흐린 날씨가 되겠습니다. 흐린 날씨는 한동안 이어질 것으로 보입니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 据预报，另一个锋面正在逼近 - 预计今日阴天，而且可能会持续一段时间。
Key.Japanese: 天気予報です。残念ながら、曇りが予想されます。しばらくは曇りが続くでしょう。
Key.Turkish: Hava tahminimize göre yine bulutlu hava dalgası geliyor; korkarım bulutlar bir süre kalacak.

Container.name: 023_am_radio_broadcast_forecast_cloud_uncertain
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: Regarding our forecast, there may be some cloud about but that should clear up.
Key.Chinese: 至於天氣預報，現在可能有些雲朵，但很快就會多雲轉晴。
Key.French: Nos prévisions annoncent quelques nuages, mais ils ne se maintiendront pas.
Key.Spanish: El pronóstico del tiempo dice que habrá algunas nubes pero que acabarán despejándose.
Key.Italian: Riguardo alle previsioni del tempo, potrebbe esserci qualche nuvola ma poi il cielo dovrebbe aprirsi.
Key.Polish: Wracając do prognozy, zachmurzenie powinny niebawem zniknąć.
Key.Russian: Что касается прогноза, то ожидается небольшая и кратковременная облачность.
Key.German: Laut Wetterbericht gibt es zwar vereinzelte Wolken, aber der Himmel sollte schnell wieder klar sein.
Key.Czech: Podle předpovědi má být trochu zataženo, ale postupně se vyjasní.
Key.English: Regarding our forecast, there may be some cloud about but that should clear up.
Key.Portuguese: Em relação à nossa previsão, pode haver algumas nuvens, mas logo o céu deve ficar limpo.
Key.Korean: 일기예보를 전해드리면, 약간 구름은 끼겠지만 금방 사라질 것으로 보입니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 据预报，可能会有一些云团，但应该会转晴。
Key.Japanese: 天気予報ですが、曇りが予想されますが、のちに晴れ渡る見込みです。
Key.Turkish: Hava tahminimize göre hava biraz bulutlanabilir ancak bulutlar dağılacak.

Container.name: 022_am_radio_broadcast_forecast_cloud_clearing
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: As for the forecast, we're not anticipating any cloud in the next few hours.
Key.Chinese: 至於天氣預報，幾個小時內預計不會有雲層出現。
Key.French: Pour ce qui est des prévisions, le ciel restera dégagé dans les prochaines heures.
Key.Spanish: El pronóstico del tiempo es que no se esperan nubes en las próximas horas.
Key.Italian: Per quanto riguarda le previsioni del tempo, non dovrebbero esserci nuvole nelle prossime ore.
Key.Polish: Jeśli chodzi o prognozę pogody, nie przewidujemy żadnych chmur przez kilka najbliższych godzin.
Key.Russian: Что касается прогноза, то в ближайшие пару часов небо должно быть чистым.
Key.German: Was das Wetter angeht, erwarten wir keine Wolken in den nächsten Stunden.
Key.Czech: Předpověď neočekává v příštích hodinách žádnou oblačnost.
Key.English: As for the forecast, we're not anticipating any cloud in the next few hours.
Key.Portuguese: Quanto à previsão, não percebemos nenhuma nuvem nas próximas horas.
Key.Korean: 기상에 따르면 앞으로 몇 시간 동안은 구름이 없을 전망입니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 至于天气预报方面，我们预计未来几小时内晴朗无云。
Key.Japanese: 天気予報ですが、今から数時間は雲らない見込みです。
Key.Turkish: Hava durumuna gelirsek, önümüzdeki birkaç saat içinde bulut olmayacak gibi.

Container.name: 021_am_radio_broadcast_rain_b
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: And obviously, there's the rain. Drive carefully if you're on a late one.
Key.Chinese: 當然還會下雨。夜間開車時請小心。
Key.French: Comme vous le voyez, il pleut. Soyez prudent si vous êtes sur la route.
Key.Spanish: Y, por supuesto, llueve. Conducid con precaución si salís tarde.
Key.Italian: E, ovviamente, piove. Prestate attenzione alla strada se fate tardi.
Key.Polish: Pada oczywiście deszcz. Prowadźcie ostrożnie, jeśli jesteście jeszcze na drogach.
Key.Russian: Ну, и само собой разумеется, будет дождь. Будьте осторожны за рулем, особенно поздно вечером.
Key.German: Und selbstverständlich regnet es auch. Fahrt vorsichtig, wenn ihr spät unterwegs seid.
Key.Czech: A pochopitelně taky prší. Jestli máte noční, dávejte pozor při řízení.
Key.English: And obviously, there's the rain. Drive carefully if you're on a late one.
Key.Portuguese: E, obviamente, tem a chuva. Dirija com cuidado se estiver atrasado.
Key.Korean: 비가 내리고 있습니다. 밤 늦게까지 일하시는 분들은 운전 조심해서 하시기 바랍니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 显然，现在有雨。如果您误了点，请小心开车。
Key.Japanese: そして、明らかに今雨が降っています。遅れている場合は気を付けて運転してください。
Key.Turkish: Ve tabii ki gibi yağmur var. Geç saatlere kalırsanız aracınızı dikkatli sürün.

Container.name: 020_am_radio_broadcast_rain_a
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: And, of course, it's raining.
Key.French: Et il pleut, évidemment.
Key.Spanish: Y, cómo no, está lloviendo.
Key.Italian: E, naturalmente, piove.
Key.German: Und natürlich regnet es auch.
Key.English: And, of course, it's raining.
Key.Portuguese: E, claro, está chovendo.
Key.Japanese: そして、今雨が降っています。

Container.name: 019_am_radio_broadcast_night_stormy
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: There's a lot of storm clouds rolling in, so expect some thunder and lightning.
Key.Chinese: 許多烏雲將至，預計今晚會有閃電雷鳴。
Key.French: Les nuages s'accumulent, attendez-vous à de l'orage.
Key.Spanish: Se acercan bastantes nubes de tormenta, así que contad con truenos y relámpagos.
Key.Italian: Ci sono un sacco di nuvole temporalesche in arrivo, aspettatevi lampi e tuoni.
Key.Polish: Zbliża się dużo burzowych chmur, możecie się więc spodziewać nawałnicy.
Key.Russian: Над нами сгущаются грозовые облака, так что вечером будет гром и молния.
Key.German: Dicke Wolken ziehen sich über uns zusammen, also sollten wir uns auf ein Gewitter einstellen.
Key.Czech: Blíží se bouřkové mraky, tak se připravte na hromy a blesky.
Key.English: There's a lot of storm clouds rolling in, so expect some thunder and lightning.
Key.Portuguese: Há muitas nuvens de tempestade, então pode esperar raios e trovões.
Key.Korean: 먹구름이 몰려오고 있는데 천둥 번개도 칠 것 같습니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 目前乌云滚滚，预计会很快就会电闪雷鸣。
Key.Japanese: 嵐雲がたくさん流れてきているため、雷が予想されます。
Key.Turkish: Bir sürü fırtına bulutu yaklaşıyor; şimşek ve gök gürültüsüne hazırlıklı olun.

Container.name: 018_am_radio_broadcast_night_very_cloudy
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: It's a cloudy one tonight.
Key.French: C'est une nuit nuageuse.
Key.Spanish: Vamos a tener una noche nubosa.
Key.Italian: Sarà una notte piena di nuvole.
Key.German: Heute Nacht ist es stark bewölkt.
Key.English: It's a cloudy one tonight.
Key.Portuguese: O céu permanece bem nublado hoje à noite.
Key.Japanese: 今夜は雲りです。

Container.name: 017_am_radio_broadcast_night_cloudy
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: Our night's looking a little cloudy right now.
Key.French: Ce soir, le ciel est un peu couvert.
Key.Spanish: La noche pinta algo nubosa en este momento.
Key.Italian: Al momento il cielo di stanotte sembra un po’ coperto.
Key.German: Unsere Nacht sieht gerade ein wenig bewölkt aus.
Key.Czech: Noční obloha je dnes trochu zatažená.
Key.English: Our night's looking a little cloudy right now.
Key.Portuguese: Nossa noite de hoje parece um pouco nublada por enquanto.
Key.Korean: 오늘 밤 하늘은 구름이 많을 것으로 보입니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 目前夜空中云朵有点多。
Key.Japanese: 今現在は、夜空は少し雲で覆われています。
Key.Turkish: Bu gece hava biraz bulutlu görünüyor.

Container.name: 016_am_radio_broadcast_night_some_cloud
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: There's a few clouds around tonight but it's mostly pretty clear.
Key.Chinese: 今晚會有一些雲，不過天空還算月明星稀。
Key.French: Ce soir, il y a quelques nuages, mais le ciel reste dégagé.
Key.Spanish: Esta noche hay unas cuantas nubes, pero el cielo está bastante despejado.
Key.Italian: C’è qualche nuvola stanotte, ma il cielo è prevalentemente sereno.
Key.Polish: Z wyjątkiem paru obłoków noc powinna być niemal bezchmurna.
Key.Russian: Сегодня вечером будет небольшая облачность, но по большей части небо будет чистым.
Key.German: Heute Nacht gibt es ein paar Wolken, aber das Wetter bleibt größtenteils klar.
Key.Czech: Dnes v noci je na obloze jenom pár mraků, celkově spíš jasno.
Key.English: There's a few clouds around tonight but it's mostly pretty clear.
Key.Portuguese: Hoje à noite haverá algumas nuvens, mas em sua maior parte o céu permanece livre.
Key.Korean: 오늘 밤 하늘엔 구름이 조금 끼겠지만, 대체적으론 맑겠습니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 今晚有云，但基本上还是月朗星稀。
Key.Japanese: 今夜は雲があるものの、おおむね晴れるでしょう。
Key.Turkish: Bu gece birkaç bulut var ancak genel olarak hava oldukça açık.

Container.name: 015_am_radio_broadcast_night_clear
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: It's a clear and starry, starry night tonight.
Key.Chinese: 萬里無雲，今晚會有明亮的星空。
Key.French: Ce soir, le ciel est très étoilé.
Key.Spanish: Tenemos una noche despejada y llenita de estrellas.
Key.Italian: Stanotte avremo un cielo terso e pieno di stelle.
Key.Russian: Сегодня нас ждет ясная звездная ночь.
Key.German: Heute Nacht funkelt ein klarer Sternenhimmel.
Key.English: It's a clear and starry, starry night tonight.
Key.Portuguese: Hoje será uma noite sem nuvens e bem estrelada.
Key.Korean: 하늘이 맑아서 오늘 밤엔 별이 반짝반짝 잘 보일 것 같습니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 今晚晴空无云，星光灿烂。
Key.Japanese: 今夜は晴れて星が輝く夜となるでしょう。
Key.Turkish: Bu gece hava açık ve yıldızlı.

Container.name: 014_am_radio_broadcast_day_stormy
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: It's pretty stormy out there.
Key.French: Le temps est à l'orage.
Key.Spanish: La tormenta arrecia por aquí.
Key.Italian: Il tempo sembra parecchio burrascoso.
Key.German: Da draußen ist es ziemlich stürmisch.
Key.English: It's pretty stormy out there.
Key.Portuguese: O tempo está bem agitado lá fora.
Key.Japanese: 外はかなりの強風が吹いています。

Container.name: 013_am_radio_broadcast_day_very_cloudy
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: As you can see, it's a bit of a dismal day today. Lots of cloud and only a little sun.
Key.Chinese: 很明顯，今天的天氣很差，烏雲密佈且陽光很少。
Key.French: Comme vous le voyez, c'est assez gris, aujourd'hui. Beaucoup de nuages et peu de soleil.
Key.Spanish: Como podéis ver, hoy está el día feúcho: muchas nubes y muy poco sol.
Key.Italian: Come vedete, il tempo è un po’ cupo oggi. Molte nuvole e pochissimo sole.
Key.Polish: Jak widać, pogoda nie dopisuje. Dużo chmur i chwilowe przejaśnienia.
Key.Russian: Как видите, день сегодня выдался довольно мрачный. Много облаков и лишь немного солнца.
Key.German: Wie ihr sehr, ist heute schreckliches Wetter. Viele Wolken und kaum Sonne.
Key.Czech: Jak vidíte, máme dneska trochu škaredě. Spousta mraků a jen trocha slunce.
Key.English: As you can see, it's a bit of a dismal day today. Lots of cloud and only a little sun.
Key.Portuguese: Como se pode perceber, hoje é um dia encoberto. Muitas nuvens e só um pouquinho de sol.
Key.Korean: 보시다시피 오늘은 약간 흐리군요. 구름이 많고 해는 거의 나지 않고 있어요.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大家可以看到，今天有点阴沉沉的。云量较多，只有一点点阳光。
Key.Japanese: ご覧の通り、今日は少し薄暗い日になります。雲が厚く、太陽はあまり顔を出さないでしょう。
Key.Turkish: Sizin de görebildiğiniz gibi, bugün hava biraz kapalı. Bir sürü bulut var ve güneş yüzünü çok az gösteriyor.

Container.name: 012_am_radio_broadcast_day_cloudy
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: It's looking a little overcast at the moment.
Key.French: Le ciel est couvert.
Key.Spanish: En este momento tenemos el cielo un poco cubierto.
Key.Italian: Il tempo sembra un po’ imbronciato al momento.
Key.Russian: Погода немного пасмурная на данный момент.
Key.German: Aktuell ist es ein wenig bewölkt.
Key.English: It's looking a little overcast at the moment.
Key.Portuguese: Parece um pouco nublado no momento.
Key.Japanese: 今は少し曇っています。
Key.Turkish: Hava şu anda biraz kapalı görünüyor.

Container.name: 011_am_radio_broadcast_day_some_cloud
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: It's another gorgeous day. Sunshine, blue skies, and a little scattered cloud.
Key.Chinese: 又一個大晴天。陽光、藍天和零星的雲朵。
Key.French: Encore une belle journée. Du soleil, un ciel bleu et seulement quelques nuages.
Key.Spanish: Tenemos otro día espléndido: sol, cielo azul y unas pocas nubes dispersas.
Key.Italian: Un’altra splendida giornata. Sole, cielo azzurro e qualche nuvola qua e là.
Key.Polish: Mamy kolejny piękny dzień. Słońce, błękitne niebo i pojedyncze chmury.
Key.Russian: Еще один прекрасный день. Солнце, голубое небо и небольшие облака.
Key.German: Wieder ein toller Tag. Sonne, blauer Himmel und nur eine kleine Wolke.
Key.Czech: Máme další nádherný den. Sluníčko, azuro, jen pár menších mráčků.
Key.English: It's another gorgeous day. Sunshine, blue skies, and a little scattered cloud.
Key.Portuguese: Outro dia lindo. Luz do sol, céu azul e uma nuvenzinha dispersa.
Key.Korean: 오늘도 아주 좋은 날입니다. 화창하고 파란 하늘에 구름들이 약간씩 흩어져 있습니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 今天仍然是个大晴天。阳光明媚，蓝天中飘浮着几朵白云。
Key.Japanese: 今日もまた晴れです。太陽がまぶしく、青い空が広がり、雲もほとんどありません。
Key.Turkish: Muhteşem bir gün daha. Güneş, masmavi gökyüzü ve birkaç dağınık bulut.

Container.name: 010_am_radio_broadcast_day_clear
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: As I'm sure you can see, it's a beautiful day out there.
Key.Chinese: 毫無疑問，今天天氣風和日麗。
Key.French: Comme vous le voyez, c'est une belle journée.
Key.Spanish: Como podréis ver vosotros mismos, hace un día precioso.
Key.Italian: Come potete sicuramente vedere, oggi è una bellissima giornata.
Key.Polish: Mamy piękny dzień, jak mieliście okazje się przekonać.
Key.Russian: Как вы уже заметили, сегодня прекрасный день.
Key.German: Wie ihr sicher selbst sehen könnt, ist heute ein wunderbarer Tag.
Key.Czech: Jak jistě vidíte sami, venku je krásný den.
Key.English: As I'm sure you can see, it's a beautiful day out there.
Key.Portuguese: Como com certeza você pode perceber, está um dia lindo lá fora.
Key.Korean: 밖을 보면 아시겠지만 오늘은 아주 화창한 날씨군요.
Key.Chinesesimp: 相信大家都能看到，外面是一派风和日丽的景象。
Key.Japanese: 空を見上げれば分かる通り、とても晴れています。
Key.Turkish: Sizin de görebildiğiniz gibi, güzel bir gün.

Key.Original: Barely a cloud in sight.
Key.French: Pas un nuage en vue.
Key.Spanish: Apenas hay nubes.
Key.Italian: A malapena una nuvola in cielo.
Key.Polish: Na niebie nie ma praktycznie żadnej chmurki.
Key.Russian: В небе почти ни одного облака.
Key.German: Wolkenloser Himmel.
Key.English: Barely a cloud in sight.
Key.Portuguese: Quase sem nuvens à vista.
Key.Korean: 거의 구름 한 점 없는 날씨입니다.
Key.Japanese: 雲がほとんどありません。

Container.name: 009_am_radio_broadcast_out_d
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: Alright. Let's talk about the weather.
Key.Chinese: 好了，讓我們開始天氣預報吧。
Key.French: Bien, voici le bulletin météo.
Key.Spanish: Muy bien, hablemos del tiempo.
Key.Italian: Bene. Parliamo delle previsioni del tempo.
Key.German: Alles klar, jetzt kommt das Wetter.
Key.Czech: Dobře, pojďme si říct, jaké bude počasí.
Key.English: Alright. Let's talk about the weather.
Key.Portuguese: Ok. Vamos conversar sobre o clima.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吧。我们来聊一聊天气。
Key.Japanese: さて、それではお天気についてお話しましょう。

Container.name: 008_am_radio_broadcast_out_c
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: Next, the weather.
Key.Chinese: 即將播出的是，天氣預報。
Key.French: Maintenant, la météo.
Key.Spanish: A continuación, el tiempo.
Key.Italian: E ora le previsioni del tempo.
Key.German: Als Nächstes kommt das Wetter.
Key.English: Next, the weather.
Key.Portuguese: A seguir, o clima.
Key.Japanese: 次は天気予報です。

Container.name: 007_am_radio_broadcast_out_b
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: So, okay, on to the weather.
Key.Chinese: 好，接下來，我們將帶來天氣預報。
Key.French: Passons maintenant à la météo.
Key.Spanish: Pues nada, vamos con el tiempo.
Key.Italian: Allora, okay, passiamo alle previsioni del tempo.
Key.German: Okay, jetzt zum Wetter.
Key.English: So, okay, on to the weather.
Key.Portuguese: Então, tudo bem, vamos ao clima.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那么，好的，下面说说天气。
Key.Japanese: はい。それでは天気予報です。

Container.name: 006_am_radio_broadcast_out_a
Container.situation: broadcaster gives the weather forecast.

Key.Original: As for the weather, well...
Key.French: Pour ce qui est de la météo, eh bien...
Key.Spanish: Respecto al tiempo, pues...
Key.Italian: Per quanto riguarda le previsioni, beh...
Key.German: Was das Wetter angeht ...
Key.English: As for the weather, well...
Key.Portuguese: Em relação ao clima, bem...
Key.Japanese: さて、お天気ですが...

Container.name: 005_am_radio_broadcast_in_c
Container.situation: broadcaster reads the latest news stories.

Key.Original: You're listening to Radio Horizons on 90.3 and 90.7 FM.
Key.Chinese: 您現在正在收聽 Horizon 電台，FM 90.3 和 90.7。
Key.French: Vous écoutez Radio Horizons sur 90.3 et 90.7 FM.
Key.Spanish: Estáis escuchando Radio Horizons en el 90.3 y el 90.7 de vuestro dial de FM.
Key.Italian: State ascoltando Radio Horizons su 90.3 e 90.7 FM.
Key.Polish: Słuchacie stacji Radio Horizons, 90,3 i 90,7 FM.
Key.Russian: Вы слушаете Радио «Горизонты» на 90.3 и 90.7 FM.
Key.German: Ihr hört Radio Horizons auf 90.3 und 90.7 FM.
Key.Czech: Posloucháte rádio Horizons na 90,3 a 90,7 FM.
Key.English: You're listening to Radio Horizons on 90.3 and 90.7 FM.
Key.Portuguese: Você está ouvindo a Rádio Horizons na 90.3 e 90.7 FM.
Key.Korean: 90.3 및 90.7 FM에서 라디오 호라이즌을 듣고 계십니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你正在收听地平线广播电台，调频 90.3 和 90.7。
Key.Japanese: 90.3 および 90.7 FM でラジオ・ホライゾンをご視聴いただいています。

Key.Original: Next up, local news.
Key.Chinese: 即將播出的是，本地新聞。
Key.French: Maintenant, les actualités locales.
Key.Spanish: A continuación, las noticias locales.
Key.Italian: Ora parliamo delle notizie a livello locale.
Key.German: Als Nächstes: die Lokalnachrichten.
Key.English: Next up, local news.
Key.Portuguese: A seguir, as notícias locais.
Key.Japanese: 次は地元のニュースです。

Container.name: 004_am_radio_broadcast_in_b
Container.situation: broadcaster reads the latest news stories.

Key.Original: Latest news stories next.
Key.French: Tout de suite, les actualités.
Key.Spanish: A continuación, las últimas noticias.
Key.Italian: E ora le ultime notizie.
Key.German: Als Nächstes kommen die neusten Nachrichten.
Key.English: Latest news stories next.
Key.Portuguese: As últimas notícias a seguir.
Key.Japanese: 次は最新ニュースです。

Key.Original: You can find us on 90.3 and 90.7 FM. Radio Horizons.
Key.Chinese: Horizon 電台，就在 FM 90.3 和 90.7。
Key.French: Vous êtes sur Radio Horizons. Retrouvez-nous sur 90.3 et 90.7 FM.
Key.Spanish: En el 90.3 y el 90.7 de vuestro dial de FM. Radio Horizons.
Key.Italian: Potete trovarci su 90.3 e 90.7 FM. Radio Horizons.
Key.Polish: Można nas usłyszeć na częstotliwościach 90,3 i 90,7 FM. Radio Horizons.
Key.Russian: Ищите нас на 90.3 и 90.7 FM. Радио «Горизонты».
Key.German: Ihr findet uns auf 90.3 und 90.7 FM. Radio Horizons.
Key.Czech: Vysíláme na 90,3 a 90,7 FM. Rádio Horizons.
Key.English: You can find us on 90.3 and 90.7 FM. Radio Horizons.
Key.Portuguese: Você pode sintonizar com a gente na 90.3 e 90.7 FM. Rádio Horizons.
Key.Korean: 90.3 및 90.7 FM에서 청취하실 수 있습니다. 라디오 호라이즌입니다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 您可以通过调频 90.3 和 90.7 收听我们的节目。这里是地平线广播电台。
Key.Japanese: ラジオ・ホライゾンは 90.3 または 90.7 FM でご視聴いただけます。
Key.Turkish: Bizi 90.3 ve 90.7 FM’de dinleyebilirsiniz. Radio Horizons.

Container.name: 003_am_radio_broadcast_in_a
Container.situation: broadcaster reads the latest news stories.

Key.Original: You're listening to Radio Horizons.
Key.Chinese: 您現在正在收聽 Horizon 電台。
Key.French: Vous écoutez Radio Horizons.
Key.Spanish: Estáis escuchando Radio Horizons.
Key.Italian: State ascoltando Radio Horizons.
Key.German: Ihr hört Radio Horizons.
Key.English: You're listening to Radio Horizons.
Key.Portuguese: Você está ouvindo a Rádio Horizons.
Key.Chinesesimp: 您正在收听地平线广播电台。
Key.Japanese: ラジオ・ホライゾンの時間です。

Key.Original: I'm Leila Allaire, and this is the news.
Key.Chinese: 我是莉菈‧阿萊爾，現在正在播放新聞。
Key.French: Voici les actualités, avec Leila Allaire.
Key.Spanish: Soy Leila Allaire y os traigo las noticias.
Key.Italian: Io sono Leila Allaire e queste sono le notizie di oggi.
Key.Polish: Nazywam się Leila Allaire, czas na wiadomości.
Key.Russian: Я Лейла Аллер, в эфире новости.
Key.German: Ich bin Leila Allaire und das sind die Nachrichten.
Key.Czech: Jsou tady zprávy s Leilou Allaire.
Key.English: I'm Leila Allaire, and this is the news.
Key.Portuguese: Eu sou Leila Allaire e estas são as notícias.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我是 Leila Allaire，下面播报新闻。
Key.Japanese: 私、レイラ・アレアがニュースをお届けします。

Container.name: 002_am_radio_broadcast_segue_b
Container.situation: broadcaster reads the latest news stories.

Key.Original: In other news...
Key.French: Autres nouvelles...
Key.Spanish: Cambiando de tema...
Key.Italian: Tra le altre notizie...
Key.German: Außerdem ...
Key.English: In other news...
Key.Portuguese: Outra notícia...
Key.Japanese: 他のニュースです...

Container.name: 001_am_radio_broadcast_segue_a
Container.situation: broadcaster reads the latest news stories.

Key.Original: Now, in news elsewhere...
Key.French: Autre actualité...
Key.Spanish: Pasando a otras noticias...
Key.Italian: Passando ad altre notizie...
Key.German: Jetzt zu weiteren Neuigkeiten ...
Key.English: Now, in news elsewhere...
Key.Portuguese: Agora, as notícias de outras regiões...
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在播报其他地方的新闻...
Key.Japanese: さて、次のニュースです...
Key.Turkish: Şimdi, başka bir kaynaktan gelen haberler...

Container.name: 013_ex_silo_destroyed_no_operation
Container.situation: boss informs player that the operation launching from cerebu is not happening, because the primary target has already been destroyed.

Key.Original: Hey, Képi.
Key.French: Hé, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Eh, Képi.
Key.Italian: Ehi, Képi.
Key.German: Hey, Képi.
Key.English: Hey, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, Képi.
Key.Japanese: オイ、ケピ。

Key.Original: Forget about Cerebu. Our operation. It is a no-go now.
Key.Chinese: 別管什麼西盧布了，我們的任務取消了。
Key.French: Oublie Cerebu. L'opération est annulée.
Key.Spanish: Olvida lo de Cerebu. La operación se ha ido a la mierda.
Key.Italian: Lascia stare Cerebu. La nostra operazione. Non è più il caso.
Key.Polish: Zapomnij o Cerebu. Naszej operacji. Odwołane.
Key.Russian: Забудь о Серебу. Наша операция отменяется.
Key.German: Vergiss Cerebu. Unsere Operation wurde abgebrochen.
Key.Czech: Zapomeň Cerebu. Naše operace se teď ruší.
Key.English: Forget about Cerebu. Our operation. It is a no-go now.
Key.Portuguese: Esqueça Cerebu. Nossa operação. Tá vetada agora.
Key.Chinesesimp: 别管塞热布了。我们的行动，现在不宜进行。
Key.Japanese: "セレブ" ノコトハ忘レロ。作戦ハ中止ダ。

Key.Original: Some paysans hit our target!
Key.Chinese: 有些農民攻擊了我們的目標！
Key.French: Des paysans ont déjà attaqué la cible !
Key.Spanish: ¡Unos paysans han ido a por nuestro objetivo!
Key.Italian: Alcuni paysans hanno colpito il nostro obiettivo!
Key.German: Irgendwelche paysans haben unser Ziel schon erwischt!
Key.Czech: Nějací paysans útočili na náš cíl!
Key.English: Some paysans hit our target!
Key.Portuguese: Alguns paysans acertaram nosso alvo!
Key.Chinesesimp: 一伙农民袭击了我们的目标！
Key.Japanese: ドッカノ "ペイゾン" ガ俺達ノ標的ヲ撃ッタンダ！

Key.Original: The revolution, seems it got a mind of its own, eh?
Key.Chinese: 看來這場革命現在有些失去控制了，是吧？
Key.French: La révolution prend son envol, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Parece que la revolución elige su propio camino, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: La rivoluzione sembra avere una coscienza propria, eh?
Key.Polish: Rewolucja rządzi się własnymi prawami, co?
Key.Russian: Похоже, что у революции есть свой разум.
Key.German: Die Revolution läuft ganz von alleine, was?
Key.Czech: Revoluce si žije vlastní život, co?
Key.English: The revolution, seems it got a mind of its own, eh?
Key.Portuguese: A revolução parece que tem mente própria, né?
Key.Korean: 진짜 혁명이 시작된 것 같군, 안그래?
Key.Chinesesimp: 革命，似乎不请自来了，是吧？
Key.Japanese: 革命ヲ自分ノ "タイミング" デ引キ起コスノハ意外ニ難シイモノダナ。
Key.Turkish: Devrim... Görünüşe bakılırsa kendi kafasına göre hareket ediyor, ne dersin?

Key.Original: Anyway, no matter. The job is done.
Key.Chinese: 不管了，反正目標還是達成了。
Key.French: En tout cas, le boulot est fait.
Key.Spanish: En fin, da igual. El trabajo está hecho.
Key.Italian: Ad ogni modo, non importa. Il lavoro è terminato.
Key.Polish: W każdym razie, nieważne. Sprawa załatwiona.
Key.German: Wie auch immer, der Job wurde erledigt.
Key.Czech: No to nevadí. Už je to hotový.
Key.English: Anyway, no matter. The job is done.
Key.Portuguese: Enfim, não importa. O trabalho tá feito.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不管怎样，没关系。事情搞定了。
Key.Japanese: トニカク、大シタコトジャナイ。標的ガ始末サレタノハ同ジダ。
Key.Turkish: Her neyse, önemli değil. Bu iş halloldu.

Key.Original: If you find guns, bring them to us. Equipment too. La lutte continue...
Key.Chinese: 如果你找到槍或裝備，把它們通通交給我們。鬥爭還在繼續…
Key.French: Si tu trouves des flingues, apporte-les. De l'équipement aussi. La lutte continue...
Key.Spanish: Si encuentras armas, tráenoslas. También nos vale equipamiento. La lutte continue...
Key.Italian: Se trovi delle armi, portacele. Lo stesso vale per l’equipaggiamento. La lutte continue...
Key.Polish: Jak znajdziesz broń, przynieś nam ją. Sprzęt też. La lutte trwa…
Key.Russian: Если найдешь оружие, неси его нам. Снаряжение тоже не помешает. Ля лют продолжается...
Key.German: Wenn du Waffen oder Ausrüstung findest, bring sie zu uns. La lutte continue ...
Key.Czech: Když najdeš zbraně, dones nám je. Taky vybavení. La lutte continue...
Key.English: If you find guns, bring them to us. Equipment too. La lutte continue...
Key.Portuguese: Se achar armas, traz pra gente. Equipamento também. La lutte continue...
Key.Korean: 총을 찾으면 우리에게 가져와라. 장비도 마찬가지다. 싸움은 계속된다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你找到枪支，就给我们送过来。装备也一样。斗争还在继续...
Key.Japanese: 銃ヲ見ツケタラ、俺達ノトコロニ持ッテコイ。"ラ・ルート" ハ続ク...
Key.Turkish: Silah bulursan bize getir. Ekipman da getir tabii. La lutte continue...

Container.name: 012_eve_reputation_plus_three_pos
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Heya, mon homme de main!
Key.French: Mon homme de main !
Key.Spanish: ¡Salut, mon homme de main!
Key.Italian: Ehilà, mon homme de main!
Key.German: Hey, mon homme de main!
Key.English: Heya, mon homme de main!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, mon homme de main!
Key.Japanese: ヤア、モン・オム・ドゥ・マン！

Key.Original: L'Ensemble want you to know, anything you need - you got it, eh?
Key.Chinese: L'Ensemble 想讓你知道，你要什麼，我們都能提供，知道了吧？
Key.French: L'Ensemble te fait savoir que tu peux avoir tout ce que tu veux, OK ?
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble quiere que sepas que, si necesitas algo, solo tienes que pedirlo, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ci tiene a farti sapere che tutto quello che ti serve è a tua disposizione, eh?
Key.Polish: L’Ensemble informuje cię, że dostaniesz wszystko, co chcesz, jasne?
Key.Russian: У Л'Енсабля есть все, что тебе нужно, понял?
Key.German: L'Ensemble will, dass du Folgendes weißt: Was immer du brauchst – du kriegst es, ok?
Key.Czech: L'Ensemble ti vzkazuje, že ať chceš cokoli, máš to mít.
Key.English: L'Ensemble want you to know, anything you need - you got it, eh?
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble tá aqui pro que der e vier. Precisar de algo, só falá, d'accord?
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会想让你知道，你需要什么，就能搞到什么，明白吗？
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" カラ一言言ワセテクレ。必要ナモノガアッタラ何デモ言ウンダ。分カッタカ？
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble ihtiyacın olan her şeyi alabileceğini bilmeni istiyor, tamam mı?

Key.Original: I make sure we do the lowest price.
Key.Chinese: 我會確保我們以最低的價格賣給你。
Key.French: Tu auras le meilleur prix.
Key.Spanish: Me aseguraré de que te ofrezcan los precios más bajos.
Key.Italian: Farò in modo di applicarti i prezzi più vantaggiosi.
Key.Polish: Dopilnuję, żeby było u nas najtaniej.
Key.Russian: Я проконтролирую, чтобы ты получил все по самой низкой цене.
Key.German: Ich kümmere mich darum, dass du die besten Preise bekommst.
Key.Czech: Zajistím, že u nás je nejlepší cena.
Key.English: I make sure we do the lowest price.
Key.Portuguese: Garanto que a gente faz o menor preço.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我保证我们能搞到最低价。
Key.Japanese: 値段ヲ目イッパイ下ゲテヤルカラナ。
Key.Turkish: En düşük fiyatı uyguladığımızdan emin olacağım.

Key.Original: You a rising star, Képi.
Key.French: T'es une vraie star, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Eres una estrella en alza, Képi.
Key.Italian: Sei un astro nascente, Képi.
Key.German: Dein Stern geht auf, Képi.
Key.English: You a rising star, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Você é a estrela em ascension, Képi.
Key.Japanese: オ前ハ希望ノ星ダ、ケピ。

Key.Original: And la victoire, it coming, very soon; we will remember such commitment to the cause! Au revoir.
Key.Chinese: 還有，勝利將至，很快啦。我們會記得你的奉獻！再見。
Key.French: Et la victoire sera à nous. On n'oublie pas ceux qui se battent pour la cause ! Au revoir.
Key.Spanish: La victoire llegará pronto y no olvidaremos tu compromiso con la causa. ¡Au revoir!
Key.Italian: E la victoire arriverà, molto presto. Ci ricorderemo della tua dedizione verso la causa! Au revoir.
Key.Polish: A la victoire nadchodzi, już wkrótce; zapamiętamy takie poświęcenie sprawie! Au revoir.
Key.Russian: Скоро нас ждет ля виктва; мы не забудем такую преданность нашему делу! О ревуа'р.
Key.German: Und la victoire steht schon bald bevor. Wir werden deine Bemühungen nicht vergessen. Au revoir.
Key.Czech: La victoire se blíží. Bude tu za chvíli. Budeme pamatovat, jak moc naší věci pomáháš. Au revoir.
Key.English: And la victoire, it coming, very soon; we will remember such commitment to the cause! Au revoir.
Key.Portuguese: E la victoire tá chegando logo, logo. Vamo lembrar da sua dedicação com a causa! Au revoir.
Key.Korean: 그리고 라 빅투와. 즉, 승리는 곧 우리 것이다. 네 노력은 절대 잊지 않을 것이다! 오 르부아르.
Key.Chinesesimp: 还有，胜利即将来临，不用多久了；我们会记住你的奉献！再见。
Key.Japanese: ソシテ、"ラ・ビクトア" ハモウ手ノ届クトコロニアル。オ前ノ貢献ブリヲ覚エテオコウ！オブワー。
Key.Turkish: Ve la victoire yaklaşıyor; yakında bizim olacak. Amacımız için bu kadar vefakar davranışlar sergileyen birini unutmayız! Au revoir.

Container.name: 011_eve_reputation_plus_two_pos
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Képi, I hear good things about you.
Key.French: Képi, on me dit du bien de toi.
Key.Spanish: Képi, me cuentan cosas muy buenas sobre ti.
Key.Italian: Képi, ho sentito ottime cose su di te.
Key.Polish: Képi, słyszę o tobie dużo dobrego.
Key.Russian: Кепи, о тебе много говорят хорошего.
Key.German: Képi, ich höre nur Gutes über dich.
Key.Czech: Képi, slyším o tobě samý dobrý věci.
Key.English: Képi, I hear good things about you.
Key.Portuguese: Képi, tô ouvindo coisas boas de você.
Key.Chinesesimp: Képi，我听到了你的光荣事迹了。
Key.Japanese: ケピ、オ前ハナカナカ良クヤッテルソウダナ。
Key.Turkish: Képi, senin hakkında iyi şeyler duydum.

Key.Original: Everyone know, you a proper guérillero. A real freedom fighter.
Key.Chinese: 大家都知道，你是個真正的游擊隊員，一名真正的自由戰士。
Key.French: Tout le monde dit que tu es un vrai guérillero. Un défenseur de la liberté.
Key.Spanish: Todos dicen que eres un guérillero como Dios manda, un auténtico luchador por la libertad.
Key.Italian: Tutti sanno che sei un vero guérillero. Un guerriero della libertà.
Key.Polish: Wszyscy wiedzą, że dobry z ciebie guérillero. Prawdziwy bojownik o wolność.
Key.Russian: Говорят, ты отличный партизан. Настоящий борец за свободу.
Key.German: Alle wissen, dass du ein wahrer guérillero bist. Ein echter Freiheitskämpfer.
Key.Czech: Každej ví, že jsi pořádný guérillero. Bojovník za svobodu.
Key.English: Everyone know, you a proper guérillero. A real freedom fighter.
Key.Portuguese: Todo mundo sabe que cê é bom guérillero. Um verdadeiro lutador da liberdade.
Key.Korean: 너는 이제 모두가 인정하는 게릴라야. 진정한 자유의 전사다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大家都认为，你是个名副其实的游击队员。一个真正的自由战士。
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ信頼デキル "ゲリラ" ダト皆ガ口ヲ揃エテ言ッテル。自由ノタメニ戦ウ本物ノ戦士ダ。
Key.Turkish: Herkes senin gerçek bir guérillero olduğunu biliyor. Gerçek bir özgürlük savaşçısısın sen.

Key.Original: I will see about a better price for you on guns, and médicament.
Key.Chinese: 我們會確保你在購買槍枝和藥物時能夠享有折扣。
Key.French: Tu auras un meilleur prix sur les armes et les médicaments.
Key.Spanish: Veré de conseguirte un precio mejor para tus armas y médicaments.
Key.Italian: Vedrò di farti un buon prezzo per armi e médicament.
Key.Polish: Postaram się, żebyś miał lepsze ceny na broń i médicament.
Key.Russian: Я постараюсь сделать тебе скидку на оружие и медикаменты.
Key.German: Ich werde mich um bessere Preise für unsere Waffen und médicament kümmern.
Key.Czech: Zařídím ti lepší ceny na naše zbraně a médicament.
Key.English: I will see about a better price for you on guns, and médicament.
Key.Portuguese: Vou ver um preço melhor para você em armas e médicament.
Key.Chinesesimp: 枪，还有药品，我都会给你争取个好价钱。
Key.Japanese: 銃ト "メディカモン" ヲモットイイ値デ買エルヨウニ話ヲツケテヤル。
Key.Turkish: Silahlar ve médicament için daha iyi bir fiyat almanı sağlayacağım.

Key.Original: And any place you want to stay, eh?
Key.Chinese: 你想找個地方落腳，對吧？
Key.French: Et sur ton loyer aussi, d'accord ?
Key.Spanish: Y también para tus alojamientos, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: In qualsiasi posto ti troverai.
Key.Polish: I wszędzie tam, gdzie będziesz się chciał zatrzymać.
Key.German: Und um einen Unterschlupf für dich, alles klar?
Key.Czech: A kdykoli budeš potřebovat střechu nad hlavou, jo?
Key.English: And any place you want to stay, eh?
Key.Portuguese: E algum lugar que cê queira ficar, ok?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你想有个地方落脚吗，嗯？
Key.Japanese: ソレカラ宿泊先ノ値段モナ。
Key.Turkish: Konaklamak istediğin herhangi bir yer var mı peki?

Key.Original: Just continuer, vive la révolution.
Key.French: Continue. Vive la révolution.
Key.Spanish: Sigue así. ¡Vive la révolution!
Key.Italian: Pensa solo a continuer, vive la révolution.
Key.Polish: Oby tak dalej, vive la révolution.
Key.Russian: Продолжай в том же духе, вив ля революсьон.
Key.German: Juste continuer, vive la révolution.
Key.English: Just continuer, vive la révolution.
Key.Portuguese: Apenas continuez, vive la révolution.
Key.Japanese: ソノママ "コンティニュエ"、ビブ・ラ・レボルシオン。

Container.name: 010_eve_reputation_plus_one_pos
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Salut. It is Samjo.
Key.French: Salut, c'est Samjo.
Key.Spanish: Salut. Soy Samjo.
Key.Italian: Salut. Qui è Samjo.
Key.German: Salut, hier ist Samjo.
Key.English: Salut. It is Samjo.
Key.Portuguese: Salut. Aqui é o Samjo.
Key.Japanese: サリュー。"サムジョ" ダ。

Key.Original: So - you do well, I hear.
Key.French: Tu t'en sors bien, on m'a dit.
Key.Spanish: Así que... dicen que te va bien.
Key.Italian: Quindi... ho sentito che te la stai cavando bene.
Key.German: Ich hab gehört, dass du dich gut schlägst.
Key.English: So - you do well, I hear.
Key.Portuguese: Então, você foi bem, pelo que ouvi.
Key.Chinesesimp: 嗯 - 听说你干得不错。
Key.Japanese: イイ仕事ヲシテルト聞イテル。

Key.Original: L'Ensemble, it arrange special price for you, on black market.
Key.Chinese: L'Ensemble 會在黑市上為你安排個特殊的折扣。
Key.French: Avec l'Ensemble, tu as un meilleur prix sur le marché noir.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble te conseguirá un precio especial en el mercado negro.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ti farà un prezzo di favore al mercato nero.
Key.Polish: L’Ensemble załatwi ci specjalną cenę na czarnym rynku.
Key.Russian: Л'Енсабль сделает тебе специальную скидку на черном рынке.
Key.German: L'Ensemble hat dir ein paar Sonderangebote auf dem Schwarzmarkt beschafft.
Key.Czech: L'Ensemble ti zařizuje speciální cenu na černým trhu.
Key.English: L'Ensemble, it arrange special price for you, on black market.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble consegue preço especial pra você no mercado negro.
Key.Korean: ‘앙상블’이 암시장에서 너에게 특별 가격을 제시할 것이다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会会帮你在黑市上搞定优惠价格。
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ガオ前ノタメニ闇市場ノ値段ヲ調整シテヤッタ。
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble, kara borsada senin için özel bir fiyat ayarladı.

Key.Original: Make sure you afford what you need. Talk again soon, mon ami.
Key.Chinese: 記得帶夠錢。我們晚點再聊，我的朋友。
Key.French: Achète-toi ce qu'il te faut. On se rappelle, mon ami.
Key.Spanish: Asegúrate de poder pagar lo que necesitas. Ya hablaremos, mon ami.
Key.Italian: In modo che ti possa permettere quello che ti serve. A presto, mon ami.
Key.Polish: Upewnij się, że stać cię na zakup. Usłyszymy się niedługo, mon ami.
Key.Russian: Чтобы ты мог купить все, что тебе нужно. До скорого, мон ами.
Key.German: Du sollst alles kriegen, was du brauchst. Wir hören uns, mon ami.
Key.Czech: Ať si můžeš dovolit, co potřebuješ. Brzo se zas uslyšíme, mon ami.
Key.English: Make sure you afford what you need. Talk again soon, mon ami.
Key.Portuguese: Trate de pegar o que precisa. Logo a gente se fala, mon ami.
Key.Korean: 필요한 걸 살 수 있게 돈을 준비해놔라. 조만간 연락하겠다, 모나미.
Key.Chinesesimp: 记得带够钱。回头再聊，我的朋友。
Key.Japanese: 必要ナモノヲ買ッテオケ。ソレジャ、マタナ、モン・アミ。
Key.Turkish: İhtiyacın olan şeyler için yeterli paran olsun. Yakında tekrar konuşuruz, mon ami.

Container.name: 009_eve_reputation_zero_pos
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Bonjour, Képi.
Key.French: Bonjour, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Bonjour, Képi.
Key.Italian: Bonjour, Képi.
Key.German: Bonjour, Képi.
Key.English: Bonjour, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Bonjour, Képi.
Key.Japanese: ボンジュール、ケピ。

Key.Original: You make good impression out there.
Key.Chinese: 你給大家留了一個好印象。
Key.French: Tu as fait bonne impression.
Key.Spanish: Has causado buena impresión por ahí.
Key.Italian: Ci hai fatto una buona impressione.
Key.German: Du hast einen guten Eindruck hinterlassen.
Key.English: You make good impression out there.
Key.Portuguese: Cê causou boa impressão em campo.
Key.Japanese: イイ仕事ヲシテルヨウダナ。

Key.Original: Lot of talk, eh?
Key.Chinese: 大家都在談論你做的事呢。
Key.French: On parle pas mal de toi.
Key.Spanish: Se habla mucho, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Troppe parole, eh?
Key.German: Es wird viel über dich geredet.
Key.English: Lot of talk, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Muito comentário, sabe?
Key.Japanese: イロイロ聞イテルゾ。

Key.Original: I guess I still got eye for talent.
Key.French: Je sais reconnaître les pros.
Key.Spanish: Supongo que sigo teniendo buen ojo para el talento.
Key.Italian: Penso di avere ancora occhio per il talento.
Key.Russian: Видимо, у меня глаз наметан на толковых ребят.
Key.German: Schätze, ich habe ein Auge für Talent.
Key.Czech: Zdá se, že pořád umím poznat talenta.
Key.English: I guess I still got eye for talent.
Key.Portuguese: Acho que ainda tenho olho pra talento.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我觉得我还是挺能识才的。
Key.Japanese: 俺ノ目ハヤハリ節穴ジャナカッタ。

Key.Original: You welcome to fight beside us now.
Key.Chinese: 歡迎和我們一起並肩作戰。
Key.French: Tu as ta place à nos côtés.
Key.Spanish: Estaremos encantados de que luches con nosotros.
Key.Italian: Sei il benvenuto se vuoi combattere al nostro fianco.
Key.Polish: Możesz teraz walczyć u naszego boku.
Key.Russian: Ты можешь сражаться вместе с нами.
Key.German: Ab jetzt kannst du an unserer Seite kämpfen.
Key.Czech: Budeme rádi, když teď bojuješ na naší straně.
Key.English: You welcome to fight beside us now.
Key.Portuguese: Cê é bem-vindo pra lutar junto da gente agora.
Key.Korean: 이제 넌 우리와 함께 싸워도 좋다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在，欢迎你和我们并肩作战。
Key.Japanese: 俺達ト一緒ニ戦ッテイイ。歓迎スル。

Container.name: 008_eve_reputation_minus_one_pos
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Képi. L'Ensemble okay with you now.
Key.Chinese: Képi，L'Ensemble 現在對你感覺不錯。
Key.French: Képi. L'Ensemble t'a accepté.
Key.Spanish: Képi. L'Ensemble está en paz contigo.
Key.Italian: Képi. L’Ensemble non ha più problemi con te adesso.
Key.Polish: Képi. L’Ensemble nic już do ciebie nie ma.
Key.German: Képi, L'Ensemble hat dich akzeptiert.
Key.Czech: Képi. Pro L'Ensemble už jsi v pohodě.
Key.English: Képi. L'Ensemble okay with you now.
Key.Portuguese: Képi. L'Ensemble tá de boa com você agora.
Key.Chinesesimp: Képi。现在大帮会对你很满意。
Key.Japanese: ケピ。"ランサンブル" ハ、今ノトコロハオ前ヲ受ケ入レテヤル。
Key.Turkish: Képi. L'Ensemble artık sana onayı verdi.

Key.Original: But we not gonna do you any favors.
Key.French: Mais pas de traitement spécial.
Key.Spanish: Pero no te vamos a hacer ningún favor.
Key.Italian: Ma non ti faremo nessun favore.
Key.Russian: Но мы не будем делать тебе поблажек.
Key.German: Aber wir werden dir keine Gefallen tun.
Key.English: But we not gonna do you any favors.
Key.Portuguese: Mas não vamo te fazer favor nenhum.
Key.Korean: 하지만 그렇다고 해서 봐주는 건 없다.
Key.Japanese: ダガ、頼ミ事ハシテヤラナイゾ。
Key.Turkish: Fakat sana herhangi bir iyilikte bulunmayacağız.

Key.Original: You want respect... earn it. Salut.
Key.Chinese: 你若要我們的尊重…就得努力去贏得尊重。Salut。
Key.French: Notre respect, tu dois le gagner. Salut.
Key.Spanish: Si quieres respeto... gánatelo. Salut.
Key.Italian: Se vuoi rispetto... guadagnatelo. Salut.
Key.Polish: Chcesz szacunku… zapracuj na niego. Salut.
Key.German: Wenn du unseren Respekt willst, musst du ihn dir verdienen. Salut.
Key.English: You want respect... earn it. Salut.
Key.Portuguese: Quer respeito... Então conquiste. Salut.
Key.Korean: 존경받고 싶으면... 그에 걸맞는 일을 해라. 셀루.
Key.Chinesesimp: 想让人服你...就得付出代价。Salut。
Key.Japanese: 尊敬シテホシイナラ... 尊敬デキルコトヲヤルンダ。サリュー。

Container.name: 007_eve_reputation_minus_two_pos
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Képi blanc...
Key.French: Képi blanc...
Key.Spanish: Képi blanc...
Key.Italian: Képi blanc...
Key.German: Képi Blanc ...
Key.English: Képi blanc...
Key.Portuguese: Képi blanc...
Key.Japanese: ケピ・ブロン...

Key.Original: I hear you do good.
Key.French: Tu as bien travaillé.
Key.Spanish: Dicen que has hecho un buen trabajo.
Key.Italian: Ho sentito dire che te la stai cavando bene.
Key.German: Du schlägst dich gut.
Key.English: I hear you do good.
Key.Portuguese: Soube que cê se saiu bem.
Key.Japanese: イイ働キヲシタソウジャナイカ。

Key.Original: But make no mistake, we don't trust you. Still...
Key.Chinese: 不過別搞錯了，我們還不相信你…
Key.French: Mais attention, on n'a pas encore confiance. Enfin...
Key.Spanish: No te equivoques, no confiamos en ti. Pero...
Key.Italian: Ma non commettere errori, non ci fidiamo di te. Non ancora...
Key.Polish: Nie łudź się tylko. Nie ufamy ci. Ale…
Key.Russian: Но не думай, что мы тебе доверяем. Как бы там ни было...
Key.German: Aber wir trauen dir noch nicht ...
Key.Czech: Ale nemysli špatně, pořád ti nevěříme. Zatím.
Key.English: But make no mistake, we don't trust you. Still...
Key.Portuguese: Mas não se engane, não confiamos em você. Ainda...
Key.Korean: 하지만 착각하지 마라. 우린 널 신뢰하는 것이 아니다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 但别误会，我们并不信任你。不过嘛...
Key.Japanese: ダガ、勘違イスルナ。オ前ノコトヲ信用シタワケジャナイ。マダナ...
Key.Turkish: Sakın hata yapayım deme; sana güvenmiyoruz. Henüz...

Key.Original: Keep up the good work.
Key.French: Continue comme ça.
Key.Spanish: Sigue haciendo un buen trabajo.
Key.Italian: Continua così.
Key.German: Weiter so.
Key.English: Keep up the good work.
Key.Portuguese: Continue com o bom desempenho.
Key.Japanese: ソノ調子デ頑張ルンダゾ。

Key.Original: Maybe you make it through this, eh?
Key.French: Et peut-être que tu t'en tireras, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Igual acabas saliendo de esta, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Forse ce la farai, eh?
Key.Russian: Кто знает, может сможешь выбраться из этой передряги?
Key.German: Vielleicht überlebst du das Ganze ja doch ...
Key.English: Maybe you make it through this, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Talvez cê consiga superar isso, não?
Key.Korean: 그럼 이 일을 마무리지을 수 있을지도 모른다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 也许你能熬过这个难关，嗯？
Key.Japanese: ソシタラ、生キテ帰レルカモナ。

Container.name: 006_eve_reputation_plus_two_neg
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Képi. Listen.
Key.French: Képi. Écoute.
Key.Spanish: Képi. Mira.
Key.Italian: Képi. Ascolta.
Key.German: Képi, hör zu.
Key.English: Képi. Listen.
Key.Portuguese: Képi. Na escuta.
Key.Japanese: ケピ。ヨク聞ケ。

Key.Original: If you want our help out there, you gonna have to earn respect.
Key.Chinese: 如果你在外頭需要協助，你得先贏得我們的尊重。
Key.French: Pour qu'on t'aide, tu dois obtenir notre respect.
Key.Spanish: Si quieres que te ayudemos, vas a tener que ganarte nuestro respeto.
Key.Italian: Se vuoi il nostro aiuto, dovrai guadagnarti rispetto.
Key.Polish: Jeśli mamy ci pomóc, musisz zasłużyć na nasz szacunek.
Key.Russian: Если хочешь, чтобы мы тебе помогли, тебе придется заработать уважение.
Key.German: Wenn du unsere Hilfe willst, musst du dir unseren Respekt verdienen.
Key.Czech: Jestli od nás chceš pomoct, musíš si udělat respekt.
Key.English: If you want our help out there, you gonna have to earn respect.
Key.Portuguese: Se quer nossa ajuda, cê vai ter que ganhar respeito.
Key.Korean: 우리의 도움을 받고 싶다면 우리의 신임을 받아야 한다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 想得到我们的帮助，就得让人服你。
Key.Japanese: 俺達ニ協力シテホシイナラ、尊敬サレル存在ジャナイトダメダ。
Key.Turkish: Sana yardım etmemizi istiyorsan saygı kazanmak zorundasın.

Key.Original: My men won't follow some solitaire.
Key.Chinese: 我的人可不會追隨只會單打獨鬥的人。
Key.French: Mes hommes ne suivent pas les solitaires.
Key.Spanish: Mis hombres no van a seguir a un solitaire.
Key.Italian: I miei uomini non seguiranno un solitaire qualunque.
Key.Polish: Moi ludzie nie pójdą za jakimś solitaire.
Key.Russian: Мои люди не пойдут за волком-одиночкой.
Key.German: Meine Männer werden keinem solitaire folgen.
Key.English: My men won't follow some solitaire.
Key.Portuguese: Meus homens não seguem un solitaire.
Key.Korean: 내 부하들은 혼자 노는 놈은 따르지 않는다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我的人可不会追随那种独来独往的家伙。
Key.Japanese: 俺ノ兵士ハ、ドコゾノ一匹狼ニハ従ワナイゾ。
Key.Turkish: Adamlarım bir gösteriş budalasının peşinden gitmez.

Key.Original: Money talk...
Key.French: L'argent parle.
Key.Spanish: El dinero habla...
Key.Italian: I soldi contano...
Key.German: Geld ist wichtig ...
Key.English: Money talk...
Key.Portuguese: Dinheiro ajuda...
Key.Japanese: 金ノ話デモアルガ...

Key.Original: But dedication to our cause?
Key.Chinese: 但是，對我們目標的堅持？
Key.French: Mais se dévouer à la cause...
Key.Spanish: Pero la dedicación a nuestra causa...
Key.Italian: Ma la dedizione alla nostra causa...
Key.German: Aber die Hingabe zu unserem Ziel?
Key.English: But dedication to our cause?
Key.Portuguese: Mas dedicação com nossa causa?
Key.Chinesesimp: 可也要认真对待我们的事业吧？
Key.Japanese: 俺達ノ活動ヘノ献身サヲ見セロ。

Key.Original: That talk a lot louder. Think about it, eh? Salut.
Key.Chinese: 那可比錢更有說服力。你好好想想吧？Salut。
Key.French: Ça parle plus fort. Tu y réfléchiras, hein ? Salut.
Key.Spanish: Habla mucho más alto. Piénsatelo, ¿eh? Salut.
Key.Italian: Quella conta molto di più. Pensaci su, eh? Salut.
Key.Polish: To argument silniejszy. Przemyślisz to? Salut.
Key.Russian: Это совсем другой разговор. Подумай над этим, хорошо? Салют.
Key.German: Die ist noch wichtiger. Denk drüber nach, ok? Salut.
Key.Czech: Ta se počítá ještě víc. Projdi si to hlavou, jo? Salut.
Key.English: That talk a lot louder. Think about it, eh? Salut.
Key.Portuguese: Ajuda muito mais. Pense nisso, ok? Salut.
Key.Korean: 돈보다도 중요한 건 바로 그거다. 잘 생각해라. 셀루.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这个更重要。好好想想吧，嗯？Salut。
Key.Japanese: ソノ方ガ認メラレヤスイ。考エトケヨ。サリュー。
Key.Turkish: O daha da sesli konuşur. Bunu bir düşün, olur mu? Salut.

Container.name: 005_eve_reputation_plus_one_neg
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Hey. Samjo here.
Key.French: Hé, c'est Samjo.
Key.Spanish: Hola. Aquí Samjo.
Key.Italian: Ehi. Parla Samjo.
Key.German: Hey, Samjo hier.
Key.English: Hey. Samjo here.
Key.Portuguese: Ei. Samjo aqui.
Key.Japanese: オイ。"サムジョ" ダ。

Key.Original: L'Ensemble - it not sure about you. People talking.
Key.Chinese: L'Ensemble 對你還抱有些疑心，很多人在說閒話。
Key.French: L'Ensemble a des doutes sur toi. Les gens parlent.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble no tiene claro de qué vas. La gente habla.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ha dei dubbi su di te. La gente mormora.
Key.Polish: L’Ensemble ma wobec ciebie wątpliwości. Ludzie gadają.
Key.Russian: Л'Енсабль не уверен насчет тебя. Люди всякое поговаривают.
Key.German: L'Ensemble ist sich bei dir nicht sicher. Die Leute reden über dich.
Key.Czech: L'Ensemble neví, co s tebou. Něco se mezi lidma říká.
Key.English: L'Ensemble - it not sure about you. People talking.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble não tem certeza sobre você. O povo anda comentando.
Key.Korean: ‘앙상블’은 너에 대한 확신이 없다. 다들 수군거리고 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会 - 对你不放心。大家都在议论。
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ハオ前ニ不信感ヲ抱イテル。噂ガ聞コエテキテル。
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble senden pek emin değil. İnsanlar konuşuyor.

Key.Original: Bad rumor on you... tu me suis ?
Key.Chinese: 有很多關於你的負面傳聞…你要跟著我嗎？
Key.French: Des rumeurs sur toi. Tu me suis ?
Key.Spanish: Corren rumores malos sobre ti... Tu me suis ?
Key.Italian: Girano brutte voci sul tuo conto... tu me suis ?
Key.Polish: Są o tobie złe plotki… tu me suis ?
Key.Russian: Плохие слухи о тебе... мэ сью вэву?
Key.German: Es gibt Gerüchte ... tu me suis?
Key.Czech: Jdou o tobě špatný drby. Tu me suis ?
Key.English: Bad rumor on you... tu me suis ?
Key.Portuguese: Rumores ruins sobre você... Tu me suis ?
Key.Korean: 너에게 아주 안 좋은 소문들이지... 메 쉬베 부?
Key.Chinesesimp: 有人说你坏话了...tu me suis？
Key.Japanese: オ前ニ関スル悪イ噂ダ... ム・シューヴェ・ヴー？
Key.Turkish: Seninle ilgili kötü söylentiler var... Tu me suis ?

Key.Original: Remember, we need to work together.
Key.Chinese: 記得了，我們必須一起合作。
Key.French: N'oublie pas. On travaille ensemble.
Key.Spanish: Recuerda que tenemos que trabajar juntos.
Key.Italian: Ricorda. Dobbiamo collaborare.
Key.German: Vergiss nicht, wir müssen zusammenarbeiten.
Key.English: Remember, we need to work together.
Key.Portuguese: Lembra, a gente tem que trabalhar junto.
Key.Korean: 기억해. 우린 서로 힘을 모아야 된다.
Key.Japanese: 忘レルナ。俺達ハ協力シナイトダメダッテコトヲナ。

Container.name: 004_eve_reputation_zero_neg
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Hey. It is Samjo.
Key.French: Hé, ici Samjo.
Key.Spanish: Hola. Soy Samjo.
Key.Italian: Ehi. Qui è Samjo.
Key.German: Hey, hier ist Samjo.
Key.English: Hey. It is Samjo.
Key.Portuguese: Ei. Aqui é o Samjo.
Key.Japanese: オイ。"サムジョ" ダ。

Key.Original: Look, I know you with us now, but I got word - you let us down.
Key.Chinese: 聽好了，我知道你現在跟我們在同一個陣營，不過我聽說，你讓我們很失望。
Key.French: Écoute, je sais que tu es avec nous, mais tu as déconné.
Key.Spanish: Mira, sé que ahora estás con nosotros, pero dicen que... nos has fallado.
Key.Italian: Ascolta, so che ora sei con noi, ma mi sono arrivate delle voci. Ci hai delusi.
Key.Polish: Wiem, że jesteś teraz z nami, ale przyszły wieści – zawiodłeś nas.
Key.Russian: Я знаю, что ты с нами, но мне сообщили, что ты нас подвел.
Key.German: Ich weiß, dass du jetzt zu uns gehörst, aber man hat mir erzählt, dass du uns enttäuscht hast.
Key.Czech: Vím, že teď jsi s náma, ale něco slyším. Prej nám děláš zklamání.
Key.English: Look, I know you with us now, but I got word - you let us down.
Key.Portuguese: Olha, sei que cê tá com a gente agora, mas soube que cê deu mole.
Key.Korean: 네가 우리 편인 것은 알지만, 네가 우릴 실망시켰다는 보고를 받았다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 喂，我知道你现在站在我们这边，可我听说 - 你没把事办好。
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ俺達ノ仲間ニナッタノハ分カル。ダガ、連絡ガ入ッタンダ。オ前、"ヘマ" シタナ。
Key.Turkish: Bak, şu an bizimle olduğunu biliyorum ama öğrendiğime göre bizi yüzüstü bırakmışsın.

Key.Original: Don't fail again.
Key.French: N'échoue plus.
Key.Spanish: Que no vuelva a ocurrir.
Key.Italian: Non fallire di nuovo.
Key.German: Versage nicht noch einmal.
Key.English: Don't fail again.
Key.Portuguese: Não falha de novo.
Key.Japanese: 二度ト失敗スルナ。

Container.name: 003_eve_reputation_minus_one_neg
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Képi. This no good.
Key.French: Képi. Ça ne va pas.
Key.Spanish: Képi. Muy mal.
Key.Italian: Képi. Così non va.
Key.German: Képi, das ist nicht gut.
Key.English: Képi. This no good.
Key.Portuguese: Képi. Isso não é bom.
Key.Japanese: ケピ。問題発生ダ。

Key.Original: Your action, it upset L'Ensemble.
Key.French: Tes actions gênent l'Ensemble.
Key.Spanish: Tu acción ha molestado a L'Ensemble.
Key.Italian: Le tue azioni hanno infastidito L’Ensemble.
Key.Russian: Л'Енсабль не в восторге от твоих действий.
Key.German: Du hast L'Ensemble ganz schön wütend gemacht.
Key.English: Your action, it upset L'Ensemble.
Key.Portuguese: Sua ação perturbou L'Ensemble.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的所做所为，让大帮会很不爽。
Key.Japanese: オ前ノヤッタコトニ "ランサンブル" ハ怒ッテル。

Key.Original: Tread careful. Don't piss us off...
Key.French: Fais attention. Ne nous cherche pas...
Key.Spanish: Ve con cuidado. No nos toques los cojones...
Key.Italian: Occhio. Non farci incazzare...
Key.German: Pass auf dich auf und leg dich nicht mit uns an ...
Key.English: Tread careful. Don't piss us off...
Key.Portuguese: Ande com cuidado. Não nos irrite...
Key.Korean: 조심해라. 절대 우릴 화나게 하지 마라...
Key.Japanese: 背後ニ気ヲ付ケルンダナ。俺達ヲ怒ラセルナ...

Container.name: 002_eve_reputation_minus_two_neg
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Hey. Képi...
Key.French: Hé, Képi...
Key.Spanish: Eh, Képi...
Key.Italian: Ehi, Képi...
Key.German: Hey, Képi ...
Key.English: Hey. Képi...
Key.Portuguese: Ei. Képi...
Key.Japanese: オイ。ケピ...

Key.Original: C'est quoi, ce bordel ?
Key.French: C'est quoi, ce bordel ?
Key.Spanish: Pero ¿qué coño...?
Key.Italian: Cos’è questo bordello?
Key.German: Was zum Teufel ...
Key.English: What the fuck?
Key.Portuguese: Que porra é essa?
Key.Japanese: 何シテクレタンダ？

Key.Original: You mess up, bad.
Key.French: Tu as déconné.
Key.Spanish: La has cagado. Fatal.
Key.Italian: L’hai fatta grossa, molto grossa.
Key.German: Du hast ganz schon Scheiße gebaut.
Key.English: You mess up, bad.
Key.Portuguese: Você ferrou mesmo.
Key.Japanese: カナリノシクジリダ。

Key.Original: L'Ensemble got eye on you. Best you make good, eh?
Key.Chinese: L'Ensemble 正盯著你，你好好幹，知道吧？
Key.French: L'Ensemble t'a à l'œil. Tu vas te rattraper, hein ?
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble no te quita ojo. Mejor que lo hagas bien, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ti tiene d’occhio. Vedi di rigare dritto, eh?
Key.Polish: L’Ensemble ma na ciebie oko. Będziesz grzeczny?
Key.Russian: Л'Енсабль следит за тобой. Больше никаких косяков, понял?
Key.German: L‘Ensemble hat dich im Auge. Du solltest es wiedergutmachen.
Key.Czech: L'Ensemble si tě teď hlídá. Radši buď hodnej, jo?
Key.English: L'Ensemble got eye on you. Best you make good, eh?
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble tá de olho em você. Melhor se esforçar, hein?
Key.Korean: ‘앙상블’이 널 지켜보고 있다. 만회하는 것이 좋을 거다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会盯着你呢。你最好把事办妥，明白？
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ガオ前ヲ監視シテルカラナ。償ッテモラウゾ。
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble’nin gözü üzerinde. İyi iş çıkarsan iyi edersin!

Key.Original: Au revoir.
Key.French: Au revoir.
Key.Spanish: Adiós.
Key.Italian: Arrivederci.
Key.German: Tschüss.
Key.English: Goodbye.
Key.Portuguese: Adeus.
Key.Japanese: ジャアナ。

Container.name: 001_eve_reputation_minus_three_neg
Container.situation: boss contacts player to inform them of a change in their relationship status.

Key.Original: Képi? It is Samjo.
Key.French: Képi ? Ici Samjo.
Key.Spanish: Képi? Soy Samjo.
Key.Italian: Képi? Qui è Samjo.
Key.German: Képi? Hier ist Samjo.
Key.English: Képi? It is Samjo.
Key.Portuguese: Képi? É o Samjo.
Key.Japanese: ケピ？"サムジョ" ダ。

Key.Original: You become a problem, I think.
Key.Chinese: 我看你現在成了個問題。
Key.French: Tu poses problème, on dirait.
Key.Spanish: Creo que te has convertido en un problema.
Key.Italian: Credo che tu sia diventato un problema.
Key.Russian: Кажется, ты стал для нас проблемой.
Key.German: Ich glaube, du wirst langsam zum Problem.
Key.English: You become a problem, I think.
Key.Portuguese: Você virou um problema, eu acho.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我想，你是成了个棘手的麻烦。
Key.Japanese: オ前ハ問題ニナリソウダ。

Key.Original: Time you decide what side you on...
Key.French: Il est temps de choisir ton camp.
Key.Spanish: Te toca decidir de qué lado estás...
Key.Italian: È ora che tu decida da che parte stare...
Key.Russian: Пора решить, на чьей ты стороне...
Key.German: Entscheide dich, auf welcher Seite du stehst ...
Key.Czech: Teď je čas rozhodnout se, na čí jsi straně.
Key.English: Time you decide what side you on...
Key.Portuguese: Hora de decidir de que lado cê tá...
Key.Chinesesimp: 你该决定站在哪一边了...
Key.Japanese: ドッチ側ニ付クカ決メルンダ...
Key.Turkish: Hangi tarafta olduğuna karar verme zamanı...

Key.Original: I not warn you again.
Key.French: C'est le dernier avertissement.
Key.Spanish: No te lo volveré a advertir.
Key.Italian: Questo è l’ultimo avvertimento.
Key.Russian: Я два раза предупреждать не буду.
Key.German: Das ist meine letzte Warnung.
Key.English: I not warn you again.
Key.Portuguese: Não vô dizer de novo.
Key.Japanese: 二度モ警告シテヤランゾ。

Container.name: 029_am_landing_on_airstrip
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about l'ensemble smuggling guns.

Key.Original: I got a friend, right.
Key.French: J'ai un pote, tu sais.
Key.Spanish: Un amigo me ha contado una cosa.
Key.Italian: Sai, ho un amico.
Key.Russian: Есть у меня, короче, один друг.
Key.German: Also, ich habe einen Freund.
Key.English: I got a friend, right.
Key.Portuguese: Tenho um amigo.
Key.Japanese: 友人ガイルンダ。

Key.Original: He works nights, at the Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Chinese: 他在塔諾雅製糖公司上晚班。
Key.French: Il bosse de nuit à la Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Spanish: Hace el turno de noche en la Compañía Azucarera de Tanoa.
Key.Italian: Fa i turni di notte alla Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Polish: Robi nocki w Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Russian: Он работает в ночную смену на сахарном заводе на Таноа.
Key.German: Er macht die Nachtschicht bei der Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Czech: Dělá noční směny v Tanoa Sugar Company
Key.English: He works nights, at the Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Portuguese: Trabalha à noite, na Companhia de Açúcar Tanoana.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他上晚班，就在塔诺亚糖业公司上班。
Key.Japanese: Tanoa Sugar Company デ夜間働イテル。

Key.Original: He's out having a cigarette, when a small plane flies over.
Key.Chinese: 他出去抽根煙的時候，看見了頭頂上有架小飛機飛過去。
Key.French: Il fumait sa clope, et un petit avion est passé au-dessus de lui.
Key.Spanish: Estaba fuera echándose un piti cuando, de repente, pasa una avioneta.
Key.Italian: Era uscito a fumarsi una sigaretta e ha visto un piccolo aereo volargli sopra...
Key.Polish: Wychodzi zapalić, a tu zbliża się mały samolot.
Key.Russian: Короче говоря, стоит он как-то, курит, как вдруг у него над головой пролетает небольшой самолет.
Key.German: Während seiner Raucherpause sieht er, wie ein kleines Flugzeug über ihn hinwegfliegt.
Key.Czech: Jednou si takhle vyjde ven na cigáro a najednou kolem proletí malý letadlo.
Key.English: He's out having a cigarette, when a small plane flies over.
Key.Portuguese: Tinha saído pra fumar um cigarro quando, de repente, surgiu um aviãozinho.
Key.Korean: 하루는 밖에서 담배를 피우고 있는데 소형 비행기가 날아오더래.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他出去抽烟时，看到一架小型飞机在上空飞过。
Key.Japanese: 休憩中ニ外デ煙草ヲ吸ッテタラ、小サナ飛行機ガ頭上ヲ飛ンデッタ。
Key.Turkish: Bir sigara yakmak için dışarı çıktığında küçük bir uçağın geçtiğini görüyor.

Key.Original: And it lands on a field. No runway. No nothing.
Key.Chinese: 飛機落在一片空地上，那裡連個跑道也沒有。
Key.French: Il a atterri dans un champ, sans piste d'atterrissage.
Key.Spanish: Y va y aterriza en un campo. Ni pista ni leches.
Key.Italian: E poi atterrare in mezzo a un campo. Senza pista di atterraggio. Niente di niente.
Key.Polish: Ląduje w szczerym polu. Kompletnie nic tam nie ma.
Key.Russian: Самолет садится прямо на поле. Без посадочной полосы. Без ничего.
Key.German: Dann landet es auf einem Feld. Ganz ohne Landebahn.
Key.Czech: A přistane na poli. Nikde žádná ranvej, nic.
Key.English: And it lands on a field. No runway. No nothing.
Key.Portuguese: E daí pousou em um campo. Sem pista. Sem nada.
Key.Korean: 그러더니 공터에 착륙했다는 거야. 활주로고 뭐고 아무것도 없는데 말이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 飞机降落在田野里。没有跑道。什么都没有。
Key.Japanese: 野原ニ着陸シタラシイ。滑走路モ何モナイトコロデナ。
Key.Turkish: Ve uçak bir tarlaya iniyor. Pist yok. Hiçbir şey yok.

Key.Original: Next thing he knows, gendarmes have arrived and everybody's shooting at each other...
Key.Chinese: 然後，國家憲兵出現，大家開始朝彼此開槍。
Key.French: Là, t'as les gendarmes qui débarquent, et ils commencent à se tirer dessus...
Key.Spanish: Al poco, aparecen unos gendarmes y todos se lían a tiros con todos...
Key.Italian: Neanche un attimo dopo sono arrivati i gendarmi e tutti hanno cominciato a spararsi addosso...
Key.Polish: A za chwilę zjawiają się żandarmi i wszyscy do siebie strzelają…
Key.Russian: Сразу прибыли жандармы, все орут друг на друга...
Key.German: Kurz darauf stehen die Gendarmes vor der Tür und ein Feuergefecht bricht aus ...
Key.Czech: Než se stihne rozkoukat, dorazí na místo četníci a najednou po sobě všichni střílejí.
Key.English: Next thing he knows, gendarmes have arrived and everybody's shooting at each other...
Key.Portuguese: Logo em seguida, os gendarmes chegaram, daí tá todo mundo tava atirando uns nos outros...
Key.Korean: 잠시 후 헌병특공대가 도착해서 서로에게 총을 쏴대고 난리도 아니었나봐...
Key.Chinesesimp: 接下来，宪兵队来了，双方都在胡乱朝着对方开枪...
Key.Japanese: 次ノ瞬間、憲兵ガ到着シテ、全員ガ撃チ合イヲ始メタ...
Key.Turkish: Sonra öğrendiği, jandarmaların geldiği ve herkesin birbirine ateş ettiği...

Key.Original: And this plane, it takes-off again!
Key.Chinese: 結果，這架飛機卻在此時飛走了！
Key.French: Et là, l'avion redécolle !
Key.Spanish: ¡Y la avioneta vuelve a despegar!
Key.Italian: E questo aereo ha ripreso il volo!
Key.Russian: А самолет берет и снова взлетает!
Key.German: Und dann hebt dieses Flugzeug wieder ab!
Key.Czech: A to letadlo, to si klidně zase vzlítne!
Key.English: And this plane, it takes-off again!
Key.Portuguese: E o avião decolou de novo!
Key.Japanese: ソレデ、コノ飛行機ハマタ離陸シタンダ！
Key.Turkish: Ve bu uçak yeniden kalkışa geçiyor!

Key.Original: Turns out the pilot was flying guns for L'Ensemble.
Key.Chinese: 他們後來查出，這架飛機是在為 L'Ensemble 運送槍械。
Key.French: En fait, le pilote livrait des flingues pour l'Ensemble.
Key.Spanish: Al parecer, el piloto estaba traficando con armas para L'Ensemble.
Key.Italian: A quanto pare, il pilota stava trasportando armi per L’Ensemble.
Key.Polish: Okazuje się, że dostarczał L’Ensemble broń.
Key.Russian: Оказалось, что он доставлял оружие для Л'Енсабля.
Key.German: Anscheinend hat der Pilot Waffen für L'Ensemble geschmuggelt.
Key.Czech: Ukázalo se, že pilot pašoval zbraně pro L'Ensemble.
Key.English: Turns out the pilot was flying guns for L'Ensemble.
Key.Portuguese: Acontece que o piloto estava transportando armas para L'Ensemble.
Key.Korean: 알고 보니 그 파일럿이 ‘앙상블’에 총을 실어 나르고 있었던 거지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 原来飞行员是在给大帮会送枪械。
Key.Japanese: ドウヤラ "パイロット" ハ "ランサンブル" ノタメニ銃ヲ運ンデタラシイ。
Key.Turkish: Pilotun L'Ensemble için silah taşıdığı ortaya çıkıyor.

Key.Original: I mean, you gotta admit, these guys have got some courage, eh?
Key.Chinese: 不得不承認，這些傢伙膽子很大，對吧？
Key.French: On peut pas nier que ces types ont du courage, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Hay que reconocer que ese tío los tiene bien puestos, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Insomma, ammettiamolo... questi tizi ne hanno di coraggio, eh?
Key.Polish: Trzeba przyznać, że goście są odważni, co nie?
Key.Russian: Нужно признать, смелости у этих ребят не отбавляй.
Key.German: Man muss schon sagen: Die Jungs haben ganz schön Eier, was?
Key.Czech: Musíš uznat, že tihle lidi mají docela kuráž.
Key.English: I mean, you gotta admit, these guys have got some courage, eh?
Key.Portuguese: E, bom, venhamos e convenhamos: esses caras têm coragem, né?
Key.Chinesesimp: 老实说，你得承认，这些家伙挺有勇气的，是吧？
Key.Japanese: ソンナコトスルナンテ、スゴイ勇気ガイルヨナ。ソレダケハ認メルヨ。
Key.Turkish: Yani, şunu kabul etmelisin... Bu adamlar epey bir cesur, ha?

Container.name: 028_am_facility_destroyed
Container.situation: ambcivlian speaks about the destruction of the main facility on tuvanaka.

Key.Original: Hey, tu as entendu?
Key.French: Hé, tu as entendu?
Key.Spanish: Oye, ¿tu as entendu?
Key.Italian: Ehi, tu as entendu?
Key.German: Hey, tu as entendu?
Key.English: Hey, tu as entendu?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, t'as entendu?
Key.Japanese: オイ、トゥ・ア・アントンドゥ？

Key.Original: There was a major firefight over on Tuvanaka.
Key.Chinese: 土萬納卡那裡有場大火拼。
Key.French: Il y a eu des combats sur Tuvanaka.
Key.Spanish: Ha habido un tiroteo del copón en Tuvanaka.
Key.Italian: C’è stato un grosso scontro armato a Tuvanaka.
Key.German: Drüben auf Tuvanaka gab es ein massives Feuergefecht.
Key.English: There was a major firefight over on Tuvanaka.
Key.Portuguese: Rolou um baita de um tiroteio em Tuvanaka.
Key.Chinesesimp: 突瓦纳加那边有一场大仗呢。
Key.Japanese: "トゥバナカ" デ大規模ナ銃撃戦ガアッタラシイ。
Key.Turkish: Tuvanaka’da büyük bir silahlı çatışma vardı.

Key.Original: CSAT are locking down every island.
Key.Chinese: CSAT 正在鎖定整座島嶼。
Key.French: Le CSAT isole toutes les îles.
Key.Spanish: El CSAT está cerrando todas las islas.
Key.Italian: La CSAT sta mettendo in sicurezza tutte le isole.
Key.German: CSAT riegelt alle Inseln ab.
Key.English: CSAT are locking down every island.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT tá bloqueando todas as ilhas.
Key.Japanese: CSAT ガ全部ノ島ヲ封鎖シテル。

Key.Original: It's total chaos. I don't know what happened, but, it's big!
Key.Chinese: 情況非常混亂，我不知道發生了什麼事，不過很嚴重！
Key.French: C'est le chaos. Je sais pas ce qui se passe, mais c'est du lourd !
Key.Spanish: Hay un caos total. No sé qué habrá pasado, pero tiene que ser algo gordo.
Key.Italian: È il caos più totale. Non so cos’è successo, ma è roba grossa!
Key.Polish: Totalny chaos. Nie wiem, co się stało, ale się stało!
Key.Russian: Тут полный хаос. Не знаю, что произошло, но явно что-то серьезное!
Key.German: Es herrscht totales Chaos. Ich weiß nicht, was passiert ist, aber es muss was Großes sein!
Key.Czech: Je to naprostej chaos. Nevím, co se tam stalo, ale určitě něco velkýho.
Key.English: It's total chaos. I don't know what happened, but, it's big!
Key.Portuguese: Tá um caos total. Não sei o que aconteceu, mas foi alguma coisa grande!
Key.Korean: 혼돈의 도가니라니까. 무슨 일이 있었는지는 모르겠지만 엄청난 사건이었던 것만은 분명해!
Key.Chinesesimp: 全乱套了。我不知道发生了什么事情，不过，动静很大！
Key.Japanese: モノスゴイ混乱ガ起コッテルゾ。何カハ知ラナイガ、デカイコトガ起コッタンダロウ！
Key.Turkish: Bu tam bir karmaşa. Neler olduğunu bilmiyorum ama büyük bir olay!

Container.name: 027_am_radar_destroyed
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about the destruction of a radar site.

Key.Original: Did you hear the latest?
Key.Chinese: 你聽見了最新消息了嗎？
Key.French: T'as entendu ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Te has enterado de la última?
Key.Italian: Hai sentito le ultime notizie?
Key.German: Hast du schon das Neuste gehört?
Key.English: Did you hear the latest?
Key.Portuguese: Soube da última novidade?
Key.Japanese: 最新ノ "ニュース" ヲ聞イタカ？

Key.Original: Somebody took out CSAT's radar sites! Too bad the guérilleros don't have an air force. They could drive those bâtards into the sea...
Key.Chinese: 有人幹掉了 CSAT 的雷達站！只可惜游擊隊沒有空軍。要不然他們就能把這些混蛋通通趕到海裡…
Key.French: Les radars du CSAT ont sauté ! Dommage que les guérilleros aient pas d'avions. Ils t'enverraient ces bâtards au large...
Key.Spanish: ¡Alguien se ha cargado las estaciones de radar del CSAT! Lástima que los guerilleros no tengan medios aéreos, podrían echar a esos bâtards al mar...
Key.Italian: Qualcuno ha distrutto i siti radar della CSAT! Peccato che i guérilleros non abbiano una forza aerea. Potrebbero far finire quei bâtards in mare...
Key.Polish: Ktoś zlikwidował stacje radarowe CSAT! Szkoda, że guérilleros nie mają sił powietrznych. Mogliby zepchnąć tych bâtards do morza…
Key.Russian: Кто-то уничтожил РЛС CSAT! Жаль, что у партизан нет военно-воздушных сил. Они бы загнали этих сволочей в море...
Key.German: Jemand hat die Radaranlagen von CSAT ausgeschaltet! Zu schade, dass die guérilleros keine Luftwaffe haben. Sonst könnten sie diese bâtards ins Meer treiben ...
Key.Czech: Někdo zničil radary CSAT! Škoda, že guérilleros nemají vlastní letectvo. Mohli by ty bâtards zahnat do moře.
Key.English: Somebody took out CSAT's radar sites! Too bad the guérilleros don't have an air force. They could drive those bâtards into the sea...
Key.Portuguese: Alguém destruiu as áreas de radar da CSAT! Pena que os guérilleros não possuem força aérea. Poderiam conduzir aqueles bâtards pro mar...
Key.Korean: CSAT 레이더 기지가 공격 당했다! 젠장, 게릴라에 공군이 있었으면 좋았을 걸... 지금쯤 벌써 놈들을 바다로 내쳤을 텐데...
Key.Chinesesimp: 有人干掉了 CSAT 的雷达站！可惜游击队没有空军。要不，他们就能把那些王八蛋赶到海里去...
Key.Japanese: 誰カガ CSAT ノ "レーダー" 基地ヲ破壊シタラシイ！"ゲリラ" ニ空軍ガナイノハ残念ダッタナ。アイツラヲ海ヘ追イ出セタノニ...
Key.Turkish: Biri CSAT’nin radar bölgelerini ele geçirmiş! Guérilleros’un hava kuvvetine sahip olmaması çok kötü. Şu bâtard’ları denize dökebilirlerdi...

Container.name: 026_am_vagalala_house_destroyed
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about the destruction of a house in vagalala.

Key.Original: That house in Vagalala...
Key.French: Cette maison à Vagalala...
Key.Spanish: Aquella casa de Vagalala...
Key.Italian: Quella casa a Vagalala...
Key.German: Dieses Haus in Vagalala ...
Key.English: That house in Vagalala...
Key.Portuguese: Aquela casa em Vagalala...
Key.Japanese: "バガララ" ノアノ家...

Key.Original: Y'know - the one that got blown up?
Key.Chinese: 你知道吧，就是被炸掉的那一棟？
Key.French: Tu sais, celle qui a sauté ?
Key.Spanish: Ya sabes, la que saltó por los aires...
Key.Italian: Sai, quella che è stata fatta saltare in aria?
Key.German: Du weißt schon – das in die Luft gesprengt wurde.
Key.English: Y'know - the one that got blown up?
Key.Portuguese: Lembra, a que foi explodida?
Key.Korean: 그 집 폭발한 거 알고 있었어?
Key.Japanese: 爆破サレタアノ家ダ。

Key.Original: La gendarmerie seized it, but it belonged to some guy they arrested.
Key.Chinese: 那被憲兵隊徵收了，原來的主人被他們逮捕了。
Key.French: La Gendarmerie l'avait perquisitionnée, c'était celle d'un type en garde à vue.
Key.Spanish: La gendarmerie se la quedó, pero era de un tío al que arrestaron.
Key.Italian: La gendarmeria l’aveva sequestrata, ma apparteneva a un tizio che hanno arrestato.
Key.Polish: La gendarmerie go przejęła, to dom jakiegoś gościa, którego złapali.
Key.Russian: Жандармерия отжала его у какого-то мужика, которого они арестовали.
Key.German: La gendarmerie hatte es beschlagnahmt, aber es gehörte irgendeinem Typen, den sie verhaftet hatten.
Key.Czech: La gendarmerie ho uzavřeli. Ale patřil prej někomu, koho zatkli.
Key.English: La gendarmerie seized it, but it belonged to some guy they arrested.
Key.Portuguese: La gendarmerie tomou posse, mas ela pertencia a um cara que eles prenderam.
Key.Korean: 헌병특공대가 그 집을 장악했었지, 그게 헌병대가 체포한 한 놈의 집이었나봐.
Key.Chinesesimp: 宪兵队查封了它，他们还逮捕了原户主。
Key.Japanese: 憲兵ガ占拠シタガ、元ハアイツラガ逮捕シタ男ノ家ダッタラシイ。
Key.Turkish: La gendarmerie onu ele geçirdi ama o ev tutukladıkları bir adama aitti.

Key.Original: Seems L'Ensemble were worried about him talking.
Key.Chinese: 看來 L'Ensemble 擔心他會透露消息。
Key.French: On dirait que l'Ensemble avait peur qu'il parle.
Key.Spanish: Parece que a L'Ensemble le preocupaba que el pavo hablase.
Key.Italian: A quanto pare L’Ensemble temeva che lui parlasse.
Key.Polish: W L’Ensemble bali się, że będzie gadał.
Key.Russian: Похоже, что Л'Енсабль боялись, что он проболтается.
Key.German: L'Ensemble war anscheinend besorgt, dass er reden würde.
Key.Czech: L'Ensemble se začal bát, aby ten chlap nezačal zpívat.
Key.English: Seems L'Ensemble were worried about him talking.
Key.Portuguese: Parece que L'Ensemble estava preocupado de ele abrir o bico.
Key.Korean: ‘앙상블’은 체포된 녀석이 아는 걸 전부 불어댈까봐 걱정됐던 것 같아.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会似乎很担心他开口。
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ハ彼ガ何カシャベルンジャナイカッテ不安ダッタンダナ。
Key.Turkish: Görünüşe bakılırsa, L'Ensemble adamın konuşmasından endişeliydi.

Key.Original: Anyway, there's not much left of it now. And no witnesses either.
Key.Chinese: 反正，現在什麼也不剩了，而且連證人也沒有了。
Key.French: En tout cas, il en reste pas grand-chose. Et il y a aucun témoin.
Key.Spanish: En fin, ahora ya no hay casa. Ni tampoco testigos.
Key.Italian: In ogni caso, non ne è rimasto granché. Tantomeno testimoni.
Key.Polish: Z budynku niewiele zostało. Świadków też nie ma.
Key.Russian: Как бы там ни было, от него почти ничего не осталось. Свидетелей тоже нет.
Key.German: Jetzt ist davon jedenfalls nicht mehr viel übrig. Und Zeugen gibt es auch keine.
Key.Czech: Takže teď už z něj nic moc nezůstalo. A nejsou ani svědci.
Key.English: Anyway, there's not much left of it now. And no witnesses either.
Key.Portuguese: Enfim, não resta muita coisa agora. E nenhuma testemunha também.
Key.Korean: 어쨌든 이젠 아무것도 남은 게 없어. 목격자도 없고.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不管怎样，现在那儿没剩下什么了。也没有见证人。
Key.Japanese: トニカク、モウ何モ残ッテナイ。目撃者モイナイ。
Key.Turkish: Her neyse, şimdi ondan geriye pek bir şey kalmadı. Şahit bile yok.

Key.Original: Everyone's too afraid of reprisals!
Key.French: Tout le monde a peur de parler !
Key.Spanish: ¡Todo el mundo está acojonado por si hay represalias!
Key.Italian: Hanno tutti paura di qualche rappresaglia!
Key.German: Die Leute haben zu viel Angst vor Vergeltung!
Key.English: Everyone's too afraid of reprisals!
Key.Portuguese: Todo mundo tem medo de represálias!
Key.Japanese: 皆、報復ガ怖インダ！

Container.name: 025_am_night_club
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about night club.

Key.Original: I been thinking.
Key.French: J'y repensais.
Key.Spanish: He estado pensando.
Key.Italian: Stavo pensando.
Key.German: Ich hab über was nachgedacht.
Key.English: I been thinking.
Key.Portuguese: Andei pensando.
Key.Japanese: ズット考エテタ。

Key.Original: The discotheque in Lifou...
Key.French: La discothèque, à Lifou...
Key.Spanish: La discothèque de Lifou...
Key.Italian: La discoteca a Lifou...
Key.German: Die Diskothek in Lifou ...
Key.Czech: Víš, jak je v Lifou ta discotheque?
Key.English: The discotheque in Lifou...
Key.Portuguese: A discoteca em Lifou...
Key.Japanese: "リフ" ノ "ディスコテーク" ダガ...

Key.Original: It's not that great, n'ais pas?
Key.French: Elle est pas terrible, n'est-ce pas ?
Key.Spanish: No mola tanto, ¿n'ais pas?
Key.Italian: Non è un granché, n'est-ce pas?
Key.German: Die ist nicht so der Knaller, n'est-ce pas?
Key.Czech: Je to docela díra, n'ais pas?
Key.English: It's not that great, n'ais pas?
Key.Portuguese: Não é tão boa assim, si?
Key.Japanese: ソンナ大シタ場所ジャナイヨナ？
Key.Turkish: Pek de harika değil, n'ais pas?

Key.Original: There's no women there, and the guy on the door's a total crétin.
Key.Chinese: 那裡沒有女人，看門的這傢伙完全是個白癡。
Key.French: Y'a jamais de filles et le videur est un vrai crétin.
Key.Spanish: No hay chicas y el gorila de la puerta es un crétin de la hostia.
Key.Italian: Non ci sono donzelle e quel tizio all’ingresso è proprio un crétin.
Key.Polish: Nie ma tam kobiet, a facet przy drzwiach to totalny crétin.
Key.Russian: Девчонок там нет и в помине, а на дверях стоит какой-то кретин.
Key.German: Da gehen gar keine Frauen hin und der Türsteher ist ein crétin.
Key.Czech: Nechodí tam holky a ten chlap u dveří je totální crétin.
Key.English: There's no women there, and the guy on the door's a total crétin.
Key.Portuguese: Não tem mulheres por lá, e o cara da portaria é um puta de um crétin.
Key.Korean: 여자는 하나도 없는데다 기도라는 놈이 아주 멍청했지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那儿没女人，门口的伙计是个十足的蠢货。
Key.Japanese: 女ガイナイシ、"ドアマン" ハ本当ニ "クレトン" ダ。
Key.Turkish: Orada hiç kadın yok ve kapıdaki adam tam bir crétin.

Key.Original: Once this malaria thing's over, you know what we should do?
Key.Chinese: 等這瘧疾風波過後，你知道我們應該做什麼嗎？
Key.French: Quand cette histoire de malaria sera terminée, tu sais ce qu'on va faire ?
Key.Spanish: Cuando pase esto de la malaria, ¿sabes qué tendríamos que hacer?
Key.Italian: Quando questa storia della malaria sarà finita, sai che dovremmo fare?
Key.Polish: Jak już ta malaria się uspokoi, wiesz, co zrobimy?
Key.Russian: Знаешь, что нам нужно сделать, как только мы покончим с этой малярией?
Key.German: Sobald diese Malaria-Geschichte vorbei ist, sollten wir was anderes machen.
Key.Czech: Víš, co bysme měli podniknout, až odezní ta malárie?
Key.English: Once this malaria thing's over, you know what we should do?
Key.Portuguese: Quando essa coisa da malária acabar, sabe o que devíamos fazer?
Key.Korean: 이 말라리아 사태가 끝나면, 우리가 뭘 해야 할지 알지?
Key.Chinesesimp: 虐疾这事儿结束后，你知道我们该做什么吗？
Key.Japanese: コノ "マラリア" ノ一件ガ終ワッタラ、ヤリタイコトガアルンダ。
Key.Turkish: Bu sıtma işi bittikten sonra ne yapmamız gerektiğini biliyor musun?

Key.Original: Beach parties, mec - bring back the fêtes sur la plage, y'know?
Key.Chinese: 海灘派對，夥計－－真懷念那海灘派對，對吧？
Key.French: Des beach parties, mec. Refaire la fête sur la plage, tu vois ?
Key.Spanish: Fiestas en la playa, mec... Recuperar las fêtes sur la plage, ¿a que sí?
Key.Italian: Feste in spiaggia, mec. Ricominciare con le fêtes sur la plage, sai?
Key.Polish: Imprezy na plaży, mec, przywrócimy fêtes sur la plage.
Key.Russian: Устроить пляжную вечеринку, мэк! Вернем фет сюр ля пляж, секёшь?
Key.German: Strandpartys, mec. Lass uns die fêtes sur la plage wiederbeleben.
Key.Czech: Party na pláži! Oživíme tradici fêtes sur la plage, chápeš?
Key.English: Beach parties, mec - bring back the fêtes sur la plage, y'know?
Key.Portuguese: Festas na praia, mec. Recuperar as fêtes sur la plage, sabe?
Key.Korean: 바로 비치 파티야, 멕. 끝내주는 비치 파티 생활로 돌아가는 거야, 어때?
Key.Chinesesimp: 沙滩派对，伙计 - 再来一次海滩派对，知道吗？
Key.Japanese: "ビーチパーティー" ダ。"フェット・シュー・ラ・プラジュ" ヲヤルンダ。
Key.Turkish: Plaj partileri, mec... Fêtes sur la plage, bilirsin!

Container.name: 024_am_idap_worker_b
Container.situation: ambcivilian talks about the mysterious malaria virus.

Key.Original: I shit you not, I left him for like a couple of minutes, came back with an RDT and...
Key.Chinese: 不騙你，我離開他幾分鐘，帶個快速診斷測試回來，然後…
Key.French: Je déconne pas, je suis parti deux minutes, je reviens avec un test paludique et...
Key.Spanish: No estoy de coña, lo dejé solo un par de minutos, volví con una prueba de diagnóstico rápido y...
Key.Italian: Non sto dicendo una cazzata. Sono andato via un paio di minuti, ritornato con un test di diagnosi rapida e...
Key.Polish: No mówię ci, zostawiłem go na kilka minut, wracam z testem, a on…
