Key.Russian: Я те говорю, я оставил его всего на пару минут, возвращаюсь с БДТ...
Key.German: Kein Scherz: Ich habe ihn ein paar Minuten alleine gelassen, um einen Schnelldiagnosetest zu holen und ...
Key.Czech: Nekecám ti. Na chvíli ho tam nechám, pak se vrátím s testem na malárii a...
Key.English: I shit you not, I left him for like a couple of minutes, came back with an RDT and...
Key.Portuguese: Não tô de brincadeira: larguei ele por alguns minutos, daí voltei com um relatório médico e...
Key.Korean: 정말 심각해. 기껏해야 몇 분 동안 두고 말라리아 신속진단검사기를 가져왔는데...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我可没忽悠你，我离开他两分钟的样子，拿了 RDT 试剂回来，然后...
Key.Japanese: 本当ダ。ホンノ数分席ヲ立ッテ、RDT ヲ持ッテ戻ッテキタラ...
Key.Turkish: İnan bana, onu birkaç dakikalığına yalnız bıraktım. Bir RDT ile geri döndüm ve...

Key.Original: Boom, he's burning up.
Key.French: Boum, il avait déjà la fièvre.
Key.Spanish: Bum, estaba ardiendo.
Key.Italian: Boom, scottava.
Key.German: Plötzlich stirbt er mir weg.
Key.English: Boom, he's burning up.
Key.Portuguese: Já era, ele tava queimando.
Key.Japanese: 彼ハ高熱ヲ出シテタ。

Key.Original: I had about enough time to call the CMO before he, y'know...
Key.Chinese: 我才剛剛給主軍醫打通電話，結果這就…
Key.French: J'ai à peine eu le temps d'appeler le médecin avant que, tu vois...
Key.Spanish: Apenas tuve tiempo para llamar al oficial médico antes de que, ya sabes...
Key.Italian: Ho avuto giusto il tempo di chiamare il capo del servizio medico prima che, insomma...
Key.Polish: Zdążyłem tylko wezwać lekarza, a już za chwilę on, no wiesz…
Key.Russian: Я только и успел что позвать главврача, прежде чем он того...
Key.German: Ich konnte gerade noch den CMO erreichen, bevor er ... du weißt schon ...
Key.Czech: Sotva se mi povedlo zavolat doktora, než... však víš.
Key.English: I had about enough time to call the CMO before he, y'know...
Key.Portuguese: Só tive tempo suficiente pra ligar para o diretor médico antes de ele...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我倒是来得及呼叫 CMO，可他，你懂的...
Key.Japanese: スグニ CMO ニ連絡シタンダガ、ソノ時ニハモウ...
Key.Turkish: Ondan önce CMO’yu arayacak kadar yeterli zamanım vardı, bilirsin...

Key.Original: And his skin - I mean, hell, it was practically peeling off.
Key.Chinese: 他的皮膚－－該死，居然開始剝落了。
Key.French: Et sa peau ! On aurait dit qu'elle se décollait.
Key.Spanish: Y su piel... Me cago en la puta, se le caía a jirones.
Key.Italian: E la pelle, diamine, stava praticamente venendo via dal corpo.
Key.Polish: A jego skóra… praktycznie schodziła płatami.
Key.Russian: Ты бы видел его кожу, — она практически слезла с него живьем.
Key.German: Und seine Haut hat sich nahezu abgeschält.
Key.Czech: A ta jeho kůže? Prakticky se loupal, do háje.
Key.English: And his skin - I mean, hell, it was practically peeling off.
Key.Portuguese: E a pele dele, porra, tava praticamente descascando.
Key.Korean: 그 친구 피부가... 말 그대로 벗겨지고 있었어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他的皮肤 - 老实说，见鬼，直往下掉。
Key.Japanese: 彼ノ皮膚ハボロボロニ剥ガレテタ。
Key.Turkish: Ve cildi. Yani, lanet olsun; cildi soyuluyordu onun.

Key.Original: Does that sound anything like malaria to you?
Key.French: Ça n'a rien à voir avec la malaria, si ?
Key.Spanish: ¿A ti te parece malaria?
Key.Italian: Ti sembra malaria questa?
Key.German: Hört sich das für dich nach Malaria an?
Key.Czech: Tobě to snad připadá jako malárie?
Key.English: Does that sound anything like malaria to you?
Key.Portuguese: Isso parece malária pra você?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你说这像虐疾的样子吗？
Key.Japanese: ソンナ症状ガ "マラリア" ニアルノカ？
Key.Turkish: Bu sana sıtma gibi mi geliyor?

Container.name: 023_am_idap_worker_a
Container.situation: ambcivilian about the mysterious malaria virus.

Key.Original: I've seen malaria, man.
Key.French: Je connais la malaria, mec.
Key.Spanish: He visto la malaria, tío.
Key.Italian: So cos’è la malaria, amico.
Key.German: Mann, ich kenne Malaria.
Key.English: I've seen malaria, man.
Key.Portuguese: Eu já vi malária, cara.
Key.Japanese: "マラリア" ヲコノ目デ見タコトガアルンダ。

Key.Original: And it isn't this. You call it that and people don't panic...
Key.Chinese: 這可不是瘧疾；不過，這樣的叫法，大家才不會慌…
Key.French: Là, c'est différent. Tu dis "malaria" et personne ne panique...
Key.Spanish: Y esto no lo es. Si lo llamas malaria, no cunde el pánico...
Key.Italian: E non è questa. Se la chiami così, la gente non si fa prendere dal panico...
Key.Polish: To nie to. Ale ludzie nie panikują na wieść o malarii…
Key.Russian: И это не она. Назовешь ее так, и люди не будут паниковать...
Key.German: Und das ist keine. Bei Malaria bricht das Volk nicht in Panik aus ...
Key.Czech: A takhle rozhodně ne. Jenom tomu tak říkají, aby lidi nepanikařili.
Key.English: And it isn't this. You call it that and people don't panic...
Key.Portuguese: E não é como isso aqui. Você fala sobre ela e as pessoas não entram em pânico...
Key.Korean: 이건 말라리아가 아니야. 말라리아라고 하면 사람들이 당황하지 않으니까 그냥 그렇게 부르는 것뿐이지...
Key.Chinesesimp: 虐疾不是这个样子。但是，这样叫，它就不会引起恐慌...
Key.Japanese: コンナ症状ジャナイ。コレヲ "マラリア" トハ呼ンデルガ、ソレハ住人ガ "パニック" ニ陥ラナイヨウニダ...
Key.Turkish: Ve bu sıtma değil. Siz buna sıtma dediğiniz için insanlar panik olmuyor.

Key.Original: But call it a killer virus, with no known cure? Yeah, then...
Key.Chinese: 要是叫它「沒藥救的殺人病毒」？那就…
Key.French: Si tu dis "virus mortel sans antidote", alors là...
Key.Spanish: Pero si lo llamas virus mortal sin cura conocida, entonces...
Key.Italian: Ma non appena la chiami “virus killer senza cura conosciuta”? Beh, allora...
Key.Polish: A jak usłyszą, że to zabójczy wirus i nie ma na to lekarstwa…
Key.Russian: Но стоит только назвать это неизлечимым вирусом-убийцей и тогда, да...
Key.German: Aber bei einem Killer-Virus ohne Gegenmittel? Da geht die Post ab ...
Key.Czech: Kdyby se řeklo, že je to smrtící virus a není na něj lék? Tak to pak...
Key.English: But call it a killer virus, with no known cure? Yeah, then...
Key.Portuguese: Mas se você chamar de vírus assassino, sem cura conhecida? Aí sim...
Key.Korean: 하지만 치료약도 없는 죽음의 바이러스라고 하면 어떨까? 그럼...
Key.Chinesesimp: 但是，把它说成无药可治的致命病毒？嗯，那可就...
Key.Japanese: コレヲ殺人 "ウィルス" ナンテ呼ンデ、シカモ治療薬ガナイト知レタラ、ドンナ混乱ガ起コルカ...
Key.Turkish: Peki ya bunun öldürücü virüs olduğunu ve tedavisinin olmadığını söylerseniz? Evet, o zaman...

Key.Original: Then you got a problem!
Key.French: Ça devient un vrai problème !
Key.Spanish: ¡Entonces tienes un problema!
Key.Italian: Allora le cose cambiano!
Key.German: Dann hast du ein Problem!
Key.English: Then you got a problem!
Key.Portuguese: Aí você tem um problema!
Key.Korean: 그럼 문제가 보통 심각한 게 아니라고!
Key.Japanese: ソレコソ手ニ負エナイゾ！

Container.name: 022_am_political_dialogue_d
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about political situation on tanoa.

Key.Original: Strangest thing...
Key.French: Trop bizarre...
Key.Spanish: El otro día pasó algo muy raro...
Key.Italian: Che roba assurda...
Key.German: Schon merkwürdig ...
Key.English: Strangest thing...
Key.Portuguese: O mais estranho é que...
Key.Japanese: 変ナコトガ起コッタ...

Key.Original: Renou, he was out fishing the other day near Tuvanaka.
Key.Chinese: 有一天，雷諾在土萬納卡附近釣魚。
Key.French: L'autre jour, Renou pêchait près de Tuvanaka.
Key.Spanish: Renou estaba pescando cerca de Tuvanaka.
Key.Italian: Renou era fuori a pescare vicino Tuvanaka l’altro giorno.
Key.Polish: Renou wędkował sobie w pobliżu Tuvanaki.
Key.German: Renou war letztens in der Nähe von Tuvanaka angeln.
Key.Czech: Renou byl před pár dny chytat ryby u Tuvanaky.
Key.English: Renou, he was out fishing the other day near Tuvanaka.
Key.Portuguese: O Renou, ele tava pescando outro dia perto de Tuvanaka.
Key.Korean: 리누 그 친구가 며칠 전에 투바나카 근처로 낚시하러 갔거든.
Key.Chinesesimp: 有一天，雷诺出门到突瓦纳加附近钓鱼。
Key.Japanese: レヌー。コノ間、アイツハ "トゥバナカ" ノ近クデ魚釣リヲシテタ。
Key.Turkish: Renou, geçen gün Tuvanaka yakınlarında balığa çıkmıştı.

Key.Original: Said he saw a small plane come down and crash into the sea!
Key.Chinese: 他說他看見一架小飛機掉到海裡去了！
Key.French: Il dit qu'il a vu un petit avion s'écraser en mer !
Key.Spanish: ¡Y vio una avioneta caer en picado y estrellarse en el mar!
Key.Italian: Ha detto di aver visto un piccolo aereo precipitare e schiantarsi in mare!
Key.Polish: Mówi, że widział, jak mały samolot wpada do morza!
Key.Russian: Он говорит, что видел, как в море упал небольшой самолет!
Key.German: Dort hat er gesehen, wie ein kleines Flugzeug ins Meer gestürzt ist!
Key.Czech: Najednou přiletělo malé letadlo a pláclo sebou do moře!
Key.English: Said he saw a small plane come down and crash into the sea!
Key.Portuguese: Disse que viu um aviãozinho descer e cair no mar!
Key.Korean: 그런데 소형 비행기가 하늘에서 떨어져서 바다 위로 추락했대!
Key.Chinesesimp: 他说看到一架小型飞机掉进海里坠毁了！
Key.Japanese: ソノ時ニ小サナ飛行機ガ降下シテキテ、海ニ落チタラシイ！
Key.Turkish: Söylediğine göre küçük bir uçak gelip suya çakılmış!

Key.Original: That's got to be smugglers - right?
Key.French: C'était des contrebandiers, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Serían contrabandistas, ¿no?
Key.Italian: Devono essere contrabbandieri, no?
Key.German: Das müssen Schmuggler gewesen sein, stimmt‘s?
Key.English: That's got to be smugglers - right?
Key.Portuguese: Devia ser de contrabandistas, né?
Key.Chinesesimp: 肯定是走私贩 - 对吧？
Key.Japanese: 多分、密輸者ダヨナ？

Key.Original: But what were they doing out there?
Key.French: Mais qu'est-ce qu'ils foutaient là ?
Key.Spanish: Pero ¿qué estaban haciendo allí?
Key.Italian: Ma che ci facevano da quelle parti?
Key.German: Aber was hatten die da draußen zu suchen?
Key.English: But what were they doing out there?
Key.Portuguese: Mas o que eles tavam fazendo por lá?
Key.Korean: 그런데 거기서 대체 뭘 하고 있었던 걸까?
Key.Chinesesimp: 可是他们在那儿干嘛呢？
Key.Japanese: ダケド、アンナトコロデ何ヲシテタンダロウ？

Container.name: 021_am_political_dialogue_c
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about political situation on tanoa.

Key.Original: C'est fou...
Key.French: C'est fou...
Key.Spanish: Qué locura...
Key.Italian: Roba da pazzi...
Key.German: Verrückt ...
Key.English: It's crazy...
Key.Portuguese: Que loucura...
Key.Japanese: イカレテル...

Key.Original: How can our government support CSAT after what they did?
Key.Chinese: CSAT 做出了這種事，我們的政府怎麼能夠支持他們？
Key.French: Comment le gouvernement peut encore appuyer le CSAT ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Cómo puede seguir apoyando el gobierno al CSAT después de lo que hicieron?
Key.Italian: Come fa il nostro governo a sostenere la CSAT dopo quello che hanno fatto?
Key.Polish: Jak rząd może popierać CSAT po tym, co zrobili?
Key.Russian: Как наше правительство может поддержать CSAT после того, что они сделали?
Key.German: Wie kann unsere Regierung CSAT unterstützen – nach dem, was die abgezogen haben?
Key.Czech: Jak může naše vláda podporovat CSAT potom, co provedli?
Key.English: How can our government support CSAT after what they did?
Key.Portuguese: Como nosso governo pode apoiar a CSAT depois do que fizeram?
Key.Korean: 우리 정부는 어떻게 그런 짓을 저지른 CSAT를 지지할 수가 있는 거야?
Key.Chinesesimp: 看看 CSAT 的所作所为，我们的政府怎么还能支持他们呢？
Key.Japanese: CSAT ガアンナ事ヲシタ後ナノニ、ドウシテ政府ハアイツラヲ支援スルンダ？
Key.Turkish: Hükûmetimiz yaptıklarından sonra CSAT’yi nasıl desteklesin?

Key.Original: They were trying to destabilize the country - remember? Selling guns to dangerous criminals.
Key.Chinese: 他們曾經想要破壞我們國家的穩定性，你還記得嗎？他們向危險的罪犯販賣槍枝。
Key.French: Ils ont déstabilisé le pays en vendant des armes à des criminels, tu te rappelles ?
Key.Spanish: Estaban intentando desestabilizar el país, ¿recuerdas? Vendían armas a delincuentes peligrosos.
Key.Italian: Hanno provato a destabilizzare il paese, ti ricordi? Vendendo armi a criminali senza scrupoli.
Key.Polish: Próbowali zdestabilizować kraj, pamiętasz? Sprzedawali broń groźnym przestępcom.
Key.Russian: Неужели позабыли, что они пытались дестабилизировать нашу страну? Продавая оружие опасным преступникам.
Key.German: Sie wollten unser Land destabilisieren, erinnert sich keiner daran? Sie haben Waffen an Kriminelle verkauft.
Key.Czech: Vždyť se snažili destabilizovat zemi, pamatuješ? Prodávají zbraně nebezpečným zločincům.
Key.English: They were trying to destabilize the country - remember? Selling guns to dangerous criminals.
Key.Portuguese: Estavam tentando desestabilizar o país, lembra? Venda de armas para criminosos perigosos.
Key.Korean: 놈들은 우리나라를 와해시키려고 했잖아. 기억 나? 위험한 범죄자들에게 총이나 팔아치우고.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们在破坏国家稳定 - 记得吗？卖枪给那些险恶的犯罪分子。
Key.Japanese: 国ヲ不安定ナ状態ニシヨウトシタンダゾ。覚エテルカ？危険ナ犯罪者ニ銃ヲ売ッテタ。
Key.Turkish: Ülkenin istikrarını bozmaya çalıştılar, unuttun mu? Tehlikeli suçlulara silah sattılar.

Key.Original: And now we invite them back!
Key.Chinese: 現在我們卻要請他們回來！
Key.French: Et on les invite chez nous !
Key.Spanish: ¡Y ahora les invitamos a que vuelvan!
Key.Italian: E ora li riportiamo di nuovo qui!
Key.Russian: А теперь мы пригласили их снова!
Key.German: Und jetzt bitten wir sie einfach wieder ins Land?
Key.Czech: A my si je teď pozveme zpátky!
Key.English: And now we invite them back!
Key.Portuguese: E agora nós os convidamos de volta!
Key.Korean: 그런데 이젠 그런 놈들을 다시 초대하다니!
Key.Chinesesimp: 而现在我们却把他们请回来了！
Key.Japanese: ソレナノニ、マタアイツラヲ招キイレテル！
Key.Turkish: Şimdi biz de onları geri davet ettik!

Key.Original: No wonder things are spiralling out of control...
Key.Chinese: 難怪事情越來越棘手了…
Key.French: Pas étonnant que tout parte en vrille...
Key.Spanish: No me extraña que las cosas se estén saliendo de madre...
Key.Italian: Non c’è da stupirsi che la situazione sia sempre più fuori controllo...
Key.Polish: Nic dziwnego, że nie panujemy nad sytuacją…
Key.Russian: Неудивительно, что все выходит из-под контроля...
Key.German: Kein Wunder, dass hier alles außer Kontrolle gerät ...
Key.Czech: Pak se nemáš divit, že se to tu vymyká kontrole.
Key.English: No wonder things are spiralling out of control...
Key.Portuguese: Não é de se admirar que as coisas estejam fora de controle...
Key.Japanese: ドオリデ何モカモガ、グチャグチャニナッテルワケダ...
Key.Turkish: İşlerin gitgide kontrolden çıkıyor olmasına şaşırmamalı...

Container.name: 020_am_political_dialogue_b
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about political situation on tanoa.

Key.Original: CSAT are everywhere now, huh?
Key.Chinese: CSAT 現在簡直無所不在，對吧？
Key.French: Le CSAT est partout, on dirait.
Key.Spanish: Ahora los del CSAT están por todas partes, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: La CSAT è ovunque adesso, eh?
Key.German: CSAT ist jetzt überall stationiert, was?
Key.English: CSAT are everywhere now, huh?
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT tá em todo lugar agora, hein?
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在 CSAT 无处不在，是吧？
Key.Japanese: ドコヲ見テモ CSAT ノヤツラバカリダナ。
Key.Turkish: CSAT şimdi her yerde, değil mi?

Key.Original: So much for doctors. All I'm seeing are soldiers and checkpoints...
Key.Chinese: 還說什麼醫生呢，我看見的都是士兵和檢查點…
Key.French: Tu parles de docteurs. Moi, je vois que des soldats et des checkpoints...
Key.Spanish: Pero no hay un puto médico. En los puntos de control solo se ven soldados...
Key.Italian: Alla faccia dei dottori. Qua non vedo altro che soldati e punti di controllo...
Key.Polish: Tyle w temacie lekarzy. Wszędzie tylko żołnierze i kontrole…
Key.Russian: То же мне, врачи. Я вижу лишь солдат и КПП...
Key.German: Von wegen Ärzte. Ich sehe nur Soldaten und Checkpoints ...
Key.Czech: Už žádní doktoři. Teď jsou všude jenom vojáci a kontrolní stanoviště.
Key.English: So much for doctors. All I'm seeing are soldiers and checkpoints...
Key.Portuguese: Coisa demais pros médicos. Tudo que vejo são soldados e postos de controle...
Key.Korean: 의사는 코빼기도 안 보인다니까. 보이는 거라곤 군인들과 검문소뿐이야...
Key.Chinesesimp: 医生就别提了。满眼都是士兵和关卡...
Key.Japanese: 医者ヲ送ッテクルドコロカ、今ジャ兵士ト検問所バッカリダ...
Key.Turkish: Doktorlar için çok fazla. Askerler ve kontrol noktalarından başka hiçbir şey görmüyorum...

Container.name: 019_am_political_dialogue_a
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about political situation on tanoa.

Key.Original: Y'know, I got a cousin who's a desk clerk at the gendarme station, over in Vagalala.
Key.Chinese: 我有個親戚在瓦加拉拉的國家憲兵站裡當接待員。
Key.French: Tu sais, j'ai un cousin qui travaille à l'accueil de la gendarmerie de Vagalala.
Key.Spanish: ¿Sabes qué? Un primo mío es administrativo en la gendarmerie de Vagalala.
Key.Italian: Sai, mio cugino lavora come impiegato al commissariato di Vagalala.
Key.Polish: Wiesz, mój kuzyn pracuje na posterunku żandarmerii w Vagalala.
Key.Russian: У меня двоюродный брат работает в приемной жандармерии в Вагалале.
Key.German: Mein Cousin arbeitet als Empfangsmitarbeiter in der Polizeiwache in Vagalala.
Key.Czech: Můj bratránek dělá v kanceláři na četnický stanici ve Vagalale.
Key.English: Y'know, I got a cousin who's a desk clerk at the gendarme station, over in Vagalala.
Key.Portuguese: Viu, tenho um primo que é balconista de uma gendarme, em Vagalala.
Key.Korean: 바갈라라에 있는 헌병특공대 본부에서 사무직으로 일하는 사촌이 있거든.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你知道的，我有个表兄在瓦加拉拉那边的宪兵站做接待员。
Key.Japanese: 俺ノ従弟ガ "バガララ" ノ憲兵 "ステーション" デ "フロント" 係リヲヤッテルンダ。
Key.Turkish: Bilirsin, Vagalala’daki jandarma istasyonunda resepsiyon görevlisi olarak çalışan bir kuzenim var.

Key.Original: He was taking an inventory of their evidence room, and found most of it missing. Stolen, I guess.
Key.Chinese: 他在證物室進行清點的時候，發現大多東西都不見了。我看是被偷了。
Key.French: Il faisait l'inventaire des preuves, et la plupart ont disparu. Volées, sûrement.
Key.Spanish: Estaba haciendo inventario en la sala de pruebas y faltaba casi todo. Lo habrían robado, supongo.
Key.Italian: Stava facendo un inventario della stanza in cui tengono le prove e ha scoperto che erano sparite quasi tutte. Rubate, immagino.
Key.Polish: Robił spis dowodów w magazynie i odkrył, że większości brakuje. Ukradli chyba.
Key.Russian: Он проводил инвентаризацию в хранилище вещдоков и обнаружил, что большая их часть пропала. Видимо, их украли.
Key.German: Und bei einer Inventur des Beweiszimmers haben einige Sachen gefehlt. Ich schätze, die wurden gestohlen.
Key.Czech: Prej dělal inventuru ve skladu důkazů a zjistil, že většina z nich chybí. Někdo je asi ukradl.
Key.English: He was taking an inventory of their evidence room, and found most of it missing. Stolen, I guess.
Key.Portuguese: Estava fazendo um inventário na sala das provas e percebeu que a maioria delas tinha sumido. Roubadas, acho.
Key.Korean: 증거물 보관소에서 물품 목록을 확인했는데 증거물 대부분이 사라졌대. 아마 누가 훔쳐간 거겠지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他在清查证物室库存时发现，大多数证物都不见了。我猜是被偷了。
Key.Japanese: 証拠保管室デ在庫ヲ数エテタラ、ソノ大半ガナクナッテルコトニ気ヅイタ。盗マレタンダロウ。
Key.Turkish: Delil odalarından bir envanteri alırken birçoğunun kayıp olduğunu fark etti. Muhtemelen çalınmıştır.

Key.Original: Anyhow, he reported it, and nothing happened. I mean, talk about police corruption!
Key.Chinese: 反正呢，他報告了這件事，但最後卻不了了之。你看看這警察有多腐敗！
Key.French: Il l'a signalé, mais rien n'a été fait. Ils sont corrompus jusqu'à l'os !
Key.Spanish: En cualquier caso, lo denunció y no pasó nada. ¡Hay que ver cómo está la corrupción policial!
Key.Italian: Ha segnalato comunque l’accaduto, ma è finita lì. Quando si dice che la polizia è corrotta!
Key.Polish: No i zgłosił to. Nie było żadnej reakcji. To dopiero dowód na korupcję w policji!
Key.Russian: Как бы там ни было, он доложил руководству и ничего не произошло. Коррумпированность полиции, не иначе!
Key.German: Na ja, er hat es gemeldet und nichts ist passiert. Von wegen die Polizei ist nicht korrupt!
Key.Czech: Potom to nahlásil a nic se nestalo. To je normálně policejní korupce!
Key.English: Anyhow, he reported it, and nothing happened. I mean, talk about police corruption!
Key.Portuguese: De qualquer forma, fez o relatório e nada aconteceu. Pura corrupção policial!
Key.Korean: 어쨌든 사촌이 그 사실을 보고했는데도 아무 일도 안 일어났대. 경찰이 이렇게 썩었다니까!
Key.Chinesesimp: 不管怎么说，他汇报了情况，但最后不了了之。我是说，这事关系到警察腐败！
Key.Japanese: トニカク、ソレヲ報告シテモ誰モ何モシナカッタ。警察ガソレダケ腐敗シテルッテコトダ。
Key.Turkish: Her neyse, bunu rapor etti ve hiçbir şey olmadı. Yani, polisin yolsuzluğundan bahsediyorum!

Key.Original: They even investigated some guy but he had links to Syndikat.
Key.Chinese: 他們本來在調查了一個人，不過這傢伙跟 Syndikat 有關係。
Key.French: Ils ont enquêté sur un des leurs, mais il avait des contacts au Syndikat.
Key.Spanish: Incluso investigaron a un pavo, pero tenía vínculos con el Syndikat.
Key.Italian: Hanno persino indagato su un tipo, ma aveva contatti con i Syndikat.
Key.Polish: Sprawdzili jakiegoś gościa, ale miał powiązania z Syndikatem.
Key.Russian: Они даже подозревали одного мужика, но у него нашлись связи с Syndikat.
Key.German: Angeblich führte die Spur zu einem Typen, der Verbindungen zu Syndikat hat.
Key.Czech: Dokonce vyšetřovali jednoho chlapa, ale má vazby na Syndikat.
Key.English: They even investigated some guy but he had links to Syndikat.
Key.Portuguese: Até investigaram um cara, mas ele tinha conexões com o Syndikat.
Key.Korean: 한 녀석을 조사했더니 Syndikat과 관련이 있더래.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们还审讯了一个家伙，但他和 Syndikat 有关系。
Key.Japanese: トアル男ヲ調ベタコトモアッタガ、ソイツハ Syndikat トツナガリガアッタンダ。
Key.Turkish: Hatta bir adamı sorguya çektiler ama Syndikat ile bağlantıları vardı.

Key.Original: So, they just dropped it. And, he's still on active duty, making stacks of cash. Putain de connard...
Key.Chinese: 所以呢，他們後來就不查了。而且，這個人到現在還在外頭賺大錢呢。該死的混蛋…
Key.French: Alors ils ont laissé tomber. Il est toujours là, à s'en mettre plein les fouilles. Putain de connard...
Key.Spanish: Así que le dieron carpetazo al asunto y el tío sigue en activo, forrándose a saco. Putain de connard...
Key.Italian: Allora hanno lasciato perdere. E lui è ancora in servizio e fa soldi a palate. Putain de connard...
Key.Polish: Więc nie drążyli. A ten facet dalej tam pracuje i zarabia lewą kasę. Putain de connard…
Key.Russian: Поэтому они просто закрыли дело. А он до сих пор служит и гребет бабло лопатой. Путэн де коннард...
Key.German: Also haben sie die Sache einfach ignoriert und der Typ ist noch im Dienst. Verdient sich bestimmt eine goldene Nase, Putain de connard ...
Key.Czech: Tak ho nechali jít. Pořád je ve službě a vydělává pěknej balík. Putain de connard.
Key.English: So, they just dropped it. And, he's still on active duty, making stacks of cash. Putain de connard...
Key.Portuguese: Então, simplesmente desistiram. E ele ainda tá na ativa, ganhando pilhas de dinheiro. Putain de connard...
Key.Korean: 그래서 그냥 수사를 마무리지은 거야. 조사받은 그 인간은 아직도 근무하면서 돈을 엄청 벌고 있나봐. 쀠땅 드 꼬나흐...
Key.Chinesesimp: 于是，他们就此结案。而且，他还在任职，大把捞钱。该死的混蛋...
Key.Japanese: ダカラ、オ咎メナシサ。今デモ素知ラヌ顔デ勤務シテ、大金ヲ稼イデル。プタン・ドゥ・コナール...
Key.Turkish: O yüzden serbest bıraktılar. Ve o adam hâlâ aktif görevde, paranın dibine vuruyor. Putain de connard...

Container.name: 018_am_syndikat_dialogue_d
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about l'ensemble and syndikat.

Key.Original: So, you see the police?
Key.French: T'as su, pour les gendarmes ?
Key.Spanish: Qué, ¿sabes lo de la poli?
Key.Italian: Allora, hai visto la polizia?
Key.German: Hast du die Polizei gesehen?
Key.English: So, you see the police?
Key.Portuguese: Então, você vê a polícia?
Key.Japanese: ソレデ、アノ警察ガ見エルカ？

Key.Original: They took a guérillero to Auclair's old place.
Key.Chinese: 他們把一名游擊隊員帶到了奧克萊爾的舊家。
Key.French: Ils ont pris un guérillero là où habitait Auclair.
Key.Spanish: Se han llevado a un guérillero adonde lo de Auclair.
Key.Italian: Ha portato un guérillero alla vecchia fattoria di Auclair.
Key.Polish: Zabrali jednego guérillero na starą plantację Auclaira.
Key.Russian: Они отвели партизана на старое место Оклера.
Key.German: Sie haben einen Guérillero zu Auclairs alter Farm verschleppt.
Key.Czech: U Auclaira prý zatkli nějakýho guérillero.
Key.English: They took a guérillero to Auclair's old place.
Key.Portuguese: Eles levaram um guérillero ao antigo local de Auclair.
Key.Korean: 저놈들이 게릴라 병사 하나를 어클레어의 예전 집으로 데리고 갔어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们把一个游击队员带到 Auclair 的老地方去了。
Key.Japanese: "ゲリラ" 隊員ヲ "オークレア" ノ古イ場所ニ連レテッタンダ。
Key.Turkish: Bir guérillero’yu Auclair’in eski yerine götürdüler.

Key.Original: Probably another interrogation.
Key.French: Encore un interrogatoire.
Key.Spanish: Seguro que para otro interrogatorio.
Key.Italian: Forse per un altro interrogatorio.
Key.German: Wahrscheinlich wieder zur „Befragung“.
Key.English: Probably another interrogation.
Key.Portuguese: Provavelmente outro interrogatório.
Key.Chinesesimp: 也许又要来一次审讯了。
Key.Japanese: 多分、マタ尋問ガアッタンダ。

Key.Original: Mon dieu...
Key.French: Mon Dieu...
Key.Spanish: Mon Dieu...
Key.Italian: Mon dieu...
Key.German: Mon dieu ...
Key.English: Mon dieu...
Key.Portuguese: Mon dieu...
Key.Japanese: モン・デュー...

Key.Original: I hope it don't take as long as the last one.
Key.Chinese: 希望不會跟上次 一樣那麼久。
Key.French: J'espère que ça ira plus vite que le dernier.
Key.Spanish: Espero que dure menos que el último.
Key.Italian: Spero che non ci mettano tanto come l’altra volta.
Key.Polish: Oby nie trwało tak długo jak poprzednie.
Key.Russian: Надеюсь, этот займет не так много времени, как предыдущий.
Key.German: Hoffentlich dauert es nicht wieder so lange wie beim letzten Mal.
Key.Czech: Snad nedopadne tak jako ten poslední.
Key.English: I hope it don't take as long as the last one.
Key.Portuguese: Espero que não demore tanto quanto o último.
Key.Korean: 지난 번처럼 오래 걸리지 않았으면 좋겠는데.
Key.Chinesesimp: 希望不要像上次那么久。
Key.Japanese: コノ間ノホド長クナイトイインダケドナ。
Key.Turkish: Umarım bu seferki sonuncusu kadar uzun sürmez.

Key.Original: Pauvre bâtard. You remember? He was screaming all night.
Key.Chinese: 可憐的混蛋。你還記得嗎？他整晚不停地尖叫。
Key.French: Pauvre bâtard. Tu te rappelles ? Il a hurlé toute la nuit.
Key.Spanish: Pauvre bâtard. ¿Te acuerdas? Estuvo toda la noche gritando.
Key.Italian: Pauvre bâtard. Ricordi? Ha urlato tutta la notte.
Key.Polish: Pauvre bâtard. Pamiętasz? Krzyczał całą noc.
Key.Russian: Повр батар. Помнишь, что было? Как он кричал всю ночь?
Key.German: Pauvre bâtard. Erinnerst du dich? Er hat die ganze Nacht lang geschrien.
Key.Czech: Pauvre bâtard. Pamatuješ na to? Křičel celou noc.
Key.English: Pauvre bâtard. You remember? He was screaming all night.
Key.Portuguese: Pauvre bâtard. Lembra? Passou a noite toda gritando.
Key.Korean: 뽀브르 바타르. 기억 나? 그 자식 밤새 비명을 질러댔잖아.
Key.Chinesesimp: 可怜的混蛋。记得吗？他惨叫了一整夜。
Key.Japanese: ブーブレ・バター。覚エテルカ？彼ハ夜中ズット叫ンデタ。
Key.Turkish: Pauvre bâtard. Hatırlıyor musun? Tüm gece bağırmıştı.

Container.name: 017_am_syndikat_dialogue_c
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about l'ensemble and syndikat.

Key.Original: You remember the parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons?
Key.Chinese: 你記得反對黨新視野嗎？
Key.French: Tu connais le parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Te acuerdas del parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons?
Key.Italian: Ti ricordi il parti d’opposition, Nouveaux Horizons?
Key.Russian: Помнишь, была такая парти д'опозисьон «Нуво Оризон»...?
Key.German: Erinnerst du dich noch an die parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons?
Key.Czech: Pamatuješ tu parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons?
Key.English: You remember the parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons?
Key.Portuguese: Você se lembra do parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你记得反对党新视野吗？
Key.Japanese: "パルティ・ドポジション" ノ "ニューヴォ・オリゾン" ヲ覚エテルカ？
Key.Turkish: D'opposition partisini, Nouveaux Horizons’u hatırlıyor musun?

Key.Original: Their top guy got fed to the crocos at Croconeel's last night.
Key.Chinese: 他們的老大昨晚被丟到鱷魚池裡餵鱷魚。
Key.French: Leur chef a été bouffé par les crocos de Croconeel, la nuit dernière.
Key.Spanish: Esta noche echaron a su líder a los cocodrilos en Croconeel's.
Key.Italian: Il loro leader è stato dato in pasto ai coccodrilli del Croconeel’s ieri notte.
Key.Polish: Ich szefa rzucili wczoraj krokodylom w Croconeel’s.
Key.Russian: Их лидера вчера скормили крокодилам на ранчо «Кроконил».
Key.German: Ihr Spitzenkandidat wurde gestern Nacht an die Krokodile in Croconeel‘s verfüttert.
Key.Czech: Včera večer někdo předhodil jejich šéfa krokodýlům na Croconeelově farmě.
Key.English: Their top guy got fed to the crocos at Croconeel's last night.
Key.Portuguese: O cara principal deles virou comida de crocodilo no Croconeel na noite passada.
Key.Korean: 어젯밤 거기 당 대표가 크로코닐에서 악어밥이 됐대.
Key.Chinesesimp: 昨晚他们的老大在鳄鱼潭被喂了鳄鱼。
Key.Japanese: 昨晩、上層部ノヤツラガ "クロコネールス" デ "クロコダイル" ノ餌ニサレタッテ。
Key.Turkish: Dün gece en iyi adamları Croconeel’s’te timsahlara yem oldu.

Key.Original: Gendarmes are still picking out the pieces...
Key.Chinese: 國家憲兵到現在還在撿屍塊呢…
Key.French: Les gendarmes en sont encore à chercher les morceaux...
Key.Spanish: Los gendarmes siguen buscando los trocitos...
Key.Italian: I gendarmi stanno ancora recuperando parti del suo corpo...
Key.Russian: Жандармы до сих пор вылавливают то, что от него осталось...
Key.German: Die Gendarmes sammeln seine Einzelteile immer noch ein ...
Key.English: Gendarmes are still picking out the pieces...
Key.Portuguese: Os gendarmes ainda estão recolhendo os pedacinhos...
Key.Korean: 헌병특공대가 아직도 남은 찌거기를 청소 중인가봐...
Key.Chinesesimp: 宪兵队现在还在捞碎尸呢...
Key.Japanese: 憲兵ハマダ後始末シテルラシイ...

Key.Original: Must be L'Ensemble - I mean, that's how they do politique, pas vrai?
Key.Chinese: 一定是 L'Ensemble－－我是說，這就是他們的政治手段，不對嗎？
Key.French: C'est forcément l'Ensemble. C'est comme ça qu'ils font de la politique, pas vrai ?
Key.Spanish: Tuvo que ser L'Ensemble... Porque vamos, así hacen ellos la politique, pas vrai?
Key.Italian: Deve esserci dietro L’Ensemble. Voglio dire, è così che fanno politique, pas vrai?
Key.Polish: To jak nic L’Ensemble. W końcu tak uprawiają politique, pas vrai?
Key.Russian: Наверное, Л'Енсабль. Это их подход к политике, па врай?
Key.German: Das muss L'Ensemble gewesen sein. Das ist ihr Verständnis von Politik, pas vrai?
Key.Czech: To musel udělat L'Ensemble. Víš, jakým způsobem dělají politique, pas vrai?
Key.English: Must be L'Ensemble - I mean, that's how they do politique, pas vrai?
Key.Portuguese: Deve ser L'Ensemble. Quer dizer, é assim que fazem politique, pas vrai?
Key.Korean: ‘앙상블’이 그랬을 거야. 그게 놈들의 정치 방식이니까, 안 그래?
Key.Chinesesimp: 肯定是大帮会干的 - 我是说，这是他们玩政治的手法，不是吗？
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ダヨナ？アイツラハソウイウ "ポリティーク" ナンダロウ、パ・ヴレイ？
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble olmalı. Yani, onların politika tarzı bu, pas vrai?

Container.name: 016_am_syndikat_dialogue_b
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about l'ensemble and syndikat.

Key.Original: You hear the latest?
Key.Chinese: 你聽見了最新的消息了嗎？
Key.French: Hé, t'as entendu ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Te has enterado de la última?
Key.Italian: Hai sentito quello che è successo?
Key.German: Hast du schon das Neuste gehört?
Key.English: You hear the latest?
Key.Portuguese: Soube das novidades?
Key.Japanese: 最新ノ "ニュース" ヲ聞イタカ？

Key.Original: L'Ensemble took down a radio station. And in broad daylight too.
Key.Chinese: L'Ensemble 拆了一棟無線電站，就光天化日之下。
Key.French: L'Ensemble a neutralisé un émetteur radio. En plein jour.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble se ha cargado una estación de radio. Y a plena luz del día.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ha distrutto una stazione radio. In pieno giorno, per giunta.
Key.Polish: L’Ensemble załatwiło stację radiową. W biały dzień.
Key.Russian: Л'Енсабль уничтожили радиостанцию. Причем посреди бела дня.
Key.German: L‘Ensemble haben eine Radiostation gesprengt – am helllichten Tag.
Key.Czech: L'Ensemble zničil vysílač. Za denního světla.
Key.English: L'Ensemble took down a radio station. And in broad daylight too.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble destroçou uma estação de rádio. E em plena luz do dia.
Key.Korean: ‘앙상블’이 라디오 방송국을 습격했대. 그것도 대낮에 말이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会搞掉了一座电台。就在光天化日之下。
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ガ "ラジオ" 局ヲ襲撃シタラシイ。シカモ、白昼堂々。
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble bir telsiz istasyonunu etkisiz hale getirmiş. Hem de güpegündüz.

Key.Original: They just blew up the tower.
Key.Chinese: 他們直接把高塔給炸了。
Key.French: Ils ont fait sauter la tour.
Key.Spanish: Volaron la torre y a chuparla.
Key.Italian: Hanno fatto saltare in aria la torre di trasmissione.
Key.German: Die haben den Funkmast einfach in die Luft gejagt.
Key.English: They just blew up the tower.
Key.Portuguese: Simplesmente explodiram a torre.
Key.Japanese: 塔ヲフッ飛バシタンダ。

Key.Original: That's pretty audacieux, eh?
Key.French: Plutôt audacieux, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Es bastante audacieux, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Decisamente audacieux, eh?
Key.German: Ziemlich audacieux, was?
Key.English: That's pretty audacieux, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Isso é muito audacieux, né?
Key.Japanese: カナリ "オーダシュー" ダナ。

Container.name: 015_am_syndikat_dialogue_a
Container.situation: ambcivilian speaks about l'ensemble and syndikat.

Key.Original: Hey, you listen to the news lately?
Key.Chinese: 喂，你有沒有聽到最新的消息？
Key.French: Hé, t'as entendu la dernière ?
Key.Spanish: Oye, ¿estás al tanto de las noticias?
Key.Italian: Ehi, hai sentito le ultime notizie?
Key.German: Hey, hast du dir in letzter Zeit mal die Nachrichten angehört?
Key.English: Hey, you listen to the news lately?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, soube das últimas notícias?
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你听到最新的消息了吗？
Key.Japanese: おい、最近のニュースを聞いたか？
Key.Turkish: Selam, son günlerde haberleri takip ediyor musun?

Key.Original: L'Ensemble attacked a supply depot.
Key.French: L'Ensemble a attaqué un dépôt.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble ha atacado un depósito de suministros.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ha attaccato un deposito di rifornimenti.
Key.German: L'Ensemble hat ein Versorgungslager angegriffen.
Key.English: L'Ensemble attacked a supply depot.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble atacou um depósito de suprimentos.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会袭击了一个补给站。
Key.Japanese: ランサンブルが物資集積所を襲撃したらしい。

Key.Original: Big operation from the sound of it.
Key.Chinese: 聽起來好像是個很大的行動。
Key.French: Une grosse opération, apparemment.
Key.Spanish: Pinta que fue una operación de las gordas.
Key.Italian: Un’operazione grossa, mi sembra di capire.
Key.Polish: Duża operacja, z tego co słyszę.
Key.Russian: Судя по всему, это была крупная операция.
Key.German: Hört sich nach einer großen Sache an.
Key.English: Big operation from the sound of it.
Key.Portuguese: Parece que foi uma grande operação.
Key.Japanese: でかい作戦だったみたいだ。
Key.Turkish: Kulağa büyük bir operasyonmuş gibi geliyor.

Key.Original: They even had a boat.
Key.French: Ils avaient un bateau.
Key.Spanish: Hasta tenían un barco.
Key.Italian: Avevano persino una barca.
Key.German: Die hatten sogar ein Boot.
Key.Czech: Měli na to dokonce i člun.
Key.English: They even had a boat.
Key.Portuguese: Usaram até um barco.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们甚至搞到了一条船。
Key.Japanese: ボートまで用意してたって。

Key.Original: Crossed Yanukka Bay and caught CSAT completely off-guard.
Key.Chinese: 他們跨越了雅努卡灣，讓 CSAT 措手不及。
Key.French: Ils ont traversé la baie de Yanukka pour surprendre le CSAT.
Key.Spanish: Cruzaron la bahía de Yanukka y pillaron al CSAT con los pantalones bajados.
Key.Italian: Hanno attraversato la Baia di Yanukka e colto la CSAT completamente alla sprovvista.
Key.Polish: Pokonali zatokę Yanukka i całkiem zaskoczyli CSAT.
Key.Russian: Переплыли Янукка Бэй и застали CSAT врасплох.
Key.German: Sind über Yanukka Bay gefahren und haben CSAT mit heruntergelassenen Hosen erwischt.
Key.Czech: Přepluli Yanuckou zátoku a úplně CSAT zaskočili.
Key.English: Crossed Yanukka Bay and caught CSAT completely off-guard.
Key.Portuguese: Atravessaram a baía de Yanukka e pegaram a CSAT completamente desprevenida.
Key.Korean: 야누카 만을 건너서 완전히 무방비 상태의 CSAT를 공격했다지 뭐야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 穿过雅努加湾，给了 CSAT 一个出其不意。
Key.Japanese: ヤヌッカ湾を横断して完全に CSAT の不意を突いたらしい。
Key.Turkish: Yanukka Körfezi’ni geçip CSAT’yi tamamen savunmasız yakalamışlar.

Key.Original: I mean, those guys, they're getting organized. Few more raids like that and, I dunno...
Key.Chinese: 我是說，那些傢伙越來越有組織性了。再搞幾次這樣的攻擊，不知道會怎樣…
Key.French: Ils sont de plus en plus organisés. Encore quelques attaques de ce genre et...
Key.Spanish: Esos tíos se están organizando. Unos cuantos ataques como este y quién sabe...
Key.Italian: Insomma, quei tizi si stanno organizzando. Qualche altro assalto e poi, chi lo sa...
Key.Polish: Ci goście są coraz lepiej zorganizowani. Jeszcze parę takich akcji i sam nie wiem…
Key.Russian: Эти ребята с каждым разом все организованнее. Еще пара-тройка таких налетов, и...
Key.German: Die Typen werden immer professioneller. Noch ein paar Überfälle mehr und wer weiß, wo das noch hinführen soll ...
Key.Czech: Začínají být docela organizovaní. Ještě pár takových útoků a nevím, nevím...
Key.English: I mean, those guys, they're getting organized. Few more raids like that and, I dunno...
Key.Portuguese: Sério, esses caras tão se organizando. Mais uns ataques como esse e, sei lá...
Key.Korean: 그 자식들 점점 더 조직적으로 움직이는 것 같아. 그렇게 습격을 몇 번 더 했다간...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我是说，那些家伙，他们正在组织起来。如果再搞几次这样的袭击，而且，很难说...
Key.Japanese: あいつら、だんだん統率が取れてきたな。ああいう襲撃があと数回あったら... どうだろう...
Key.Turkish: Yani, bu adamlar gittikçe organize oluyorlar. Böyle birkaç baskın daha olursa sonucu ne olur, bilemiyorum...

Key.Original: Maybe they will start a revolution.
Key.French: La révolution pourra commencer.
Key.Spanish: Igual empiezan una revolución.
Key.Italian: Magari daranno il via a una rivoluzione.
Key.German: Vielleicht starten sie sogar eine Revolution.
Key.English: Maybe they will start a revolution.
Key.Portuguese: Talvez iniciem uma revolução.
Key.Chinesesimp: 也许他们会发动一场革命。
Key.Japanese: もしかすると、革命が始まるかもしれないぞ。

Container.name: 014_am_gendarme_greeting_d
Container.situation: ambcivilian acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Bonjour.
Key.French: Bonjour.
Key.Spanish: Bonjour.
Key.Italian: Bonjour.
Key.German: Bonjour.
Key.English: Bonjour.
Key.Portuguese: Bonjour.
Key.Japanese: ボンジュール。

Container.name: 013_am_gendarme_greeting_c
Container.situation: ambcivilian acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Affaire de police officielle.
Key.French: Affaire de police officielle.
Key.Spanish: Affaire de police officielle.
Key.Italian: Affaire de police officielle.
Key.German: Affaire de police officielle.
Key.English: Affaire de police officielle.
Key.Portuguese: Affaire de police officielle.
Key.Japanese: アファ・ドゥ・ポリス・オフィシエル。

Container.name: 012_am_gendarme_greeting_b
Container.situation: ambcivilian acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Il y a un problème, vieux?
Key.French: Il y a un problème, vieux ?
Key.Spanish: Il y a un problème, vieux?
Key.Italian: Il y a un problème, vieux?
Key.Polish: Il y a un problème, vieux?
Key.German: Il y a un problème, vieux?
Key.Czech: Il y a un problème, vieux?
Key.English: Il y a un problème, vieux?
Key.Portuguese: Il y a un problème, vieux?
Key.Korean: 일 이 아 엉 프로블렘, 비유?
Key.Japanese: イリ・アン・プロブレム、ビウ？
Key.Turkish: Il y a un problème, vieux?

Container.name: 011_am_gendarme_greeting_a
Container.situation: ambcivilian acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Restez prudent dehors.
Key.French: Reste prudent, dehors.
Key.Spanish: Restez prudent dehors.
Key.Italian: Restez prudent dehors.
Key.German: Restez prudent dehors.
Key.English: Restez prudent dehors.
Key.Portuguese: Restez prudent dehors.
Key.Japanese: レステ・プルダン・デオール。

Container.name: 010_am_syndikat_greeting_d
Container.situation: ambcivilian acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Mener le Bon Combat, mec.
Key.French: Continue le combat, mec.
Key.Spanish: Mène un bon combat, mec.
Key.Italian: Mener le Bon Combat, mec.
Key.German: Mener le Bon Combat, mec.
Key.English: Mener le Bon Combat, mec.
Key.Portuguese: Combats le bon combat, mec.
Key.Japanese: メネル・ル・ボン・コンバット。

Container.name: 008_am_syndikat_greeting_b
Container.situation: ambcivilian acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Heya. Comment ça va?
Key.French: Hé, comment ça va?
Key.Spanish: Buenas. Comment ça va?
Key.Italian: Ehilà. Comment ça va?
Key.German: Hey, comment ça va?
Key.English: Heya. Comment ça va?
Key.Portuguese: E aí. Comment ça va?
Key.Japanese: ヨオ。コモ・サ・ヴァ？

Container.name: 007_am_syndikat_greeting_a
Container.situation: ambcivilian acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Salut, mec.
Key.French: Salut, mec.
Key.Spanish: Salut, mec.
Key.Italian: Salut, mec.
Key.German: Salut, mec.
Key.English: Salut, mec.
Key.Portuguese: Salut, mec.
Key.Japanese: サリュー。

Container.name: 009_am_idap_worker_greeting_d
Container.situation: idap workerj acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Bonjour, mon ami.
Key.French: Bonjour, mon ami.
Key.Spanish: Bonjour, mon ami.
Key.Italian: Bonjour, mon ami.
Key.German: Bonjour, mon ami.
Key.English: Bonjour, mon ami.
Key.Portuguese: Bonjour, mon ami.
Key.Japanese: ボンジュール、モン・アミ。

Container.name: 008_am_idap_worker_greeting_c
Container.situation: idap workeri acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Hi, how you doing?
Key.French: Salut, ça va ?
Key.Spanish: Hola, ¿cómo te va?
Key.Italian: Ehilà, che si dice?
Key.German: Hi, wie steht‘s?
Key.English: Hi, how you doing?
Key.Portuguese: Oi, tudo bem?
Key.Japanese: ヤア、調子ハドウダ？

Container.name: 007_am_idap_worker_greeting_b
Container.situation: idap workerh acknowledges player.

Key.Original: You need anything, man?
Key.Chinese: 你需要什麼東西嗎，老兄？
Key.French: T'as besoin d'un truc, mec ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Quieres algo, tío?
Key.Italian: Ti serve qualcosa?
Key.German: Brauchst du irgendwas?
Key.English: You need anything, man?
Key.Portuguese: Precisando de alguma coisa, cara?
Key.Japanese: 何カ必要カ？
Key.Turkish: Bir şeye ihtiyacın var mı, adamım?

Container.name: 006_am_idap_worker_greeting_a
Container.situation: idap workerg acknowledges player.

Key.Original: Heya, pal.
Key.French: Salut, mon pote.
Key.Spanish: Qué pasa, colega.
Key.Italian: Ehilà, amico.
Key.German: Da sagst du was.
Key.English: Heya, pal.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, amigo.
Key.Japanese: ヨオ！

Container.name: 005_am_idap_worker_c
Container.situation: workere talks to workerf about idap medical supplies appearing on the black market.

Key.Original: Yeah - driver didn't show.
Key.French: Ouais, le chauffeur est pas venu.
Key.Spanish: Sí, el conductor no apareció.
Key.Italian: Già, l’autista non è arrivato a destinazione.
Key.Russian: Да, водитель так и не объявился.
Key.German: Der Fahrer ist nicht aufgetaucht.
Key.Czech: Jo. Řidič se tu ani neukázal.
Key.English: Yeah - driver didn't show.
Key.Portuguese: Pois é. O motorista não apareceu.
Key.Japanese: ああ、運転手は来なかった。

Key.Original: Looks as though they got the lot...
Key.Chinese: 看來都落到他們手中了…
Key.French: Il s'est tiré avec la cargaison.
Key.Spanish: Parece que se lo han llevado todo...
Key.Italian: Sembra proprio che si siano presi tutto...
Key.German: Scheint, als hätten sie sich die Lieferung geschnappt ...
Key.Czech: Zdá se, že to někdo ukradl.
Key.English: Looks as though they got the lot...
Key.Portuguese: Parece que conseguiram a carga...
Key.Chinesesimp: 看来他们好像搞到货了...
Key.Japanese: どうやら商品を手に入れたみたいだ...

Key.Original: Nope, but I heard there was a shit-ton of anti-malarial supplies.
Key.Chinese: 沒有，但是我聽說是一大堆抗瘧疾藥物。
Key.French: Non, mais on m'a dit qu'il y avait plein d'antipaludiques.
Key.Spanish: No, pero dicen que había la hostia de suministros contra la malaria.
Key.Italian: No, ma ho sentito che c’erano un fottio di rifornimenti antimalarici.
Key.Polish: Nie, ale ponoć było tam od cholery środków przeciw malarii.
Key.Russian: Нет, но я слышал, что там была хренова туча противомалярийных препаратов.
Key.German: Nein, aber es sollen eine Menge Anti-Malaria-Mittel drin gewesen sein.
Key.Czech: Ne, ale slyšel jsem, že je v něm hromada zásob proti malárii.
Key.English: Nope, but I heard there was a shit-ton of anti-malarial supplies.
Key.Portuguese: Não, mas ouvi dizer que tinha uma caralhada de suprimentos antimaláricos.
Key.Korean: 아니. 그런데 항말라리아 의약품이 잔뜩 들어있었다고 하더라고.
Key.Chinesesimp: 没有，不过我听说竟然有一大堆抗虐疾药。
Key.Japanese: いいや。だが、抗マラリア物資がわんさかあるって聞いたよ。
Key.Turkish: Hayır ama bir sürü lanet olasıca sıtma ilacı malzemesi olduğunu duydum.

Key.Original: If he didn't, someone did.
Key.Chinese: 若不是他，那肯定是其他人。
Key.French: Lui, ou quelqu'un d'autre.
Key.Spanish: Si no fue él, sería otra persona.
Key.Italian: Se non lui, qualcun altro.
Key.Polish: Jak nie on, to ktoś inny.
Key.German: Und wenn nicht er, dann jemand anderes.
Key.Czech: Jestli ne on, tak někdo určitě.
Key.English: If he didn't, someone did.
Key.Portuguese: Se não foi ele, foi alguém.
Key.Korean: 몰랐다고 해도, 다른 누군가가 알고 있었겠지.
Key.Japanese: 彼が知らなかったんなら、他のヤツが知ってたはずだ。

Key.Original: Did you read the manifest?
Key.French: Tu as regardé le manifeste ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Has leído el manifiesto?
Key.Italian: Hai letto il manifesto del carico?
Key.German: Hast du dir die Ladeliste angesehen?
Key.English: Did you read the manifest?
Key.Portuguese: Você leu o manifesto?
Key.Japanese: 積荷目録を読んだか？

Key.Original: It's all over the black market now.
Key.Chinese: 東西現在都流入黑市了。
Key.French: Tout est passé sur le marché noir.
Key.Spanish: Ahora están circulando por el mercado negro.
Key.Italian: Adesso si trovano ovunque sul mercato nero.
Key.German: Jetzt ist das Zeug auf dem Schwarzmarkt.
Key.Czech: Teď je toho plnej černej trh.
Key.English: It's all over the black market now.
Key.Portuguese: Agora tá tudo no mercado paralelo.
Key.Japanese: もう闇市場中に広がってる。

Key.Original: Son of a bitch. He knew what he was doing, then.
Key.Chinese: 王八蛋，那他肯定是計畫好的。
Key.French: Le fils de pute. Il savait ce qu'il volait.
Key.Spanish: Qué cabrón. Entonces sabía lo que estaba haciendo.
Key.Italian: Figlio di puttana. Allora sapeva quello che stava facendo.
Key.Polish: A to sukinkot. Wiedział, co robi.
Key.Russian: Сукин сын. Значит он знал, что делает.
Key.German: Der Bastard wusste also genau, was er tut.
Key.Czech: No ty vole. Takže on věděl, co se tady děje.
Key.English: Son of a bitch. He knew what he was doing, then.
Key.Portuguese: Filho da puta. Então ele sabia o que tava fazendo.
Key.Korean: 젠장. 그럼 일부러 그걸 노린 거잖아.
Key.Chinesesimp: 狗日的。那他就知道自己在干什么。
Key.Japanese: チクショウめ。それじゃ、何を運んでるか分かっててやったんだな。
Key.Turkish: Şerefsiz. Demek ki ne yaptığını biliyordu.

Key.Original: IDAP might even try to buy it back.
Key.Chinese: 搞不好 IDAP 會把它們都買回來。
Key.French: L'IDAP va peut-être tout racheter.
Key.Spanish: Igual el IDAP intenta recuperarlos.
Key.Italian: L’IDAP potrebbe addirittura provare a ricomprarseli.
Key.Polish: IDAP może nawet próbować to odkupić.
Key.German: Vielleicht wird IDAP sogar versuchen, es zurückzukaufen.
Key.Czech: IDAP se to možná pokusí skoupit zpátky.
Key.English: IDAP might even try to buy it back.
Key.Portuguese: O IDAP pode até tentar recomprar.
Key.Chinesesimp: IDAP 可能还得想办法回购。
Key.Japanese: IDAP が買い戻そうとするかもな。
Key.Turkish: IDAP onu geri satın almayı bile deneyebilir.

Key.Original: For a price, I bet. Talk about biting the hand that feeds you, eh?
Key.Chinese: 我看這可不便宜，真是恩將仇報？
Key.French: Au prix fort, j'imagine. Ils mordent la main qui les nourrit, hein ?
Key.Spanish: A ver a qué precio. Mira que morder la mano que te da de comer...
Key.Italian: A caro prezzo, immagino. Quando si dice “sputare nel piatto in cui si mangia”, eh?
Key.Polish: Pewnie za sporą kasę. To jak gryźć rękę, która cię karmi.
Key.Russian: Явно втридорога. Пилят сук, на котором сами же и сидят.
Key.German: Und ich wette, das wird nicht günstig. So viel zu der Hand, die dich füttert, was?
Key.Czech: To se pěkně prohnou. Tady si někdo pěkně přihřál polívčičku.
Key.English: For a price, I bet. Talk about biting the hand that feeds you, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Por um puta preço, aposto. Isso que é morder a mão que te alimenta, né?
Key.Korean: 돈 꽤나 줘야 할 걸? 은혜를 이런 식으로 갚다니.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那要付出代价的，我敢肯定。这就是忘恩负义吧，嗯？
Key.Japanese: 高額でだろうな。飼い犬に手を噛まれるとはこういうことか。
Key.Turkish: Bahse girerim çok pahalıdır. Besle kargayı oysun gözünü, değil mi?

Container.name: 004_am_idap_worker_b
Container.situation: workerd talks about the mysterious malaria virus.

Key.Original: What?
Key.French: Hein ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Qué?
Key.Italian: Che cosa?
Key.German: Was?
Key.English: What?
Key.Portuguese: Como?
Key.Japanese: 何ダッテ？

Key.Original: I shit you not, I left him for like a couple of minutes, came back with an RDT and...
Key.Chinese: 不騙你，我離開他幾分鐘，帶個快速診斷測試回來，然後…
Key.French: Je déconne pas, je suis parti deux minutes, je reviens avec un test paludique et...
Key.Spanish: No estoy de coña, lo dejé solo un par de minutos, volví con una prueba de diagnóstico rápido y...
Key.Italian: Non sto dicendo una cazzata. Sono andato via un paio di minuti, ritornato con un test di diagnosi rapida e...
Key.Polish: No mówię ci, zostawiłem go na kilka minut, wracam z testem, a on…
Key.Russian: Я те говорю, я оставил его всего на пару минут, возвращаюсь с БДТ...
Key.German: Kein Scherz: Ich habe ihn ein paar Minuten alleine gelassen, um einen Schnelldiagnosetest zu holen und ...
Key.Czech: Nekecám ti. Na chvíli ho tam nechám, pak se vrátím s testem na malárii a...
Key.English: I shit you not, I left him for like a couple of minutes, came back with an RDT and...
Key.Portuguese: Não tô de brincadeira: larguei ele por alguns minutos, daí voltei com um relatório médico e...
Key.Korean: 정말 심각해. 기껏해야 몇 분 동안 두고 말라리아 신속진단검사기를 가져왔는데...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我可没忽悠你，我离开他两分钟的样子，拿了 RDT 试剂回来，然后...
Key.Japanese: 本当ダ。ホンノ数分席ヲ立ッテ、RDT ヲ持ッテ戻ッテキタラ...
Key.Turkish: İnan bana, onu birkaç dakikalığına yalnız bıraktım. Bir RDT ile geri döndüm ve...

Key.Original: Boom, he's burning up.
Key.French: Boum, il avait déjà la fièvre.
Key.Spanish: Bum, estaba ardiendo.
Key.Italian: Boom, scottava.
Key.German: Plötzlich stirbt er mir weg.
Key.English: Boom, he's burning up.
Key.Portuguese: Já era, ele tava queimando.
Key.Japanese: 彼ハ高熱ヲ出シテタ。

Key.Original: I had about enough time to call the CMO before he, y'know...
Key.Chinese: 我才剛剛給主軍醫打通電話，結果這就…
Key.French: J'ai à peine eu le temps d'appeler le médecin avant que, tu vois...
Key.Spanish: Apenas tuve tiempo para llamar al oficial médico antes de que, ya sabes...
Key.Italian: Ho avuto giusto il tempo di chiamare il capo del servizio medico prima che, insomma...
Key.Polish: Zdążyłem tylko wezwać lekarza, a już za chwilę on, no wiesz…
Key.Russian: Я только и успел что позвать главврача, прежде чем он того...
Key.German: Ich konnte gerade noch den CMO erreichen, bevor er ... du weißt schon ...
Key.Czech: Sotva se mi povedlo zavolat doktora, než... však víš.
Key.English: I had about enough time to call the CMO before he, y'know...
Key.Portuguese: Só tive tempo suficiente pra ligar para o diretor médico antes de ele...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我倒是来得及呼叫 CMO，可他，你懂的...
Key.Japanese: スグニ CMO ニ連絡シタンダガ、ソノ時ニハモウ...
Key.Turkish: Ondan önce CMO’yu arayacak kadar yeterli zamanım vardı, bilirsin...

Key.Original: And his skin - I mean, hell, it was practically peeling off.
Key.Chinese: 他的皮膚－－該死，居然開始剝落了。
Key.French: Et sa peau ! On aurait dit qu'elle se décollait.
Key.Spanish: Y su piel... Me cago en la puta, se le caía a jirones.
Key.Italian: E la pelle, diamine, stava praticamente venendo via dal corpo.
Key.Polish: A jego skóra… praktycznie schodziła płatami.
Key.Russian: Ты бы видел его кожу, — она практически слезла с него живьем.
Key.German: Und seine Haut hat sich nahezu abgeschält.
Key.Czech: A ta jeho kůže? Prakticky se loupal, do háje.
Key.English: And his skin - I mean, hell, it was practically peeling off.
Key.Portuguese: E a pele dele, porra, tava praticamente descascando.
Key.Korean: 그 친구 피부가... 말 그대로 벗겨지고 있었어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他的皮肤 - 老实说，见鬼，直往下掉。
Key.Japanese: 彼ノ皮膚ハボロボロニ剥ガレテタ。
Key.Turkish: Ve cildi. Yani, lanet olsun; cildi soyuluyordu onun.

Key.Original: Yeah. Does that sound anything like malaria to you?
Key.Chinese: 是啊 ，這聽起來像是瘧疾嗎？
Key.French: Ouais. Ça n'a rien à voir avec la malaria, si ?
Key.Spanish: Como lo oyes. ¿A ti te parece malaria?
Key.Italian: Già. Ti sembra malaria questa?
Key.Polish: No. Tak według ciebie wygląda malaria?
Key.Russian: Ага. Это по-твоему похоже на малярию?
Key.German: Ganz genau. Hört sich das für dich nach Malaria an?
Key.Czech: Jo. Tobě to snad připadá jako malárie?
Key.English: Yeah. Does that sound anything like malaria to you?
Key.Portuguese: É. Parece malária pra você?
Key.Korean: 그래. 네가 보기에도 이게 말라리아 같아?
Key.Chinesesimp: 对啊。你说这像虐疾的样子吗？
Key.Japanese: ソウナンダ。ソンナ症状ガ "マラリア" ニアルノカ？
Key.Turkish: Evet. Bu sana sıtma gibi mi geliyor?

Container.name: 003_am_idap_worker_a
Container.situation: workerc about the mysterious malaria virus.

Key.Original: I've seen malaria, man.
Key.French: Je connais la malaria, mec.
Key.Spanish: He visto la malaria, tío.
Key.Italian: So cos’è la malaria, amico.
Key.German: Mann, ich kenne Malaria.
Key.English: I've seen malaria, man.
Key.Portuguese: Eu já vi malária, cara.
Key.Japanese: "マラリア" ヲコノ目デ見タコトガアルンダ。

Key.Original: And it isn't this. You call it that and people don't panic...
Key.Chinese: 這可不是瘧疾；不過，這樣的叫法，大家才不會慌…
Key.French: Là, c'est différent. Tu dis "malaria" et personne ne panique...
Key.Spanish: Y esto no lo es. Si lo llamas malaria, no cunde el pánico...
Key.Italian: E non è questa. Se la chiami così, la gente non si fa prendere dal panico...
Key.Polish: To nie to. Ale ludzie nie panikują na wieść o malarii…
Key.Russian: И это не она. Назовешь ее так, и люди не будут паниковать...
Key.German: Und das ist keine. Bei Malaria bricht das Volk nicht in Panik aus ...
Key.Czech: A takhle rozhodně ne. Jenom tomu tak říkají, aby lidi nepanikařili.
Key.English: And it isn't this. You call it that and people don't panic...
Key.Portuguese: E não é como isso aqui. Você fala sobre ela e as pessoas não entram em pânico...
Key.Korean: 이건 말라리아가 아니야. 말라리아라고 하면 사람들이 당황하지 않으니까 그냥 그렇게 부르는 것뿐이지...
Key.Chinesesimp: 虐疾不是这个样子。但是，这样叫，它就不会引起恐慌...
Key.Japanese: コンナ症状ジャナイ。コレヲ "マラリア" トハ呼ンデルガ、ソレハ住人ガ "パニック" ニ陥ラナイヨウニダ...
Key.Turkish: Ve bu sıtma değil. Siz buna sıtma dediğiniz için insanlar panik olmuyor.

Key.Original: But call it a killer virus, with no known cure? Yeah, then...
Key.Chinese: 要是叫它「沒藥救的殺人病毒」？那就…
Key.French: Si tu dis "virus mortel sans antidote", alors là...
Key.Spanish: Pero si lo llamas virus mortal sin cura conocida, entonces...
Key.Italian: Ma non appena la chiami “virus killer senza cura conosciuta”? Beh, allora...
Key.Polish: A jak usłyszą, że to zabójczy wirus i nie ma na to lekarstwa…
Key.Russian: Но стоит только назвать это неизлечимым вирусом-убийцей и тогда, да...
Key.German: Aber bei einem Killer-Virus ohne Gegenmittel? Da geht die Post ab ...
Key.Czech: Kdyby se řeklo, že je to smrtící virus a není na něj lék? Tak to pak...
Key.English: But call it a killer virus, with no known cure? Yeah, then...
Key.Portuguese: Mas se você chamar de vírus assassino, sem cura conhecida? Aí sim...
Key.Korean: 하지만 치료약도 없는 죽음의 바이러스라고 하면 어떨까? 그럼...
Key.Chinesesimp: 但是，把它说成无药可治的致命病毒？嗯，那可就...
Key.Japanese: コレヲ殺人 "ウィルス" ナンテ呼ンデ、シカモ治療薬ガナイト知レタラ、ドンナ混乱ガ起コルカ...
Key.Turkish: Peki ya bunun öldürücü virüs olduğunu ve tedavisinin olmadığını söylerseniz? Evet, o zaman...

Key.Original: Then you got a problem!
Key.French: Ça devient un vrai problème !
Key.Spanish: ¡Entonces tienes un problema!
Key.Italian: Allora le cose cambiano!
Key.German: Dann hast du ein Problem!
Key.English: Then you got a problem!
Key.Portuguese: Aí você tem um problema!
Key.Korean: 그럼 문제가 보통 심각한 게 아니라고!
Key.Japanese: ソレコソ手ニ負エナイゾ！

Container.name: 002_am_oreokastro_priest
Container.situation: civilianb talks to civiliana about a priest helping the sick on tanoa.

Key.Original: So, he's been around the outbreaks?
Key.Chinese: 所以，他和疫情有所接觸？
Key.French: Il a été en contact avec l'épidémie ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Entonces ha estado donde los brotes?
Key.Italian: Quindi è stato in mezzo ai focolai epidemici?
Key.Polish: Czyli cały czas jest wśród chorych?
Key.Russian: Значит он был здесь, когда начались вспышки?
Key.German: War er denn in den infizierten Gebieten unterwegs?
Key.English: So, he's been around the outbreaks?
Key.Portuguese: Então, ele esteve por perto dos surtos?
Key.Korean: 그러니까 전염병 환자들이랑 같이 생활하고 있는 거야?
Key.Chinesesimp: 这么说，他一直在和瘟疫打交道？
Key.Japanese: ソレジャ、蔓延シタ時ニソノ付近ニイタッテコトカ？
Key.Turkish: O halde salgınların olduğu yerlerin civarında mıydı?

Key.Original: Maybe he's blessed?
Key.French: Il est béni ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Igual tiene una bendición?
Key.Italian: Forse è benedetto?
Key.German: Vielleicht wurde er gesegnet?
Key.English: Maybe he's blessed?
Key.Portuguese: Será que ele é abençoado?
Key.Japanese: 神ノゴ加護ガアルッテコトジャナイカ？

Key.Original: Really, I mean it.
Key.French: Je te jure.
Key.Spanish: Te lo digo en serio.
Key.Italian: Dico sul serio.
Key.German: Ich mein das ernst.
Key.English: Really, I mean it.
Key.Portuguese: Sério mesmo.
Key.Japanese: 本当ナンダ。

Key.Original: He must be immune or something. The guy's been administering last rites for like, a month.
Key.Chinese: 他肯定自帶免疫功能；那傢伙一個月以來一直在辦葬禮。
Key.French: Il doit être immunisé. Ça fait un mois qu'il donne les derniers sacrements.
Key.Spanish: Tiene que ser inmune o algo. Llevan dando extremaunciones, en plan, un mes.
Key.Italian: Deve essere immune o qualcosa del genere. Quel tizio sta dando estreme unzioni da circa un mese.
Key.Polish: Musi być odporny czy coś. Facet udziela sakramentów ostatniego namaszczenia już jakoś z miesiąc.
Key.Russian: У него наверное иммунитет или что-то типа того. Он проводил последние обряды около месяца.
Key.German: Er muss immun sein oder sowas. Der Typ hat schon seit einem Monat die letzte Ölung bei Leuten durchgeführt.
Key.Czech: Musí být imunní nebo co já vím. Dává jim poslední pomazání už jak dlouho... měsíc?
Key.English: He must be immune or something. The guy's been administering last rites for like, a month.
Key.Portuguese: Ele deve ser imune ou algo assim. O cara já tá administrando extrema unção há mais de mês.
Key.Korean: 아마 무슨 면역이라도 있는 것 같아. 그 사람 거의 한 달 동안 종부성사를 행하고 있거든.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他一定是有免疫力还是怎么着。这家伙一直在给人做临终圣礼，好像有一个月了。
Key.Japanese: 彼ハ免疫カナンカガアルンダ。臨終ノ秘跡ヲモウ 1 カ月クライヤッテルンダヨ。
Key.Turkish: Bağışıklığı falan olmalı. Adam bir ay gibi bir süredir son törenleri yönetiyor.

Key.Original: Sant Georgioupolis... what is that? Greek? It sounds familiar.
Key.Chinese: Sant Georgioupolis…那是什麼？希臘文？感覺有些熟悉…
Key.French: Saint-Georgioupolis... C'est grec ? Ça me dit quelque chose.
Key.Spanish: Sant Georgioupolis... ¿Qué es, griego? Me suena de algo.
Key.Italian: Sant Georgioupolis... cos’è? Greco? Mi suona familiare.
Key.Polish: Święty Georgioupolis… to z greckiego? Brzmi znajomo.
Key.Russian: Сант-Георгиуполис... чье это имя? Греческое? Где-то я его уже слышал.
Key.German: St. Georgioupolis ... ist das Griechisch? Kommt mir bekannt vor.
Key.Czech: Sant Georgioupolis... co to je? Něco řeckýho? Zní to povědomě.
Key.English: Sant Georgioupolis... what is that? Greek? It sounds familiar.
Key.Portuguese: Sant Georgioupolis... o que é isso? Grego? Soa familiar.
Key.Korean: 생 게오르기우폴리스... 어디 출신이지? 그리스인인가? 왠지 익숙한 이름인데.
Key.Chinesesimp: Sant Georgioupolis...那是什么？希腊语？听起来挺熟的。
Key.Japanese: オイ... アレハ何ダ？ギリシャ語カ？聞キ覚エガアルナ。
Key.Turkish: Sant Georgioupolis... O da ne? Yunanca mı? Tanıdık geliyor.

Key.Original: Oui - I mean, how he's still alive, it's a miracle.
Key.Chinese: Oui－－真不知道他怎麼還活著，根本就是奇蹟。
Key.French: Oui. C'est un miracle qu'il soit encore vivant.
Key.Spanish: Oui... Y, a ver, ¿cómo es que sigue vivo? Es un milagro.
Key.Italian: Oui. Cioè, è un miracolo che sia ancora vivo.
Key.Polish: Oui. To normalnie cud, że wciąż żyje.
Key.Russian: Уи, я диву даюсь, как он не умер. Это настоящее чудо.
Key.German: Oui, es ist ein Wunder, dass er noch am Leben ist.
Key.Czech: Oui. Je zázrak, že ještě žije.
Key.English: Oui - I mean, how he's still alive, it's a miracle.
Key.Portuguese: Oui, quer dizer, o fato de ainda estar vivo é um milagre.
Key.Chinesesimp: 噢 - 我是说，他怎么活下来的，这是个奇迹。
Key.Japanese: ウィー。マダ生キテルナンテ奇跡ダヨ。
Key.Turkish: Oui! Yani, artık nasıl hayatta kaldıysa, bu bir mucize.

Key.Original: Maybe. Or cursed. Pauvre bâtard. He seen a lotta death.
Key.Chinese: 或許，他是被詛咒了。Pauvre bâtard，見了這麼多死亡的景象。
Key.French: Ou maudit. Pauvre bâtard. Il en aura vu, des morts.
Key.Spanish: Igual. O una maldición. Pauvre bâtard. Ha visto morir a muchos.
Key.Italian: Forse. Oppure maledetto. Pauvre bâtard. Ne ha visti di morti.
Key.Polish: Albo przeklął. Pauvre bâtard. Ten człowiek widział dużo śmierci.
Key.Russian: Может быть да. Или проклят. Повр батар. Он видел много смертей.
Key.German: Oder verflucht, pauvre bâtard. Er hat viele Tote gesehen.
Key.Czech: Možná. Anebo kletbu. Pauvre bâtard. Viděl spoustu mrtvých.
Key.English: Maybe. Or cursed. Pauvre bâtard. He seen a lotta death.
Key.Portuguese: Talvez. Ou amaldiçoado. Pauvre bâtard. Ele viu morte pra caralho.
Key.Korean: 그럴 수도 있지. 저주 받았을 수도 있고. 뽀브르 바타르. 사람들이 죽어나가는 걸 수도 없이 봤을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 或许吧。也可以说在折磨他。可怜的混蛋。他经常看到死人的事情。
Key.Japanese: カモナ。ソレカ呪ワレテルカ。ブーブレ・バター。何度モ死ヲ見テキタンダロウ。
Key.Turkish: Belki. Ya da lanetlidir. Pauvre bâtard. Bir sürü ölüm gördü.

Key.Original: Church should have him canonisé or, I dunno. Paid more.
Key.Chinese: 這教會應該給他個 canonisé 一下，不然給他加個薪。
Key.French: L'Église devrait le canoniser. Ou mieux le payer.
Key.Spanish: La Iglesia debería canonizarlo o... yo qué sé, pagarle más.
Key.Italian: Meriterebbe di essere canonisé dalla Chiesa, o non so... essere pagato di più.
Key.Polish: Powinni go kanonizować. Albo nie wiem, dać podwyżkę.
Key.Russian: Как по мне, церковь должна его канонизировать, ну или платить ему больше.
Key.German: Die Kirche sollte ihn heilig sprechen ... oder sein Gehalt erhöhen.
Key.Czech: Církev by ho měla canonisé, nebo nevím. Víc mu platit.
Key.English: Church should have him canonisé or, I dunno. Paid more.
Key.Portuguese: A igreja devia canoniser ele, sabe. Ou pagar mais.
Key.Korean: 교회에서 성인으로 지정하던가, 돈을 더 주던가 해야 할 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 教堂应该封他为圣者，或者，我不知道。给他加工资。
Key.Japanese: 教会ハ彼ヲ聖人ニスルトカ、給料ヲ上ゲルトカシテヤルベキダヨ。
Key.Turkish: Kilise onu canonisé yapmalıydı ya da daha fazla ödemeliydi; bilmiyorum.

Container.name: 001_am_croconeels_ranch
Container.situation: civilianb talks to civiliana about syndikat becoming a political force on tanoa.

Key.Original: Because they got guns? Voyons donc!
Key.Chinese: 就因為他們有槍？ Voyons donc！
Key.French: Parce qu'ils ont des flingues ? Voyons donc !
Key.Spanish: ¿Porque tienen armas? Voyons donc!
Key.Italian: Perché hanno delle armi? Voyons donc!
Key.Russian: Потому что у них есть оружие? Войон донк!
Key.German: Nur weil sie Waffen haben? Voyons donc!
Key.English: Because they got guns? Voyons donc!
Key.Portuguese: Por que eles têm armas? Voyons donc!
Key.Korean: 총 들고 다닌다고 그렇게 생각하는 거야? 웃기지 좀 마!
Key.Japanese: 銃ヲ持ッテルカラカ？ボヨン・ドンク！
Key.Turkish: Silahları olduğu için mi? Voyons donc!

Key.Original: Es-tu sérieux, mec ?
Key.French: Es-tu sérieux, mec ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Estás de coña, mec?
Key.Italian: Dici sul serio, mec?
Key.German: Ist das dein Ernst, mec?
Key.English: You serious, mec?
Key.Portuguese: Tá falando sério, mec?
Key.Japanese: 本気カ？

Key.Original: L'Ensemble are Syndikat thugs.
Key.Chinese: L'Ensemble 就是一堆 Syndikat 的流氓。
Key.French: L'Ensemble, c'est juste des brigands du Syndikat.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble son matones del Syndikat.
Key.Italian: Quelli dell’Ensemble sono delinquenti Syndikat.
Key.German: L'Ensemble sind Syndikat-Schläger.
Key.English: L'Ensemble are Syndikat thugs.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble são bandidos do Syndikat.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会是一伙 Syndikat 匪徒。
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ハ Syndikat ノ "ゴロツキ" ダ。

Key.Original: Merde alors - I take my kids there!
Key.Chinese: Merde alors－－我常帶我的孩子們去那裡呢！
Key.French: Merde alors ! J'y vais avec mes gamins !
Key.Spanish: Merde alors... ¡si llevo allí a mis chavales!
Key.Italian: Merde alors, ci porto i miei figli lì!
Key.Polish: Merde alors – ja tam dzieci zabieram!
Key.Russian: Мьерде алор, я водил туда своих детей!
Key.German: Merde alors, da gehe ich immer mit meinen Kindern hin!
Key.Czech: Merde alors. Tam chodím s dětma!
Key.English: Merde alors - I take my kids there!
Key.Portuguese: Merde alors, eu costumo levar meus filhos lá!
Key.Korean: 맙소사, 거기 우리 애들도 데리고 가는데!
Key.Chinesesimp: Merde alors - 我经常带孩子去那儿！
Key.Japanese: メルド・アロール。ヨクアソコニ子供ヲ連レテ行クノニ！
Key.Turkish: Merde alors; oraya çocuklarımı götürüyorum ben!

Key.Original: Non, because they don't do politique - you remember that parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons...?
Key.Chinese: 不，因為他們不搞政治，你記得那個反對黨新視野…？
Key.French: Parce qu'ils font pas dans la politique. Tu connais le parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons ?
Key.Spanish: No , porque no se meten en política... ¿Recuerdas aquel parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons...?
Key.Italian: Non, perché non fanno politique. Ricordi quel parti d’opposition, Nouveaux Horizons...?
Key.Polish: Non, bo nie robią politique. Pamiętasz tę parti d’opposition, Nouveaux Horizons…?
Key.Russian: Нет, потому что они вне политики. Помнишь, была такая парти д'опозисьон «Нуво Оризон»...?
Key.German: Non, weil sie sich über die Politik hinwegsetzen. Erinnerst du dich noch an diese parti d‘opposition, Nouveaux Horizons?
Key.Czech: Non, protože nedělají politique. Pamatuješ tu parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons...?
Key.English: Non, because they don't do politique - you remember that parti d'opposition, Nouveaux Horizons...?
Key.Portuguese: Não, porque não se envolvem com política. Lembra aquele parti d'opposition, o New Horizons...?
Key.Korean: 아냐. 왜냐하면 놈들은 정치따윈 안 하거든. 반대당 누보 호라이즌 기억해...?
Key.Chinesesimp: 不，因为他们不掺和政治 - 你记得反对党新视野吗...？
Key.Japanese: ノン。"ポリティーク" ガ通用シナイカラダ。"パルティ・ドポジション" ノ "ニューヴォ・オリゾン" ヲ覚エテルカ...？
Key.Turkish: Non, çünkü onlar politika yapmıyor. Şu d'opposition partisi, Nouveaux Horizons var ya, hatırlıyor musun?

Key.Original: There a good reason they don't make no trouble no more.
Key.Chinese: 他們現在不再惹麻煩，也不是沒有原因的。
Key.French: C'est pas pour rien qu'ils font profil bas.
Key.Spanish: Hay buenas razones por las que ya no montan jaleo.
Key.Italian: C’è una buona ragione per cui non crea più casini.
Key.Polish: Nie bez powodu nie ma już z nimi kłopotów.
Key.Russian: Про них давно ничего не слышно, и на это есть причины.
Key.German: Es gibt einen guten Grund dafür, dass die keinen Stress mehr machen.
Key.Czech: Tak hádej, proč už dneska nedělá problémy.
Key.English: There a good reason they don't make no trouble no more.
Key.Portuguese: Não é à toa que não causa mais nenhum problema.
Key.Korean: 놈들이 더 이상 말썽을 일으키지 않는 이유가 있지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们现在不会再添乱了，但也不是没有原因的。
Key.Japanese: アイツラガ問題ヲ起コサナクナッタノニハ理由ガアルンダ。
Key.Turkish: Artık daha fazla sorun çıkarmamaları için iyi bir neden var.

Key.Original: That psycho, Samjo?
Key.French: Ce taré de Samjo...
Key.Spanish: ¿Te suena el pirado de Samjo?
Key.Italian: Quel pazzo, Samjo...
Key.Russian: Знаешь, что сделал этот псих Самджо?
Key.German: Samjo, dieser Psychopath ...
Key.English: That psycho, Samjo?
Key.Portuguese: Aquele psicopata, o Samjo?
Key.Japanese: アノイカレタ "サムジョ" カ？

Key.Original: He fed their main man to the crocos at Croconeel's. Bit by bit.
Key.Chinese: 他把他們的老大大卸八塊，然後丟到鱷魚池裡去餵鱷魚。
Key.French: Il a donné leur chef à bouffer aux crocos de Croconeel.
Key.Spanish: Echó al jefe del partido a los cocodrilos en Croconeel's. A trocitos.
Key.Italian: Ha dato in pasto il loro leader ai coccodrilli del Croconeel’s. Pezzo per pezzo.
Key.Polish: Nakarmił ich szefem krokodyle w Croconeel’s. Po kawałeczku.
Key.Russian: Скормил лидера их партии крокодилам на ранчо «Кроконил». Кусок за куском.
Key.German: Er hat ihren Spitzenkandidaten Stück für Stück an die Krokodile bei Croconeel‘s verfüttert.
Key.Czech: Předhodil jejich šéfa krokodýlům na Croconeelově farmě. Po kouskách.
Key.English: He fed their main man to the crocos at Croconeel's. Bit by bit.
Key.Portuguese: Ele jogou o principal subordinado dele pros crocodilos no Croconeel. Pedacinho por pedacinho.
Key.Korean: 놈이 반대당 대표를 크로코닐의 악어 밥으로 만들었지. 사지를 잘라서 말이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他在鳄鱼潭把他们的头儿大卸八块。一块一块丢去喂鳄鱼了。
Key.Japanese: 幹部ノヤツヲ "クロコネールス" デ "クロコダイル" ノ餌ニシタラシイ。体部ヲ 1 ツ 1 ツナ。
Key.Turkish: Baş adamlarını Croconeel’s’te timsahlara yem ettiler. Hem de parça parça.

Key.Original: Stop and get out, now!
Key.French: Stop. Sors de là. Tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Para y sal ya mismo!
Key.Italian: Fermati ed esci fuori, adesso!
Key.Russian: Живо остановился и вышел из машины!
Key.German: Anhalten und aussteigen – sofort!
Key.English: Stop and get out, now!
Key.Portuguese: Pare e saia agora!
Key.Japanese: 止マレ。降リロ。今スグダ！

Key.Original: So, whatever you want, we got it...
Key.French: J'ai tout ce que tu veux...
Key.Spanish: Lo que quieras, lo tenemos...
Key.Italian: Qualsiasi cosa tu voglia, noi ce l’abbiamo...
Key.Russian: У нас есть все, что тебе нужно...
Key.German: Was immer du brauchst – wir haben es ...
Key.English: So, whatever you want, we got it...
Key.Portuguese: Então, o que você quiser, nós conseguimos...
Key.Korean: 뭘 원하든지 다 구해줄 수 있어요...
Key.Chinesesimp: 嗯，你要什么，我们就有什么...
Key.Japanese: 何デモ必要ナモノハ揃ッテルゾ...

Key.Original: Hey, out the vehicle, mec.
Key.French: Hé, sors du véhicule, mec.
Key.Spanish: Eh, fuera del vehículo, mec.
Key.Italian: Ehi, fuori dal veicolo, mec.
Key.Russian: А ну вышел из машины, мэк.
Key.German: Hey, aussteigen, mec.
Key.Czech: Hej, vystup z toho auta, mec.
Key.English: Hey, out the vehicle, mec.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, saia do veículo, mec.
Key.Japanese: オイ、車カラ降リロ。

Key.Original: If you need guns, no problem.
Key.French: S'il te faut des flingues, pas de problème.
Key.Spanish: Si necesitas armas, no hay problema.
Key.Italian: Se hai bisogno di armi, nessun problema.
Key.German: Du brauchst Waffen? Kein Problem.
Key.English: If you need guns, no problem.
Key.Portuguese: Se precisar de armas, sem problema.
Key.Japanese: 銃ガ必要ナラアル。
Key.Turkish: Silaha ihtiyacın varsa, hiç sorun değil.

Key.Original: Okay, il n'écoute pas. Tue-le !
Key.French: Okay, il n'écoute pas. Tue-le !
Key.Spanish: Vale, no hace caso. ¡Acabad con él!
Key.Italian: Okay, non ci ascolta. Fatelo fuori!
Key.Polish: Dobra, nie słucha się. Załatwić go!
Key.Russian: Так, он не слушает. Стреляй в него!
Key.German: Okay, er hört nicht hin. Schalte ihn aus!
Key.English: Okay, he's not listening. Take him out!
Key.Portuguese: Ok, ele não tá ouvindo. Acaba com ele!
Key.Japanese: アイツ、聞イテナイナ。殺セ！

Key.Original: See anything you want?
Key.French: Y'a un truc qui te plaît ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Ves algo que te guste?
Key.Italian: Vedi qualcosa che ti interessa?
Key.German: Ist was Interessantes dabei?
Key.English: See anything you want?
Key.Portuguese: Achou algo que deseja?
Key.Japanese: ホシイモノガ見ツカッタカ？
Key.Turkish: İstediğin herhangi bir şeyi görüyor musun?

Key.Original: Descendez le conducteur !
Key.French: Descendez le conducteur !
Key.Spanish: ¡Disparad al conductor!
Key.Italian: Sparate all’autista!
Key.German: Erschieße den Fahrer!
Key.English: Shoot the driver!
Key.Portuguese: Atira no motorista!
Key.Japanese: 運転手ヲ撃テ！

Key.Original: As you can see, patron... there's not much we can't get, eh?
Key.Chinese: 你看吧，夥計…沒什麼我們弄不到手的東西，對吧？
Key.French: Tu as vu, patron, on peut tout avoir, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Como ves, patron... podemos conseguir casi de todo, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Come puoi notare, patron... non c’è cosa che non possiamo procurarci, eh?
Key.Polish: Jak widzisz, drogi kliencie… wszystko możemy załatwić.
Key.Russian: Как видишь, патрон, мы можем достать что угодно.
Key.German: Wie du siehst, patron ... haben wir so ziemlich alles auf Lager.
Key.Czech: Jak vidíš, kamaráde, dokážeme sehnat prakticky cokoli.
Key.English: As you can see, patron... there's not much we can't get, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Como pode ver, patron... Não tem muita coisa que a gente não consiga, né?
Key.Korean: 보시다시피... 우리가 구하지 못하는 건 거의 없거든요?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你瞧瞧，伙计...我们基本上什么都有，是吧？
Key.Japanese: 見テノ通リダ、オ客サン... 手ニ入ラナイモノハホトンドナイ。
Key.Turkish: Gördüğün gibi, patron... Elde edemeyeceğimiz pek bir şey yok, ha?

Key.Original: Restricted area, soldier-man. No place for you.
Key.Chinese: 限制區域，士兵。你不該來這裡。
Key.French: Zone interdite, soldat. T'as rien à faire là.
Key.Spanish: Esto es zona restringida, soldado. No es tu sitio.
Key.Italian: Zona ad accesso limitato, soldato. Non è il posto per te.
Key.Polish: To strefa strzeżona, żołnierzu, nie masz tu wstępu.
Key.Russian: Это запретная зона, солдат. Тебе вход запрещен.
Key.German: Sperrgebiet, Soldat. Du bist hier falsch.
Key.English: Restricted area, soldier-man. No place for you.
Key.Portuguese: Área restrita, soldado. Não é lugar pra você.
Key.Korean: 제한구역이야, 군인 양반. 네가 있을 곳이 아니라고.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这是禁区，老兄。闲人免进。
Key.Japanese: 立入禁止エリアダ。兵士サンヨ。オ前ノ来テイイ場所ジャナイ。
Key.Turkish: Yasak bölge, asker adam. Senin için uygun bir yer değil.

Key.Original: Tanoa Tower to Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, you're clear to land.
Key.Chinese: 塔諾雅塔台呼叫 JSO15N，准許降落。
Key.French: Tour de Tanoa pour César Juliette Sierra Oscar 1-5 Novembre, vous avez l'autorisation d'atterrir.
Key.Spanish: Torre de Tanoa a César Julieta Sierra Óscar Uno Cinco Noviembre: Ya puede aterrizar.
Key.Italian: Torre di controllo di Tanoa a Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, siete autorizzati ad atterrare.
Key.Polish: Wieża Tanoa do Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, możesz lądować.
Key.Russian: Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, это Башня Таноа, посадку разрешаем.
Key.German: Tanoa Tower an Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November: Landeerlaubnis erteilt.
Key.Czech: Řídicí věž Tanoa volá Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar Jedna Pět November. Můžete jít na přistání.
Key.English: Tanoa Tower to Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, you're clear to land.
Key.Portuguese: Torre de Tanoa para Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, permissão para pousar concedida.
Key.Korean: 타노아 관제탑에서 시저 JSO15N에게 전달한다. 착륙을 허가한다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 突瓦纳加塔台呼叫 Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November，准许着陆。
Key.Japanese: タノアタワーカラ、"シーザー・ジュリエット・シエラ・オスカー・ワン・ファイブ・ノーベンバー" ヘ。着陸許可ガ下リテイル。
Key.Turkish: Tanoa Kulesi’nden Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November’e, iniş yapabilirsiniz.

Key.Original: This no place for you. Dégage!
Key.Chinese: 這裡不是你該來的地方，快滾！
Key.French: T'as rien à foutre là. Dégage !
Key.Spanish: Aquí no pintas nada. Dégage!
Key.Italian: Questo non è il posto per te. Dégage!
Key.Polish: To nie miejsce dla ciebie. Dégage!
Key.German: Du bist hier ganz falsch. Dégage!
Key.English: This no place for you. Dégage!
Key.Portuguese: Este não é um lugar para você. Dégage!
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ来テイイ場所ジャナイゾ。ディガージ！
Key.Turkish: Burası sana uygun bir yer değil. Dégage!

Key.Original: Lijnhaven Tower to Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, you're clear to land.
Key.Chinese: Lijnhaven 塔台呼叫 JSO15N，准許降落。
Key.French: Tour de Lijnhaven pour César Juliette Sierra Oscar 1-5 Novembre, vous avez l'autorisation d'atterrir.
Key.Spanish: Torre de Lijnhaven a César Julieta Sierra Óscar Uno Cinco Noviembre: Ya puede aterrizar.
Key.Italian: Torre di controllo di Lijnhaven a Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, siete autorizzati ad atterrare.
Key.Polish: Wieża Lijnhaven do Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, możesz lądować.
Key.Russian: Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, это Башня Лайнхейвен, посадку разрешаем.
Key.German: Lijnhaven Tower an Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November: Landeerlaubnis erteilt.
Key.Czech: Řídicí věž Lijnhaven volá Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar Jedna Pět November. Můžete jít na přistání.
Key.English: Lijnhaven Tower to Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, you're clear to land.
Key.Portuguese: Torre de Lijnhaven para Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, permissão para pousar concedida.

Key.Turkish: Lijnhaven Kulesi’nden Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November’e, iniş yapabilirsiniz.

Key.Original: This L'Ensemble land, mec. Foutre le camp, eh ?
Key.Chinese: 這是 L'Ensemble 島，夥計。給我滾，明白？
Key.French: C'est le territoire de l'Ensemble, mec. Foutez le camp.
Key.Spanish: Esto es territorio de L'Ensemble, mec. Foutez le camp.
Key.Italian: Questo è il territorio de L’Ensemble, mec. Foutez le camp.
Key.Polish: To teren L’Ensemble, mec. Foutez le camp.
Key.Russian: Это земля Л'Енсабля, мэк. Иди нахер, понял?
Key.German: Du solltest dich aus diesem L'Ensemble-Revier verziehen, mec.
Key.Czech: Tohle je území L'Ensemble, mec. Foutez le camp.
Key.English: This L'Ensemble land, mec. Fuck off, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Aqui é terra de L'Ensemble, mec. Foutez le camp.
Key.Korean: 이 땅은 ‘앙상블’ 소유다, 멕. 꺼시지시, 허?
Key.Chinesesimp: 这是大帮会的地盘，伙计。滚开，嗯？
Key.Japanese: ココハ "ランサンブル" ノ "ナワバリ" ダ。出テイケ。
Key.Turkish: Burası L'Ensemble toprakları, mec. Foutez le camp.

Key.Russian: Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, это Башня Рошель, посадку разрешаем.
Key.German: Rochelle Tower an Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November: Landeerlaubnis erteilt.

Key.Japanese: ロシェルタワーカラ、"シーザー・ジュリエット・シエラ・オスカー・ワン・ファイブ・ノーベンバー" ヘ。着陸許可ガ下リテイル。
Key.Turkish: Rochelle Kulesi’nden Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November’e, iniş yapabilirsiniz.

Key.Original: Hey, where the hell are you going! This area's off limits!
Key.Chinese: 喂，你是要去哪！這是禁區！
Key.French: Hé, qu'est-ce que tu fous là ? La zone est interdite !
Key.Spanish: ¿Adónde coño crees que vas? ¡Está prohibido el paso!
Key.Italian: Ehi, dove diavolo stai andando?! Quest’area è interdetta!
Key.Polish: Cholera jasna, dokąd to?! To teren strzeżony!
Key.Russian: Эй, куда, черт возьми, ты прёшь! Это запретная зона!
Key.German: Hey, wo zum Teufel willst du hin? Das hier ist ein Sperrgebiet!
Key.Czech: Hele, co to jako děláš? Tohle je zakázaná oblast.
Key.English: Hey, where the hell are you going! This area's off limits!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, onde diabos você tá indo? Esta área tá fora dos limites!
Key.Korean: 이봐. 여기서 뭐 하는 거야? 여긴 제한구역이라고!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你到底要去哪儿！这是禁区！
Key.Japanese: オイ、ドコニ行クツモリダ！？コノ "エリア" ハ立入禁止ダ！
Key.Turkish: Hey, hangi cehenneme gidiyorsun! Bu bölge yasak!

Key.Italian: Torre di controllo di Tanoa a Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, siete autorizzati a decollare.
Key.Polish: Wieża Tanoa do Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, możesz startować.
Key.Russian: Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November, это Башня Таноа, взлет разрешаем.
Key.German: Tanoa Tower an Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November: Starterlaubnis erteilt.

Key.Turkish: Tanoa Kulesi’nden Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November’e, kalkış yapabilirsiniz.

Key.Original: Get out of the vehicle, you can't be here!
Key.Chinese: 給我下車，你不能待在這裡！
Key.French: Descends du véhicule, t'as rien à faire là !
Key.Spanish: Sal del vehículo. ¡No puedes estar aquí!
Key.Italian: Esci da quel veicolo, non puoi stare qui!
Key.Polish: Opuść pojazd, nie masz tu wstępu!
Key.Russian: Вышел из машины, тебе нельзя здесь находиться!
Key.German: Steig aus, du hast hier nichts verloren!
Key.Czech: Vylez z toho auta. Sem nesmíš!
Key.English: Get out of the vehicle, you can't be here!
Key.Portuguese: Saia do veículo, você não pode permanecer aqui!
Key.Korean: 차에서 내려. 여긴 들어오면 안 돼!
Key.Chinesesimp: 从车里滚出来，这儿不能进来！
Key.Japanese: 車カラ降リロ！ココニ来ルベキジャナイゾ！

Key.Original: I don't recognize you - what are you doing here?
Key.Chinese: 我不認得你，你在這裡幹嘛？
Key.French: Je te connais pas. Qu'est-ce que tu fous là ?
Key.Spanish: No te reconozco... ¿qué haces aquí?
Key.Italian: Non ti riconosco. Che stai facendo qui?
Key.Polish: Nie kojarzę cię. Co tu robisz?
Key.Russian: Я тебя не знаю, что ты тут делаешь?
Key.German: Ich kenne dich nicht. Was hast du hier zu suchen?
Key.English: I don't recognize you - what are you doing here?
Key.Portuguese: Eu não te reconheço, o que você tá fazendo aqui?
Key.Korean: 처음 보는 얼굴인데. 여기서 뭐 하는 거야?
Key.Chinesesimp: 我不认识你 - 你在这儿干嘛？
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ顔ナンカ見タコトナイゾ。ココデ何ヲシテル？

Key.Original: Hey - who are you?
Key.French: Hé, t'es qui ?
Key.Spanish: Oye... ¿y tú quién eres?
Key.Italian: Ehi, e tu chi sei?
Key.German: Hey, wer bist du?
Key.English: Hey - who are you?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, quem é você?
Key.Japanese: オイ、オ前ハ誰ダ？

Key.Turkish: Tanoa Kulesi’nden Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November’e, iniş için izniniz yok.

Key.Chinese: 出現安全漏洞！響起警報！
Key.French: Brèche de sécurité ! Sonnez l'alarme !
Key.Spanish: ¡Violación de seguridad! ¡Dad la alarma!
Key.Italian: Violazione della sicurezza! Suonate l’allarme!
Key.German: Sicherheitsverstoß! Aktiviert den Alarm!
Key.English: Security breach! Sound the alarm!
Key.Portuguese: Falha de segurança! Toque o alarme!
Key.Chinesesimp: 安全防线被突破！发出警报！
Key.Japanese: 侵入者ダ！警報ヲ鳴ラセ！

Key.Spanish: Alarme! Alarme!

Key.German: Alarme! Alarme!

Key.Portuguese: Alarme! Alarme!
Key.Japanese: 警報！警報！

Key.Turkish: Rochelle Kulesi’nden Caesar Juliet Sierra Oscar One Five November’e, iniş için izniniz yok.

Key.Original: Merde ! Sonnez l'alarme !
Key.French: Merde ! Sonnez l'alarme !
Key.Spanish: ¡Mierda! ¡Dad la alarma!
Key.Italian: Merda! Suonate l’allarme!
Key.German: Scheiße! Aktiviert den Alarm!
Key.English: Shit! Sound the alarm!
Key.Portuguese: Merda! Toque o alarme!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！警報ヲ鳴ラセ！

Key.Original: Something you need?
Key.French: T'as besoin de quelque chose ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Necesitas algo?
Key.Italian: Hai bisogno di qualcosa?
Key.German: Brauchst du was?
Key.English: Something you need?
Key.Portuguese: Precisa de algo?
Key.Japanese: 必要ナモノハ何ダ？

Key.Original: Put that weapon down, mec!
Key.French: Baisse ton arme, mec !
Key.Spanish: ¡Deja esa arma, mec!
Key.Italian: Metti quell’arma a terra, mec!
Key.German: Waffe runter, mec!
Key.English: Put that weapon down, mec!
Key.Portuguese: Larga essa arma, mec!
Key.Japanese: ソノ武器ヲ置ケ！

Key.Original: What you looking for, eh?
Key.French: Tu cherches quoi ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Qué estás buscando, eh?
Key.Italian: Cosa stai cercando, eh?
Key.German: Was suchst du?
Key.English: What you looking for, eh?
Key.Portuguese: O que você tá procurando, hein?
Key.Japanese: 何ヲ探シテル？

Key.Original: Drop the weapon!
Key.French: Lâche ton arme !
Key.Spanish: ¡Suelta el arma!
Key.Italian: Getta l’arma!
