Key.German: Lass die Waffe fallen!
Key.English: Drop the weapon!
Key.Portuguese: Larga a arma!
Key.Japanese: 武器を置け！

Key.Original: Come on, see what's here...
Key.French: Regarde ce que j'ai.
Key.Spanish: Venga, mira lo que tengo...
Key.Italian: Forza, vieni a dare un’occhiata...
Key.Russian: Давай, посмотрим, что там у тебя...
Key.German: Wirf mal einen Blick darauf ...
Key.Czech: Tak se podívej, co tu mám.
Key.English: Come on, see what's here...
Key.Portuguese: Vamos lá, veja o que temos aqui...
Key.Korean: 여기 와서 뭐가 있는지 한번 봐요...
Key.Japanese: コッチニ来イ。見テイケ...

Key.Original: See you real soon, eh?
Key.French: À bientôt, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Nos vemos muy pronto, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ci vediamo molto presto, eh?
Key.German: Schau demnächst mal wieder vorbei, ok?
Key.English: See you real soon, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Vejo você em breve, hein?
Key.Japanese: マタ会オウ。

Key.Original: Come on, take a look.
Key.French: Jette un œil.
Key.Spanish: Venga, echa un vistazo.
Key.Italian: Avanti, vieni a dare un’occhiata.
Key.German: Werfen wir mal einen Blick darauf.
Key.English: Come on, take a look.
Key.Portuguese: Venha, vamos conferir.
Key.Japanese: サア、見テイケ。

Key.Original: Salut, mec.
Key.French: Salut, mec.
Key.Spanish: Salut, mec.
Key.Italian: Salut, mec.
Key.German: Salut, mec.
Key.English: Hi, mec.
Key.Portuguese: Salut, mec.
Key.Japanese: サリュー。

Key.Original: Take him out!
Key.French: Neutralisez-le !
Key.Spanish: ¡Acabad con él!
Key.Italian: Fatelo fuori!
Key.German: Schaltet ihn aus!
Key.English: Take him out!
Key.Portuguese: Acaba com ele!
Key.Japanese: あいつを殺せ！

Key.Original: Okay, see you later.
Key.French: OK, à plus tard.
Key.Spanish: Vale, nos vemos.
Key.Italian: Okay, ci vediamo.
Key.German: Okay, bis später.
Key.English: Okay, see you later.
Key.Portuguese: Ok, te vejo mais tarde.
Key.Japanese: ヨシ、マタナ。

Key.Original: He's hostile!
Key.French: Il est hostile !
Key.Spanish: ¡Es hostil!
Key.Italian: È un nemico!
Key.German: Ein Feind!
Key.English: He's hostile!
Key.Portuguese: Ele é hostil!
Key.Japanese: 敵ダ！

Key.Original: That it?
Key.French: C'est bon ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Eso es todo?
Key.Italian: Tutto qui?
Key.German: War‘s das?
Key.English: That it?
Key.Portuguese: Pronto?
Key.Japanese: ソレダケカ？

Key.Original: I'm engaging!
Key.French: J'engage !
Key.Spanish: ¡Voy a atacar!
Key.Italian: È sotto tiro!
Key.German: Ich greife an!
Key.English: I'm engaging!
Key.Portuguese: Tô atacando!
Key.Japanese: 射撃する！

Key.Original: You come back again, eh?
Key.French: Hésite pas à revenir !
Key.Spanish: Así que has vuelto, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Torna a trovarmi, eh?
Key.German: Schau demnächst mal wieder vorbei, ok?
Key.English: You come back again, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Você voltou, hein?
Key.Japanese: マタ来イ。

Key.Original: Open fire - take him down!
Key.French: Ouvrez le feu, abattez-le !
Key.Spanish: ¡Abrid fuego! ¡Acabad con él!
Key.Italian: Aprite il fuoco, eliminatelo!
Key.German: Feuer frei, macht ihn fertig!
Key.English: Open fire - take him down!
Key.Portuguese: Dispara, acaba com ele!
Key.Japanese: 撃テ！殺セ！

Key.Original: Hey. Comment ςa va ?
Key.French: Hey. Comment ςa va ?
Key.Spanish: Hola. ¿Cómo te va?
Key.Italian: Ehilà. Come te la passi?
Key.German: Hey, wie läuft‘s?
Key.English: Hey. How goes it?
Key.Portuguese: Ei. Como vão as coisas?
Key.Japanese: オイ。調子ハドウダ？

Key.Original: Alright, open up!
Key.French: OK, ouvrez le feu !
Key.Spanish: ¡Vale, abrid!
Key.Italian: Okay, aprire il fuoco!
Key.German: Alles klar, Feuer frei!
Key.English: Alright, open up!
Key.Portuguese: Certo, dispare!
Key.Japanese: よし、撃て！

Key.Original: Heya, gros dur. I'm open for business...
Key.French: Salut, gros dur. C'est ouvert...
Key.Spanish: Qué pasa, gros dur. Estoy disponible para hacer negocios...
Key.Italian: Ehilà, gros dur. Sono pronto a fare affari...
Key.Russian: Привет, грос дюр. Всегда рад помочь...
Key.German: Heya, gros dur. Ich bin bereit, Geschäfte zu machen ...
Key.English: Heya, gros dur. I'm open for business...
Key.Portuguese: Ei, gros dur. Estou aberto a negócios...
Key.Japanese: オイ、グロ・デュー。必要ナモノハアルカ...？
Key.Turkish: Heya, gros dur. İş tekliflerine açığım...

Key.Original: Intruder!
Key.French: Un intrus !
Key.Spanish: ¡Intruso!
Key.Italian: Intruso!
Key.German: Eindringling!
Key.English: Intruder!
Key.Portuguese: Intruso!
Key.Japanese: 侵入者だ！

Key.Original: Hey, salut.
Key.French: Hé, salut.
Key.Spanish: Hey, salut.
Key.Italian: Ehi, salut.
Key.German: Hey, salut.
Key.English: Hey, salut.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, salut.
Key.Japanese: オイ、サリュー。

Key.Original: He's an enemy agent - take him out!
Key.French: Un agent ennemi, neutralisez-le !
Key.Spanish: Es un agente enemigo... ¡acabad con él!
Key.Italian: È un agente nemico, neutralizzatelo!
Key.German: Er ist ein feindlicher Agent. Schaltet ihn aus!
Key.Czech: Je to nepřátelský agent. Zastřelte ho!
Key.English: He's an enemy agent - take him out!
Key.Portuguese: Ele é um agente inimigo, acaba com ele!
Key.Chinesesimp: 他是敌方特务 - 干掉他！
Key.Japanese: 敵の工作員だ。殺せ！
Key.Turkish: O bir düşman ajanı; öldür onu!

Key.Original: Good to see you.
Key.French: Content de te revoir.
Key.Spanish: Me alegro de verte.
Key.Italian: Felice di vederti.
Key.German: Salut, schön dich zu sehen.
Key.English: Good to see you.
Key.Portuguese: Bom te ver.
Key.Japanese: ヨク来タナ。

Key.Original: Tuvanaka Tower to unidentified aircraft, you're entering a restricted flight zone! Turn around immediately or you will be fired upon.
Key.Chinese: 土納萬卡塔台呼叫不明飛機，你進入了禁飛區！請立即返回，否則我們將向你開槍。
Key.French: Tour de Tuvanaka à avion non identifié, vous entrez dans une zone de survol réglementée. Changez de cap ou vous serez abattu.
Key.Spanish: Torre de Tuvanaka a aeronave no identificada: ¡está entrando en espacio aéreo restringido! Dé media vuelta de inmediato o abriremos fuego.
Key.Italian: Torre di controllo di Tuvanaka a velivolo non identificato, state entrando in una zona di volo vietata! Tornate immediatamente indietro o verrà aperto il fuoco.
Key.Polish: Wieża Tuvanaka do niezidentyfikowanego samolotu: wlatujesz do strefy strzeżonej! Natychmiast zawróć albo otworzymy ogień.
Key.Russian: Башня Туванака неопознанному самолету – вы вошли в ограниченную для полетов зону! Немедленно развернитесь, иначе мы откроем огонь.
Key.German: Tuvataka Tower an nicht identifiziertes Flugzeug: Sie fliegen in ein Sperrgebiet! Kehren Sie unverzüglich um, oder wir eröffnen das Feuer.
Key.Czech: Řídicí věž Tuvanaka neznámému letadlu. Vstupujete do bezletové zóny. Okamžitě se otočte, nebo začneme střílet.
Key.English: Tuvanaka Tower to unidentified aircraft, you're entering a restricted flight zone! Turn around immediately or you will be fired upon.
Key.Portuguese: Torre Tuvanaka para aeronave não identificada: você está entrando em uma zona de voo restrita! Retorne imediatamente ou vamos abrir fogo.
Key.Korean: 투바나카 탑에서 미확인 비행체에게 전달한다. 제한비행구역에 진입하고 있다! 즉시 경로를 돌리지 않으면 발포하겠다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 突瓦纳加塔台呼叫不明飞机，你即将进入限飞区！请马上掉头，否则我们就开火了。
Key.Japanese: トゥバナカタワーカラ未確認ノ飛行機ヘ。飛行制限区ニ入ロウトシテイルゾ！スグニ引キ返セ。デナケレバ、射撃スル。
Key.Turkish: Tuvanaka Kulesi’nden belirsiz uçağa; yasak bir uçuş bölgesine giriyorsunuz! Hemen geri dönün yoksa üzerinize ateş açılacaktır.

Key.Original: Hey, fous le camp - get outta here!
Key.French: Hé, fous le camp. Dégage de là !
Key.Spanish: Eh, fous le camp... ¡Fuera de aquí!
Key.Italian: Ehi! Fous le camp, sparisci!
Key.Polish: Hey, fous le camp – zmiataj stąd!
Key.Russian: Эй, фу ле кам! Проваливай отсюда!
Key.German: Hey, fous le camp – verschwinde!
Key.Czech: Hej, fous le camp. Koukej se klidit.
Key.English: Hey, fous le camp - get outta here!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, fous le camp. Saia daqui!
Key.Korean: 어이, 풀 르 컹! 여기서 꺼져!
Key.Japanese: オイ、フー・ル・カン。出テイケ！
Key.Turkish: Hey, fous le camp; defol buradan!

Key.Original: Attention, unidentified aircraft! You're approaching a no-fly zone. Turn around immediately or you will be fired upon.
Key.Chinese: 注意，不明飛機！你正在接近禁飛區。請立即返回，否則我們將會對你開槍。
Key.French: Attention, avion non identifié ! Vous approchez d'une zone d'exclusion aérienne ! Changez de cap ou on vous tirera dessus.
Key.Spanish: ¡Attention, aeronave no identificada! Se está aproximando a espacio aéreo restringido. Dé media vuelta de inmediato o abriremos fuego.
Key.Italian: Attenzione, velivolo non identificato! State entrando in una zona di interdizione aerea. Tornate immediatamente indietro o verrà aperto il fuoco.
Key.Polish: Uwaga, pilocie! Nie masz tu wstępu! Natychmiast zawróć albo otworzymy ogień.
Key.Russian: Внимание, неопознанный самолет! Вы приближается к бесполетной зоне. Немедленно развернитесь, иначе мы откроем огонь.
Key.German: Unidentifiziertes Flugzeug, bitte kommen! Sie nähern sich einem Sperrgebiet! Kehren Sie unverzüglich um, oder wir werden angreifen.
Key.Czech: Upozornění neznámému letadlu! Blížíte se k bezletové zóně. Okamžitě se otočte, nebo začneme střílet.
Key.English: Attention, unidentified aircraft! You're approaching a no-fly zone. Turn around immediately or you will be fired upon.
Key.Portuguese: Atenção, aeronave não identificada! Você está se aproximando de uma zona de exclusão aérea! Retorne já ou vamos disparar.
Key.Korean: 미확인 비행체에게 전달한다! 비행금지구역에 접근하고 있다! 즉시 경로를 돌리지 않으면 발포하겠다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 注意，不明飞机！你即将进入禁飞区！请马上掉头，否则我们就开火了。
Key.Japanese: 未確認ノ飛行機ヘ、注意勧告スル！飛行禁止区ニ接近シテイルゾ！スグニ引キ返セ。デナケレバ、射撃スル！
Key.Turkish: Dikkat, tanınmayan uçak! Uçuşa yasak bölgeye yaklaşıyorsunuz! Hemen geri dönün yoksa ateş edeceğiz.

Key.Original: Hey! You shouldn't be here - leave, now!
Key.Chinese: 喂！你不該來這裡－－給我滾，快！
Key.French: Hé ! T'as rien à faire là. Dégage tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! No deberías estar aquí. ¡Lárgate a la voz de ya!
Key.Italian: Ehi! Non dovresti essere qui. Vattene, ora!
Key.Polish: Hej! Nie powinno cię tu być, znikaj!
Key.Russian: Эй! Тебе нельзя здесь находится. Быстро покинул территорию!
Key.German: Hey! Du hast hier nichts zu suchen. Verschwinde, sofort!
Key.Czech: Hej, tady nemáš co dělat. Jdi pryč!
Key.English: Hey! You shouldn't be here - leave, now!
Key.Portuguese: Ei! Você não devia estar aqui. Saia, agora!
Key.Korean: 이봐! 여긴 들어오면 안 돼. 어서 나가!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你不能呆在这儿 - 快离开！快！
Key.Japanese: おい！お前、ここにいるべきじゃないぞ。今すぐ立ち去れ！

Key.Original: Attention, unidentified aircraft! You're approaching a no-fly zone! Turn around at once or we will engage!
Key.Chinese: 注意，不明飛機！你正在接近禁飛區！請立即返回，否則我們將開火射擊！
Key.French: Attention, avion non identifié ! Vous approchez d'une zone d'exclusion aérienne ! Changez de cap ou vous serez abattu !
Key.Spanish: ¡Attention, aeronave no identificada! ¡Se está aproximando a espacio aéreo restringido! ¡Dé media vuelta de inmediato o procederemos al ataque!
Key.Italian: Attenzione, velivolo non identificato! State entrando in una zona di interdizione aerea! Tornate subito indietro o faremo fuoco!
Key.Polish: Uwaga, pilocie! Nie masz tu wstępu! Natychmiast zawróć albo podejmiemy działania obronne!
Key.Russian: Внимание, неопознанный самолет! Вы приближается к бесполетной зоне! Немедленно развернитесь, иначе мы откроем огонь!
Key.German: Unidentifiziertes Flugzeug, bitte kommen! Sie nähern sich einem Sperrgebiet! Kehren Sie unverzüglich um, oder wir werden angreifen.
Key.Czech: Upozornění neznámému letadlu! Blížíte se k bezletové zóně. Okamžitě se otočte, jinak zaútočíme.
Key.English: Attention, unidentified aircraft! You're approaching a no-fly zone! Turn around at once or we will engage!
Key.Portuguese: Atenção, aeronave não identificada! Você está se aproximando de uma zona de exclusão aérea! Retorne imediatamente ou vamos disparar!
Key.Korean: 미확인 비행체에게 전달한다! 비행금지 구역으로 접근 중이다! 당장 경로를 돌리지 않으면 발포하겠다!
Key.Chinesesimp: 注意，不明飞机！你正在靠近禁飞区！请马上掉头，否则我们就开火了！
Key.Japanese: 未確認ノ飛行機ヘ、注意勧告スル！飛行禁止区ニ接近シテイルゾ！スグニ引キ返セ。デナケレバ、射撃スル！
Key.Turkish: Dikkat, belirsiz uçak! Uçuşa yasak bölgeye yaklaşıyorsunuz! Derhal geri dönün yoksa ateş açacağız!

Key.Original: You gotta problem, old man? Dégage!
Key.French: T'as un problème, le vieux ? Dégage !
Key.Spanish: ¿Algún problema, viejo? ¡Dégage!
Key.Italian: Hai qualche problema, vecchio? Dégage!
Key.German: Hast du ein Problem, alter Mann? Dégage!
Key.English: You gotta problem, old man? Dégage!
Key.Portuguese: Algum problema, velho? Dégage!
Key.Japanese: 問題デモアルノカ、オッサン？ディガージ！
Key.Turkish: Bir sorunun mu var, yaşlı adam? Dégage!

Key.Original: Hey, you! Leave! Now!
Key.French: Hé, toi ! Dégage tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Eh, tú! ¡Fuera! ¡Pero ya!
Key.Italian: Ehi, tu! Vattene! Adesso!
Key.Russian: Эй, ты! Покинул территорию! Сейчас же!
Key.German: Hey, du! Verschwinde, sofort!
Key.English: Hey, you! Leave! Now!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você! Saia! Agora!
Key.Japanese: おい、お前！今すぐ出ていけ！

Key.Original: Hey, Legionnaire! Assez, aller! You not welcome here.
Key.Chinese: 嘿，Legionnaire！夠了，滾！這裡不歡迎你。
Key.French: Hé, Légionnaire ! Assez, allez ! T'es pas le bienvenu.
Key.Spanish: Eh, légionnaire! Assez, va-t'en! No te queremos aquí.
Key.Italian: Ehi, Légionnaire! Assez, allez! Non sei il benvenuto qui.
Key.Polish: Hej, Legionnaire! Assez, aller! Nie chcemy cię tu.
Key.Russian: Эй, Легионер! Асси, алли! Тебе здесь не рады.
Key.German: Hey, Legionnaire! Assez, aller! Du bist hier nicht willkommen.
Key.Czech: Hej, legionnaire! Assez, aller! Tady nejsi vítanej.
Key.English: Hey, Legionnaire! Assez, aller! You not welcome here.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, legionnaire! Ça suffit, allez! Você não é bem-vindo aqui.
Key.Korean: 어이, 군인 아저씨! 저리 가! 여긴 당신이 있을 곳이 아니야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，当兵的！够了，滚！这儿可不欢迎你。
Key.Japanese: オイ、レジョネア！アゼ、アレ！ココニ来テハダメダ。
Key.Turkish: Hey, Legionnaire! Assez, aller! Burada istenmiyorsun.

Key.Original: You! Clear out! Move!
Key.French: Hé, toi ! Reste pas là ! Dégage !
Key.Spanish: ¡Tú! ¡Fuera de aquí! ¡Andando!
Key.Italian: Tu! Via da qui! Sbrigati!
Key.German: Du da! Hau ab!
Key.English: You! Clear out! Move!
Key.Portuguese: Você! Sai daí! Anda!
Key.Japanese: お前！行け！あっちへ行け！

Key.Original: Back off, mec. I not say again, eh?
Key.Chinese: 退開，夥計。我不會再說一次，知道吧？
Key.French: Recule, mec. Je le répéterai pas, OK ?
Key.Spanish: Atrás, mec. No te lo pienso repetir, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Indietro, mec. Non lo ripeterò un’altra volta, eh?
Key.Russian: Отойди, мэк. Два раза повторять не буду.
Key.German: Verschwinde, mec. Ich werde mich nicht wiederholen, ok?
Key.English: Back off, mec. I not say again, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Recue, mec. Não vou falar de novo, ok?
Key.Korean: 물러서, 멕. 더 이상 얘기 안 할 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 往后退，伙计。我最后说一遍，明白？
Key.Japanese: 下ガレ。二度モ言ワナイゾ。
Key.Turkish: Geri çekil, mec. Tekrar etmeyeceğim, ha?

Key.Original: Hey, get out of here!
Key.French: Hé, tire-toi de là !
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye, lárgate de aquí!
Key.Italian: Ehi, sparisci!
Key.German: Hey, verschwinde von hier!
Key.English: Hey, get out of here!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, saia daqui!
Key.Japanese: おい、ここから出ていけ！

Key.Original: You - no! Go, now. Dégage!
Key.French: Toi. Non ! Allez, dégage !
Key.Spanish: Eh... ¡no! Vamos. Dégage!
Key.Italian: Tu, no! Vattene, adesso. Dégage!
Key.German: Du da! Hau ab Dégage!
Key.English: You - no! Go, now. Dégage!
Key.Portuguese: Você. Não! Agora anda, vai. Dégage!
Key.Korean: 너, 안 돼! 어서 가. 데가쥐!
Key.Chinesesimp: 你 - 不行！快走开。滚蛋！
Key.Japanese: オ前――来ルナ！今スグ消エロ。ディガージ！

Key.Original: Hey, you - what are you doing here?
Key.French: Hé, toi. Tu fais quoi, là ?
Key.Spanish: Oye, tú, pero ¿qué haces aquí?
Key.Italian: Ehi, tu, che stai facendo qui?
Key.Polish: Ej, ty, co ty tu robisz?
Key.German: Hey, was machst du da?
Key.English: Hey, you - what are you doing here?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, o que você tá fazendo aqui?
Key.Korean: 이봐, 너! 여기서 뭐 하는 거야?
Key.Japanese: おい、お前。ここで何をしてる？

Key.Original: Hey! Get outta here!
Key.French: Hé ! Tire-toi de là !
Key.Spanish: ¡Eh! ¡Largo de aquí!
Key.Italian: Ehi! Via da qui!
Key.German: Hey! Verschwinde von hier!
Key.English: Hey! Get outta here!
Key.Portuguese: Ei! Cai fora daí!
Key.Japanese: オイ！ココカラ出テ行ケ！

Key.Original: This is a military matter, beat it.
Key.French: Ici, c'est une zone militaire, dégage.
Key.Spanish: Esto es un asunto militar, date el piro.
Key.Italian: Sono questioni militari, via da qui.
Key.German: Das ist Sache des Militärs. Verzieh dich!
Key.English: This is a military matter, beat it.
Key.Portuguese: Este é um negócio militar, dê o fora.
Key.Japanese: これは軍の機密事項だ。消えろ。

Key.Original: Hey, you! Leave! Now!
Key.French: Hé, toi ! Dégage tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Eh, tú! ¡Fuera! ¡Pero ya!
Key.Italian: Ehi, tu! Vattene! Adesso!
Key.Russian: Эй, ты! Покинул территорию! Сейчас же!
Key.German: Hey, du! Verschwinde, sofort!
Key.English: Hey, you! Leave! Now!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você! Saia! Agora!
Key.Japanese: おい、お前！今すぐ出ていけ！

Key.Original: Hey, you! Go! Get out of here!
Key.French: Hé, toi ! Dégage ! Tire-toi de là !
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye, tú! ¡Lárgate de aquí!
Key.Italian: Ehi, tu! Vattene! Fila via!
Key.German: Hey du, verschwinde von hier!
Key.English: Hey, you! Go! Get out of here!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você! Se manda! Sai daqui!
Key.Japanese: おい、お前！出ていけ！ここから出ていくんだ！

Key.Original: Hey, je ne te connais pas...
Key.French: Hey, je ne te connais pas...
Key.Spanish: Oye, no te conozco...
Key.Italian: Ehi, io non ti conosco...
Key.German: Hey, dich kenne ich nicht ...
Key.English: Hey, I don't know you...
Key.Portuguese: Ei, não te conheço...
Key.Japanese: オイ。見ナイ顔ダナ...

Key.Original: This is military business.
Key.French: Ici, c'est une zone militaire.
Key.Spanish: Esto es un asunto militar.
Key.Italian: Questa è un’operazione militare.
Key.German: Das ist eine Angelegenheit fürs Militär.
Key.English: This is military business.
Key.Portuguese: Isso é negócio militar.
Key.Japanese: これは軍関連の事項だ。

Key.Original: Hey - qui es-tu ?
Key.French: Hey - qui es-tu ?
Key.Spanish: Oye... ¿y tú quién eres?
Key.Italian: Ehi, e tu chi sei?
Key.German: Hey, wer bist du?
Key.English: Hey - who are you?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, quem é você?
Key.Japanese: オイ、オ前ハ誰ダ？

Key.Original: Hey! You shouldn't be here - leave, now!
Key.Chinese: 喂！你不該來這裡－－給我滾，快！
Key.French: Hé ! T'as rien à faire là. Dégage tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! No deberías estar aquí. ¡Lárgate a la voz de ya!
Key.Italian: Ehi! Non dovresti essere qui. Vattene, ora!
Key.Polish: Hej! Nie powinno cię tu być, znikaj!
Key.Russian: Эй! Тебе нельзя здесь находится. Быстро покинул территорию!
Key.German: Hey! Du hast hier nichts zu suchen. Verschwinde, sofort!
Key.Czech: Hej, tady nemáš co dělat. Jdi pryč!
Key.English: Hey! You shouldn't be here - leave, now!
Key.Portuguese: Ei! Você não devia estar aqui. Saia, agora!
Key.Korean: 이봐! 여긴 들어오면 안 돼. 어서 나가!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你不能呆在这儿 - 快离开！快！
Key.Japanese: おい！お前、ここにいるべきじゃないぞ。今すぐ立ち去れ！

Key.Original: C'est un espion - tue-le - tue-le !
Key.Chinese: 他是間諜，殺了他…殺了他！
Key.French: C'est un espion - tue-le - tue-le !
Key.Spanish: Es un espía... Matadlo... ¡Matadlo!
Key.Italian: È una spia. Uccidetelo, uccidetelo!
Key.German: Ein Spion! Tötet ihn, na los!
Key.English: He's a spy - kill him - kill him!
Key.Portuguese: Ele é um espião. Mata ele, mata!
Key.Chinesesimp: 他是个间谍 - 杀了他 - 杀了他！
Key.Japanese: "スパイ" ダ。殺セ。殺セ！
Key.Turkish: O bir ajan, öldür onu! Öldür onu!

Key.Original: You! Get lost!
Key.French: Toi ! Dégage !
Key.Spanish: ¡Tú! ¡Esfúmate!
Key.Italian: Tu! Sparisci!
Key.German: Du da, verschwinde!
Key.English: You! Get lost!
Key.Portuguese: Você! Dê o fora!
Key.Japanese: お前！消えろ！

Key.Original: Infiltrateur !
Key.French: Infiltrateur !
Key.Spanish: ¡Un infiltrado!
Key.Italian: Infiltrato!
Key.German: Eindringling!
Key.English: Infiltrator!
Key.Portuguese: Infiltrador!
Key.Japanese: 侵入者ダ！

Key.Original: Hey, you want to get shot?
Key.French: Hé, tu veux qu'on te tire dessus ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Qué pasa, quieres que te peguen un tiro?
Key.Italian: Ehi, vuoi farti sparare?
Key.German: Hey, willst du etwa erschossen werden?
Key.English: Hey, you want to get shot?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, quer levar um tiro?
Key.Japanese: おい、撃たれたいのか？

Key.Original: Engagez ! Tue-le, maintenant !
Key.French: Engagez ! Tue-le, maintenant !
Key.Spanish: ¡Al ataque! ¡Acabad con él ya!
Key.Italian: Fate fuoco! Ammazzatelo, ora!
Key.Russian: Открыть огонь! Стреляй в него, живо!
Key.German: Angriff! Schaltet ihn aus! Sofort!
Key.English: Engage! Take him out, now!
Key.Portuguese: Ataque! Acaba com ele agora!
Key.Japanese: 攻撃開始！今スグ始末シロ！

Key.Original: Hey - who are you?
Key.French: Hé, t'es qui ?
Key.Spanish: Oye... ¿y tú quién eres?
Key.Italian: Ehi, e tu chi sei?
Key.German: Hey, wer bist du?
Key.English: Hey - who are you?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, quem é você?
Key.Japanese: オイ、オ前ハ誰ダ？

Key.Original: Suffisant - tue-le !
Key.French: Suffisant - tue-le !
Key.Spanish: Ya basta... ¡Matadlo!
Key.Italian: Ora basta, uccidetelo!
Key.German: Genug davon, tötet ihn!
Key.English: Enough - kill him!
Key.Portuguese: Chega, mate ele!
Key.Japanese: モウイイ。殺セ！

Key.Original: You, come here a moment...
Key.French: Toi, viens là...
Key.Spanish: Eh, tú, ven aquí un momento.
Key.Italian: Tu, vieni qui un secondo...
Key.German: Du da, komm mal kurz her ...
Key.Czech: Ty tam, Pojď sem na chvilku.
Key.English: You, come here a moment...
Key.Portuguese: Você, venha aqui um momento...
Key.Japanese: お前、ちょっとこっちに来い。

Key.Original: Merde ! Je m'engage !
Key.French: Merde ! Je m'engage !
Key.Spanish: ¡Mierda! ¡Voy a atacar!
Key.Italian: Merda! È sotto tiro!
Key.German: Verdammt ... ich greife an!
Key.English: Shit! I'm engaging!
Key.Portuguese: Merda! Tô atacando!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！射撃スル！

Key.Original: Drop the weapon!
Key.French: Lâche ton arme !
Key.Spanish: ¡Suelta el arma!
Key.Italian: Getta l’arma!
Key.German: Lass die Waffe fallen!
Key.English: Drop the weapon!
Key.Portuguese: Larga a arma!
Key.Japanese: 武器を置け！

Key.Original: Il est hostile !
Key.French: Il est hostile !
Key.Spanish: ¡Es hostil!
Key.Italian: È un nemico!
Key.German: Ein Feind!
Key.English: Il est hostile !
Key.Portuguese: Ele é hostil!
Key.Japanese: 敵ダ！

Key.Original: Stop! Drop the fucking weapon, now!
Key.Chinese: 別動！他媽的給我把武器放下，快！
Key.French: Stop ! Lâche ton arme tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alto! ¡Suelta la puta arma, pero ya!
Key.Italian: Fermo! Getta quella cazzo di arma, adesso!
Key.German: Halt, Waffe fallen lassen – sofort!
Key.English: Stop! Drop the fucking weapon, now!
Key.Portuguese: Parado! Larga a porra da arma, agora!
Key.Chinesesimp: 站住！放下该死的武器，快！
Key.Japanese: 止まれ！武器を置け！今すぐだ！

Key.Original: Putain ! Ouvrez le feu !
Key.French: Putain ! Ouvrez le feu !
Key.Spanish: ¡Joder! ¡Abrid fuego!
Key.Italian: Cazzo! Aprite il fuoco!
Key.German: Scheiße, Feuer eröffnen!
Key.English: Fuck! Open fire!
Key.Portuguese: Porra! Dispara!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！撃テ！

Key.Original: Intruder - somebody sound the alarm!
Key.Chinese: 有入侵者－－有人響起了警報！
Key.French: Un intrus, donnez l'alarme !
Key.Spanish: Un intruso... ¡Que alguien dé la alarma!
Key.Italian: Intruso, qualcuno dia l’allarme!
Key.German: Eindringling, aktiviert den Alarm!
Key.English: Intruder - somebody sound the alarm!
Key.Portuguese: Intruso, alguém toque o alarme!
Key.Chinesesimp: 有人闯入 - 有人触发警报！
Key.Japanese: 侵入者だ！誰か警報を鳴らせ！

Key.Original: Dispatch, shots fired. Requesting back-up. Over.
Key.Chinese: 調度中心，有人開槍。請求支援，完畢。
Key.French: QG, coups de feu. Demande de soutien, à vous.
Key.Spanish: Central, se han producido disparos. Solicito refuerzos. Cambio.
Key.Italian: Qui è la centrale, colpi sparati. Richiesta di supporto. Passo.
Key.Polish: Centrala, padły strzały. Potrzebne wsparcie. Odbiór.
Key.Russian: Враг открыл огонь. Запрашиваю поддержку. Прием.
Key.German: Zentrale, es wird geschossen. Bitte um Verstärkung. Kommen.
Key.Czech: Dispečink, slyšíme výstřely. Žádám o posily. Přepínám.
Key.English: Dispatch, shots fired. Requesting back-up. Over.
Key.Portuguese: Comunicado, tiros disparados. Solicitamos reforço. Câmbio.
Key.Korean: 본부, 총기가 발포됐다. 지원병력을 요청한다. 이상.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我是调度，开火了。请求支援。完毕。
Key.Japanese: 本部、射撃ガ起コッタ。援軍ヲ要請スル。オーバー。
Key.Turkish: Sevkiyat, ateş edildi. Destek istiyoruz. Tamam.

Key.Original: Alarm, alarm!
Key.French: Alerte, alerte !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alarma! ¡Alarma!
Key.Italian: Allarme, allarme!
Key.German: Alarm! Alarm!
Key.English: Alarm, alarm!
Key.Portuguese: Alarme, alarme!
Key.Japanese: 警報！警報！

Key.Original: This is dispatch, we're sending support...
Key.Chinese: 這是調度中心，我們正在派遣支援…
Key.French: Ici le QG, appui en approche...
Key.Spanish: Aquí central, vamos a enviar apoyo...
Key.Italian: Qui è la centrale, stiamo inviando supporti...
Key.German: Hier spricht die Zentrale, wir schicken Verstärkung ...
Key.English: This is dispatch, we're sending support...
Key.Portuguese: Comunicado, estamos enviando suporte...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我是调度，我们正在派遣支援部队...
Key.Japanese: コチラ本部。支援ヲ送ル...

Key.Original: Security breach, we've got an intruder!
Key.Chinese: 出現安全漏洞；有人入侵了！
Key.French: Alerte de sécurité, un intrus !
Key.Spanish: ¡Violación de seguridad, tenemos un intruso!
Key.Italian: Violazione della sicurezza, abbiamo un intruso!
Key.German: Sicherheitsverstoß, Eindringling!
Key.English: Security breach, we've got an intruder!
Key.Portuguese: Violação de segurança, temos um invasor!
Key.Chinesesimp: 安全防线被突破，有人闯入！
Key.Japanese: 侵入者だ。侵入者がいるぞ！

Key.Original: Give us a report god damn it! Over.
Key.Chinese: 該死，快給我報告情況！完畢。
Key.French: Faites-moi un rapport, bordel ! À vous.
Key.Spanish: ¡Denos un puto informe! Cambio.
Key.Italian: Fate rapporto, maledizione! Passo.
Key.German: Wir brauchen einen verdammten Lagebericht! Kommen.
Key.English: Give us a report god damn it! Over.
Key.Portuguese: Envie um relatório, caramba! Câmbio.
Key.Chinesesimp: 见鬼，报告下情况啊！完毕。
Key.Japanese: 報告しないか！オーバー。
Key.Turkish: Bize rapor verin, lanet olsun! Tamam.

Key.Original: Hey - who's that? Identify yourself!
Key.Chinese: 嘿，誰在那？表明你的身份！
Key.French: Hé, qui va là ? Identifiez-vous !
Key.Spanish: Eh, ¿quién va? ¡Identifícate!
Key.Italian: Ehi, chi è là? Identificati!
Key.Polish: Hej, kto tam? Mów, kim jesteś!
Key.German: Hey, wer ist da? Identifiziere dich!
Key.Czech: Hej, kdo je tam? Identifikuj se.
Key.English: Hey - who's that? Identify yourself!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, quem é? Se identifique!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿 - 你是谁？报一下你的身份！
Key.Japanese: おい、誰だ？名前を言え！

Key.Original: Reinforcements are inbound, hold your position.
Key.Chinese: 支援正在路上，堅守陣地。
Key.French: Renforts en approche, tenez votre position.
Key.Spanish: Los refuerzos van en camino, mantenga la posición.
Key.Italian: Rinforzi in arrivo, mantenere la posizione.
Key.Polish: Posiłki są w drodze, utrzymajcie pozycję.
Key.Russian: Подкрепление уже в пути, удерживайте позиции.
Key.German: Verstärkung ist unterwegs. Position halten.
Key.Czech: Posíláme k vám posily. Držte pozici.
Key.English: Reinforcements are inbound, hold your position.
Key.Portuguese: Reforços a caminho, mantenha sua posição.
Key.Chinesesimp: 增援部队即将到达，守住阵地。
Key.Japanese: 援軍が向かっている。その場を死守しろ。

Key.Original: You, stop!
Key.French: Toi, arrête !
Key.Spanish: ¡Eh, tú! ¡Alto!
Key.Italian: Tu, fermo!
Key.German: Du da! Halt!
Key.English: You, stop!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você! Parado!
Key.Japanese: お前、止まれ！

Key.Original: Nothing heard, respond! Over.
Key.Chinese: 沒有收到回應，請回覆！完畢。
Key.French: Je reçois pas, répondez ! À vous.
Key.Spanish: No he oído nada, ¡responda! Cambio.
Key.Italian: Nessun messaggio ricevuto, rispondete! Passo.
Key.German: Nichts gehört, bitte antworten! Kommen.
Key.English: Nothing heard, respond! Over.
Key.Portuguese: Nada na linha, responda! Câmbio.
Key.Japanese: 何も聞こえないぞ。応答しろ！オーバー。
Key.Turkish: Hiçbir şey duyulmuyor, yanıt verin! Tamam.

Key.Original: Stop! Get out of the vehicle!
Key.French: Stop ! Descends du véhicule !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alto! ¡Sal del vehículo!
Key.Italian: Fermo! Esci da quel veicolo!
Key.German: Halt, aussteigen!
Key.English: Stop! Get out of the vehicle!
Key.Portuguese: Parado! Saia do veículo!
Key.Japanese: 止まれ！車から降りろ！

Key.Original: Sergeant, report - what's your situation...?
Key.French: Sergent, rapport. Quelle est votre situation ?
Key.Spanish: Sargento, informe... ¿Cuál es su situación...?
Key.Italian: Sergente, rapporto. Cosa succede lì...?
Key.German: Sergeant, Lagebericht. Wie sieht es aus?
Key.Czech: Seržante, hlaste se. Jak to u vás vypadá?
Key.English: Sergeant, report - what's your situation...?
Key.Portuguese: Sargento, relatório. Qual a sua situação...?
Key.Chinesesimp: 中士，请报告 - 你那儿情况怎样...？
Key.Japanese: 軍曹、報告しろ。そちらの状況はどうだ...？

Key.Original: Hey - what the hell are you doing! Get out of that vehicle!
Key.Chinese: 喂，你在搞什麼！快給我下車！
Key.French: Hé, qu'est-ce que tu fous là ? Descends du véhicule !
Key.Spanish: Oye, pero ¿qué coño estás haciendo? ¡Sal del vehículo!
Key.Italian: Ehi, che diavolo stai facendo?! Esci da quel veicolo!
Key.Polish: Hej, co ty robisz, do cholery?! Wysiadaj z tego pojazdu!
Key.Russian: Эй, какого хрена ты творишь? Вышел из машины!
Key.German: Hey, was zum Teufel machst du! Steig gefälligst aus!
Key.Czech: Hej, co tady kurva děláš? Vylez z toho auta!
Key.English: Hey - what the hell are you doing! Get out of that vehicle!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, o que diabos você tá fazendo! Saia desse veículo!
Key.Korean: 어이, 여기서 뭐 하는 거야! 차에서 내려!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿 - 你在搞什么鬼！从车里滚出来！
Key.Japanese: おい、一体何をしてる！？車から降りろ！
Key.Turkish: Hey; ne halt ediyorsun! İn o araçtan!

Key.Original: Get out of the vehicle or we will open fire!
Key.Chinese: 下車，不然我們就開槍了！
Key.French: Descends ou on ouvre le feu !
Key.Spanish: ¡Sal del vehículo o abriremos fuego!
Key.Italian: Esci da quel veicolo o apriremo il fuoco!
Key.Russian: Выходи из машины, иначе мы открываем огонь!
Key.German: Steig aus oder wir eröffnen das Feuer!
Key.Czech: Vylez z toho auta, nebo začneme střílet!
Key.English: Get out of the vehicle or we will open fire!
Key.Portuguese: Saia do veículo ou vamos disparar!
Key.Chinesesimp: 从车里滚出来，否则我们就开枪了！
Key.Japanese: 車カラ降リロ。デナケレバ、撃ツゾ！

Key.Original: No! This is a restricted area - walk away.
Key.Chinese: 不！這是限制區域－－快離開。
Key.French: Non ! C'est une zone interdite. Repars.
Key.Spanish: ¡No! Esto es zona restringida. Lárgate.
Key.Italian: No! Questa è una zona ad accesso limitato. Vai via.
Key.Russian: Нет! Это запретная зона. Иди отсюда.
Key.German: Nein, das hier ist ein abgeriegelter Bereich! Verschwinde.
Key.Czech: Ne! Tohle je vyhrazená oblast. Odejdi.
Key.English: No! This is a restricted area - walk away.
Key.Portuguese: Não! Esta é uma área restrita, vá embora.
Key.Korean: 안 돼! 여긴 제한구역이야. 어서 돌아가.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不行！这是禁区 - 走开。
Key.Japanese: だめだ！ここは立入禁止だ。立ち去れ。

Key.Original: Stop! Get out of that vehicle, now!
Key.French: Stop ! Descends de ce véhicule !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alto! ¡Sal del vehículo, pero ya!
Key.Italian: Fermo! Esci subito da quel veicolo!
Key.German: Halt! Raus aus dem Fahrzeug, los!
Key.Czech: Stát! Vystup si z auta, dělej!
Key.English: Stop! Get out of that vehicle, now!
Key.Portuguese: Pare! Saia desse veículo, agora!
Key.Japanese: 止まれ！車から降りろ。今すぐだ！

Key.Original: Stop. This area is off limits.
Key.French: Stop. Cette zone est interdite.
Key.Spanish: Alto. Está prohibido el paso.
Key.Italian: Fermo. Questa è una zona vietata.
Key.German: Halt, dieser Bereich ist Sperrgebiet.
Key.English: Stop. This area is off limits.
Key.Portuguese: Pare. Esta área tá fora dos limites.
Key.Japanese: 止まれ。ここは立入禁止だ。

Key.Original: Arrête !
Key.French: Arrête !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alto!
Key.Italian: Fermo!
Key.German: Halt!
Key.English: Stop!
Key.Portuguese: Pare!
Key.Japanese: 止マレ！

Key.Original: Hey, you're not supposed to be here! This area is restricted.
Key.Chinese: 喂，你不該在這裡！這裡是限制區域。
Key.French: Hé, t'as rien à faire ici ! C'est une zone interdite.
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye, no tendrías que estar aquí! Esto es zona restringida.
Key.Italian: Ehi, non dovresti essere qui! Questa è una zona vietata.
Key.Polish: Hej, nie możesz tu wchodzić! Zakaz wstępu.
Key.Russian: Эй, тебе нельзя здесь находиться! Вход на эту территорию запрещен.
Key.German: Hey, du hast hier nichts zu suchen. Das ist Sperrgebiet!
Key.Czech: Hele, tady nemáš co dělat. Tohle je vyhrazená oblast.
Key.English: Hey, you're not supposed to be here! This area is restricted.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você não devia estar aqui! Esta área é restrita.
Key.Korean: 이봐, 여긴 들어오면 안 돼! 여긴 제한구역이라고.
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你不应该呆在这儿！这是禁区。
Key.Japanese: おい、お前はここに来るべきじゃない！このエリアは立ち入りが制限されている。
Key.Turkish: Hey, senin burada olmaman gerekiyor! Bu bölge yasak.

Key.Original: Tire dans les pneus ou autre chose !
Key.French: Tire dans les pneus ou autre chose !
Key.Spanish: ¡Disparadle a las ruedas o algo!
Key.Italian: Sparate alle ruote o qualcosa del genere!
Key.German: Schießt auf die Reifen!
Key.English: Shoot the tires out or something!
Key.Portuguese: Atira nos pneus ou algo assim!
Key.Chinesesimp: 把车胎打破，怎么搞都行！
Key.Japanese: "タイヤ" カ何カヲ撃テ！

Key.Original: Enough - shoot the driver. Take him out!
Key.French: C'est bon. Visez le conducteur. Abattez-le !
Key.Spanish: Ya basta. Disparad al conductor. ¡Acabad con él!
Key.Italian: Questo è troppo. Sparate all’autista. Fatelo fuori!
Key.Russian: Хватит! Стреляйте в водителя! Стреляйте в него!
Key.German: Jetzt reicht‘s. Erschießt den Fahrer. Schaltet ihn aus!
Key.Czech: A dost. Zastřelte řidiče! Zneškodněte ho!
Key.English: Enough - shoot the driver. Take him out!
Key.Portuguese: Já chega, atire no motorista. Acabe com ele!
Key.Korean: 더 이상은 못 참아. 운전수를 쏴. 제거하라고!
Key.Chinesesimp: 够了 - 向司机开枪。干掉他！
Key.Japanese: もういい。運転手を撃て。あいつを殺せ！

Key.Original: Merde ! Ouvrir le feu !
Key.French: Merde ! Ouvrir le feu !
Key.Spanish: ¡Mierda! ¡Abrid fuego!
Key.Italian: Merda! Aprite il fuoco!
Key.German: Scheiße, Feuer frei!
Key.English: Shit! Open fire!
Key.Portuguese: Merda! Dispara!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！撃テ！

Key.Original: He's not listening. Open fire!
Key.French: Il n'écoute pas. Ouvrez le feu !
Key.Spanish: No hace caso. ¡Abrid fuego!
Key.Italian: Non ci ascolta. Aprire il fuoco!
Key.German: Er will nicht hören. Feuer frei!
Key.English: He's not listening. Open fire!
Key.Portuguese: Ele não tá ouvindo. Dispare!
Key.Korean: 전혀 말을 안 들어. 사격 개시!
Key.Japanese: こちらの言うことを無視したぞ。撃て！

Key.Original: Hey - hey! Pull over! This is a restricted area!
Key.Chinese: 喂、喂！停車！這是限制區域！
Key.French: Hé, hé ! Arrête-toi, c'est une zone interdite !
Key.Spanish: Oye... ¡Oye! ¡A un lado! ¡Esto es zona restringida!
Key.Italian: Ehi, ehi! Accosta! Questa è una zona vietata!
Key.Polish: Hej, hej! Stój! To teren strzeżony!
Key.Russian: Эй ты! Тормози! Это запретная зона!
Key.German: Hey – hey! Anhalten! Das hier ist ein Sperrgebiet!
Key.Czech: Hej, hej. Zastav! Tohle je vyhrazená oblast!
Key.English: Hey - hey! Pull over! This is a restricted area!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, ei! Pare aí! Essa é uma área restrita!
Key.Korean: 어이, 어이! 차 세워! 여긴 제한구역이야!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿 - 嘿！靠边停车！这是禁区！
Key.Japanese: オイ。オイ！車ヲ停メロ！ココハ立入禁止ダ！
Key.Turkish: Hey, hey! Kenara çek! Burası yasak bölge!

Key.Original: Stop! Get out of that vehicle, now!
Key.French: Stop ! Descends de ce véhicule !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alto! ¡Sal del vehículo, pero ya!
Key.Italian: Fermo! Esci subito da quel veicolo!
Key.German: Halt! Raus aus dem Fahrzeug, los!
Key.Czech: Stát! Vystup si z auta, dělej!
Key.English: Stop! Get out of that vehicle, now!
Key.Portuguese: Pare! Saia desse veículo, agora!
Key.Japanese: 止まれ！車から降りろ。今すぐだ！

Key.Original: Stop! Get out and identify yourself - now!
Key.Chinese: 停下！下車，表明你的身份，快！
Key.French: Stop ! Sors et identifie-toi. Tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alto! Sal e identifícate. ¡Ya!
Key.Italian: Fermo! Esci da quel veicolo e identificati, ora!
Key.Polish: Stój! Wyjdź i mów, co tu robisz. Już!
Key.Russian: Стой! Вышел из машины и назвал себя. Живо!
Key.German: Halt! Steig aus und identifiziere dich – sofort!
Key.Czech: Stůj! Vystup a identifikuj se. Dělej!
Key.English: Stop! Get out and identify yourself - now!
Key.Portuguese: Parado! Saia e identifique-se já!
Key.Korean: 멈춰! 차에서 내려서 신원을 밝혀. 당장!
Key.Chinesesimp: 停下！滚出来，报一下你的身份 - 快！
Key.Japanese: 止マレ！出テキテ名ヲ名乗レ。今スグダ！
Key.Turkish: Dur! Çık dışarı ve kendini tanıt, hemen!

Key.Original: Hey, you, stop - exit that vehicle!
Key.French: Hé, toi, stop. Descends du véhicule !
Key.Spanish: Oye, tú, para.. ¡Baja del vehículo!
Key.Italian: Ehi tu, fermo! Esci da quel veicolo!
Key.Polish: Ej, ty, stój, wyjdź z pojazdu!
Key.Russian: Эй, стой! А ну выйди из машины!
Key.German: Hey, du! Anhalten und aussteigen!
Key.Czech: Hej ty, zastav. Vystup z auta!
Key.English: Hey, you, stop - exit that vehicle!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você, parado. Saia do veículo!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你，停下 - 从车里出来！
Key.Japanese: おい、お前。止まれ。車から降りろ！
Key.Turkish: Hey, sen, dur; in o araçtan!

Key.Original: Stop - show me some ID - now!
Key.Chinese: 停下來－－給我看看你的 ID，快！
Key.French: Stop. Tes papiers, vite !
Key.Spanish: Alto. Déjame ver tu identificación. ¡Ya!
Key.Italian: Fermo, mostrami un documento di riconoscimento. Ora!
Key.German: Halt, zeig mir deinen Ausweis – sofort!
Key.Czech: Stůj. Ukaž mi nějaký průkaz. Hned!
Key.English: Stop - show me some ID - now!
Key.Portuguese: Parado, mostre já sua identificação!
Key.Chinesesimp: 站住 - 给我看看身份证 - 快！
Key.Japanese: 止マレ。ID ヲ見セロ。今スグ！

Key.Original: Suffisant - tue-le !
Key.French: Suffisant - tue-le !
Key.Spanish: Ya basta... ¡Matadlo!
Key.Italian: Ora basta, uccidetelo!
Key.German: Genug davon, tötet ihn!
Key.English: Enough - kill him!
Key.Portuguese: Chega, mate ele!
Key.Japanese: モウイイ。殺セ！

Key.Original: Hey - who's that? Identify yourself!
Key.Chinese: 嘿，誰在那？表明你的身份！
Key.French: Hé, qui va là ? Identifiez-vous !
Key.Spanish: Eh, ¿quién va? ¡Identifícate!
Key.Italian: Ehi, chi è là? Identificati!
Key.Polish: Hej, kto tam? Mów, kim jesteś!
Key.German: Hey, wer ist da? Identifiziere dich!
Key.Czech: Hej, kdo je tam? Identifikuj se.
Key.English: Hey - who's that? Identify yourself!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, quem é? Se identifique!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿 - 你是谁？报一下你的身份！
Key.Japanese: おい、誰だ？名前を言え！

Key.Original: Il est hostile !
Key.French: Il est hostile !
Key.Spanish: ¡Es hostil!
Key.Italian: È un nemico!
Key.German: Ein Feind!
Key.English: He's hostile!
Key.Portuguese: Ele é hostil!
Key.Japanese: 敵ダ！

Key.Original: Vous devez quitter la zone - you are not supposed to be here!
Key.Chinese: Vous devez quitter la zone－－你不該來這裡！
Key.French: Vous devez quitter la zone. Vous avez rien à faire ici !
Key.Spanish: Tu dois quitter la zone... ¡No tendrías que estar aquí!
Key.Italian: Vous devez quitter la zone, non dovresti essere qui!
Key.Polish: Vous devez quitter la zone, nie wolno ci tu przebywać!
Key.Russian: Ву дивэ китэ ля зон! Тебе нельзя здесь находиться!
Key.German: Vous devez quitter la zone – du hast hier nichts zu suchen!
Key.Czech: Vous devez quitter la zone. Tady nemáš vůbec bejt!
Key.English: Vous devez quitter la zone - you are not supposed to be here!
Key.Portuguese: Vous devez quitter la zone, você não devia estar aqui!
Key.Korean: 부 드베 끼떼 라 존. 당신은 여기 오면 안된다구!
Key.Chinesesimp: Vous devez quitter la zone - 你不能呆在这里！
Key.Japanese: ヴー・ドゥーヴ・キテ・ラ・ゾン。オ前ハココニイルベキジャナイゾ！
Key.Turkish: Vous devez quitter la zone; burada olmaman gerekiyor!

Key.Original: Merde ! Je m'engage !
Key.French: Merde ! Je m'engage !
Key.Spanish: ¡Mierda! ¡Voy a atacar!
Key.Italian: Merda! È sotto tiro!
Key.German: Verdammt ... ich greife an!
Key.English: Shit! I'm engaging!
Key.Portuguese: Merda! Tô atacando!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！射撃スル！

Key.Original: C'est une zone interdite! This is a restricted area!
Key.Chinese: 這是禁區！這是限制區域！
Key.French: C'est une zone interdite ! Restricted area !
Key.Spanish: C'est une zone interdite! ¡Esto es zona restringida!
Key.Italian: C’est une zone interdite! Questa è una zona vietata!
Key.Polish: C’est une zone interdite! Tu nie ma wstępu!
Key.Russian: Сэ ун зон интердит! Это запретная зона!
Key.German: C'est une zone interdite! Das hier ist ein Sperrgebiet!
Key.Czech: C'est une zone interdite! Tohle je vyhrazená oblast!
Key.English: C'est une zone interdite! This is a restricted area!
Key.Portuguese: C'est une zone interdite! Essa é uma área restrita!
Key.Japanese: セット・ウン・ゾン・ウンタルディ。ココハ立入禁止ダ。
Key.Turkish: C'est une zone interdite! Burası yasak bölge!

Key.Original: Ouvrez le feu - a le descendre !
Key.French: Ouvrez le feu - a le descendre !
Key.Spanish: ¡Abrid fuego! ¡Acabad con él!
Key.Italian: Aprite il fuoco, eliminatelo!
Key.German: Feuer frei, macht ihn fertig!
Key.English: Open fire - take him down!
Key.Portuguese: Dispara, acaba com ele!
Key.Japanese: 撃テ！殺セ！

Key.Original: Arrête !
Key.French: Arrête !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alto!
Key.Italian: Fermo!
Key.German: Halt!
Key.English: Stop!
Key.Portuguese: Pare!
Key.Japanese: 止マレ！

Key.Original: C'est des conneries ! Engagez !
Key.French: C'est des conneries ! Engagez !
Key.Spanish: ¡A tomar por culo! ¡Al ataque!
Key.Italian: Porca puttana! Fate fuoco!
Key.German: Scheiß drauf! Angriff!
Key.English: Fuck this! Engage!
Key.Portuguese: Pra porra com isso! Ataque!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！攻撃シロ！

Key.Original: This area's restricted. Leave, now!
Key.French: Cette zone est interdite. Dégage !
Key.Spanish: Esto es zona restringida. ¡Lárgate ya!
Key.Italian: Questa è una zona proibita. Vattene, ora!
Key.German: Das hier ist Sperrgebiet. Hau besser ab!
Key.Czech: Tohle je vyhrazená oblast. Hned odejdi.
Key.English: This area's restricted. Leave, now!
Key.Portuguese: Esta área é restrita. Saia agora!
Key.Japanese: コノ "エリア" ハ立チ入リガ制限サレテイル。今スグ立チ去レ！

Key.Original: Il n'est pas avec nous !
Key.French: Il n'est pas avec nous !
Key.Spanish: ¡No es uno de los nuestros!
Key.Italian: Non è uno dei nostri!
Key.German: Er ist keiner von uns!
Key.English: He's not one of us!
Key.Portuguese: Ele não é um de nós!
Key.Japanese: ヤツハ敵ダ！

Key.Original: Non ! C'est une zone interdite.
Key.French: Non ! C'est une zone interdite.
Key.Spanish: ¡No! Esto es zona restringida.
Key.Italian: No! Questa è una zona ad accesso limitato.
Key.German: Nein, das hier ist ein abgeriegelter Bereich!
Key.English: No! This is a restricted area.
Key.Portuguese: Não! Esta é uma área restrita.
Key.Japanese: ダメダ！ココハ立入禁止ダ。

Key.Original: Imposteur !
Key.French: Imposteur !
Key.Spanish: ¡Un impostor!
Key.Italian: Impostore!
Key.German: Ein Spion!
Key.English: Imposter!
Key.Portuguese: Impostor!
Key.Japanese: 偽物ダ！

Key.Original: Brèche de sécurité ! Sonner l'alarme !
Key.Chinese: 出現安全漏洞！響起警報！
Key.French: Brèche de sécurité ! Sonner l'alarme !
Key.Spanish: ¡Violación de seguridad! ¡Dad la alarma!
Key.Italian: Violazione della sicurezza! Suonate l’allarme!
Key.German: Sicherheitsverstoß! Aktiviert den Alarm!
Key.English: Security breach! Sound the alarm!
Key.Portuguese: Falha de segurança! Toque o alarme!
Key.Chinesesimp: 安全防线被突破！发出警报！
Key.Japanese: 侵入者ダ！警報ヲ鳴ラセ！

Key.Original: Hey, you! Leave! Now!
Key.French: Hé, toi ! Dégage tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Eh, tú! ¡Fuera! ¡Pero ya!
Key.Italian: Ehi, tu! Vattene! Adesso!
Key.Russian: Эй, ты! Покинул территорию! Сейчас же!
Key.German: Hey, du! Verschwinde, sofort!
Key.English: Hey, you! Leave! Now!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você! Saia! Agora!
Key.Japanese: おい、お前！今すぐ出ていけ！

Key.Original: Alarme ! Alarme !
Key.French: Alarme ! Alarme !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alarma! ¡Alarma!
Key.Italian: Allarme, allarme!
Key.German: Alarm! Alarm!
Key.English: Alarm! Alarm!
Key.Portuguese: Alarme! Alarme!
Key.Japanese: 警報！警報！

Key.Original: You! Clear out! Move!
Key.French: Hé, toi ! Reste pas là ! Dégage !
Key.Spanish: ¡Tú! ¡Fuera de aquí! ¡Andando!
Key.Italian: Tu! Via da qui! Sbrigati!
Key.German: Du da! Hau ab!
Key.English: You! Clear out! Move!
Key.Portuguese: Você! Sai daí! Anda!
Key.Japanese: お前！行け！あっちへ行け！

Key.Original: Merde ! Sonnez l'alarme !
Key.French: Merde ! Sonnez l'alarme !
Key.Spanish: ¡Mierda! ¡Dad la alarma!
Key.Italian: Merda! Suonate l’allarme!
Key.German: Scheiße! Aktiviert den Alarm!
Key.English: Shit! Sound the alarm!
Key.Portuguese: Merda! Toque o alarme!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！警報ヲ鳴ラセ！

Key.Original: This is police business - get lost!
Key.French: N'interfère pas avec la police. Dégage !
Key.Spanish: Esto es un asunto policial...¡Esfúmate!
Key.Italian: Sono affari della polizia, fila via!
Key.German: Das ist Sache der Polizei, verschwinde!
Key.English: This is police business - get lost!
Key.Portuguese: Isso é assunto da polícia, dê o fora!
Key.Chinesesimp: 警察执行公务 - 滚开！
Key.Japanese: 警察ノ問題ダ。消エロ！

Key.Original: Stop! Lose the weapon. Now!
Key.French: Stop ! Jette ton arme, tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Alto! Tira el arma. ¡Ya!
Key.Italian: Fermo! Getta l’arma a terra. Ora!
Key.German: Halt! Lass die Waffe fallen. Sofort!
Key.English: Stop! Lose the weapon. Now!
Key.Portuguese: Parado! Larga a arma. Agora!
Key.Japanese: 止マレ！武器ヲ捨テロ。今スグ！

Key.Original: Hey, you! Go, get out of here, mec.
Key.Chinese: 喂，你！給我離開這裡，夥計。
Key.French: Hé, toi ! Tire-toi de là, mec !
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye, tú! Lárgate de aquí, mec.
Key.Italian: Ehi, tu! Vai, vattene via da qui, mec.
Key.German: Hey, du! Verschwinde hier, mec.
Key.English: Hey, you! Go, get out of here, mec.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você! Anda, saia daqui, mec.
Key.Japanese: オイ、オ前！ココカラ出テイケ。
Key.Turkish: Hey, sen! Git, çık buradan, mec.

Key.Original: You - drop the weapon!
Key.French: Toi, lâche ton arme !
Key.Spanish: ¡Tú, suelta el arma!
Key.Italian: Tu, getta l’arma!
Key.German: Du da, Waffe fallen lassen!
Key.English: You - drop the weapon!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você! Larga a arma!
Key.Japanese: オ前、武器ヲ置ケ！

Key.Original: Hey! You shouldn't be here - leave, now!
Key.Chinese: 喂！你不該來這裡－－給我滾，快！
Key.French: Hé ! T'as rien à faire là. Dégage tout de suite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! No deberías estar aquí. ¡Lárgate a la voz de ya!
Key.Italian: Ehi! Non dovresti essere qui. Vattene, ora!
Key.Polish: Hej! Nie powinno cię tu być, znikaj!
Key.Russian: Эй! Тебе нельзя здесь находится. Быстро покинул территорию!
Key.German: Hey! Du hast hier nichts zu suchen. Verschwinde, sofort!
Key.Czech: Hej, tady nemáš co dělat. Jdi pryč!
Key.English: Hey! You shouldn't be here - leave, now!
Key.Portuguese: Ei! Você não devia estar aqui. Saia, agora!
Key.Korean: 이봐! 여긴 들어오면 안 돼. 어서 나가!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你不能呆在这儿 - 快离开！快！
Key.Japanese: おい！お前、ここにいるべきじゃないぞ。今すぐ立ち去れ！

Key.Original: Viens ici un moment.
Key.French: Viens ici un moment.
Key.Spanish: Ven aquí un momento.
Key.Italian: Vieni qui un secondo.
Key.German: Komm mal kurz her.
Key.English: Come here a moment.
Key.Portuguese: Vem cá um instante.
Key.Japanese: チョットコッチニ来イ。

Key.Original: You! Get lost!
Key.French: Toi ! Dégage !
Key.Spanish: ¡Tú! ¡Esfúmate!
Key.Italian: Tu! Sparisci!
Key.German: Du da, verschwinde!
Key.English: You! Get lost!
Key.Portuguese: Você! Dê o fora!
Key.Japanese: お前！消えろ！

Key.Original: Hey - qui es-tu ?
Key.French: Hey - qui es-tu ?
Key.Spanish: Oye... ¿y tú quién eres?
Key.Italian: Ehi, e tu chi sei?
Key.German: Hey, wer bist du?
Key.English: Hey - who are you?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, quem é você?
Key.Japanese: オイ、オ前ハ誰ダ？

Key.Original: Hey, dégage! Go on, get outta here!
Key.French: Hé, dégage ! Allez, tire-toi de là !
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye, dégage! ¡Venga, lárgate!
Key.Italian: Ehi, dégage! Forza, vattene via da qui!
Key.Polish: Hej, dégage! Jazda stąd, no już!
Key.German: Hey, dégage! Mach schon, hau ab!
Key.Czech: Hej, dégage! No tak, koukej zmizet!
Key.English: Hey, dégage! Go on, get outta here!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, dégage! Anda, saia daqui!
Key.Japanese: オイ、ディガージ！ココカラ出テイケ！

Key.Original: Hey, you! Back off, get outta here!
Key.French: Hé, toi ! Recule. Reste pas là !
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye, tú! ¡Atrás, fuera de aquí!
Key.Italian: Ehi, tu! Fatti da parte e sparisci!
Key.Polish: Ej, ty! W tył zwrot, jazda stąd!
Key.Russian: Эй, ты! А ну отошел отсюда!
Key.German: Hey, du! Verschwinde, hau ab!
Key.Czech: Hej ty tam! Jdi pryč. Odejdi!
Key.English: Hey, you! Back off, get outta here!
Key.Portuguese: Ei, você! Se afaste, saia daqui!
Key.Japanese: オイ、オ前！下ガレ。ココカラ出テイケ！

Key.Original: This ain't no place for you, mec...
Key.French: T'es au mauvais endroit, mec...
Key.Spanish: Aquí no pintas nada, mec...
Key.Italian: Questo non è il posto per te, mec...
Key.Polish: To nie miejsce dla ciebie, mec...
Key.German: Das ist der falsche Ort für dich, mec ...
Key.English: This ain't no place for you, mec...
Key.Portuguese: Aqui não é lugar pra você, mec...
Key.Korean: 여긴 당신이 있을 곳이 아니야, 멕...
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ来テイイ場所ジャナイゾ...
Key.Turkish: Burası sana uygun bir yer değil, mec...

Container.name: 001_cut_camera_placement_call
Container.situation: miller is communicating with player and reporting that he has a video feed, after player's placement of a remote surveillance device. first few lines accompany black screen and bohemia interactive presents text.

Key.Original: Alright, good - that's good. I got a visual.
Key.Chinese: 啊，很好－－這樣很好。我看到了。
Key.French: OK, très bien. J'ai un visuel.
Key.Spanish: A ver, bien, muy bien... Tengo imagen.
Key.Italian: Okay, bene. Bene così. Sono in collegamento visivo.
Key.German: Alles klar, das ist gut. Ich hab ein Bild.
Key.Czech: Tak jo, fajn – takhle je to dobrý. Mám signál.
Key.English: Alright, good - that's good. I got a visual.
Key.Portuguese: Ok, bom, tá bom assim. Tenho confirmação visual.
Key.Chinesesimp: 很好，不错 - 挺不错。我看到了。
Key.Japanese: よし、いいぞ。そっちの様子がちゃんと見える。
Key.Turkish: Evet, işte bu. Bir şey görüyorum.

Key.Original: Now pan around...
Key.French: Déplace la caméra...
Key.Spanish: Gira un poco...
Key.Italian: Ora fai una panoramica...
Key.German: Jetzt schwenken ...
Key.English: Now pan around...
Key.Portuguese: Agora, olhe ao redor...
Key.Japanese: カメラを回してみてくれ...

Key.Original: Okay, and stop...
Key.French: OK, arrête...
Key.Spanish: Vale, ahora para...
Key.Italian: Okay, fermo...
Key.German: Okay, und stopp ...
Key.English: Okay, and stop...
Key.Portuguese: Ok, pare...
Key.Japanese: よし、そこで止めろ...

Key.Original: The red bin. Hide the camera there.
Key.Chinese: 紅色的桶子，把攝影機藏在那裡。
Key.French: La poubelle rouge. Caches-y la caméra.
Key.Spanish: El contenedor rojo. Esconde ahí la cámara.
Key.Italian: La pattumiera rossa. Nascondi lì la telecamera.
Key.German: Der rote Mülleimer. Versteck die Kamera dort.
Key.Czech: Schovej kameru do toho červenýho koše.
Key.English: The red bin. Hide the camera there.
Key.Portuguese: Na lixeira vermelha. Esconda a câmera lá.
Key.Chinesesimp: 红色垃圾桶，把相机藏在那儿。
Key.Japanese: 赤い容器だ。そこにカメラを隠せ。

Key.Original: That should do us for the livefeed.
Key.Chinese: 這樣應該就能取得即時影像。
Key.French: Ça ira pour le direct.
Key.Spanish: Esto nos dará imagen en directo.
Key.Italian: Questo dovrebbe bastare per la trasmissione video in tempo reale.
Key.Polish: No i mamy transmisję na żywo.
Key.German: Das sollte für die Liveübertragung reichen.
Key.English: That should do us for the livefeed.
Key.Portuguese: Isso deve nos bastar pra transmissão em tempo real.
Key.Korean: 그렇게 하면 실시간으로 다 볼 수 있지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这样应该就能看到实时视频。
Key.Japanese: これでリアルタイム映像を得られるはずだ。

Key.Original: I suggest you head home, crash out.
Key.Chinese: 我建議你回家好好睡一覺。
Key.French: Tu devrais aller te reposer chez toi.
Key.Spanish: Te sugiero que vayas a casa y te tumbes un rato.
Key.Italian: Ti consiglio di tornare a casa e farti una bella dormita.
Key.Russian: Советую тебе отправиться домой и отдохнуть.
Key.German: Du solltest nach Hause gehen und dich ausruhen.
Key.Czech: Teď bych ti doporučoval jít domů a natáhnout se.
Key.English: I suggest you head home, crash out.
Key.Portuguese: Sugiro que vá para casa, tire uma soneca.
Key.Korean: 이제 집으로 가서 눈 좀 붙여.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我建议你回去，好好休息一下。
Key.Japanese: 今のところは家に帰って休め。
Key.Turkish: Bence eve git ve vur kafayı yat.

Key.Original: Any intel's going to take some time to process.
Key.Chinese: 取得的情報需要一些時間來處理。
Key.French: Il faudra du temps pour traiter la moindre info.
Key.Spanish: Llevará un tiempo procesar la información que saquemos de aquí.
Key.Italian: Ci vorrà un po’ per elaborare qualsiasi dato.
Key.Russian: Обработка любой информации займет какое-то время.
Key.German: Es wird eine Weile dauern, die Informationen auszuwerten.
Key.English: Any intel's going to take some time to process.
Key.Portuguese: Qualquer informação ainda vai levar um tempo para ser processada.
Key.Korean: 어떤 정보든 처리를 하려면 시간이 걸릴 테니까.
Key.Chinesesimp: 搞到的情报需要一些时间来处理。
Key.Japanese: 情報が入ってきても処理するのに時間がかかるからな。

Key.Original: I'll hit you up when we got a lead.
Key.Chinese: 我們有線索的時候會通知你。
Key.French: Je t'appelle dès qu'on a une piste.
Key.Spanish: Te avisaré en cuanto tengamos una pista.
Key.Italian: Ti contatterò non appena avremo una pista.
Key.Russian: Я дам тебе знать, если будет что-то существенное.
Key.German: Ich melde mich, sobald wir eine Spur haben.
Key.Czech: Dám ti vědět, až něco zjistíme.
Key.English: I'll hit you up when we got a lead.
Key.Portuguese: Falo contigo quando tivermos alguma coisa.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们一有线索就联系你。
Key.Japanese: 手掛かりを得られたら連絡する。

Container.name: 001_ta_destroy_police_station_call
Container.situation: player receives a call from boss and is tasked with destroying a police station.

Key.Original: Képi.
Key.French: Képi.
Key.Spanish: Képi.
Key.Italian: Képi.
Key.German: Képi.
Key.English: Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Képi.
Key.Japanese: ケピ。

Key.Original: Gendarmes arrest our leader politique - so now, we strike back.
Key.Chinese: 國家憲兵逮捕了我們的政治首領－－現在，我們將反擊。
Key.French: Les gendarmes ont arrêté notre leader politique. On doit répliquer.
Key.Spanish: Les gendarmes han arrestado a nuestro leader politique... así que vamos a devolverles el golpe.
Key.Italian: I gendarmi hanno arrestato il nostro leader politique. Quindi adesso noi contrattaccheremo.
Key.Polish: Żandarmi aresztowali nam szefa politique, teraz nasz ruch.
Key.Russian: Жандармы арестовали нашего политического лидера. Пришло время нанести ответный удар.
Key.German: Gendarmes haben unseren politischen Anführer festgenommen, also schlagen wir jetzt zurück.
Key.Czech: Četníci zatýkají náš lídr politique. Takže my to teď vracíme.
Key.English: Gendarmes arrest our leader politique - so now, we strike back.
Key.Portuguese: Os gendarmes prendem líder politique da gente. Então, agora fazemos contra-ataque.
Key.Korean: 현병특공대에서 우리 정치인을 체포했다. 이제 우리가 반격한다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 宪兵队逮捕了我们的政治领袖 - 现在嘛，我们要反击了。
Key.Japanese: 憲兵ガ俺タチの "ポリティーク" ノ "リーダー" ヲ逮捕シタ。ダカラ、ヤリ返シテヤルゾ。
Key.Turkish: Jandarmalar politik liderimizi tutukladı. Biz de şimdi karşı saldırıya geçiyoruz.

Key.Original: There is a car, with a bomb inside.
Key.Chinese: 有一輛車，裡面裝有炸彈。
Key.French: Il y a une voiture piégée.
Key.Spanish: Hay un coche con una bomba dentro.
Key.Italian: C’è un’autobomba.
Key.German: Es gibt einen Wagen mit einer Bombe.
Key.Czech: Jedno auto má v sobě bombu.
Key.English: There is a car, with a bomb inside.
Key.Portuguese: Tem um carro com uma bomba dentro.
Key.Chinesesimp: 有辆小车，里面装了炸弹。
Key.Japanese: 爆弾ヲ積ンダ車ガアル。
Key.Turkish: İçinde bomba olan bir araba var.

Key.Original: Take it to address I just send you.
Key.Chinese: 把它開到我傳給你的地址。
Key.French: Gare-la à l'adresse que je t'ai envoyée.
Key.Spanish: Llévalo a la dirección que te acabo de mandar.
Key.Italian: Guidala fino all’indirizzo che ti ho appena mandato.
Key.Polish: Wysłałem ci adres – jedź nim tam.
Key.Russian: Отвези ее на адрес, который я тебе прислал.
Key.German: Fahre ihn zu der Adresse, die ich dir gerade geschickt habe.
Key.Czech: Dojeď s ním na adresu, kterou ti posílám.
Key.English: Take it to address I just send you.
Key.Portuguese: Leve pro endereço que acabei de mandar.
Key.Chinesesimp: 把它开到我发给你的地址那儿。
Key.Japanese: 俺ガ今送ッタ住所ニ持ッテイケ。
Key.Turkish: Onu, az önce sana gönderdiğim adrese götür.

Key.Original: Avoid checkpoints.
Key.French: Évite les checkpoints.
Key.Spanish: Evita los puntos de control.
Key.Italian: Evita i punti di controllo.
Key.German: Meide die Kontrollpunkte.
Key.English: Avoid checkpoints.
Key.Portuguese: Evite pontos de verificação.
Key.Japanese: 検問所ハ避ケロ。

Key.Original: And when you get there, park close.
Key.Chinese: 到了以後，把車停得離目標近一點。
Key.French: Quand tu y es, gare-toi très près.
Key.Spanish: Y, cuando llegues, aparca cerca.
Key.Italian: E quando arrivi parcheggia nelle vicinanze.
Key.Russian: Припаркуй ее как можно ближе к зданию.
Key.German: Und wenn du da bist, parke nahe am Haus.
Key.Czech: A až tam budeš, parkuj blízko.
Key.English: And when you get there, park close.
Key.Portuguese: E, quando chegar lá, estacione perto.
Key.Chinesesimp: 到那儿后，把车停在旁边。
Key.Japanese: 目的地ニ着イタラ、近クニ駐車シロ。
Key.Turkish: Ve oraya vardığında, yakına park et.

Key.Original: Then, moment you clear, explode it.
Key.Chinese: 然後，你一離開，馬上引爆它。
Key.French: Une fois parti, fais-la sauter.
Key.Spanish: Tan pronto te vayas, hazlo explotar.
Key.Italian: Poi, non appena ti sei allontanato, falla esplodere.
Key.Russian: Как только отойдешь на безопасное расстояние — сразу взрывай.
Key.German: Sobald du in Sicherheit bist, zünde die Bombe.
Key.Czech: Potom až budeš pryč, můžeš ho vybuchnout.
Key.English: Then, moment you clear, explode it.
Key.Portuguese: Aí, no momento que tiver livre, exploda.
Key.Korean: 그 다음, 준비가 되면 폭파시키는 거다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 然后，跑开后就引爆炸弹。
Key.Japanese: 誰ニモ見ラレテナイノヲ確認シタラ爆発サセロ。

Key.Original: Government will see, they can't act against us with impunité.
Key.Chinese: 政府會瞭解到，他們不能用武力對我們採取行動。
Key.French: Le gouvernement saura qu'il peut pas agir en toute impunité.
Key.Spanish: El gobierno verá que no puede actuar contra nosotros con impunité.
Key.Italian: Il governo capirà che non può agire contro di noi con impunité.
Key.Polish: Rząd zobaczy, że nie może nas zwalczać impunité.
Key.Russian: Пускай правительство узнает, что их действия против нас не останутся безнаказанными.
Key.German: Die Regierung wird merken, dass sie nicht mit impunité gegen uns vorgehen kann.
Key.Czech: Vláda uvidí, že k nám musí mít respekt!
Key.English: Government will see, they can't act against us with impunité.
Key.Portuguese: O governo vai ver, eles não podem agir contra a gente com impunidade.
Key.Korean: 우릴 건드리면 어떻게 되는지 정부도 알게 될 거다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 让政府放明白点，跟我们作对是没有好下场。
Key.Japanese: 政府ニ思イ知ラセテヤルンダ。コッチニハ "アンピュニテ" ガアル。ヤツラモ手ヲ出セナイ。
Key.Turkish: Hükûmet bize karşı impunité ile hareket edemeyeceğini anlayacak.

Container.name: 028_eve_disco_dancer
Container.situation: dancerb comments on the lack of women at the disco.

Key.Original: Yo, mec...
Key.French: Yo, mec...
Key.Spanish: Eh, mec...
Key.Italian: Yo, mec...
Key.German: Yo, mec ...
Key.English: Yo, mec...
Key.Portuguese: Ei, mec...
Key.Japanese: ヨオ...

Key.Original: Où sont les dames ?
Key.French: Où sont les dames ?
Key.Spanish: A ver, ¿dónde están las chicas?
Key.Italian: Allora, dove sono le donzelle?
Key.German: Und wo sind die Mädels?
Key.English: So, where are the ladies?
Key.Portuguese: Então, cadê as damas?
Key.Japanese: ソレデ、女ハドコダ？

Container.name: 023_eve_dancera_afraid_in
Container.situation: dancera tells player to take anything he wants.

Key.Original: Tu es fou !
Key.French: Tu es folle !
Key.Spanish: ¡Se te va la olla!
Key.Italian: Ma tu sei pazzo!
Key.German: Du spinnst doch!
Key.English: You're insane!
Key.Portuguese: Você é insano!
Key.Japanese: オ前、オカシインジャナイカ！？

Key.Original: Prends ce que tu voulais !
Key.French: Prends ce que tu voulais !
Key.Spanish: ¡Llévate lo que quieras!
Key.Italian: Prenditi quello che ti pare!
Key.German: Nimm, was immer du willst!
Key.English: Take whatever you want!
Key.Portuguese: Pegue o que quiser!
Key.Japanese: 何デモ持ッテ行ケバイイ！

Container.name: 024_eve_dancera_afraid_out
Container.situation: dancera tells player to keep his access pass.

Key.Original: Ma carte d'accès ?
Key.French: Ma carte d'accès ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Mi tarjeta de acceso?
Key.Italian: La mia tessera magnetica?
Key.German: Meine Zugangskarte?
Key.English: My access card?
Key.Portuguese: Meu cartão de acesso?
Key.Japanese: 俺ノアクセスカード？

Key.Original: Oui, allez, peu importe !
Key.French: Oui, allez, peu importe !
Key.Spanish: Claro, toma. ¡Toda tuya!
Key.Italian: Certo, fai pure, prenditela!
Key.German: Klar, nimm sie dir!
Key.English: Sure, go ahead, take it!
Key.Portuguese: Claro, vá em frente, pode pegar!
Key.Japanese: アア、持ッテイケ！

Container.name: 022_eve_dancera_go_away_c
Container.situation: dancera tells player to stop bothering him.

Key.Original: Sérieux, c'est quoi ton problème ?
Key.French: Sérieux, c'est quoi ton problème ?
Key.Spanish: En serio, ¿qué coño te pasa?
Key.Italian: Seriamente, che problemi hai?
Key.Russian: Серьезно, что с тобой не так?
Key.German: Jetzt mal im Ernst: Was ist dein Problem?
Key.Czech: Ale vážně už. Co máš za problém?
Key.English: Seriously, what is your problem?
Key.Portuguese: Sério, qual é o seu problema?
Key.Japanese: オイ、本当ニ何ナンダ？

Container.name: 021_eve_dancera_go_away_b
Container.situation: dancera tells player to stop bothering him.

Key.Original: Va danser, ou bouge !
Key.French: Va danser, ou bouge !
Key.Spanish: ¡A bailar o a tomar por saco!
Key.Italian: Vattene a ballare o vedi di andartene a fanculo!
Key.German: Geh tanzen oder verpiss dich!
Key.English: Go dance, or fuck off!
Key.Portuguese: Dança ou dá o fora!
Key.Japanese: "ダンス" シナイナラ消エロ！
Key.Turkish: Gidip dans et ya da defol git!

Container.name: 020_eve_dancera_go_away_a
Container.situation: dancera tells player to stop bothering him.

Key.Original: Tu veux quoi ?
Key.French: Tu veux quoi ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Qué quieres?
Key.Italian: E tu che vuoi?
Key.German: Was willst du?
Key.English: What do you want?
Key.Portuguese: O que você quer?
Key.Japanese: 何カ用カ？

Key.Original: Tu veux pas danser ?
Key.French: Tu veux pas danser ?
Key.Spanish: ¿No quieres bailar?
Key.Italian: Non hai voglia di ballare?
Key.German: Willst du nicht tanzen?
Key.English: You don't wanna dance?
Key.Portuguese: Não quer dançar?
Key.Japanese: "ダンス" シタクナイカ？

Key.Original: Oh - Peut-être que tu es trop vieux maintenant.
Key.Chinese: 哦…可能是老了，跳不動了…
Key.French: Oh - Peut-être que tu es trop vieux maintenant.
Key.Spanish: Ay, igual te pesan los años...
Key.Italian: Oh, forse sei troppo vecchio...
Key.Polish: Aaa, może jesteś na to za stary...
Key.Russian: Или ты слишком стар для этого...
Key.German: Oh, du bist wahrscheinlich zu alt dafür ...
Key.Czech: Aha, možná jsi na to moc starej.
Key.English: Oh - maybe you're too old now...
Key.Portuguese: Ah, talvez você esteja velho demais agora...
Key.Chinesesimp: 哦 - 也许你太老了点...
Key.Japanese: アア、年寄リダカラ踊レナイノカ...

Container.name: 051_in_aa_intel_airstrike
Container.situation: player gets a call from miller, who mentions the presence of aa sites across the islands.

Key.Original: Santiago...
Key.French: Santiago...
Key.Spanish: Santiago...
Key.Italian: Santiago...
Key.German: Santiago ...
Key.English: Santiago...
Key.Portuguese: Santiago...
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ...

Key.Original: The intel you fished out from the plane wreck, we had someone take a look at it.
Key.Chinese: 你從墜機現場中找到的情報，我們已經找人去研究了。
Key.French: J'ai transmis les infos que tu as repêchées dans l'avion à un collègue.
Key.Spanish: Le hemos echado un vistazo a la información que pescaste en el avión siniestrado.
Key.Italian: Le informazioni che hai recuperato dal relitto aereo sono state analizzate.
Key.Polish: Przyjrzeliśmy się tym danym wywiadowczym, które wyłowiłeś z wraku samolotu.
Key.Russian: Мы кое-что поняли из документов, которые ты вытащил из обломков самолета.
Key.German: Die Informationen, die du aus dem Flugzeugwrack geborgen hast, haben wir uns angeschaut.
Key.Czech: Naši lidi prošli data, která jsi vytáhl z toho zříceného letadla.
Key.English: The intel you fished out from the plane wreck, we had someone take a look at it.
Key.Portuguese: A informação que você obteve dos destroços do avião, arranjamos uma pessoa para conferir.
Key.Korean: 비행기 잔해에서 찾아온 정보를 우리쪽에서 확인해봤어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你从飞机残骸那儿搜到的情报，我们派人去瞧了下。
Key.Japanese: お前が飛行機の残骸から回収した情報だが、それを今調べてもらっている。
Key.Turkish: Uçak enkazından topladığın istihbarat; ona göz atacak biri var.

Key.Original: There are some pretty sophisticated SAM sites here.
Key.Chinese: 這裡有許多精密的 SAM 地對空系統。
Key.French: Dans la région, il y a deux lanceurs anti-aériens plutôt sophistiqués.
Key.Spanish: Hay unos misiles tierra-aire bastante sofisticados.
Key.Italian: Ci sono dei siti SAM piuttosto sofisticati qui.
Key.Russian: У них там довольно навороченные ПЗРК.
Key.German: Hier scheint es eine Reihe fortschrittlicher SAM-Anlagen zu geben.
Key.English: There are some pretty sophisticated SAM sites here.
Key.Portuguese: Tem uns locais de mísseis superfície-ar bem sofisticados lá.
Key.Korean: 여기에 상당한 고급 기술의 지대공 미사일 발사기가 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这儿有几处挺先进的 SAM 发射场。
Key.Japanese: ここにはかなり洗練された SAM サイトがある。
Key.Turkish: Burada oldukça gelişmiş karadan havaya füze bölgeleri var.

Key.Original: They rely on two radar stations - a big one, on Mont Tanoa, and another somewhere else.
Key.Chinese: 他們仰賴兩個雷達站，大的在塔諾雅山，另一個在別處。
Key.French: Ils s'appuient sur deux radars. Un grand sur le Mont Tanoa et un autre ailleurs.
Key.Spanish: Se guían por medio de dos estaciones de radar: una grande en Mont Tanoa y otra en un lugar distinto.
Key.Italian: Fanno affidamento su due stazioni radar. Una grande, sul Mont Tanoa, e un’altra altrove.
Key.Polish: System oparty jest na dwóch stacjach radarowych: dużej, na Mont Tanoa, i drugiej gdzieś indziej.
Key.Russian: Они используют две радиолокационные станции: одна покрупнее, на Монт Таноа, и вторая где-то поблизости.
Key.German: Sie werden von zwei Radarstationen unterstützt – eine große auf Mont Tanoa und eine zweite, deren Position wir nicht kennen.
Key.Czech: Spoléhají na dva radary. Jeden velký na Mont Tanoa a druhý někde jinde.
Key.English: They rely on two radar stations - a big one, on Mont Tanoa, and another somewhere else.
Key.Portuguese: Eles contam com duas estações de radar. Uma bem grande no Monte Tanoa, e mais uma em outro lugar.
Key.Korean: 놈들은 두 개의 레이더 기지에 의존하고 있어. 큰 레이더는 타노아 산 위에 있고, 또 하나는 다른 어딘가에 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 它们靠两个雷达站起作用 - 一个大的，在塔诺亚山，另一个在别的什么地方。
Key.Japanese: 2 つのレーダー基地を使っている。デカいのはモンタノアに、もう 1 つは別の場所にある。
Key.Turkish: İki radar istasyonuna bağlılar; büyük olan Mont Tanoa’da ve diğeri de başka bir yerde.

Key.Original: If this wasn't a covert op, we could knock them out and coordinate airstrikes. But it is and we can't.
Key.Chinese: 如果這不是機密任務，我們能直接朝座標進行空襲轟炸。不過這是機密任務，所以我們不能這麼做。
Key.French: Si on agissait officiellement, on pourrait lancer une frappe. Mais on opère en secret.
Key.Spanish: Si esto no fuese una operación encubierta, podríamos reventarlas y coordinar ataques aéreos. Pero lo es, así que no podemos.
Key.Italian: Se non si trattasse di un’operazione segreta, potremmo metterle fuori uso e richiedere le incursioni aeree. Ma siamo in incognito, quindi non è possibile.
Key.Polish: Gdybyśmy nie działali po cichu, moglibyśmy je załatwić nalotami. Ale działamy, więc to odpada.
Key.Russian: Если бы наша операция не была секретной, мы бы их быстро уничтожили аваиаударом. Но, к сожалению, мы не можем.
Key.German: Wenn das keine verdeckte Mission wäre, würden wir sie aus der Luft ausschalten, aber das ist hier keine Option.
Key.Czech: Kdyby tohle nebyla tajná operace, mohli bysme je sejmout náletem. Ale tajná je, takže to nepůjde.
Key.English: If this wasn't a covert op, we could knock them out and coordinate airstrikes. But it is and we can't.
Key.Portuguese: Se não fosse uma operação secreta, podíamos eliminá-los e coordenar ataques aéreos. Mas, infelizmente, não dá.
Key.Korean: 비밀 작전만 아니었다면 전부 박살내고 공습 요청을 했을 테지만, 지금은 안 돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果这不是一次秘密行动，我们本可以直接摧毁它们，还可以请求空袭。但这是一次秘密行动，所以不能这么干。
Key.Japanese: これが隠密作戦でなければ、2 つとも破壊して空襲を手配できるんだがな。残念だが、今回はそうもいかない。
Key.Turkish: Bu gizli bir operasyon olmasaydı işlerini bitirebilirdik ve hava saldırıları koordine edebilirdik. Fakat gizli ve yapamayız.

Key.Original: That said, if you can throw a spanner in the works, go ahead, I'm happy putting options on the table.
Key.Chinese: 不過，你要是想去搞破壞，那也行，我都願意去嘗試各種方法。
Key.French: Cela dit, si tu veux leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues, je te ferai des propositions.
Key.Spanish: Dicho esto, si puedes hacerles un cristo, adelante. Nunca está de más tener alternativas disponibles.
Key.Italian: Detto questo, se riuscissi ad ostacolarne il funzionamento, fai pure. Sono aperto a vagliare altre possibilità.
Key.Polish: Co nie znaczy, że nie możesz im nabruździć – nie pogardzę żadną z opcji.
Key.Russian: Тем не менее, если тебе удастся вставить им палки в колеса, то я только «за». Я рассмотрю любые варианты.
Key.German: Wenn du dich um die Sache kümmern könntest, wäre das hervorragend. Mir ist jede Hilfe recht.
Key.Czech: Každopádně kdybys jim mohl trochu zavařit, nezlobil bych se. Přivítám jakýkoli návrh.
Key.English: That said, if you can throw a spanner in the works, go ahead, I'm happy putting options on the table.
Key.Portuguese: Enfim, se puder atrapalhar os planos deles, vá em frente, fico feliz em ter opções na mesa.
Key.Korean: 어쨌든 가서 박살내고 싶으면 그렇게 해. 방법은 알아서 선택하면 돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这样吧，如果你能去搞点破坏；那就去干吧，我乐见其成。
Key.Japanese: だが、計画を妨害できそうならやってくれ。選択肢が複数あるのはいいことだ。
Key.Turkish: Bununla birlikte, işin içine edebilirseniz, hiç çekinmeyin; seve seve seçenek sunarım.

Container.name: 050_eve_doctor_rescued
Container.situation: player rescues doctor and boss calls to threaten him.

Key.Original: Bad move, Képi blanc.
Key.French: Mauvais choix, Képi blanc.
Key.Spanish: Mala jugada, Képi blanc.
Key.Italian: Mossa sbagliata, Képi blanc.
Key.German: Schlechter Schachzug, Képi blanc.
Key.English: Bad move, Képi blanc.
Key.Portuguese: Péssima ideia, Képi blanc.
Key.Japanese: ヤッテクレタナ、ケピ・ブロン。

Key.Original: You petit homme - we will find you.
Key.Chinese: 你這個小矮人，我們會找到你的。
Key.French: Tu es un petit homme, on te trouvera.
Key.Spanish: Te vamos a encontrar, petit homme...
Key.Italian: Tu, petit homme... ti troveremo.
Key.Russian: Ах, ты пети ом, мы найдем тебя.
Key.German: Du petit homme – wir werden dich finden.
Key.Czech: Ten tvůj petit homme... My tě najít.
Key.English: You petit homme - we will find you.
Key.Portuguese: Você é petit homme, vamo te achar.
Key.Korean: 넌 쁘띠똠므다. 널 꼭 찾아낼 것이다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你这个小矮人 - 我们会找到你的。
Key.Japanese: プティ・オム。オ前ヲ探シ出ス。

Key.Original: And when we do, you crocodile food, papi...
Key.Chinese: 到時候，你就會變成鱷魚飼料，老爹…
Key.French: Et on te donnera à manger aux crocodiles, papi...
Key.Spanish: Y, cuando lo hagamos, se te van a merendar los cocodrilos, papy...
Key.Italian: E quando lo faremo, sarai cibo per coccodrilli, papi...
Key.Polish: A wtedy będziesz karmą dla krokodyli, papi…
Key.Russian: Пойдешь у нас на корм крокодилам, папи...
Key.German: Und wenn es soweit ist, bist du Krokodilfutter, papi ...
Key.Czech: A až tě najít, jsi žrádlo pro krokodýly, papi.
Key.English: And when we do, you crocodile food, papi...
Key.Portuguese: E quando isso acontecer, cê vai virar comida de crocodilo, papi...
Key.Korean: 그럼 넌 악어밥이 될 것이다, 빠트롱...
Key.Japanese: 見ツケタラ、"クロコダイル" ノ餌ニシテヤル、パピ...
Key.Turkish: Ve bulduğumuzda timsah yemi olacaksın, papi...

Container.name: 049_ta_sample_taken_to_van_alt_bad_rep_out_call
Container.situation: player takes the counteragent to the van, as ordered by syndikat_boss. reputation level is bad.

Key.Original: There is a petit submersible at the harbor in Tavu.
Key.Chinese: 塔夫的碼頭有一艘小型潛水艇。
Key.French: Il y a un petit submersible dans le port de Tavu.
Key.Spanish: Hay un petit submersible en el puerto de Tavu.
Key.Italian: C’è un petit submersible al porto di Tavu.
Key.Polish: Na przystani w Tavu jest petit submersible.
Key.Russian: В гавани Таву есть пети субмерсибль.
Key.German: Im Hafen von Tavu liegt ein kleines U-Boot.
Key.Czech: V přístavu v Tavu je un petit submersible.
Key.English: There is a petit submersible at the harbor in Tavu.
Key.Portuguese: Tem un petit submarino no porto de Tavu.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在塔夫港口，有一艘小型潜艇。
Key.Japanese: "タブ" ノ湾ニ小サナ潜水艇ガアル。
Key.Turkish: Tavu’daki limanda petit bir denizaltı var.

Key.Original: Take it, use it to escape. Go to La Roche. If I see you again...
Key.Chinese: 用它逃走。去 La Roche。要是再讓我看見你…
Key.French: Enfuis-toi avec et va à La Roche. Si je te revois...
Key.Spanish: Llévatelo y escapa con él. Ve a La Roche. Y, como te vuelva a ver el pelo...
Key.Italian: Prendilo e usalo per fuggire. Vai a La Roche. Se dovessimo rincontrarci...
Key.Polish: Weź ją i uciekaj. Do La Roche. Jak cię jeszcze zobaczę…
Key.Russian: Используй ее, чтобы сбежать. Отправляйся в Ла-Рош. Но если я тебя снова увижу...
Key.German: Damit kannst du entkommen. Fahr bis La Roche und lass dich hier nie wieder blicken ...
Key.Czech: Vezmi ho a uteč. Do La Roche. Jestli tě ještě někdy vidím...
Key.English: Take it, use it to escape. Go to La Roche. If I see you again...
Key.Portuguese: Pega e usa pra escapar. Segue pra La Roche. Se eu te ver de novo...
Key.Korean: 그걸 타고 탈출해라. 라 로슈로 가는 거다. 다시 내 눈에 띄면...
Key.Chinesesimp: 找到它，用它逃走。去拉罗歇。要是我再看到你...
Key.Japanese: ソレニ乗ッテ脱出シロ。"ラ・ロシェル" マデ行ケ。マタ会ウコトガアレバ...
Key.Turkish: Al onu, kaçmak için kullan. La Roche’ye git. Seni tekrar görürsem...

Key.Original: You not do so well. Adieu, old man.
Key.Chinese: 你表現不怎麼。再見，老頭。
Key.French: Ça ira mal. Adieu, Old Man.
Key.Spanish: No te va a ir tan bien. Adieu, viejo.
Key.Italian: le cose potrebbero mettersi male per te. Adieu, vecchio.
Key.German: Das ist nicht gut gelaufen. Adieu, alter Mann.
Key.Czech: Nebudeš to mít dobrý. Adieu, starče.
Key.English: You not do so well. Adieu, old man.
Key.Portuguese: Se não se sair bem... Adieu, velho.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那就有你好看的了。再见吧，老头。
Key.Japanese: 痛イ目ヲ見ルゾ。オデュー。
Key.Turkish: Pek iyi iş çıkaramadın. Adieu, yaşlı adam.

Container.name: 048_ta_sample_taken_to_van_alt_bad_rep_doctor_call
Container.situation: player takes the counteragent to the van, as ordered by syndikat_boss. reputation level is bad.

Key.Original: The doctor-man, he free to go.
Key.French: Le docteur est libre.
Key.Spanish: El médico puede irse.
Key.Italian: Il dottore è ora libero di andare.
Key.German: Dein Doktor-Freund kann gehen.
Key.English: The doctor-man, he free to go.
Key.Portuguese: O médico, ele tá livre pra partir.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那个医生嘛，他可以走了。
Key.Japanese: アノ医者ハ解放シテヤル。

Key.Original: But you. I want you gone from here.
Key.Chinese: 但是，你。我要你離開這裡。
Key.French: Mais toi, je veux plus te voir ici.
Key.Spanish: Y tú... Quiero que te largues de aquí.
Key.Italian: Ma tu... ti voglio via da qui.
Key.Russian: А вот тебе лучше убраться отсюда.
Key.German: Aber dich will ich hier nicht mehr sehen.
Key.Czech: Ale ty. Ty už tady bejt nesmíš.
Key.English: But you. I want you gone from here.
Key.Portuguese: Mas você... Quero que cê vá embora daqui.
Key.Chinesesimp: 而你，我希望你从这儿消失。
Key.Japanese: ダガ、オ前ニハココカラ離レテモライタイ。

Container.name: 047_ta_sample_taken_to_van_alt_bad_rep_in_call
Container.situation: player takes the counteragent to the van, as ordered by syndikat_boss. reputation level is bad.

Key.Original: Bon choix, Képi blanc.
Key.French: Bon choix, Képi blanc.
Key.Spanish: Buena suerte, Képi blanc.
Key.Italian: Buona fortuna, Képi Blanc.
Key.German: Viel Glück, Képi blanc.
Key.English: Good luck, Képi blanc.
Key.Portuguese: Boa sorte, Képi blanc.
Key.Japanese: 幸運ヲ祈ル、ケピ・ブロン。

Key.Original: You not so stupid, eh?
Key.French: T'es pas stupide, hein ?
Key.Spanish: No eres tan idiota, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Non sei così stupido, eh?
Key.Russian: Ты не такой уж и глупый, да?
Key.German: Du bist wohl doch nicht so dumm.
Key.English: You not so stupid, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Você não é tão estúpido, hein?
Key.Japanese: オ前ハ馬鹿ジャナイヨナ？
Key.Turkish: O kadar da aptal değilsin, ha?

Container.name: 046_ta_sample_taken_to_van_alt_out_call
Container.situation: player takes the counteragent to the van, as ordered by syndikat_boss. reputation level is good.

Key.Original: But, écoute moi. You in big danger.
Key.Chinese: 可是，聽我說。你的處境很危險。
Key.French: Mais écoute-moi. Tu es en danger.
Key.Spanish: Mira, écoute moi. Estás en mucho peligro.
Key.Italian: Écoute-moi. Sei in grave pericolo.
Key.Polish: Ale, écoute moi. Jesteś w tarapatach.
Key.Russian: Но, экутэ муа. Ты в большой опасности.
Key.German: Aber écoute moi, du bist in großer Gefahr.
Key.Czech: Teď, écoute moi. Máš velký nebezpečí.
Key.English: But, écoute moi. You in big danger.
Key.Portuguese: Agora, écoute-moi. Cê tá correndo grande perigo.
Key.Korean: 하지만, 에꾸뜨 므와. 넌 큰 위험에 처해 있다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过，听我说。你有大危险了。
Key.Japanese: ダガ、エクートゥ・モア。危ナイ橋ヲ渡ッテルゾ。

Key.Original: Your NATO friends, they betray you.
Key.Chinese: 你那些 NATO 的朋友們背叛了你。
Key.French: Tes amis de l'OTAN, ils t'ont trahi.
Key.Spanish: Tus amigos de la OTAN te han traicionado.
Key.Italian: I tuoi amici della NATO ti hanno tradito.
Key.Russian: Твои друзья из НАТО предадут тебя.
Key.German: Deine NATO-Freunde haben dich verraten.
Key.Czech: Tvý kámoši z NATO ti dělají zradu.
Key.English: Your NATO friends, they betray you.
Key.Portuguese: Seus amigos da OTAN te traíram.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的 NATO 朋友，他们背叛了你。
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ NATO ノ友人ガオ前ヲ裏切ッタ。

Key.Original: After you betray them.
Key.Chinese: 因為你之前出賣了他們。
Key.French: Après, tu les as trahis.
Key.Spanish: Después de que los traicionases.
Key.Italian: Dopo che tu li hai traditi.
Key.Russian: После того, как ты предал их.
Key.German: Nachdem du sie verraten hast.
Key.English: After you betray them.
Key.Portuguese: Depois de você trair eles.
Key.Chinesesimp: 因为你之前出卖了他们。
Key.Japanese: オ前ガヤツラヲ裏切ッタ後ニナ。

Key.Original: CSAT know who you are - 'Santiago'.
Key.French: Le CSAT sait qui tu es, "Santiago".
Key.Spanish: El CSAT sabe quién eres... «Santiago».
Key.Italian: La CSAT sa chi sei. “Santiago”.
Key.German: CSAT weiß, wer du bist, „Santiago“.
Key.English: CSAT know who you are - 'Santiago'.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT sabe quem você é, "Santiago".
Key.Japanese: CSAT ニオ前ノ素性ガバレタゾ。「サンティアゴ」ダトナ。

Key.Original: Tanoa. It no place for you no more.
Key.Chinese: 塔諾雅，你不該再待在這裡了。
Key.French: Tanoa, c'est plus pour toi, maintenant.
Key.Spanish: Tanoa ya no es lugar para ti.
Key.Italian: Tanoa non è più il posto per te.
Key.Polish: Nie jesteś już bezpieczny na Tanoa.
Key.Russian: Тебе нечего больше делать на Таноа.
Key.German: Tanoa ist nicht mehr sicher für dich.
Key.Czech: Tanoa už není místo pro tebe.
Key.English: Tanoa. It no place for you no more.
Key.Portuguese: Tanoa. Non tem mais lugar pra você.
Key.Chinesesimp: 塔诺亚。你不该再呆在那儿了。
Key.Japanese: タノア。オ前ニハモウ居場所ハナイ。
Key.Turkish: Tanoa. Artık orada sana yer yok.

Key.Original: But L'Ensemble? We don't forget our friends.
Key.Chinese: 至於 L'Ensemble？我們從來不會忘記我們的朋友。
Key.French: Mais l'Ensemble n'oublie pas ses amis.
Key.Spanish: ¿Y L'Ensemble? Nosotros siempre pensamos en nuestros amigos.
Key.Italian: Ma L’Ensemble non dimentica i suoi amici.
Key.Polish: Ale L’Ensemble pamięta o swoich przyjaciołach.
Key.Russian: Но мы в Л'Енсабле не забываем своих друзей.
Key.German: Aber L'Ensemble vergisst seine Freunde nicht.
Key.Czech: Ale l'Ensemble? My naše kamarádi nezapomínáme.
Key.English: But L'Ensemble? We don't forget our friends.
Key.Portuguese: Mas L'Ensemble? A gente não esquece amigos.
Key.Korean: 하지만 '앙상블'은? 우린 동지를 절대 외면하지 않는다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 至于大帮会，我们从来不会忘记自己的朋友。
Key.Japanese: ダガ、"ランサンブル" ハ友人ヲ忘レタリハシナイ。

Key.Original: There is a petit submersible at the harbor in Tavu.
Key.Chinese: 塔夫的碼頭有一艘小型潛水艇。
Key.French: Il y a un petit submersible dans le port de Tavu.
Key.Spanish: Hay un petit submersible en el puerto de Tavu.
Key.Italian: C’è un petit submersible al porto di Tavu.
Key.Polish: Na przystani w Tavu jest petit submersible.
Key.Russian: В гавани Таву есть пети субмерсибль.
Key.German: Im Hafen von Tavu liegt ein kleines U-Boot.
Key.Czech: V přístavu v Tavu je un petit submersible.
Key.English: There is a petit submersible at the harbor in Tavu.
Key.Portuguese: Tem un petit submarino no porto de Tavu.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在塔夫港口，有一艘小型潜艇。
Key.Japanese: "タブ" ノ湾ニ小サナ潜水艇ガアル。
Key.Turkish: Tavu’daki limanda petit bir denizaltı var.

Key.Original: Take it, use it to escape. Go to La Roche. Go safe. Adieu.
Key.Chinese: 找到它，用它逃走。去 La Roche。注意安全，再見。
Key.French: Enfuis-toi avec et va à La Roche. Sois prudent. Adieu.
Key.Spanish: Llévatelo y escapa con él. Ve a La Roche. Ponte a salvo. Adieu.
Key.Italian: Prendilo e usalo per fuggire. Vai a La Roche. Mettiti al sicuro. Adieu.
Key.Polish: Weź ją i uciekaj. Do La Roche. Powodzenia. Adieu.
Key.Russian: Используй ее, чтобы сбежать. Отправляйся в Ла-Рош. В безопасное место. Адью.
Key.German: Damit kannst du entkommen. Fahr bis La Roche und pass auf dich auf. Adieu.
Key.Czech: Vezmi ho a uteč. Do La Roche. Do bezpečí. Adieu.
Key.English: Take it, use it to escape. Go to La Roche. Go safe. Adieu.
Key.Portuguese: Pega e usa pra escapar. Segue pra La Roche. Vai com segurança. Adieu.
Key.Korean: 그걸 타고 탈출해라. 라 로슈로 가는 거다. 조심해라. 아듀.
Key.Chinesesimp: 找到它，用它逃走。去拉罗歇。注意安全。再见。
Key.Japanese: ソレニ乗ッテ脱出シロ。"ラ・ロシェル" マデ行ケ。気ヲ付ケロ。アデュー。
Key.Turkish: Al onu, kaçmak için kullan. La Roche’ye git. Güvenliğine dikkat et. Adieu.

Container.name: 045_ta_sample_taken_to_van_alt_doctor_call
