Container.situation: player takes the counteragent to the van, as ordered by syndikat_boss. reputation level is good.

Key.Original: Your doctor-man.
Key.French: Ton docteur.
Key.Spanish: Tu médico.
Key.Italian: Il tuo amico dottore.
Key.Russian: Скажи своему другу врачу, что он свободен.
Key.German: Dein Doktor-Freund.
Key.English: Your doctor-man.
Key.Portuguese: Seu camarada doutor.
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ医者ノ友人。

Key.Original: He done here. He free to go...
Key.French: Il en a fini ici. On l'a libéré...
Key.Spanish: Ya ha terminado. Puede irse.
Key.Italian: Ha finito qui. È libero di andare...
Key.German: Er ist hier fertig. Er kann gehen ...
Key.English: He done here. He free to go...
Key.Portuguese: Ele terminou. Pronto pra partir...
Key.Korean: 이제 더 이상 필요없다. 가도 좋다...
Key.Japanese: モウ用ナシダ。解放シテヤル...

Container.name: 044_ta_sample_taken_to_van_alt_in_call
Container.situation: player takes the counteragent to the van, as ordered by syndikat_boss. reputation level is good.

Key.Original: Okay...
Key.French: OK...
Key.Spanish: Vale...
Key.Italian: Okay...
Key.German: Okay ...
Key.English: Okay...
Key.Portuguese: Beleza...
Key.Japanese: ヨシ…

Key.Original: I think we good.
Key.French: Je crois que c'est bon.
Key.Spanish: Creo que estamos bien.
Key.Italian: Penso che siamo a posto.
Key.German: Wir sind quitt.
Key.English: I think we good.
Key.Portuguese: Acho que tudo certo.
Key.Japanese: ウマクイッタ。

Container.name: 043_ta_counteragent_in_van
Container.situation: player places the counteragent in the van and boss calls.

Key.Original: Très bien.
Key.French: Très bien.
Key.Spanish: Buen trabajo.
Key.Italian: Molto bene.
Key.German: Gute Arbeit.
Key.English: Well done.
Key.Portuguese: Muito bem.
Key.Japanese: ヨシ。

Key.Original: Leave it and go, we watchin' you...
Key.Chinese: 留下它，然後離開，我們會盯著你的…
Key.French: Laisse ça et va-t'en. On te regarde...
Key.Spanish: Haz la entrega y márchate. Te estamos vigilando...
Key.Italian: Lascialo lì e vattene, ti teniamo d’occhio...
Key.Polish: A teraz idź, mamy cię na oku...
Key.Russian: Оставь там и уходи, мы следим за тобой...
Key.German: Lass es da und verschwinde. Wir beobachten dich ...
Key.Czech: Nech to a běž. Sledujeme tě.
Key.English: Leave it and go, we watchin' you...
Key.Portuguese: Saia e prossiga, tamo de olho em você...
Key.Korean: 거기 놓고 가라. 우리가 널 지켜보고 있다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 留下东西，马上离开，我们盯你呢...
Key.Japanese: ソコニ置イテ行ケ。見テルカラナ...

Container.name: 042_eve_in_georgetown_syndikat_boss
Container.situation: boss contacts player as they approach the van.

Key.Original: I see you come to Georgetown. Good.
Key.Chinese: 你來到了喬治鎮了啊，很好。
Key.French: Je vois que tu es à Georgetown. Bien.
Key.Spanish: Veo que estás en Georgetown. Bien.
Key.Italian: Vedo che sei venuto a Georgetown. Bene.
Key.Polish: Widzę, że jesteś w Georgetown. Dobrze.
Key.German: Du bist in Georgetown angekommen, sehr gut.
Key.Czech: Vidím, že blížíš do Georgetownu. Dobrý.
Key.English: I see you come to Georgetown. Good.
Key.Portuguese: Vejo que você chegou a Georgetown. Bom.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我看见你到乔治敦了。很好。
Key.Japanese: "ジョージタウン" ニ来タナ。ヨシ。

Key.Original: The drop is close to la cathédrale. Behind the meat market...
Key.Chinese: 目的地就在大教堂附近，就在肉市後面…
Key.French: Tu livres près de la cathédrale. Derrière la boucherie "meat market"...
Key.Spanish: El punto de entrega está cerca de la cathédrale, detrás del mercado de carne...
Key.Italian: La consegna è vicino alla cathédrale. Dietro al mercato della carne...
Key.Polish: Prezent podrzuć niedaleko la cathédrale. Za targiem mięsnym…
Key.Russian: Рядом с ля катедраль. За мясным рынком...
Key.German: Dein Zielort ist in der Nähe von la cathédrale. Hinter dem Fleischmarkt ...
Key.Czech: Předávka je poblíž la cathédrale. Za trhem masa.
Key.English: The drop is close to la cathédrale. Behind the meat market...
Key.Portuguese: A carga tá próxima da cathédrale. Atrás do açougue...
Key.Chinesesimp: 目的地在大教堂附近。肉市后面...
Key.Japanese: 置キ場所ハ "ラ・カテドラール" ノ近クダ。肉屋ノ後ロダ...
Key.Turkish: İkmal, la cathédrale’e yakın bir yerde. Et pazarının arkasında...

Container.name: 041_eve_approaching_van_syndikat_boss
Container.situation: boss contacts player as they approach the van.

Key.Original: You close, Képi. It's the blue van.
Key.Chinese: 很近了，Képi。就是那輛藍色廂型車。
Key.French: Tu y es, Képi. C'est le van bleu.
Key.Spanish: Estás cerca, Képi. Es la furgoneta azul.
Key.Italian: Sei vicino, Képi. È il furgone blu.
Key.Russian: Ты уже близко, Кепи. Синий фургон.
Key.German: Du bist nah dran, Képi. Es ist ein blauer Transporter.
Key.English: You close, Képi. It's the blue van.
Key.Portuguese: Você tá perto, Képi. É a van azul.
Key.Korean: 거의 다 왔다, 케피. 파란색 밴이다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 离你很近了，Képi。是辆蓝色货车。
Key.Japanese: 近イゾ、ケピ。アノ青イ "バン" ダ。

Container.name: 040_ex_no_parking_angry
Container.situation: player is told by gendarme that they cannot park where player has parked.

Key.Original: Papi ! J'ai dit bouge ta putain de voiture !
Key.Chinese: 老頭，我叫你把這該死的車子移一下！
Key.French: Papi ! J'ai dit bouge ta putain de voiture !
Key.Spanish: ¡Viejo, te he dicho que muevas el puto coche!
Key.Italian: Vecchio, ti ho detto di spostare la tua cazzo di macchina!
Key.Polish: Staruszku, mówiłem, żebyś przestawił ten cholerny wóz!
Key.Russian: Я говорю, убрал машину, чертов старпёр!
Key.German: Alter Mann, du sollst deinen Wagen da wegschaffen!
Key.Czech: Řekl jsem, ať uhneš s tím autem, dědku!
Key.English: Old man, I said move your fucking car!
Key.Portuguese: Velho, eu disse, tira a porra do seu carro daí!
Key.Chinesesimp: 老头，我说，把你那破车挪走！
Key.Japanese: オッサン、車ヲ動カセッテ言ッタンダ！
Key.Turkish: Yaşlı adam, sana şu lanet arabanı çek dedim!

Container.name: 039_ex_no_parking
Container.situation: player is told by gendarme that they cannot park where player has parked.

Key.Original: Hey, whoah ! Non, vous ne pouvez pas stationner ici !
Key.French: Hey, whoah ! Non, vous ne pouvez pas stationner ici !
Key.Spanish: ¿De qué vas? ¡No puedes aparcar aquí!
Key.Italian: Ehi! Non puoi parcheggiare qui!
Key.German: Hey, Alter! Du kannst hier nicht parken!
Key.English: Hey, whoah! No, you can't park here!
Key.Portuguese: Epa! Não, você não pode estacionar aqui!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，哎呀！不行，你不能在这儿停车！
Key.Japanese: オイ！ココハ駐車禁止ダ！
Key.Turkish: Hey, hop! Hayır, buraya park edemezsin!

Container.name: 038_ex_timeout_traitor_alt
Container.situation: player is assigned a task to destroy the traitor's house.

Key.Original: Képi - bad news.
Key.French: Képi. Mauvaise nouvelle.
Key.Spanish: Képi, tengo malas noticias.
Key.Italian: Képi, cattive notizie.
Key.German: Képi – schlechte Neuigkeiten.
Key.English: Képi - bad news.
Key.Portuguese: Képi, más notícias.
Key.Japanese: ケピ、悪い知らせだ。

Key.Original: Gendarmes took our comrade into the mangrove swamps.
Key.Chinese: 國家憲兵把我們的同伴帶到了紅樹林沼澤中。
Key.French: Les gendarmes sont allés dans la mangrove avec notre camarade.
Key.Spanish: Los gendarmes se llevaron a nuestro camarada a los manglares.
Key.Italian: I gendarmi hanno portato il nostro compagno nelle paludi di mangrovie.
Key.Polish: Żandarmi zabrali naszego kompana na namorzyny.
Key.Russian: Жандармы повели нашего товарища на болото в мангровых зарослях.
Key.German: Gendarmes haben unseren Kameraden in die Mangrovensümpfe gebracht.
Key.Czech: Četníci odvlekli našeho člověka do močálu mangrovů.
Key.English: Gendarmes took our comrade into the mangrove swamps.
Key.Portuguese: Os gendarmes levaram nosso camarada pros pântanos.
Key.Korean: 헌병대가 우리의 동지를 잡아서 맹그로브 습지로 끌고 갔다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 宪兵队把我们的同志带到红树林沼泽地里了。
Key.Japanese: 国家憲兵隊が俺達の仲間をマングローブ林の沼地に連れて行った。
Key.Turkish: Jandarmalar silah arkadaşımızı mangrov bataklıklarına götürdüler.

Key.Original: They execute him there.
Key.French: Ils l'ont exécuté sur place.
Key.Spanish: Lo ejecutaron allí mismo.
Key.Italian: Lo giustizieranno lì.
Key.German: Sie wollen ihn dort hinrichten.
Key.English: They execute him there.
Key.Portuguese: Eles executam por lá.
Key.Japanese: そこで処刑するつもりなんだ。

Key.Original: Nothing you can do now.
Key.French: Tu peux rien faire.
Key.Spanish: Ya no se puede hacer nada.
Key.Italian: Non puoi fare niente adesso.
Key.German: Du kannst nichts dagegen tun.
Key.Czech: Teď už s tím nic neuděláš.
Key.English: Nothing you can do now.
Key.Portuguese: Não tem nada que cê possa fazer agora.
Key.Korean: 이제 우리가 할 수 있는 일은 없다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在你做什么都没用了。
Key.Japanese: 今、お前にできることは何もない。

Key.Original: Time will come when we find out who responsible - and we get justice...
Key.Chinese: 我們遲早會找出是誰幹的－－到時候再報仇雪恨…
Key.French: Le moment venu, on trouvera le responsable. Et justice sera faite...
Key.Spanish: Algún día sabremos quién fue el responsable y se hará justicia...
Key.Italian: Un giorno scopriremo chi è il responsabile e faremo giustizia...
Key.Polish: W słusznym czasie dowiemy się, kto za tym stoi, i się odpowiednio odpłacimy…
Key.Russian: Придет время, и мы добьемся справедливости...
Key.German: Irgendwann finden wir den Verantwortlichen – und dann sorgen wir für Gerechtigkeit ...
Key.Czech: Jednoho dne zjistíme, kdo za to může. A pomstíme se mu.
Key.English: Time will come when we find out who responsible - and we get justice...
Key.Portuguese: Um dia vamo descobrir quem foi responsável e obter justiça...
Key.Korean: 언젠가는 누구의 소행인지 밝혀낼 수 있을 거다. 그때 복수할 것이다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 总有一天我们会查出这是谁干的 - 正义会来的...
Key.Japanese: 誰の仕業かはそのうち分かる。分かったら、正義の鉄槌を下すぞ...
Key.Turkish: Bundan kimin sorumlu olduğunu öğreneceğimiz zaman da gelecek; adaleti sağlayacağız...

Container.name: 037_ta_loaded_plane_delivered_call
Container.situation: boss calls to congratulate player on smuggling the supplies in the plane.

Key.Original: Képi, excellent !
Key.French: Tu l'as bien fait !
Key.Spanish: Excelente, Képi.
Key.Italian: Képi, eccellente!
Key.German: Hervorragend, Képi!
Key.English: Képi, excellent!
Key.Portuguese: Excelente, Képi!
Key.Japanese: ケピ、ヨクヤッタ！

Key.Original: It seems you a man of many talents.
Key.French: Tu as de nombreux talents.
Key.Spanish: Al parecer, eres un hombre con muchos talentos.
Key.Italian: Sembra che tu sia un uomo dalle mille risorse.
Key.Polish: Zdaje się, że masz wiele talentów.
Key.Russian: Я смотрю, ты прям мастер на все руки.
Key.German: Du bist ein talentierter Mann.
Key.Czech: Jsi koukám muž se spoustou nadání.
Key.English: It seems you a man of many talents.
Key.Portuguese: Parece que cê é um homem de muitos talentos.
Key.Japanese: オ前ハイロンナ才能ヲ持ッテルナ。
Key.Turkish: Görünüşe bakılırsa on parmağında on marifet var.

Key.Original: L'Ensemble get you money very soon.
Key.French: L'Ensemble te paiera bientôt.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble te dará el dinero muy pronto.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ti farà avere i soldi molto presto.
Key.German: L'Ensemble wird dich schon bald bezahlen.
Key.English: L'Ensemble get you money very soon.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble vai dar seu dinheiro muito em breve.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会很快就会付钱给你的。
Key.Japanese: スグニ "ランサンブル" カラ金ヲ送ル。
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble çok yakında sana para verecek.

Key.Original: You earn it, Képi.
Key.French: Tu l'as mérité, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Te lo has ganado, Képi.
Key.Italian: Te li sei meritati, Képi.
Key.German: Du hast es dir verdient, Képi.
Key.English: You earn it, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Você merece, Képi.
Key.Japanese: ソレダケノ仕事ヲシテクレタ、ケピ。

Key.Original: Leave the plane, we will unload it.
Key.Chinese: 飛機停在那就好了，貨我們來搬。
Key.French: Laisse l'avion, on le déchargera.
Key.Spanish: Deja la avioneta, que ya la descargamos nosotros.
Key.Italian: Abbandona l’aereo, ci penseremo noi a scaricare il tutto.
Key.Russian: Оставь самолет, мы сами его разгрузим.
Key.German: Steig aus, wir laden jetzt aus.
Key.Czech: Letadlo nech být. Vyložíme ho my.
Key.English: Leave the plane, we will unload it.
Key.Portuguese: Saia do avião, vamo descarregar ele.
Key.Korean: 비행기는 그냥 놔둬라. 짐은 우리가 내린다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 飞机就停在那吧，我们要卸货了。
Key.Japanese: 飛行機ハソノママデイイ。コチラデ荷物ヲ降ロシテオク。

Container.name: 036_eve_loaders_kia_call
Container.situation: smuggler informs player that they need to take-off immediately.

Key.Original: It's no good - we can't get to you!
Key.French: Ça va pas, on peut pas livrer !
Key.Spanish: Esto va mal... ¡no podemos llegar hasta ti!
Key.Italian: Non va bene, non possiamo raggiungerti!
Key.Polish: Nic z tego – nie dotrzemy do ciebie!
Key.Russian: Плохи дела, мы не можем к тебе подобраться!
Key.German: Das wird nichts. Wir können dich nicht erreichen!
Key.Czech: Je to blbý, nedostaneme se k tobě.
Key.English: It's no good - we can't get to you!
Key.Portuguese: Péssimo, não conseguimos chegar até você!
Key.Korean: 안 되겠어. 거기까지 갈 수가 없어!
Key.Japanese: ダメダ。オ前ノトコロマデ行ケナイ！
Key.Turkish: Bu hiç iyi değil; sana ulaşamıyoruz!

Key.Original: Take-off with what you got. Go! Go!
Key.Chinese: 帶著你飛機上的貨物先走，快！快！
Key.French: Décolle avec ce que tu as. Go, go !
Key.Spanish: Despega con lo que tienes. ¡Venga, vete!
Key.Italian: Decolla con quello che hai. Vai! Vai!
Key.Polish: Odlatuj z tym, co masz. No, już!
Key.Russian: Взлетай с тем, что у тебя есть. Давай! Давай!
Key.German: Starte mit dem, was du hast. Los, los!
Key.Czech: Odleť s tím, co máš. Dělej, hned!
Key.English: Take-off with what you got. Go! Go!
Key.Portuguese: Decole com o que você tem. Vai! Vai!
Key.Korean: 지금 실은 것만 갖고 어서 이륙해. 빨리 출발해!
Key.Chinesesimp: 带着货物快起飞吧。快！快！
Key.Japanese: 積ンダ分ヲ持ッテ飛ビ立テ。行ケ！早ク！

Container.name: 035_eve_plane_fully_loaded_call
Container.situation: smuggler informs player that the plane is fully loaded and that he should take-off without delay.

Key.Original: That's it!
Key.French: C'est bon !
Key.Spanish: ¡Ya está!
Key.Italian: Ci siamo!
Key.German: Das war‘s!
Key.English: That's it!
Key.Portuguese: É isso aí!
Key.Japanese: ヨシ、終ワッタ！

Key.Original: Cargo's in, get her up!
Key.French: C'est chargé, décolle !
Key.Spanish: El cargamento está dentro, ¡levanta el vuelo!
Key.Italian: Il carico è dentro, muoviamoci!
Key.German: Die Ladung ist drin, du kannst starten!
Key.English: Cargo's in, get her up!
Key.Portuguese: A carga tá dentro, pode decolar!
Key.Korean: 짐은 다 실었어. 이제 비행기 띄워!
Key.Japanese: 荷物ヲ全部載セタゾ。行ッテクレ！

Key.Original: Get her outta here, go!
Key.French: Dégage de là, vite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Date el piro, venga!
Key.Italian: Fai decollare l’aereo, via da qui!
Key.German: Schaff das Zeug hier raus, los!
Key.English: Get her outta here, go!
Key.Portuguese: Saia daqui, vai!
Key.Japanese: 行ッテクレ。早ク！

Container.name: 034_eve_gendarme_attack_call
Container.situation: smuggler informs player that gendarmes have arrived.

Key.Original: Putain, les gendarmes !
Key.French: Putain, les gendarmes !
Key.Spanish: ¡Hostia, les gendarmes!
Key.Italian: Porca puttana, les gendarmes!
Key.German: Scheiße, les gendarmes!
Key.English: Fuck, les gendarmes!
Key.Portuguese: Fodam-se, les gendarmes!
Key.Japanese: クソッ、憲兵ダ！

Key.Original: Defend the plane. Buy us some time!
Key.Chinese: 保護飛機。為我們爭取些時間！
Key.French: Protège l'avion. Fais-nous gagner du temps !
Key.Spanish: Defiende la avioneta. ¡Consíguenos tiempo!
Key.Italian: Difendi l’aereo. Facci guadagnare tempo!
Key.German: Verteidige das Flugzeug. Wir brauchen mehr Zeit!
Key.English: Defend the plane. Buy us some time!
Key.Portuguese: Defenda o avião. Precisamos de mais um tempo!
Key.Korean: 비행기를 방어해. 시간을 좀 벌어야 돼!
Key.Chinesesimp: 守好飞机。为我们争取点时间！
Key.Japanese: 飛行機ヲ守レ。時間ヲ稼グンダ！
Key.Turkish: Uçağı savun. Bize biraz zaman kazandır!

Container.name: 033_eve_loading_plane_call
Container.situation: smuggler tells player the plane is almost loaded.

Key.Original: Okay, we doin' good.
Key.French: OK, ça va.
Key.Spanish: Vale, esto va fenomenal.
Key.Italian: Okay, stiamo andando bene.
Key.German: Okay, es läuft gut.
Key.English: Okay, we doin' good.
Key.Portuguese: Ok, estamos indo bem.
Key.Japanese: ヨシ、順調ダ。

Key.Original: Halfway there, hold on.
Key.French: On en est à la moitié, bouge pas.
Key.Spanish: Ya llevamos la mitad, aguanta.
Key.Italian: Siamo a metà, aspetta.
Key.German: Okay, wir haben die Hälfte verladen. Moment noch!
Key.Czech: Dobře, jsme v půlce. Drž se!
Key.English: Halfway there, hold on.
Key.Portuguese: Ok, quase lá. Aguenta aí.
Key.Korean: 반 정도 실었으니까 조금만 더 기다려.
Key.Japanese: 半分完了ダ。モウ少シ待テ。

Container.name: 032_eve_player_lands_plane_call
Container.situation: smuggler tells player to wait while smugglers load their plane with supplies.

Key.Original: Not bad, mec.
Key.French: Pas mal, mec.
Key.Spanish: No ha estado mal, mec.
Key.Italian: Niente male, mec.
Key.German: Nicht schlecht, mec.
Key.English: Not bad, mec.
Key.Portuguese: Nada mal, mec.
Key.Japanese: 悪クナイ。

Key.Original: Nice landing...
Key.French: Bel atterrissage...
Key.Spanish: Bonito aterrizaje...
Key.Italian: Bell’atterraggio...
Key.German: Tolle Landung ...
Key.English: Nice landing...
Key.Portuguese: Boa aterrissagem...
Key.Japanese: イイ着陸ダ...

Key.Original: Stay put, we gonna load you up.
Key.Chinese: 等一下，讓我們把貨物裝上飛機。
Key.French: Bouge pas, on charge.
Key.Spanish: Espera un momento, que vamos a cargar esto.
Key.Italian: Non ti muovere, dobbiamo caricare l’aereo.
Key.German: Warte, wir laden jetzt ein.
Key.English: Stay put, we gonna load you up.
Key.Portuguese: Permaneça parado, vamos te abastecer.
Key.Chinesesimp: 呆着别走，我们要装货了。
Key.Japanese: ソコニイロ。荷物ヲ積ンデヤル。

Container.name: 031_ta_plane_work_offer
Container.situation: smuggler invites player to do some work for l'ensemble.

Key.Original: So, you can fly...
Key.Chinese: 所以，你真的會開飛機呀…
Key.French: Alors tu sais piloter...
Key.Spanish: Así que sabes pilotar...
Key.Italian: Quindi, sai come si pilota un aereo...
Key.Russian: Так, ты умеешь летать на самолете...
Key.German: Du kannst also fliegen ...
Key.English: So, you can fly...
Key.Portuguese: Então, você sabe voar...
Key.Japanese: ソレデ、オ前ハ飛行機ヲ操縦デキル...

Key.Original: And you cool with the boss-man, eh?
Key.Chinese: 你跟老大關係很好，是吧？
Key.French: Et le Boss t'aime bien, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Y te llevas con el jefe, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: E il capo è d’accordo che tu sia qui, eh?
Key.German: Und du verstehst dich mit dem Boss, oder?
Key.Czech: A se šéfem si rozumíš, jo?
Key.English: And you cool with the boss-man, eh?
Key.Portuguese: E tá de boas com o chefe, né?
Key.Chinesesimp: 而且你和老大相处不错，对吧？
Key.Japanese: "ボス" トモイイ仲ダ。

Key.Original: You wanna make easy money?
Key.French: Tu veux te faire du fric ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Quieres ganar pasta fácil?
Key.Italian: Vuoi fare soldi facili?
Key.German: Willst du leichtes Geld machen?
Key.English: You wanna make easy money?
Key.Portuguese: Quer ganhar dinheiro fácil?
Key.Japanese: 楽ニ稼ギタイカ？
Key.Turkish: Kolay yoldan para kazanmak ister misin?

Key.Original: Take this plane, land near Tanouka.
Key.Chinese: 把這架飛機開到塔諾卡。
Key.French: Prends les commandes et atterris près de Tanouka.
Key.Spanish: Pilla esta avioneta y aterriza cerca de Tanouka.
Key.Italian: Prendi questo aereo e fallo atterrare vicino Tanouka.
Key.Russian: Садись в этот самолет и приземлись рядом с Таноукой.
Key.German: Dann nimm das Flugzeug und lande es bei Tanouka.
Key.Czech: Přistaň s tímhle letadlem poblíž Tanouky.
Key.English: Take this plane, land near Tanouka.
Key.Portuguese: Pegue este avião, aterrisse perto de Tanouka.
Key.Korean: 이 비행기를 몰아서 타누카 근처에 착륙시켜.
Key.Chinesesimp: 开上这架飞机，在塔诺乌加附近降落。
Key.Japanese: コノ飛行機ヲ "タノウカ" ノ近クニ着陸サセロ。
Key.Turkish: Bu uçağı alıp Tanouka yakınına in.

Key.Original: There will be a runway, east of the Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Chinese: 那裡會有跑道，就在塔諾雅製糖公司東邊。
Key.French: Il y a une piste, à l'est de la Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Spanish: Hay una pista al este de la Compañía Azucarera de Tanoa.
Key.Italian: C’è una pista di atterraggio a est della Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Polish: Na wschód od Tanoa Sugar Company jest pas.
Key.Russian: К востоку от сахарного завода должна быть взлетно-посадочная полоса.
Key.German: Östlich von der Tanoa Sugar Company ist eine Landebahn.
Key.Czech: Bude tam ranvej. Na východ od Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.English: There will be a runway, east of the Tanoa Sugar Company.
Key.Portuguese: Vai ter uma pista, a leste da Companhia de Açúcar Tanoana.
Key.Korean: 타노아 설탕공장 동쪽에 활주로가 있을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那儿有条跑道，在塔诺亚糖业公司东侧。
Key.Japanese: ソコニ滑走路ガアル。Tanoa Sugar Company ノ東ダ。
Key.Turkish: Tanoa Sugar Company’nin doğusunda bir iniş pisti olacak.

Key.Original: Our guys have cargo. Collect it and continue to Bala airstrip.
Key.Chinese: 貨物在我們的人的手上，收集它並前往巴拉小機場。
Key.French: Prends le chargement de nos gars et va jusqu'à l'aérodrome de Bala.
Key.Spanish: Nuestra gente tiene material. Recógelo y luego ve al aeródromo de Bala.
Key.Italian: I nostri ragazzi hanno un carico. Recuperalo e continua verso la pista di atterraggio di Bala.
Key.Polish: Nasi ludzie mają ładunek. Odbierz go i leć na lądowisko w Bala.
Key.Russian: Там тебя будут ждать наши ребята с грузом. Забери его и лети на Балу.
Key.German: Unsere Jungs vor Ort haben die Ware. Sammle sie ein und flieg weiter zum Bala-Flugfeld.
Key.Czech: Naši chlapi mají náklad. Vyzvedni ho a pokračuj na letiště v Bale.
Key.English: Our guys have cargo. Collect it and continue to Bala airstrip.
Key.Portuguese: Nossos caras estão com a carga. Colete e continue até a pista de pouso de Bala.
Key.Korean: 우리 애들이 물건을 갖고 있어. 그걸 싣고 발라 활주로로 가.
Key.Chinesesimp: 货在我们人手里。取货后再飞到巴拉小机场。
Key.Japanese: 俺達ノ仲間ガ積ミ荷ヲ持ッテル。ソレヲ回収シテ、バラ飛行場ヘ行ケ。
Key.Turkish: Adamlarımızın kargosu var. Onu al ve Bala iniş pistine devam et.

Key.Original: And, that's it. Real simple, right?
Key.French: C'est tout. Facile, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Y ya. Está chupado, ¿a que sí?
Key.Italian: Ecco, tutto qua. Un gioco da ragazzi, no?
Key.Polish: I to tyle. Prosta sprawa, nie?
Key.German: Und das war‘s schon. Simpel, oder?
Key.English: And, that's it. Real simple, right?
Key.Portuguese: E é isso. Muito simples, certo?
Key.Chinesesimp: 这样行了吧。够轻松的，对吧？
Key.Japanese: ソレダケダ。簡単ダロウ？
Key.Turkish: Hepsi bu kadar. Gerçekten kolay, değil mi?

Container.name: 030_eve_gun_runners
Container.situation: smuggler and pilot argue about landing a plane away from an airstrip.

Key.Original: Nope. It's fucking madness.
Key.French: Non, c'est de la folie.
Key.Spanish: Ni de coña. Es una puta locura.
Key.Italian: Assolutamente no. È pura follia.
Key.Russian: Нет. Ты совсем что ли спятил?
Key.German: Nein, das ist doch purer Wahnsinn.
Key.English: Nope. It's fucking madness.
Key.Portuguese: Não. É loucura, porra.
Key.Japanese: 断る。こんなのイカれてる。

Key.Original: I'm not doing it - I don't care how much Samjo offers.
Key.Chinese: 我不幹；無論山姆卓給多少錢，我都不幹。
Key.French: Je le ferai pas et je me fous de savoir combien paie Samjo.
Key.Spanish: No pienso hacerlo. Me la suda cuánto ofrezca Samjo.
Key.Italian: Non lo farò, non me ne frega di quanto offre Samjo.
Key.Polish: Nic z tego, choćby nie wiem ile Samjo płacił.
Key.Russian: Ни за что! Мне плевать, сколько платит Самджо.
Key.German: Ich mache das nicht, egal wie viel Samjo zahlen will.
Key.Czech: To neudělám. Je mi jedno, kolik Samjo nabízí.
Key.English: I'm not doing it - I don't care how much Samjo offers.
Key.Portuguese: Não vou fazer, não me importo com quanto o Samjo oferece.
Key.Korean: 전 못해요. 샘조가 얼마를 주든 못한다고요.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我不干 - 我才不在乎 Samjo 给多少钱。
Key.Japanese: 俺はやらないぞ。サムジョがどれだけ金を積もうが関係ない。
Key.Turkish: Yapmayacağım; Samjo’nun ne kadar önerdiği umurumda değil.

Key.Original: Oh, no - I can land a plane alright. I just can't do it without a runway!
Key.Chinese: 噢，不－－我能讓飛機降落，問題是沒有跑道啊！
Key.French: Je sais atterrir. Mais je peux pas atterrir sans piste !
Key.Spanish: Qué va, pues claro que sé aterrizar... ¡pero en una pista!
Key.Italian: Oh, no, so farlo atterrare, ma non senza una pista di atterraggio!
Key.Polish: Jasne, że potrafię, ale nie bez lądowiska!
Key.Russian: Нет, я могу посадить самолет. Но мне нужна посадочная полоса!
Key.German: Ich kann es landen, aber dafür brauche ich eine Landebahn!
Key.Czech: Ale hovno, přistát umím. Jenomže ne bez přistávací dráhy!
Key.English: Oh, no - I can land a plane alright. I just can't do it without a runway!
Key.Portuguese: Ah, não, consigo pousar um avião de boas. Só não consigo isso sem uma pista!
Key.Korean: 그게 아니에요. 비행기 착륙시키는 건 문제 없어요. 단지 활주로가 없으면 안 된다고요!
Key.Chinesesimp: 哦，不 - 我当然能让飞机着陆。可是没有跑道我怎么着陆！
Key.Japanese: そうじゃない。飛行機ならちゃんと着陸させられる。滑走路があればの話だ！
Key.Turkish: Ah, hayır; uçağı indirebilirim. Sadece iniş pisti olmadan yapamam!

Key.Original: Sure, why not.
Key.French: OK. Vas-y, alors.
Key.Spanish: Claro, por qué no.
Key.Italian: Certo, perché no.
Key.Russian: Ну да, почему бы и нет?
Key.German: Klar, warum nicht?
Key.English: Sure, why not.
Key.Portuguese: Claro, por que não?
Key.Japanese: そうだろうよ。

Key.Original: You say you proper good pilot, mec.
Key.Chinese: 你說你是個不錯的飛行員，夥計。
Key.French: Tu dis que t'es un vrai pilote, mec.
Key.Spanish: Dices que eres buen piloto, mec.
Key.Italian: Dici di essere un bravo pilota, mec.
Key.Polish: Twierdzisz, że z ciebie dobry pilot, mec.
Key.Russian: Ты же сказал, что ты хороший пилот, мэк.
Key.German: Du hast doch gesagt, dass du ein guter Pilot bist, mec.
Key.English: You say you proper good pilot, mec.
Key.Portuguese: Você diz que é um bom piloto, mec.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你说你是个飞行能手，伙计。
Key.Japanese: オ前ハ腕ノイイ "パイロット" ダト言ッテタジャナイカ。
Key.Turkish: İyi bir pilot olduğunu söyledin, mec.

Key.Original: But now you say you can't land a plane? Incroyable!
Key.Chinese: 怎麼現在連個飛機都沒辦法降落？太可怕了！
Key.French: Mais tu sais pas atterrir ? Incroyable !
Key.Spanish: Pero ¿ahora dices que no sabes aterrizar? ¡Incroyable!
Key.Italian: Ma ora dici che non sai far atterrare un aereo? Incroyable!
Key.Polish: A teraz nie potrafisz wylądować? Incroyable!
Key.Russian: А теперь ты мне говоришь, что не можешь посадить самолет? Энкроябль!
Key.German: Und jetzt kannst du das Flugzeug nicht landen? Incroyable!
Key.Czech: Ale teď říkáš, že nevíš, jak přistát? Incroyable!
Key.English: But now you say you can't land a plane? Incroyable!
Key.Portuguese: Mas agora diz que não consegue pousar um avião? Incroyable!
Key.Chinesesimp: 可现在怎么说你不能让飞机着陆？太可怕了！
Key.Japanese: ソレガ、今ニナッテ飛行機ヲ着陸サセラレナイダト？アンクロイアブレ！
Key.Turkish: Fakat şimdi uçağı indiremeyeceğini mi söylüyorsun? Incroyable!

Key.Original: He's the guy that stole this thing.
Key.French: C'est lui qui a piqué l'avion.
Key.Spanish: Este es el tipo que la robó.
Key.Italian: È lui che ha rubato questo coso.
Key.German: Er hat das Ding schließlich gestohlen.
Key.English: He's the guy that stole this thing.
Key.Portuguese: Ele é o cara que roubou esse negócio.
Key.Japanese: 飛行機を盗んできたやつだからな。
Key.Turkish: Şu şeyi çalan da o adam.

Key.Original: Arrête ton char, you got one, Mav'. It's a massive, open field.
Key.Chinese: 快停下來；有了，Mav'。那裡有一大片空地。
Key.French: Arrête ton char, y'en a une, Mav. Y'a un champ énorme.
Key.Spanish: Arrête ton char, que tenemos una, Mav'. Es un campo enorme y despejado.
Key.Italian: Arrête ton char, ce n’è una, Mav’. È un enorme campo aperto.
Key.Polish: Arrête ton char, przecież je masz, Mav. Wielkie puste pole.
Key.Russian: Арэ тон шар, у тебя есть полоса, Мав'. Огромное открытое поле.
Key.German: Arrête ton char, du hast eine, Mav'. Da ist ein riesiges, offenes Feld.
Key.Czech: Arrête ton char. Dráha tam je, Mav'. Je to velký rovný pole.
Key.English: Arrête ton char, you got one, Mav'. It's a massive, open field.
Key.Portuguese: Arrête ton char, você tem uma, Mav'. É um campo enorme e aberto.
Key.Korean: 아렛 통 샤흐, 저기 있잖아. 넓게 트인 땅이잖아.
Key.Chinesesimp: 快停下来，你有跑道，Mav'。那片广阔的田野就是。
Key.Japanese: アレ・トン・シャー。滑走路ナラアル。広大ナ野原ダ。
Key.Turkish: Arrête ton char, bir iniş pistin var, Mav'. Devasa, açık bir tarla.

Key.Original: Even this old man here could do it!
Key.French: Même le vieux pourrait y arriver !
Key.Spanish: ¡Si hasta este viejo podría aterrizar allí!
Key.Italian: Persino questo vecchio qui ci riuscirebbe!
Key.Russian: Даже этот старик сможет его посадить!
Key.German: Das könnte sogar dieser alte Mann hier schaffen!
Key.Czech: Tam by přistál i tady děda.
Key.English: Even this old man here could do it!
Key.Portuguese: Até esse velhote podia dar conta disso!
Key.Korean: 여기 이 늙은이도 할 수 있을 걸!
Key.Chinesesimp: 就算这个老头也做得到！
Key.Japanese: コノ年寄リデモ着陸サセラレルゾ！
Key.Turkish: Buradaki bu yaşlı adam bile bunu yapabilir!

Key.Original: Pay him to make a smokin' hole, eh?
Key.French: Tu peux le payer pour nous enterrer, non ?
Key.Spanish: Le pagas y te deja un agujero humeante, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Pagarlo per farci schiantare, eh?
Key.Russian: Заплатишь ему, чтобы сделать кучу горящих обломков?
Key.German: Dann kann er es auch in einen rauchenden Krater verwandeln.
Key.Czech: Klidně mu zaplaťte, ať s ním udělá kráter v zemi.
Key.English: Pay him to make a smokin' hole, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Pague pra ele derrubar o negócio, que tal?
Key.Korean: 어차피 추락할 거 저 사람한테 돈 주고 추락시키던지요?
Key.Chinesesimp: 给钱让他在地上砸个冒烟的洞，嗯？
Key.Japanese: そいつに金を払って穴を開けてもらえばいい。
Key.Turkish: Baca deliği açması için ona ödeme yapın, ha?

Key.Original: Bordel de merde! Okay, fantastique.
Key.French: Bordel de merde ! OK, fantastique.
Key.Spanish: ¡Bordel de merde! Vale, fantastique.
Key.Italian: Bordel de merde! Okay, fantastique.
Key.German: Bordel de merde! Okay, fantastique.
Key.English: Bordel de merde! Okay, fantastique.
Key.Portuguese: Bordel de merde! Ok, fantastique.
Key.Japanese: ボルデル・ドゥ・メルドゥ！ヨシ、ファンタスティーク。

Container.name: 029_ex_plane_destroyed
Container.situation: boss calls player after receiving a text message that the plane he requested has been destroyed.

Key.Original: So, there a problem with our plane, Képi?
Key.Chinese: 所以，我們的飛機出了點問題。是嗎 ，Képi？
Key.French: Il y a un problème avec l'avion, Képi ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Ha habido problemas con la avioneta, Képi?
Key.Italian: Allora, c’è stato qualche problema con il nostro aereo, Képi?
Key.Polish: Jakiś problem z naszym samolotem, Képi?
Key.Russian: Значит с самолетом возникла проблема, Кепи?
Key.German: Gibt es ein Problem mit unserem Flugzeug, Képi?
Key.Czech: Nějakej problém s naším letadlem, Képi?
Key.English: So, there a problem with our plane, Képi?
Key.Portuguese: Então, algum problema com nosso avião, Képi?
Key.Chinesesimp: 这么来说，我们的飞机出问题了，Képi？
Key.Japanese: オイ、俺達ノ飛行機ニ問題デモアルノカ、ケピ？
Key.Turkish: Uçağımızla ilgili bir sorun mu var, Képi?

Key.Original: That is a disappointment.
Key.French: C'est décevant.
Key.Spanish: Qué decepción.
Key.Italian: Che peccato.
Key.German: Das ist enttäuschend.
Key.English: That is a disappointment.
Key.Portuguese: Que decepção.
Key.Japanese: ソレハ残念ダ。

Key.Original: I hope for your sake, there was not a problem with the pilot.
Key.Chinese: 我希望出問題的不是飛行員，這也是為你好。
Key.French: J'espère pour toi que c'était pas un problème de pilotage.
Key.Spanish: Espero por tu bien que no haya habido problemas con el piloto.
Key.Italian: Spero per il tuo bene che non ci sia stato qualche problema con il pilota.
Key.Polish: Lepiej dla ciebie, żeby nie było kłopotów z pilotem.
Key.Russian: Надеюсь, с пилотом все будет нормально. Иначе тебе же хуже.
Key.German: Ich hoffe für dich, dass es nicht am Piloten lag.
Key.Czech: Doufám, že za problém nemůže pilot.
Key.English: I hope for your sake, there was not a problem with the pilot.
Key.Portuguese: Pro seu bem, espero que não tenha tido nenhum problema com o piloto.
Key.Chinesesimp: 希望飞行员不会有问题，这也是为你着想。
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ身ノタメニモ、"パイロット" ニハ問題ガナイトイインダガ。
Key.Turkish: Senin açından söylüyorum; umarım pilotla ilgili bir sorun yoktur.

Key.Original: L'Ensemble is good to fix problems.
Key.French: L'Ensemble sait régler les problèmes.
Key.Spanish: A L'Ensemble se le da bien arreglar problemas.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble sa bene come risolvere i problemi.
Key.German: L‘Ensemble kümmert sich schnell um solche Probleme.
Key.English: L'Ensemble is good to fix problems.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble é bom em resolver problemas.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会很擅长解决问题。
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ハ問題ノ修復ガ得意ダ。

Key.Original: Do not disappoint again. Au revoir.
Key.French: Ne me déçois plus. Au revoir.
Key.Spanish: No vuelvas a decepcionarnos. Au revoir.
Key.Italian: Non deludermi un’altra volta. Au revoir.
Key.Russian: Не разочаруй меня снова. О ревуа'р.
Key.German: Enttäusche mich nicht noch einmal. Au revoir.
Key.Czech: Už žádný další zklamání. Au revoir.
Key.English: Do not disappoint again. Au revoir.
Key.Portuguese: Não decepcione de novo. Au revoir.
Key.Japanese: モウ二度ト俺ヲガッカリサセルナ。オブワー。
Key.Turkish: Tekrar hayal kırıklığına uğratma. Au revoir.

Container.name: 027_eve_gendarme_bribe_accepted_a
Container.situation: gendarme receives a bribe from player to get airport access.

Key.Original: Mm. Okay...
Key.French: Hmm. OK...
Key.Spanish: Hum. Vale...
Key.Italian: Mmh. Okay...
Key.German: Hm, okay ...
Key.English: Mm. Okay...
Key.Portuguese: Hmm. Ok...
Key.Japanese: フム、イイダロウ...

Key.Original: This looks good. Go on, go through.
Key.French: Ça va. Tu peux passer.
Key.Spanish: Me encanta. Venga, pasa.
Key.Italian: Così va bene. Entra pure.
Key.Polish: Jest w porządku. No już, idź.
Key.German: Sieht gut aus. Geh durch.
Key.Czech: Vypadá to v pořádku. Můžeš jít.
Key.English: This looks good. Go on, go through.
Key.Portuguese: Tudo nos conformes. Certo, prossiga.
Key.Japanese: 問題ナイ。サア、通レ。

Container.name: 026_eve_gendarme_bribe
Container.situation: gendarme demands a bribe from player to get airport access.

Key.Original: No way, old man.
Key.French: Pas moyen, Old Man.
Key.Spanish: Ni de coña, viejo.
Key.Italian: Neanche per sogno, vecchio.
Key.German: Keine Chance, alter Mann.
Key.English: No way, old man.
Key.Portuguese: De jeito nenhum, velho.
Key.Japanese: 無駄ダ、オッサン。

Key.Original: No-one gets in here without a pass.
Key.Chinese: 沒有通行證，誰也別想進來。
Key.French: On n'entre pas sans un passe.
Key.Spanish: Aquí no entra nadie sin un pase.
Key.Italian: Qui non entra nessuno senza un pass.
Key.German: Ohne Zugangskarte kommt hier niemand rein.
Key.Czech: Dovnitř se bez povolení nikdo nedostane.
Key.English: No-one gets in here without a pass.
Key.Portuguese: Ninguém entra aqui sem um passe.
Key.Korean: 여긴 출입증 없으면 들어갈 수 없거든.
Key.Chinesesimp: 没有通行证谁也别想进来。
Key.Japanese: "パス" ヲ持タナイ者ヲ通スワケニハイカナイ。

Key.Original: Or the money to make me think I saw one, tu comprends ?
Key.Chinese: 或許來些錢，我就會覺得我看到通行證了，懂嗎？
Key.French: Ou sans argent pour que je regarde ailleurs, tu comprends ?
Key.Spanish: O sin el dinero para que crea que he visto uno, tu comprends ?
Key.Italian: A meno che tu non abbia i soldi per farmi pensare di averne visto uno, tu comprends?
Key.Polish: Albo pieniędzy, które mnie przekonają, tu comprends?
Key.Russian: Ну или можем договориться, ту компран?
Key.German: Oder mit genügend Geld, damit ich mir eine einbilde, tu comprends?
Key.Czech: Respektive bez peněz, který mi ukážeš místo něj. Tu comprends?
Key.English: Or the money to make me think I saw one, tu comprends ?
Key.Portuguese: Ou o dinheiro para me fazer pensar que vi um, tu comprends?
Key.Korean: 그런데 돈을 내면 가끔 없는 출입증이 보일 때도 있더라고. 뛰 꽁프랑?
Key.Chinesesimp: 要不就给钱，我会网开一面，懂吗？
Key.Japanese: ダガ、金ヲ持ッテルナラ "パス" ヲ持ッテルコトニシテモイイ。トゥ・コンプロン？
Key.Turkish: Belki biraz para kartı gördüğümü düşünmemi sağlayabilir, tu comprends?

Container.name: 025_ta_plane_delivered_call
Container.situation: boss congratulates player on delivering the stolen plane.

Key.Original: Képi. Excellent.
Key.French: Képi. Excellent.
Key.Spanish: Excelente, Képi.
Key.Italian: Képi. Eccellente.
Key.German: Hervorragend, Képi.
Key.English: Képi. Excellent.
Key.Portuguese: Képi. Excelente.
Key.Japanese: ケピ、ヨクヤッタ。

Key.Original: Take it to the, er, aire de chargement where the planes refuel.
Key.Chinese: 把它開到，這…飛機加油的裝貨區。
Key.French: Roule jusqu'à l'aire de chargement, là où les avions font le plein.
Key.Spanish: Llévala al, esto... al aire de chargement donde repostan los aviones.
Key.Italian: Portalo alla... aire de chargement dove vengono riforniti gli aerei.
Key.Polish: Zabierz go do… aire de chargement, gdzie tankują samoloty.
Key.Russian: Доставь его на эр де шаржема, где заправляются самолеты.
Key.German: Bring es zum, ähm, aire de chargement – wo die Flugzeuge aufgetankt werden.
Key.Czech: Teď jeď k, ehm... aire de chargement. Tam se letadlo tankuje.
Key.English: Take it to the, er, aire de chargement where the planes refuel.
Key.Portuguese: Leve ele pro aire de chargement, onde os aviões reabastecem.
Key.Korean: 그 비행기를... 음... 연료를 넣는 구역으로 가져가라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 把它送到，呃，飞机加油的装货区域。
Key.Japanese: "エア・ドゥ・シャージモン" ニ持ッテイッテ飛行機ノ燃料ヲ補給シロ。
Key.Turkish: Onu, uçakların yakıt ikmali yaptığı, ee, aire de chargement kısmına götür.

Key.Original: L'Ensemble see you proper paid, eh?
Key.French: L'Ensemble te paie bien, hein ?
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble te pagará bien, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ti pagherà adeguatamente, eh?
Key.German: L'Ensemble wird dich gut bezahlen.
Key.English: L'Ensemble see you proper paid, eh?
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble vai te pagar certinho, ok?
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会保证不亏待你，嗯？
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" カライイ金ヲ払ッテヤル。

Container.name: 019_ta_get_plane_call
Container.situation: syndikat_boss tells player he needs him to fly a plane.

Key.Original: So, Képi.
Key.French: Bon, Képi.
Key.Spanish: A ver, Képi.
Key.Italian: Allora, Képi.
Key.German: So, Képi.
Key.English: So, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Então, Képi.
Key.Japanese: オイ、ケピ。

Key.Original: I been to talk to people.
Key.French: J'ai parlé à des gens.
Key.Spanish: He estado hablando con la gente.
Key.Italian: Ho parlato con svariate persone.
Key.Russian: Я тут пообщался кое с кем.
Key.German: Ich hab mit ein paar Leuten geredet.
Key.English: I been to talk to people.
Key.Portuguese: Conversei com pessoas.
Key.Japanese: イロンナヤツト話ヲシテタンダガ。

Key.Original: Once you have the plane, take it to Bala Airstrip.
Key.Chinese: 到了飛機上後，把它開到巴拉小機場上。
Key.French: Quand tu as l'avion, atterris à l'aérodrome de Bala.
Key.Spanish: Cuando tengas la avioneta, llévala al aeródromo de Bala.
Key.Italian: Una volta preso l’aereo, portalo alla pista di atterraggio di Bala.
Key.Polish: Samolot dostarcz na lądowisko w Bala.
Key.Russian: Как только самолет будет у тебя, лети на ВПП Бала.
Key.German: Sobald du das Flugzeug hast, bring es zum Bala-Flugfeld.
Key.Czech: Až máš letadlo, leť s ním na letiště Bala.
Key.English: Once you have the plane, take it to Bala Airstrip.
Key.Portuguese: Depois de pegar o avião, leve até a pista de Bala.
Key.Chinesesimp: 搞到飞机后，立即把它送到巴拉小机场。
Key.Japanese: 飛行機ヲ手ニ入レタラ、バラ飛行場ヘ持ッテイケ。
Key.Turkish: Uçağa ulaştığında, onu Bala İniş Pisti’ne götür.

Key.Original: You know planes a little.
Key.French: Tu connais les avions.
Key.Spanish: Sabes algo de aviones.
Key.Italian: Te la cavi un po’ con gli aerei.
Key.Russian: Говорят, ты немного разбираешься в самолетах.
Key.German: Du kennst dich ein bisschen mit Flugzeugen aus.
Key.Czech: Vyznáš se v letadle, že jo?
Key.English: You know planes a little.
Key.Portuguese: Você conhece um pouco de aviões.
Key.Japanese: オ前ハ飛行機ノコトガ少シ分カルナ？

Key.Original: L'Ensemble want one and pilot also.
Key.Chinese: L'Ensemble 還需要一名飛行員。
Key.French: L'Ensemble en veut un, avec un pilote.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble quiere uno con piloto.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble ne vuole uno e anche un pilota.
Key.German: L‘Ensemble braucht eins – und den passenden Piloten.
Key.Czech: L'Ensemble jedno chce. A pilota taky.
Key.English: L'Ensemble want one and pilot also.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble quer um, e um piloto também.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会需要一架，也需要一个飞行员。
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ハ飛行機ト "パイロット" ヲ探シテル。
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble bir uçak ve bir de pilot istiyor.

Key.Original: You can help us with both, I think.
Key.Chinese: 我看，這兩件事你都能幫我們。
Key.French: Tu peux nous aider, je pense.
Key.Spanish: Y creo que puedes ayudarnos con las dos cosas.
Key.Italian: Ci puoi aiutare per entrambe le cose, credo.
Key.Polish: Chyba możesz nam z tym pomóc.
Key.Russian: Думаю, ты поможешь нам и с тем, и с другим.
Key.German: Ich glaube, du kannst uns mit beidem behilflich sein.
Key.English: You can help us with both, I think.
Key.Portuguese: Acho que cê pode nos ajudar com os dois.
Key.Korean: 네가 그 두 가지를 전부 구해주면 돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我想，你能帮我搞定这两件事。
Key.Japanese: ドチラモオ前ニ任セテ大丈夫ダナ？
Key.Turkish: Sen her ikisi için de bize yardım edebilirsin, bence.

Key.Original: But first, you want an access card.
Key.Chinese: 不過首先，你需要一張鑰匙卡。
Key.French: Mais d'abord, il te faut une carte d'accès.
Key.Spanish: Pero antes te va a hacer falta una tarjeta de acceso.
Key.Italian: Ma prima ti serve una tessera di accesso.
Key.Russian: Но для начала тебе понадобится карта доступа.
Key.German: Aber erst brauchst du eine Zugangskarte.
Key.English: But first, you want an access card.
Key.Portuguese: Mas primeiro precisa de um cartão de acesso.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过，首先你得有张门禁卡。
Key.Japanese: ダガ、マズハ "アクセスカード" ガ必要ダ。
Key.Turkish: Fakat önce bir erişim kartına ihtiyacın olacak.

Key.Original: No way you get into airport and fly away without one.
Key.Chinese: 沒有鑰匙卡，就無法進入機場，也不能起飛或降落。
Key.French: Sans ça, impossible de rentrer dans l'aéroport pour t'envoler.
Key.Spanish: No vas a poder entrar en el aeropuerto y despegar sin una.
Key.Italian: Senza non puoi accedere all’aeroporto e volare via con un aereo.
Key.Polish: Bez niej nie dostaniesz się na lotnisko i nie polatasz.
Key.Russian: Без нее ты не сможешь пробраться в аэропорт и угнать самолет.
Key.German: Ohne die kommst du nicht in den Flughafen rein.
Key.Czech: Jinak se nedostáváš na letiště. Bez ní nelítáš.
Key.English: No way you get into airport and fly away without one.
Key.Portuguese: Não tem como entrar no aeroporto e ir embora voando sem um.
Key.Korean: 출입카드가 없으면 비행은 커녕 공항에 들어갈 수도 없다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 没有它就不能进入机场，也别想飞走。
Key.Japanese: 空港ニ行ッテ、ソレナシニ飛ビ立レルワケガナイ。
Key.Turkish: Erişim kartı olmadan havaalanına giremez ya da uçamazsın.

Key.Original: Bribe the guards or go to Lifou one night...
Key.Chinese: 賄賂警衛或晚上去 Lifou…
Key.French: Achète les gardes, ou va à Lifou, un soir.
Key.Spanish: Soborna a los guardias o pásate una noche de estas por Lifou...
Key.Italian: Corrompi le guardie oppure vai una notte a Lifou...
Key.Polish: Przekup straże albo odwiedź nocą Lifou…
Key.Russian: Подкупи охранников или отправляйся вечерком в Лифоу.
Key.German: Bestich den Sicherheitsdienst oder schau nachts mal in Lifou vorbei ...
Key.Czech: Dej hlídači úplatek nebo večer jdi do Lifou.
Key.English: Bribe the guards or go to Lifou one night...
Key.Portuguese: Suborne os guardas ou vá para Lifou durante a noite...
Key.Chinesesimp: 贿赂哨兵，或者趁晚上去趟利福...
Key.Japanese: 兵士ニ賄賂ヲ渡スカ、"リフ" ニ一晩泊マレ...
Key.Turkish: Muhafızlara rüşvet ver veya bir gece Lifou’ya git...

Key.Original: There is a discothèque. Man who run it, he have a pass.
Key.Chinese: 那裡有個迪斯科舞廳，那裡的老闆有個通行證。
Key.French: Il y a une discothèque. Le patron a un passe.
Key.Spanish: Hay una discothèque y el tío que la lleva tiene un pase.
Key.Italian: C’è una discothèque. L’uomo che la gestisce ha un pass.
Key.Polish: Jest tam discothèque. Jej szef ma przepustkę.
Key.Russian: Там по вечерам дискотека. У мужика, который ее проводит, есть пропуск.
Key.German: Da gibt es eine Diskothek. Der Eigentümer hat eine Karte.
Key.Czech: Je tam discothèque. Její majitel má povolení.
Key.English: There is a discothèque. Man who run it, he have a pass.
Key.Portuguese: Tem uma discothèque. O dono dela tem um esquema.
Key.Korean: 거기에 디스코텍이 있다. 거길 운영하는 자가 출입증을 갖고 있다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那儿有个夜总会。里面的老板，他有通行证。
Key.Japanese: ソコニ "ディスコテーク" ガアル。ソコノ経営者ガ "パス" ヲ持ッテル。
Key.Turkish: Orada bir discothèque var. Onu işleten adamda kart var.

Key.Original: Convince him you need it.
Key.French: Fais-lui comprendre que t'en as besoin.
Key.Spanish: Convéncelo de que lo necesitas.
Key.Italian: Convincilo che ne hai bisogno.
Key.Polish: Przekonaj go, żeby ci ją dał.
Key.German: Überzeuge ihn davon, dass du sie brauchst.
Key.English: Convince him you need it.
Key.Portuguese: Convença ele que você precisa.
Key.Japanese: ソレガ必要ダト伝エロ。
Key.Turkish: Onu o karta ihtiyacın olduğuna ikna et.

Container.name: 018_eve_mechanic_car_ready_c
Container.situation: mechanic lets player know his vehicle has been rigged with explosives.

Key.Original: If gendarmes search your trunk, you do not know me.
Key.Chinese: 要是國家憲兵搜索你的後車廂，可別說你認識我。
Key.French: Si les gendarmes fouillent le coffre, t'as jamais entendu parler de moi.
Key.Spanish: Si los gendarmes te registran el maletero, no me conoces de nada.
Key.Italian: Se i gendarmi ti perquisiscono il bagagliaio, io e te non ci conosciamo.
Key.Polish: Jak ci zajrzą do bagażnika, to mnie nie znasz.
Key.Russian: Если жандармы начнут обыскивать твой багажник, то ты меня не знаешь.
Key.German: Wenn die gendarmes deinen Kofferraum untersuchen, hab ich nie von dir gehört.
Key.Czech: Jestli ti četníci prohledají kufr, tak mě neznáš.
Key.English: If gendarmes search your trunk, you do not know me.
Key.Portuguese: Se os gendarmes mexerem no seu bagageiro, cê não me conhece.
Key.Korean: 만약 헌병특공대가 트럭을 수색하면, 우린 모르는 사이예요.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果宪兵队搜查你的后备箱，可别说你认识我。
Key.Japanese: 憲兵ガオ前ノトランクヲ調ベタラ、俺ノ名前ハ出スナヨ。

Container.name: 017_eve_mechanic_car_ready_b
Container.situation: mechanic lets player know his vehicle has been rigged with explosives.

Key.Original: You're all set.
Key.French: C'est prêt.
Key.Spanish: Ya está todo listo.
Key.Italian: Tutto a posto.
Key.German: Alles ist vorbereitet.
Key.English: You're all set.
Key.Portuguese: Tudo pronto.
Key.Japanese: 準備オーケーダ。

Key.Original: Just stay clear of any checkpoints.
Key.French: Mais pense à éviter les checkpoints.
Key.Spanish: No te acerques a los puntos de control.
Key.Italian: Ricorda di evitare i punti di controllo.
Key.German: Aber du musst die Kontrollpunkte unbedingt meiden.
Key.English: Just stay clear of any checkpoints.
Key.Portuguese: Só fique longe de qualquer ponto de verificação.
Key.Japanese: 検問所ハ避ケロ。

Container.name: 016_eve_mechanic_car_ready_a
Container.situation: mechanic lets player know his vehicle has been rigged with explosives.

Key.Original: Remember, don't bump into anything.
Key.French: Souviens-toi, pas d'accident.
Key.Spanish: Recuerda: No te la pegues.
Key.Italian: Ricorda. Non andare a sbattere.
Key.Polish: Uważaj, by w nic nie przywalić.
Key.Russian: Главное, ни во что не врежься.
Key.German: Vergiss nicht: keine Unfälle.
Key.English: Remember, don't bump into anything.
Key.Portuguese: Lembre-se, não bata em nada.
Key.Japanese: 忘レルナ。何ニモ衝突スルナヨ。

Container.name: 015_eve_mechanic_goodbye_c
Container.situation: player leaves a garage.

Key.Original: That it? Okay, take care out there.
Key.Chinese: 就這樣？好，在外頭小心一點。
Key.French: C'est bon ? OK, fais gaffe à toi.
Key.Spanish: ¿Eso es todo? Vale, ten cuidado ahí fuera.
Key.Italian: Non c’è altro? Okay, fai attenzione là fuori.
Key.Polish: Zbierasz się? Uważaj tam na siebie.
Key.German: War‘s das? Okay, pass auf dich auf.
Key.Czech: To je všechno? Tak na sebe dávej pozor.
Key.English: That it? Okay, take care out there.
Key.Portuguese: Pronto? Ok, tome cuidado lá fora.
Key.Japanese: ソレダケカ？ソレジャ、気ヲツケルンダゾ。
Key.Turkish: Bu kadar mı? Tamam, dikkatli ol.

Container.name: 014_eve_mechanic_goodbye_b
Container.situation: player leaves a garage.

Key.Original: Alright, see you later.
Key.French: OK, à plus.
Key.Spanish: Vale, nos vemos.
Key.Italian: Bene, ci vediamo.
Key.German: Alles klar, bis später.
Key.English: Alright, see you later.
Key.Portuguese: Certo, te vejo mais tarde.
Key.Japanese: ヨシ、マタ後デナ。

Container.name: 013_eve_mechanic_goodbye_a
Container.situation: player leaves a garage.

Key.Original: Salut. Stop by again some time, eh?
Key.French: Salut. Reviens quand tu veux, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Salut. Vuelve cuando quieras, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Salut. Torna presto, eh?
Key.Russian: Салют. Загляни сюда чуть позже, хорошо?
Key.German: Salut. Schau demnächst mal wieder vorbei, ok?
Key.Czech: Salut. Zase se tu někdy zastav, jo?
Key.English: Salut. Stop by again some time, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Salut. Faça outra visita quando der, ok?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你好。有空再过来，怎么样？
Key.Japanese: サリュー。マタ来テクレヨ。
Key.Turkish: Salut. Bir ara yine uğra, ha?

Container.name: 012_eve_mechanic_welcome_c
Container.situation: mechanic welcomes player at a garage.

Key.Original: Hey, good to see you.
Key.French: Content de te voir.
Key.Spanish: Hola, me alegro de verte.
Key.Italian: Ehi, sono contento di vederti.
Key.German: Hey, schön dich zu sehen.
Key.English: Hey, good to see you.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, bom te ver.
Key.Japanese: オイ、ヨク来タナ。

Container.name: 011_eve_mechanic_welcome_b
Container.situation: mechanic welcomes player at a garage.

Key.Original: Salut.
Key.French: Salut.
Key.Spanish: Salut.
Key.Italian: Salut.
Key.German: Salut.
Key.English: Salut.
Key.Portuguese: Salut.
Key.Japanese: サリュー。

Key.Original: Anything I can help you with today?
Key.Chinese: 我今天能為你做些什麼？
Key.French: Qu'est-ce que je peux faire pour toi ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Puedo ayudarte en algo?
Key.Italian: In cosa posso esserti utile oggi?
Key.Polish: Mogę ci w czymś dzisiaj pomóc?
Key.German: Wie kann ich dir heute behilflich sein?
Key.Czech: S čím ti můžu dneska pomoct?
Key.English: Anything I can help you with today?
Key.Portuguese: Posso te ajudar com algo hoje?
Key.Japanese: 今日ハドンナ用ダ？
Key.Turkish: Bugün sana yardımcı olabileceğim bir şey var mı?

Container.name: 010_eve_mechanic_welcome_a
Container.situation: mechanic welcomes player at a garage.

Key.Original: Hey, ça va ?
Key.French: Hey, ça va ?
Key.Spanish: Qué, ¿cómo te va?
Key.Italian: Ehilà, come va?
Key.German: Hey, wie läuft‘s?
Key.English: Hey, how's it going?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, como vai?
Key.Japanese: オイ、調子ハドウダ？

Key.Original: How's it going?
Key.French: Quoi de neuf ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Cómo te va?
Key.Italian: Tutto bene?
Key.German: Wie läuft‘s?
Key.English: How's it going?
Key.Portuguese: Como vai?
Key.Japanese: 元気シテルカ？

Container.name: 009_eve_mechanic_car_select_wait_c
Container.situation: mechanic tells player he'll have the car bomb prepped in a few hours.

Key.Original: I'll let you know when you can come and collect it.
Key.Chinese: 修好之後，我會通知你回來。
Key.French: Je te dirai quand revenir le chercher.
Key.Spanish: Ya te avisaré para que vengas a recogerlo.
Key.Italian: Ti farò sapere quando puoi venire a riprendertela.
Key.Polish: Dam ci znać, kiedy będzie do odbioru.
Key.Russian: Я дам тебе знать, когда можно будет забирать.
Key.German: Ich melde mich, wenn du es wieder abholen kannst.
Key.Czech: Dám ti vědět, až si pro něj budeš moct přijít.
Key.English: I'll let you know when you can come and collect it.
Key.Portuguese: Vou avisar quando puder vir buscá-lo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 到时候，我会通知你过来取车。
Key.Japanese: 取リニ来レルヨウニナッタラ連絡スル。
Key.Turkish: Gelip onu alabileceğin zaman sana haber vereceğim.

Key.Original: Ah, okay.
Key.French: Ah, OK.
Key.Spanish: Ah, vale.
Key.Italian: Ah, okay.
Key.German: Ah, okay.
Key.English: Ah, okay.
Key.Portuguese: Ah, ok.
Key.Japanese: アア、分カッタ。

Key.Original: Give me two or three hours.
Key.French: Donne-moi deux ou trois heures.
Key.Spanish: Dame unas tres horitas.
Key.Italian: Dammi due o tre ore.
Key.Polish: Daj mi ze dwie, trzy godziny.
Key.German: Gib mir zwei bis drei Stunden.
Key.English: Give me two or three hours.
Key.Portuguese: Me dê duas ou três horas.
Key.Japanese: 2、3 時間クレ。
Key.Turkish: Bana iki ya da üç saat ver.

Container.name: 008_eve_mechanic_car_select_wait_b
Container.situation: mechanic tells player he'll have the car bomb prepped in a few hours.

Key.Original: Très bon.
Key.French: Très bon.
Key.Spanish: Vale.
Key.Italian: Molto bene.
Key.German: Alles klar.
Key.English: Alright.
Key.Portuguese: Ok.
Key.Japanese: ヨシ。

Key.Original: Leave it with me.
Key.French: Je m'en occupe.
Key.Spanish: Déjamelo a mí.
Key.Italian: Lascia fare a me.
Key.German: Lass den Wagen ruhig hier.
Key.English: Leave it with me.
Key.Portuguese: Deixe isso comigo.
Key.Japanese: 任セテオケ。

Key.Original: I'll send you a text in a couple of hours.
Key.Chinese: 幾個小時後，我會給你傳個訊息。
Key.French: Je t'envoie un texto dans deux heures.
Key.Spanish: Te mandaré un mensaje en un par de horas.
Key.Italian: Ti invierò un messaggio tra un paio d’ore.
Key.Polish: Wyślę ci SMS-a za parę godzin.
Key.Russian: Я отправлю тебе СМС через пару часов.
Key.German: Ich schicke dir in ein paar Stunden eine Nachricht.
Key.Czech: Za pár hodin ti pošlu zprávu.
Key.English: I'll send you a text in a couple of hours.
Key.Portuguese: Vou enviar uma mensagem em algumas horas.
Key.Chinesesimp: 两小时后我会给你发条短信。
Key.Japanese: 数時間後ニ "メール" ヲ送ル。
Key.Turkish: Birkaç saat içinde sana bir mesaj göndereceğim.

Container.name: 007_eve_mechanic_car_select_wait_a
Container.situation: mechanic tells player he'll have the car bomb prepped in a few hours.

Key.Original: That one?
Key.French: Celui-là ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Ese?
Key.Italian: Quella lì?
Key.German: Das da?
Key.English: That one?
Key.Portuguese: Aquele?
Key.Japanese: アレカ？

Key.Original: Bien sûr, no problem.
Key.French: Bien sûr, pas de problème.
Key.Spanish: Bien sûr, no hay problema.
Key.Italian: Bien sûr, nessun problema.
Key.German: Bien sûr, kein Problem.
Key.English: Bien sûr, no problem.
Key.Portuguese: Bien sûr, sem problema.
Key.Japanese: ビアン・シュール。問題ナイ。

Key.Original: I'll have it ready in, what? A few hours?
Key.Chinese: 我等下就給你處理好？可能要幾個小時吧?
Key.French: Ce sera prêt dans quelques heures.
Key.Spanish: Lo tendé listo en... yo qué sé, ¿unas horas?
Key.Italian: Sarà pronta tra quanto, qualche ora?
Key.Polish: Będzie gotowe za jakieś… kilka godzin?
Key.Russian: Где-то через пару часов будет готово, хорошо?
Key.German: Ich brauche ein paar Stunden.
Key.Czech: Budu to mít... za jak dlouho? Za pár hodin?
Key.English: I'll have it ready in, what? A few hours?
Key.Portuguese: Vou deixar pronto em... Umas horas, talvez?
Key.Korean: 아마 몇 시간 정도면 끝날 것 같은데요?
Key.Chinesesimp: 我会给你弄好的，大概嘛，几个小时吧。
Key.Japanese: シッカリ調整シトイテヤル。数時間クライアレバ大丈夫ダ。
Key.Turkish: Onu hazır ederim de ne zamana? Birkaç saat içinde mi?

Key.Original: You'll get a message on your phone.
Key.French: Je t'enverrai un SMS.
Key.Spanish: Recibirás un mensaje por teléfono.
Key.Italian: Riceverai un messaggio sul cellulare.
Key.German: Ich schicke dir eine Nachricht auf dein Handy.
Key.English: You'll get a message on your phone.
Key.Portuguese: Você vai receber uma mensagem no seu telefone.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的手机会收到一条消息。
Key.Japanese: デキタラ電話ニ "メッセージ" ヲ送ル。

Container.name: 006_eve_mechanic_which_car_c
Container.situation: mechanic asks player which car is his.

Key.Original: So, er - what am I working on here?
Key.French: Bon, sur quoi je dois bosser ?
Key.Spanish: Entonces... ¿en qué quieres que trabaje?
Key.Italian: Allora... su quale devo mettere le mani?
Key.Polish: No to… co my tu mamy?
Key.Russian: Так, с чем я буду работать?
Key.German: Also, welches ist es?
Key.English: So, er - what am I working on here?
Key.Portuguese: Então, com qual que eu vou mexer aqui?
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吧，嗯 - 我该整哪辆？
Key.Japanese: ソレデ、ドンナ作業ヲシテホシインダ？
Key.Turkish: Ee, peki burada ne üzerinde çalışıyorum?

Container.name: 005_eve_mechanic_which_car_b
Container.situation: mechanic asks player which car is his.

Key.Original: You wanna show me the vehicle, mec?
Key.French: Tu me montres le véhicule, mec ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Quieres enseñarme el vehículo, mec?
Key.Italian: Mi fai vedere di che veicolo si tratta, mec?
Key.German: Willst du mir nicht das Fahrzeug zeigen, mec?
Key.Czech: Nechceš mi to auto ukázat, mec?
Key.English: You wanna show me the vehicle, mec?
Key.Portuguese: Pode me mostrar o veículo, mec?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你得让我知道你的车是哪辆吧，伙计？
Key.Japanese: 車ヲ見セテクレルカ？
Key.Turkish: Bana aracı göstermek ister misin, mec?

Key.Original: I'd, er, hate to fit the wrong one!
Key.French: Il faudrait pas que je me trompe !
Key.Spanish: No querría, esto... apañar el que no es.
Key.Italian: Non vorrei mettere a punto la macchina sbagliata!
Key.Russian: А то будет неловко, если установлю бомбу не на ту!
Key.German: Wäre doch schade, wenn ich das falsche aufrüste!
Key.Czech: Nerad bych to... ehm... namontoval do špatnýho.
Key.English: I'd, er, hate to fit the wrong one!
Key.Portuguese: Eu odiaria botar no errado!
Key.Japanese: 他ノヤツノ車ヲイジルノハ悪イカラナ！
Key.Turkish: Ee, yanlış bir şeyle uğraşmak istemem!

Container.name: 004_eve_mechanic_which_car_a
Container.situation: mechanic asks player which car is his.

Key.Original: And what do you want me to work on?
Key.French: Et sur quoi tu veux que je travaille ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Y en qué quieres que trabaje?
Key.Italian: E su quale vuoi che lavori?
Key.Russian: Что конкретно ты хочешь, чтобы я с ней сделал?
Key.German: Und was soll ich für dich tun?
Key.Czech: A na jakým autě mám zapracovat?
Key.English: And what do you want me to work on?
Key.Portuguese: E com qual você quer que eu trabalhe?
Key.Japanese: ドンナ作業ヲシテホシイ？

Container.name: 003_eve_mechanic_rigging_car
Container.situation: mechanic explains to player how the car bomb will work.

Key.Original: Really? You the guy?
Key.French: C'est vraiment toi, leur gars ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Tú eres el tío? ¿En serio?
Key.Italian: Seriamente? Sei tu il tipo?
Key.German: Was, du bist der Typ?
Key.English: Really? You the guy?
Key.Portuguese: Sério? Você é o cara?
Key.Japanese: 本当カ？オ前ガソウナノカ？

Key.Original: Okay, whatever, mec. I'm done here.
Key.Chinese: 好吧，隨便你，夥計。東西準備好了。
Key.French: Bon, OK, mec. J'ai fini.
Key.Spanish: Mira, me da igual, mec. Paso de todo.
Key.Italian: Okay, non importa, mec. Qui ho fatto.
Key.German: Wie auch immer, mec. Ich bin hier fertig.
Key.Czech: No jak myslíš, mec. Já mám svoje odpracováno.
Key.English: Okay, whatever, mec. I'm done here.
Key.Portuguese: Ok, tanto faz, mec. Terminei por aqui.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吧，随你怎么说，伙计。我搞定了。
Key.Japanese: マア、イイ。俺ノ仕事ハ終ワリダ。
Key.Turkish: Tamam, her neyse, mec. Buradaki işim bitti.

Key.Original: Try not to drive into anything, you gotta cocktail mortel in there. Two artillery shells and a block of C-4 acting as a primer.
Key.Chinese: 別撞倒其他東西了，這裡面可是個致命組合。裡面有兩個砲彈和一塊 C-4 炸藥當作起爆炸藥。
Key.French: Pas d'accident, hein, c'est un cocktail mortel. Deux obus d'artillerie et un pain de C-4 comme amorce.
Key.Spanish: Intenta no estrellarte contra nada, llevas un cocktail mortel: dos obuses y un bloque de C-4 como detonador.
Key.Italian: Cerca di non andare a sbattere, hai un cocktail mortel là dentro. Due proiettili di artiglieria e un blocco di C-4 come innesco.
Key.Polish: Postaraj się w nic nie wjechać, masz tam cocktail mortel. Dwa pociski artyleryjskie i C4 jako zapalnik.
Key.Russian: Попытайся ни во что не врезаться, у тебя тут коктель мортель. Два артиллерийских снаряда и С-4 в качестве запального устройства.
Key.German: Versuch, keinen Unfall zu bauen. Das Ding ist ein cocktail mortel: zwei Artilleriegeschosse und ein Satz C-4 als Zünder.
Key.Czech: Snaž se do ničeho nenabourat, máš v tom smrtící koktejl. Dva dělostřelecký granáty a hroudu C-4 jako rozbušku.
Key.English: Try not to drive into anything, you gotta cocktail mortel in there. Two artillery shells and a block of C-4 acting as a primer.
Key.Portuguese: Tente não bater em nada, você tem um cocktail mortel aí. Dois projéteis de artilharia e um bloco de C-4 atuando como ignitor.
Key.Korean: 어디 충돌하지 않게 조심해요. 그 안에 위험한 물건들이 잔뜩 있으니까요. 포탄 2개에 C-4 폭약 블럭이 들었어요.
Key.Chinesesimp: 开车时一定要避免碰撞，车里的货可不是闹着玩的。两枚炮弹和一大块引爆用的 C4 炸弹。
Key.Japanese: 衝突シナイヨウニ運転シロ。"カクテル・モルテル" ヲ載セテルンダ。大砲ノ砲弾ガ 2 発ト点火薬トシテノ C-4 ダ。
Key.Turkish: Bir şeye bulaşmamaya çalış, orada ölümcül bir kokteylin var; öncül olarak iş gören iki ağır silah mermisi ve bir de C-4 kütlesi.

Key.Original: So, y'know, take it slow.
Key.French: Alors vas-y tout doux.
Key.Spanish: Así que ya sabes, ve despacito.
Key.Italian: Quindi, insomma, vacci piano.
Key.German: Also fahr langsam.
Key.English: So, y'know, take it slow.
Key.Portuguese: Então, vá com calma.
Key.Japanese: ダカラ、焦ルナヨ。

Key.Original: I'm gonna send you a number. Change all the fours to sevens and call it as soon as you wanna detonate. Just don't ass dial, eh?
Key.Chinese: 我把號碼傳給你，把四通通改成七，準備好之後，立即撥號引爆它。別不小心誤撥這個號碼了，知道嗎？
Key.French: Je t'envoie un numéro. Remplace les 4 par des 7 et appelle pour faire sauter. Fais gaffe à pas t'asseoir sur ton portable, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Voy a mandarte un número. Cambia todos los cuatros por sietes y llama cuando quieras que explote. Cuidado de no llamar por accidente, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ti invio un numero. Cambia tutti i quattro in sette e chiamalo non appena vuoi detonare la bomba. Non chiamarlo per sbaglio eh?
Key.Polish: Prześlę ci numer. Zmień czwórki na siódemki i zadzwoń, jak będziesz miał zdetonować, ale nie wcześniej, jasne?, jasne?
Key.Russian: Я пришлю тебе номер. Поменяй все четверки на семерки, чтобы взорвать его. Главное, случайно жопой номер не набери, понял?
Key.German: Ich schicke dir eine Nummer. Ändere jede 4 in eine 7 und ruf an, wenn du die Bombe zünden willst. Pass nur auf, dass du dich nicht auf das Telefon setzt und versehentlich anrufst.
Key.Czech: Pošlu ti číslo. Až to budeš chtít odpálit, změň všechny čtyřky na sedmičky a zavolej na něj. Hlavně to nevytoč omylem, jasný?
Key.English: I'm gonna send you a number. Change all the fours to sevens and call it as soon as you wanna detonate. Just don't ass dial, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Vou te enviar um número. Mude todos os quatro pra setes e chame assim que quiser detonar. Só não ligue por engano, ok?
Key.Korean: 번호를 보내줄게요. 그 번호에서 4를 전부 7로 바꾼 다음에 나오는 번호로 전화하면 바로 폭발할 거예요. 실수로 전화하면 안 돼요, 알겠죠?
Key.Chinesesimp: 我会把号码发给你。把所有四改成七，准备引爆时就拨这个号码。千万别误拨，嗯？
Key.Japanese: 番号ヲオ前ニ送ル。4 ヲ全部 7 ニ変エテ、起爆シタイ時ニ電話シロ。"ポケット" ノ中デ勝手ニ電話ガカカッタトカハナシダゼ。
Key.Turkish: Sana bir numara göndereceğim. Tüm dörtleri yedilerle değiştir ve patlatmak istediğinde ara. Sakın telefon cebindeyken falan yanlış arama yapma, tamam mı?

Container.name: 002_ta_police_station_destroyed_call
Container.situation: player receives a call from boss, after destroying a police station with a car bomb.

Key.Original: Good work.
Key.French: Bon boulot.
Key.Spanish: Buen trabajo.
Key.Italian: Ottimo lavoro.
Key.German: Gute Arbeit.
Key.English: Good work.
Key.Portuguese: Bom trabalho.
Key.Japanese: ヨクヤッタ。

Key.Original: I think our message was persuasive.
Key.Chinese: 我看我們的訊息很有說服力。
Key.French: Je crois que le message est passé.
Key.Spanish: Creo que ha sido un mensaje convincente.
Key.Italian: Credo che il nostro messaggio sia stato convincente.
Key.Polish: To powinno dać im do myślenia.
Key.Russian: Думаю, наше послание было весьма убедительным.
Key.German: Ich glaube, unsere Botschaft war überzeugend.
Key.English: I think our message was persuasive.
Key.Portuguese: Acho que nossa mensagem foi convincente.
Key.Korean: 우리의 메시지가 설득력이 있었던 것 같다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我觉得我们放出的信息很有说服力。
Key.Japanese: 俺タチノ "メッセージ" ハ説得力ガアッタヨウダナ。

Key.Original: Money to come soon, Képi, no worry.
Key.Chinese: 錢馬上就會送到，Képi，別擔心。
Key.French: Ton argent arrive, Képi, t'inquiète.
Key.Spanish: No te preocupes, Képi, pronto tendrás el dinero.
Key.Italian: I soldi arriveranno presto, Képi, non temere.
Key.Polish: Pieniądze niedługo będą, Képi, bez obaw.
Key.Russian: Не волнуйся, Кепи, скоро получишь свои деньги.
Key.German: Dein Geld kommt bald, Képi, keine Sorge.
Key.Czech: Peníze přijdou brzo, Képi, žádnej strach.
Key.English: Money to come soon, Képi, no worry.
Key.Portuguese: Dinheiro logo vem, Képi, não se preocupe.
Key.Korean: 돈은 곧 입금될 거다, 케피. 걱정 마라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 钱很快就会给你的，Képi，别担心。
Key.Japanese: 金ハスグニ送ル、ケピ。心配スルナ。

Key.Original: And for right price, our mécanicien can always, er, fix your car - give it some extra va-va-boom...
Key.Chinese: 而且，只要價格好，我們的機械師能幫你把車修好，或是給它增添一些馬力…
Key.French: Et pour un bon prix, notre mécanicien peut, euh, arranger ta voiture. La rendre explosive...
Key.Spanish: Y, si aflojas la pasta, nuestro mécanicien siempre puede, esto... arreglarte el coche, hacer que sea... la bomba...
Key.Italian: E per il giusto prezzo, il nostro mécanicien può sempre, ehm, darti un’aggiustatina alla macchina e rendertela un po’ più scoppiettante...
Key.Polish: Za opłatą nasz mécanicien może zawsze… podrasować twoje auto – zrobić z niego wybuchową brykę…
Key.Russian: Ну а за дополнительную плату, наш механик всегда готов, э-э, подладить твой автомобиль, будет он у тебя ва-ва-бум...
Key.German: Und für den richtigen Preis kann unser mécanicien deinen Wagen „aufrüsten“ – mit mehr Wumms ...
Key.Czech: A za poplatek ti naši mécanicien vždycky... ehm... vylepší auto. Ať má větší va-va-bum.
Key.English: And for right price, our mécanicien can always, er, fix your car - give it some extra va-va-boom...
Key.Portuguese: E por preço certo, nosso mécanicien pode, ahn, consertar seu carro. Ou adicionar uns extras explosivos...
Key.Korean: 그리고 가격만 맞는다면 우리 정비사가 언제든지... 음... 네 차를 수리해줄 수 있을 거다... 좀 더 폭발적으로 만들어주는 거지...
Key.Chinesesimp: 而且，只要给足了钱，我们的机械师总是能，呃，总是能整好你的车 - 还能让它更带劲...
Key.Japanese: ソレカラ、金サエ出セバ、俺ノ "メカネーション" ガオ前ノ車ヲイジッテクレル。モット迫力ノアルヤツニシテクレルゾ...
Key.Turkish: Ve iyi bir fiyata, bizim mécanicien her zaman, ee, arabanı tamir edebilir; ona ekstradan biraz va va bum verebilir...

Container.name: 245_in_black_market_prices_laptop
Container.situation: player has not checked boss's laptop for intel.

Key.Original: And, also, information you not take from laptop.
Key.Chinese: 另外，你還沒從筆記型電腦裡取得的資訊。
Key.French: Et les infos que t'as pas prises sur l'ordi...
Key.Spanish: Y, además, la información que no sacaste del portátil...
Key.Italian: E, un’altra cosa, le informazioni che non hai preso dal computer portatile.
Key.Polish: No i informacje, te co zapomniałeś z laptopa.
Key.Russian: И еще, информация, которую ты не извлек из ноутбука.
Key.German: Außerdem Informationen, die du nicht aus dem Laptop geholt hast.
Key.Czech: Jo a ty informace, co sis nevzal z notebooku.
Key.English: And, also, information you not take from laptop.
Key.Portuguese: Além disso, informações que cê não pegou do laptop.
Key.Chinesesimp: 还有，你没从手提电脑上获取的信息。
Key.Japanese: ソレカラ、情報ヲ "ラップトップ" カラ取ルナ。
Key.Turkish: Ayrıca, dizüstü bilgisayardan bilgiyi almayı unuttun.

Key.Original: I send it to you. Check your phone!
Key.Chinese: 我傳送給你，你看看手機！
Key.French: Je te les envoie. Regarde ton portable !
Key.Spanish: Te la mando. ¡Mira el teléfono!
Key.Italian: Te le ho inviate. Controlla il cellulare!
Key.Polish: Wysyłam je do ciebie. Sprawdź komórkę!
Key.Russian: Я отправлю ее тебе. Загляни в свой телефон!
Key.German: Ich schicke sie dir zu. Guck auf dein Handy!
Key.Czech: Pošlu ti je. Koukej na telefon.
Key.English: I send it to you. Check your phone!
Key.Portuguese: Eu mando pra você. Verifique seu telefone!
Key.Korean: 그 정보는 따로 보냈다. 휴대폰을 확인하라!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我把它发给你吧。查下你的手机！
Key.Japanese: オ前ニ送ッタ。電話ヲ "チェック" シロ！

Container.name: 050_ta_evidence_received
Container.situation: player takes evidence to boss speaker.

Key.Original: Salut, Képi.
Key.French: Salut, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Salut, Képi.
Key.Italian: Salut, Képi.
Key.German: Salut, Képi.
Key.English: Salut, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Salut, Képi.
Key.Japanese: サリュー、ケピ。

Key.Original: You do good, eh?
Key.French: Bon travail, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Todo bien, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ce l’hai fatta, eh?
Key.German: Läuft bei dir, was?
Key.English: You do good, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Cê se saiu bem, non?
Key.Japanese: ヨクヤッタナ。

Key.Original: I get our man's ID, he big loss for many fight to come.
Key.Chinese: 我要我們的人的 ID，少了他可真是一大損失。
Key.French: J'ai ses papiers. Lui grosse perte pour notre combat.
Key.Spanish: Tengo la ID de nuestro hombre, es una gran pérdida para las luchas que habrá.
Key.Italian: Ho ricevuto il documento d’identità del nostro uomo. Una grande perdita per le molte battaglie che verranno.
Key.Polish: Dostałem dowód tego człowieka. Będzie nam go brakowało w czekających nas walkach.
Key.Russian: Получил документы нашего товарища. Большая потеря для нашего общего дела.
Key.German: Ich habe den Ausweis erhalten. Dies ist ein großer Verlust für uns.
Key.Czech: Vidím občanku našeho člověka. Velká ztráta na hodně bojů ještě.
Key.English: I get our man's ID, he big loss for many fight to come.
Key.Portuguese: Peguei a ID do nosso camarada, grande perda pras próxima batalha.
Key.Korean: 우리 동지의 신분증을 받았다. 그의 죽음은 우리에게 큰 손실이다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我拿到我们那人的身份证，少了他可真是一大损失。
Key.Japanese: ヤツノ ID ヲ受ケ取ッタ。今後ノ戦イデハ戦力ガ大キク削レルナ。
Key.Turkish: Adamımızın kimliği bende; önümüzdeki savaşlar için büyük bir kayıp.

Key.Original: I will be in touch.
Key.French: Je te rappellerai.
Key.Spanish: Estaremos en contacto.
Key.Italian: Mi farò risentire.
Key.German: Ich melde mich.
Key.English: I will be in touch.
Key.Portuguese: Vou manter contato.
Key.Japanese: マタ連絡スル。

Container.name: 236_ex_target_destroyed
Container.situation: boss reports that a primary target has been destroyed, disrupting operations.

Key.Original: Too bad somebody stole our thunder.
Key.Chinese: 真可惜，有人搶了我們的功勞。
Key.French: On nous coupe l'herbe sous le pied.
Key.Spanish: Lástima que alguien nos haya robado nuestros truenos.
Key.Italian: Peccato che qualcuno ci abbia rubato la scena.
Key.Russian: Жаль, что кто-то добрался до нашей цели первым.
Key.German: Schade, dass uns jemand die Show gestohlen hat.
Key.Czech: Škoda, že někdo byl rychlejší než my.
Key.English: Too bad somebody stole our thunder.
Key.Portuguese: Pena que alguém roubou nossa ideia.
Key.Chinesesimp: 真可惜，有人抢了我们的功劳。
Key.Japanese: 誰カニ出シ抜カレルトハ残念ダ。
Key.Turkish: Bizim Thunder’ı birinin çalmış olması çok kötü.

Key.Original: Weeks of planning - and then, boom!
Key.Chinese: 幾週的計畫－－突然，「轟」的一聲！
Key.French: Des semaines de préparation, et puis boum !
Key.Spanish: Semanas de planificación y luego... ¡bum!
Key.Italian: Tante settimane di organizzazione e poi... boom!
Key.German: Wochenlange Planung und dann – BUMM!
Key.English: Weeks of planning - and then, boom!
Key.Portuguese: Semanas de planos e daí: cabum!
Key.Korean: 몇 주에 걸쳐 계획을 짰는데, 이렇게 쾅!
Key.Chinesesimp: 几个星期的计划 - 然后，烟消云散！
Key.Japanese: 何週間モ計画ヲ練ッタノニ――ドカーン！
Key.Turkish: Haftalarca yapılan plan ve sonra, bum!

Key.Original: Our target is suddenly destroyed...
Key.Chinese: 我們的目標瞬間被摧毀了……
Key.French: La cible, détruite...
Key.Spanish: Nuestro objetivo queda destruido de repente...
Key.Italian: Il nostro obiettivo viene improvvisamente distrutto...
Key.German: Unser Ziel ist plötzlich zerstört ...
Key.English: Our target is suddenly destroyed...
Key.Portuguese: Destroem nosso alvo do nada...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们的目标突然被摧毁了...
Key.Japanese: 標的ガ突然破壊サレタ...

Key.Original: The revolution, Képi. It don't need orders no more.
Key.Chinese: 這場革命不再需要命令了，Képi。
Key.French: La révolution, Képi. Pas besoin d'ordres.
Key.Spanish: La revolución, Képi. Ya no me hacen falta órdenes.
Key.Italian: La rivoluzione, Képi. Gli ordini non sono più necessari.
Key.Polish: To rewolucja, Képi. Rozkazy nie są już potrzebne.
Key.Russian: Революция, Кепи. Приказов больше не будет.
Key.German: Die Revolution, Képi. Sie braucht keine Befehle mehr.
Key.Czech: To je revoluce, Képi. Už nepotřebuje rozkazy.
Key.English: The revolution, Képi. It don't need orders no more.
Key.Portuguese: A revolução, Képi. Ela non precisa de mais ordens.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这场革命，Képi；这场革命不再需要下命令了。
Key.Japanese: 革命ダ、ケピ。モウ命令ハ必要ナイ。
Key.Turkish: Devrim, Képi. Onun artık emirlere ihtiyacı yok.

Key.Original: Every paysan's a guérillero now, eh?
Key.Chinese: 每個 paysan 都是游擊兵了，對吧？
Key.French: Tous les paysans sont des guérilleros, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Ahora cualquier paysan es un guérillero, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ogni paysan è un guérillero adesso, eh?
Key.Polish: Teraz każdy paysan to guérillero, co?
Key.German: Jeder Paysan ist jetzt ein guérillero.
Key.Czech: Každej balík je teď guérillero, víš?
Key.English: Every paysan's a guérillero now, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Todo paysan é um guérillero agora, si?
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在每个农民都是一个游击队员了，嗯？
Key.Japanese: "ペイゾン" ハモウ全員 "ゲリラ" ダ。
Key.Turkish: Şimdi her köylü bir guérillero, ha?

Key.Original: Ah, anyway, good job with them NVG.
Key.Chinese: 啊，不管怎樣，夜視鏡的事做得漂亮。
Key.French: Ah, au fait, bon boulot avec les LVN.
Key.Spanish: Ah, por cierto, buen trabajo con las gafas de visión nocturna.
Key.Italian: Ah, comunque ottimo lavoro con i visori notturni.
Key.Polish: No ale dobra robota z tym noktowizorem.
Key.Russian: Как бы там ни было, спасибо за ПНВ.
Key.German: Trotzdem gute Arbeit mit den Nachtsichtgeräten.
Key.Czech: No ale dobrá práce za to noční vidění.
Key.English: Ah, anyway, good job with them NVG.
Key.Portuguese: Ah, enfim, beau travail com os OVNs.
Key.Chinesesimp: 哈，不管怎样，夜视镜的活儿干得漂亮。
Key.Japanese: アア、トニカク、暗視 "ゴーグル" ノ件ハヨクヤッタ。
Key.Turkish: Ah, neyse; GGG konusunda iyi iş çıkardılar.

Key.Original: If you find guns, bring them to us.
Key.Chinese: 如果你找到槍枝，記得帶給我們。
Key.French: Si tu trouves des flingues, apporte-les.
Key.Spanish: Si encuentras armas, tráenoslas.
Key.Italian: Se trovi armi, portacele.
Key.Polish: Jak znajdziesz broń, przynieś nam ją.
Key.Russian: Если найдешь оружие, неси его нам.
Key.German: Wenn du Waffen findest, bring sie zu uns.
Key.Czech: Když najdeš zbraně, dones nám je.
Key.English: If you find guns, bring them to us.
Key.Portuguese: Se encontrar armas, traz pra gente.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你找到枪支，就给我们送过来。
Key.Japanese: 銃ヲ見ツケタラ、俺達ノトコロニ持ッテコイ。

Container.name: 235_ex_syndikat_friendly_fire
Container.situation: boss reprimands player after friendlies are killed.

Key.Original: You dead man.
Key.French: T'es un homme mort.
Key.Spanish: Estás muerto.
Key.Italian: Sei un uomo morto.
Key.German: Du bist ein toter Mann.
Key.English: You dead man.
Key.Portuguese: Você vai morrer, cara.
Key.Japanese: オ前ヲ殺シテヤル。

Key.Original: You dead man, Képi.
Key.French: T'es un homme mort, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Estás muerto, Képi.
Key.Italian: Sei un uomo morto, Képi.
Key.German: Du bist ein toter Mann, Képi.
Key.English: You dead man, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Você é um homem morto, Képi.
Key.Japanese: 殺シテヤルゾ、ケピ。

Key.Original: Spotter say he see you, shootin' up our own.
Key.Chinese: 有人說，他看見了你射殺自己人。
Key.French: Le guetteur t'a vu tirer sur les nôtres.
Key.Spanish: El vigía dice que te ha visto disparando a los nuestros.
Key.Italian: L’osservatore ha detto che ti ha visto spararci addosso.
Key.Polish: Obserwator mówi, że strzelasz do naszych.
Key.Russian: Мой наводчик говорит, ты открыл огонь по нашим.
Key.German: Du wurdest gesehen, als du unsere Leute beschossen hast.
Key.Czech: Hlídka tě vidí. Střílíš do našich.
Key.English: Spotter say he see you, shootin' up our own.
Key.Portuguese: Observador diz que viu cê atirando em próprios companheiros.
Key.Korean: 네놈이 우리 동지를 쏘는 걸 우리 정찰병이 봤다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 观察员说他看到你了，在向我们自己人开枪。
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ俺ノ兵士ヲ撃ッタノヲ "スポッター" ガ見タ。
Key.Turkish: Gözetleyici seni kendi adamlarımıza ateş ederken gördüğünü söylüyor.

Key.Original: Tu es un homme mort...
Key.French: Tu es un homme mort...
Key.Spanish: Eres hombre muerto...
Key.Italian: Sei un uomo morto...
Key.German: Du bist ein toter Mann ...
Key.English: You are a dead man…
Key.Portuguese: Você tá morto, cara…
Key.Japanese: オ前ハモウ死ンダモ同然ダ...

Container.name: 231_eve_threat_level_safe_syndikat_boss
Container.situation: boss contacts player to let him know he's safe.

Key.Original: Comment ça va, Képi ?
Key.French: Comment ça va, Képi ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Cómo te va, Képi?
Key.Italian: Come va, Képi?
Key.German: Wie läuft‘s, Képi?
Key.English: How’s it going, Képi?
Key.Portuguese: Como tá indo, Képi?
Key.Japanese: 調子ハドウダ、ケピ？

Key.Original: Things cool down a little, I think.
Key.French: Ça se calme un peu, je crois.
Key.Spanish: Creo que la cosa se está enfriando un poco.
Key.Italian: Le cose si sono calmate un po’, credo.
Key.German: Ich glaube, die Lage hat sich ein wenig beruhigt.
Key.English: Things cool down a little, I think.
Key.Portuguese: As coisas acalmaram um pouco, acho.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我觉得局面缓和一点了。
Key.Japanese: 状況ガ少シ落チ着イテキタト思ウ。

Container.name: 229_eve_threat_level_warning_syndikat_boss
Container.situation: boss contacts player to let him know it's not safe.

Key.Original: Képi. Salut.
Key.French: Képi. Salut.
Key.Spanish: Képi. Salut.
Key.Italian: Képi. Salut.
Key.German: Képi. Salut.
Key.English: Képi. Salut.
Key.Portuguese: Képi. Salut.
Key.Japanese: ケピ、サリュー。

Key.Original: I call to warn you, we to see a lotta movement.
Key.Chinese: 我打電話是要提醒你，我們發現很大的動靜。
Key.French: Je veux te prévenir. On voit du mouvement.
Key.Spanish: Te llamo para avisarte de que vamos a ver mucho movimiento.
Key.Italian: Ti ho chiamato per avvertirti che stiamo notando un sacco di movimento.
Key.Polish: Dzwonię, żeby ostrzec – obserwujemy duże wzmożenie.
Key.Russian: Звоню предупредить тебя. CSAT сильно суетятся.
Key.German: Ich rufe an, um dich zu warnen. Irgendwas passiert da.
Key.Czech: Volám ti varování. Všude se hodně děje.
Key.English: I call to warn you, we to see a lotta movement.
Key.Portuguese: Tô ligando pra avisar, vemos muito movimento.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我打电话是要提醒你，我们发现很大的动静。
Key.Japanese: 警告シテヤル。イロイロ動キガアルゾ。
Key.Turkish: Seni uyarmak için aradım; çok fazla hareket görüyoruz.

Key.Original: CSAT sending out reinforcements some place.
Key.Chinese: CSAT 正在向一些地方派遣援軍。
Key.French: Le CSAT envoie des renforts quelque part.
Key.Spanish: El CSAT va a enviar refuerzos a algún sitio.
Key.Italian: La CSAT sta inviando rinforzi da qualche parte.
Key.German: CSAT sendet Verstärkung aus.
Key.Czech: CSAT posílá posily na nějaký místo.
Key.English: CSAT sending out reinforcements some place.
Key.Portuguese: CSAT tá enviando reforços pra algum lugar.
Key.Chinesesimp: CSAT 正在向某个地方派遣增援部队。
Key.Japanese: CSAT ガドコカニ援軍ヲ送ッテル。

Key.Original: Maybe good idea you disappear - not make too much attention.
Key.Chinese: 或許你應該消失一下－－別去吸引他們的注意。
Key.French: Tu dois disparaître. Pas attirer l'attention.
Key.Spanish: Puede que sea buena idea que te esfumes, que no llames mucho la atención.
Key.Italian: Forse ti conviene sparire, non dare troppo nell’occhio.
Key.Polish: Może lepiej zniknij, nie zwracaj na siebie uwagi.
Key.Russian: Думаю, неплохо было бы тебе исчезнуть, не привлекай к себе много внимания.
Key.German: Vielleicht solltest du ein wenig untertauchen.
Key.Czech: Možná dobrý nápad je zmizet. Nedělat moc pozornost.
Key.English: Maybe good idea you disappear - not make too much attention.
Key.Portuguese: Peut-être é uma boa ideia desaparecer e non chamar muita atenção.
Key.Korean: 놈들 눈에 띄지 않는 게 좋을 거다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 也许你最好消失一下 - 不要引起太多注意。
Key.Japanese: 姿ヲ消シタ方ガイイダロウ。目立タナイヨウニ大人シクシテタ方ガイイ。
Key.Turkish: Belki ortadan kaybolman iyi bir fikir olabilir; çok dikkat çekme.

Key.Original: Go to safehouse or jungle, lay low.
Key.Chinese: 快去密屋或叢林裡，避避風頭。
Key.French: Trouve une planque ou va dans la jungle.
Key.Spanish: Ve a la casa franca de la selva y no la líes.
Key.Italian: Vai nel rifugio o nella giungla, mantieni un basso profilo.
Key.Polish: Przyczaj się w kryjówce albo w dżungli.
Key.Russian: Спрячься в убежище или скройся в джунглях.
Key.German: Such dir einen Unterschlupf oder versteck dich im Dschungel.
Key.Czech: Schovej se v domě nebo džungli. Pryč.
Key.English: Go to safehouse or jungle, lay low.
Key.Portuguese: Vai pra esconderijo ou selva, se esconde.
Key.Korean: 안전가옥이나 정글로 가서 숨 죽이고 있어라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 快去密屋或丛林里，躲一躲。
Key.Japanese: 隠レ家デモ "ジャングル" デモイイ。隠レテイロ。
Key.Turkish: Güvenli bir yere veya ormana gidin, saklanın.

Container.name: 227_eve_medicine_available
Container.situation: soldiera tells player where the medical supplies are located.

Key.Original: You here for medicine?
Key.French: Tu es là pour les médocs ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Has venido a por medicina?
Key.Italian: Sei qui per le medicine?
Key.German: Bist du wegen der Medikamente hier?
Key.English: You here for medicine?
Key.Portuguese: Você veio aqui pelo remédio?
Key.Japanese: 薬ヲ取リニ来タノカ？

Key.Original: Okay - yeah, we expecting you.
Key.French: Ouais, je t'attendais.
Key.Spanish: Vale... Sí, te estábamos esperando.
Key.Italian: Okay... Sì, ti stavamo aspettando.
Key.German: Okay, wir haben dich erwartet.
Key.Czech: Jo, už tady na tebe čekáme.
Key.English: Okay - yeah, we expecting you.
Key.Portuguese: Ok, sim, a gente esperava por você.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好的 - 是啊，我们正等着你呢。
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ来ルノハ知ッテタ。

Key.Original: It's on the table, in the bunker...
Key.Chinese: 就在碉堡裡面的桌子上……
Key.French: Ils sont sur la table, dans le bunker...
Key.Spanish: Está en la mesa, en el búnker...
Key.Italian: Sono sul tavolo, nel bunker...
Key.German: Sie liegen auf dem Tisch im Bunker ...
Key.English: It's on the table, in the bunker...
Key.Portuguese: Tá ali na mesa, no bunker...
Key.Korean: 벙커 안에 있는 테이블 위에 있어...
Key.Chinesesimp: 就在桌子上，地堡里里头...
Key.Japanese: "バンカー" ノ "テーブル" ノ上ダ...

Container.name: 193_ta_sample_taken_to_van_call
Container.situation: player takes the counteragent to the van, as ordered by boss.

Key.Original: Très bien, Képi blanc.
Key.French: Très bien, Képi blanc.
Key.Spanish: Buen trabajo, Képi blanc.
Key.Italian: Molto bene, Képi blanc.
Key.German: Gute Arbeit, Képi blanc.
Key.English: Well done, Képi blanc.
Key.Portuguese: Muito bem, Képi blanc.
Key.Japanese: ヨクヤッタ。ケピ・ブロン。

Key.Original: Now, écoute moi. You in big danger.
