Key.Chinese: 快，écoute moi。你的處境很危險。
Key.French: Écoute-moi. Tu es en danger.
Key.Spanish: Mira, écoute moi. Estás en mucho peligro.
Key.Italian: Ora, écoute-moi. Sei in pericolo.
Key.Russian: А теперь, экутэ муа. Ты в большой опасности.
Key.German: Écoute moi, du bist in großer Gefahr.
Key.Czech: Teď, écoute moi. Máš velký nebezpečí.
Key.English: Now, écoute moi. You in big danger.
Key.Portuguese: Agora, écoute-moi. Cê está correndo grande perigo.
Key.Korean: 에꾸뜨 므와. 넌 큰 위험에 처해 있다.
Key.Japanese: サア、エクートゥ・モア。危ナイ橋ヲ渡ッテルゾ。
Key.Turkish: Şimdi, écoute moi. Büyük bir tehlikedesin.

Key.Original: Your NATO friends, they betray you.
Key.Chinese: 你那些 NATO 的朋友們背叛了你。
Key.French: Tes amis de l'OTAN, ils t'ont trahi.
Key.Spanish: Tus amigos de la OTAN te han traicionado.
Key.Italian: I tuoi amici della NATO ti hanno tradito.
Key.Russian: Твои друзья из НАТО предадут тебя.
Key.German: Deine NATO-Freunde haben dich verraten.
Key.Czech: Tvý kámoši z NATO tě zradí.
Key.English: Your NATO friends, they betray you.
Key.Portuguese: Seus amigos da OTAN te traíram.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的 NATO 朋友背叛了你。
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ NATO ノ友人ガオ前ヲ裏切ッタ。
Key.Turkish: NATO arkadaşların, onlar sana ihanet etti.

Key.Original: After you betray them.
Key.Chinese: 因為你之前出賣了他們。
Key.French: Après, tu les as trahis.
Key.Spanish: Después de que los traicionases.
Key.Italian: Dopo che tu li hai traditi.
Key.Russian: После того, как ты предал их.
Key.German: Nachdem du sie verraten hast.
Key.English: After you betray them.
Key.Portuguese: Depois de você trair eles.
Key.Chinesesimp: 因为你之前出卖了他们。
Key.Japanese: オ前ガヤツラヲ裏切ッタ後ニナ。
Key.Turkish: Tabii sen onlara ihanet ettikten sonra.

Key.Original: Tanoa. It no place for you no more.
Key.Chinese: 塔諾雅，你不該再待在這裡了。
Key.French: Tanoa, c'est plus pour toi, maintenant.
Key.Spanish: Tanoa ya no es lugar para ti.
Key.Italian: Tanoa non è più il posto per te.
Key.Polish: Nie jesteś już bezpieczny na Tanoa.
Key.Russian: Тебе нечего больше делать на Таноа.
Key.German: Tanoa ist nicht mehr sicher für dich.
Key.Czech: Tanoa už není místo pro tebe.
Key.English: Tanoa. It no place for you no more.
Key.Portuguese: Tanoa. Non tem mais lugar pra você.
Key.Korean: 넌 더 이상 타노아에 있을 수 없다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 塔诺亚，你不该再呆在这里了。
Key.Japanese: タノア。オ前ニハモウ居場所ハナイ。
Key.Turkish: Tanoa. Artık orada sana yer yok.

Key.Original: CSAT know who you are - 'Santiago'.
Key.French: Le CSAT sait qui tu es, "Santiago".
Key.Spanish: El CSAT sabe quién eres... «Santiago».
Key.Italian: La CSAT sa chi sei, “Santiago”.
Key.German: CSAT weiß, wer du bist, „Santiago“.
Key.English: CSAT know who you are - 'Santiago'.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT sabe quem você é, "Santiago".
Key.Japanese: CSAT ニオ前ノ素性ガバレタゾ。「サンティアゴ」ダトナ。

Key.Original: But L'Ensemble? We don't forget our friends.
Key.Chinese: 至於 L'Ensemble？我們從來不會忘記我們的朋友。
Key.French: Mais l'Ensemble n'oublie pas ses amis.
Key.Spanish: ¿Y L'Ensemble? Nosotros siempre pensamos en nuestros amigos.
Key.Italian: Ma L’Ensemble non dimentica i propri amici.
Key.Polish: Ale L’Ensemble pamięta o swoich przyjaciołach.
Key.Russian: Но мы в Л'Енсабле не забываем своих друзей.
Key.German: Aber L'Ensemble vergisst seine Freunde nicht.
Key.Czech: Ale L'Ensemble? My naše kamarádi nezapomínáme.
Key.English: But L'Ensemble? We don't forget our friends.
Key.Portuguese: Mas L'Ensemble? A gente não esquece amigos.
Key.Korean: 하지만 '앙상블'은? 우린 동지를 절대 외면하지 않는다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 至于大帮会，我们从来不会忘记自己的朋友。
Key.Japanese: ダガ、"ランサンブル" ハ友人ヲ忘レタリハシナイ。

Key.Original: There is a petit submersible at the harbor in Tavu.
Key.Chinese: 塔夫的碼頭有一艘小型潛水艇。
Key.French: Il y a un petit submersible dans le port de Tavu.
Key.Spanish: Hay un petit submersible en el puerto de Tavu.
Key.Italian: C’è un petit submersible al porto di Tavu.
Key.Polish: Na przystani w Tavu jest petit submersible.
Key.Russian: В гавани Таву есть пети субмерсибль.
Key.German: Im Hafen von Tavu liegt ein kleines U-Boot.
Key.Czech: V přístavu v Tavu je un petit submersible.
Key.English: There is a petit submersible at the harbor in Tavu.
Key.Portuguese: Tem un petit submarino no porto de Tavu.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在塔夫港口，有一艘小型潜艇。
Key.Japanese: "タブ" ノ湾ニ小サナ潜水艇ガアル。
Key.Turkish: Tavu’daki limanda petit bir denizaltı var.

Key.Original: Take it, use it to escape. Go to La Roche. Go safe. Adieu.
Key.Chinese: 找到它，用它逃走。去 La Roche。注意安全，再見。
Key.French: Enfuis-toi avec et va à La Roche. Sois prudent. Adieu.
Key.Spanish: Llévatelo y escapa con él. Ve a La Roche. Ponte a salvo. Adieu.
Key.Italian: Prendilo e usalo per fuggire. Vai a La Roche. Mettiti al sicuro. Adieu.
Key.Polish: Weź ją i uciekaj. Do La Roche. Powodzenia. Adieu.
Key.Russian: Используй ее, чтобы сбежать. Отправляйся в Ла-Рош. В безопасное место. Адью.
Key.German: Damit kannst du entkommen. Fahr bis La Roche und pass auf dich auf. Adieu.
Key.Czech: Vezmi ho a uteč. Do La Roche. Do bezpečí. Adieu.
Key.English: Take it, use it to escape. Go to La Roche. Go safe. Adieu.
Key.Portuguese: Pega e usa pra escapar. Segue pra La Roche. Vai com segurança. Adieu.
Key.Korean: 그걸 타고 탈출해라. 라 로슈로 가는 거다. 조심해라. 아듀.
Key.Chinesesimp: 找到它，用它逃走。去拉罗歇。注意安全。再见。
Key.Japanese: ソレニ乗ッテ脱出シロ。"ラ・ロシェル" マデ行ケ。気ヲ付ケロ。アデュー。
Key.Turkish: Al onu, kaçmak için kullan. La Roche’ye git. Güvenliğine dikkat et. Adieu.

Container.name: 168_eve_syndikat_end_h
Container.situation: boss ends the call to player.

Key.Original: You understand, I think - à bientôt.
Key.French: Tu comprends, je crois. À bientôt.
Key.Spanish: Supongo que lo entiendes. À bientôt.
Key.Italian: Credo che tu abbia capito. À bientôt.
Key.German: Ich denke, du hast mich verstanden. À bientôt.
Key.English: You understand, I think - à bientôt.
Key.Portuguese: Você entende, acho. À bientôt.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你应该懂的，我想 - 回头见。
Key.Japanese: 分カルヨナ。アビアント。

Container.name: 167_eve_syndikat_end_g
Container.situation: boss reveals he has been monitoring the player's progress and reveals he is holding doctor hostage.

Key.Original: Same for your doctor friend.
Key.French: Et ton ami docteur aussi.
Key.Spanish: Y lo mismo vale para tu amigo el doctor.
Key.Italian: E il tuo amico dottore...
Key.Russian: То же самое касается твоего друга-доктора.
Key.German: Dasselbe gilt für deinen Freund, den Doktor.
Key.English: Same for your doctor friend.
Key.Portuguese: O mesmo vale pra seu amigo médico.
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ医者ノ友人モ同ジダ。
Key.Turkish: Doktor arkadaşın için de aynısı geçerli.

Key.Original: He will stay with us until you make good.
Key.Chinese: 你在完成我們的要求前，他會待在我們這裡。
Key.French: On le libère quand tu nous auras aidés.
Key.Spanish: Se quedará con nosotros hasta que cumplas.
Key.Italian: Lui resterà con noi fino a quando non avrai rimediato alla situazione.
Key.Polish: Zostanie u nas, dopóki nie zrobisz, co każemy.
Key.Russian: Он пока что останется с нами.
Key.German: Er wird so lange unser Gast bleiben.
Key.Czech: Zůstane u nás, než to zařídíš.
Key.English: He will stay with us until you make good.
Key.Portuguese: Ele vai ficar com a gente até cê terminar.
Key.Korean: 임무를 완수할 때까지 의사는 우리가 잡아두겠다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他会和我们呆在一起，直到你把事办成。
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ置イテ行クマデ預カラセテモラウ。
Key.Turkish: Sen başarılı olana kadar arkadaşın bizimle kalacak.

Container.name: 166_eve_syndikat_end_f
Container.situation: boss reveals he has been monitoring the player's progress and demands the malaria counteragent.

Key.Original: And, I know you can get us the cure for Jungle Fever.
Key.Chinese: 還有，我知道你能夠為我們取得瘧疾的解藥。
Key.French: Et je sais que tu peux trouver la cure de la fièvre de la jungle.
Key.Spanish: Y sé que puedes conseguirnos la cura para las fiebres de la selva.
Key.Italian: E so che puoi darci l’antidoto per la malaria.
Key.Polish: I wiem, że możesz nam załatwić lek na gorączkę z dżungli.
Key.Russian: И я знаю, что ты можешь достать нам лекарство от тропической лихорадки.
Key.German: Und ich weiß, dass du uns das Heilmittel für das Dschungelfieber beschaffen kannst.
Key.Czech: A vím, že nám umíš najít lék na horečka z džungle.
Key.English: And, I know you can get us the cure for Jungle Fever.
Key.Portuguese: E sei que você pode conseguir pra nós a cura da Febre da Selva.
Key.Korean: 그리고, 정글 전염병의 치료약을 구할 수 있다는 것도 알고 있다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 而且，我知道你能为我们搞到疟疾的特效药。
Key.Japanese: ソシテ、オ前ナラ "ジャングル・フィーバー" ノ治療薬ヲ見ツケラレルノモ知ッテル...
Key.Turkish: Ve Orman Ateşi için bize deva bulabileceğini biliyorum.

Key.Original: Ah, yes, we know about that.
Key.French: Eh oui, on sait ça.
Key.Spanish: Ah, sí, lo sabemos.
Key.Italian: Ah, sì, lo sappiamo bene.
Key.German: Ja, wir wissen davon.
Key.English: Ah, yes, we know about that.
Key.Portuguese: Ah, sim, a gente sabe disso.
Key.Korean: 아, 그렇다. 우린 그것도 다 알고 있다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 啊，是的，这些我们都知道。
Key.Japanese: アア、ソノコトハモチロン知ッテルゾ。
Key.Turkish: Ah, evet, bunun hakkında bilgimiz var.

Key.Original: There is an abandoned van on Rue de la Corneille, in Georgetown.
Key.Chinese: 喬治鎮裡 Rue de la Corneille 上有一輛廢棄的廂型車。
Key.French: Il y a une camionnette abandonnée, rue de la Corneille, à Georgetown.
Key.Spanish: Hay una furgoneta abandonada en la Rue de la Corneille, en Georgetown.
Key.Italian: C’è un furgone abbandonato in Rue de la Corneille, a Georgetown.
Key.Polish: Na Rue de la Corneille w Georgetown stoi opuszczona furgonetka.
Key.Russian: На Ру де ла Корнейль в Джорджтауне есть заброшенный фургон.
Key.German: In Georgetown, an der Rue de la Corneille, steht ein verlassener Transporter.
Key.Czech: Na Rue de la Corneille v Georgetownu je opuštěná dodávka.
Key.English: There is an abandoned van on Rue de la Corneille, in Georgetown.
Key.Portuguese: Tem uma van abandonada na Rue de la Corneille, em Georgetown.
Key.Korean: 조지타운의 뤼 드 라 코르네유에 버려진 밴이 있다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 乔治敦高乃依街有一辆废弃的货车。
Key.Japanese: "ジョージタウン" ノ "ルー・ドゥ・ラ・コーネイ" ニ放棄サレタ "バン" ガアル。
Key.Turkish: Georgetown’da Rue de la Corneille’de terk edilmiş bir panelvan var.

Key.Original: Make the drop there, and perhaps we let you live, eh?
Key.Chinese: 把東西放在那裡，這樣我們可能會給你一條生路，知道吧？
Key.French: Livre là-bas, et peut-être qu'on te laissera vivre, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Deja allí el paquete y puede que te dejemos vivir, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Lascia l’antidoto lì e forse ti risparmieremo la vita, eh?
Key.Polish: Zostaw go tam, to może pozwolimy ci żyć, co?
Key.Russian: Положишь лекарство в фургон и, возможно, мы оставим тебя в живых.
Key.German: Liefer das Gegenmittel dort ab und vielleicht lassen wir dich am Leben.
Key.Czech: Dones nám to tam a třeba tě necháme žít, co?
Key.English: Make the drop there, and perhaps we let you live, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Faz a entrega lá e, peu-être, a gente deixa você vivo, d'accord?
Key.Chinesesimp: 把东西放在那里，也许我们会给你一条生路，嗯？
Key.Japanese: ソコニ治療薬ヲ置イテイケバ、オ前ヲ生カシテヤッテモイイ。
Key.Turkish: Teslimatı oraya yap; belki yaşamana izin veririz!

Container.name: 165_eve_syndikat_end_e
Container.situation: boss reveals he has been monitoring the player's progress and knows about activity at harcourt.

Key.Original: I know you hacked remote weapons on Tuvanaka...
Key.Chinese: 我知道你黑掉了土萬納卡上的一些遙控武器……
Key.French: Je sais que tu as hacké des armes sur Tuvanaka...
Key.Spanish: Sé que has hackeado unas armas autónomas en Tuvanaka...
Key.Italian: So che hai compromesso le armi programmate a distanza su Tuvanaka...
Key.Polish: Wiem, że hakowałeś zdalną broń na Tuvanaka…
Key.Russian: Я знаю, что ты взломал дистанционные оружейные системы на Туванаке...
Key.German: Ich weiß, dass du die Luftabwehr auf Tuvanaka gehackt hast ...
Key.Czech: Vím, že jsi hackoval dálkový zbraně na Tuvanaka.
Key.English: I know you hacked remote weapons on Tuvanaka...
Key.Portuguese: Sei que você invadiu as armas remotas em Tuvanaka...
Key.Korean: 네가 투바나카의 원격 무기를 해킹한 것도 알고 있다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我知道你黑掉了突瓦纳加的一些远程武器...
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ "トゥバナカ" デ遠隔兵器ヲ "ハッキング" シタノヲ知ッテル...
Key.Turkish: Tuvanaka’daki uzaktan kumandalı silahları hack’lediğini biliyorum...

Container.name: 164_eve_syndikat_end_d
Container.situation: boss reveals he has been monitoring the player's progress and knows about activity at harcourt.

Key.Original: I know you took out CSAT's radar...
Key.Chinese: 我知道你破壞了 CSAT 的雷達……
Key.French: Je sais que tu as détruit le radar du CSAT...
Key.Spanish: Sé que has eliminado el radar del CSAT...
Key.Italian: So che hai distrutto il radar della CSAT...
Key.Russian: Я знаю, что ты уничтожил РЛС CSAT...
Key.German: Ich weiß, dass du CSATs Radar ausgeschaltet hast ...
Key.Czech: Vím, že jsi zničil radar CSAT.
Key.English: I know you took out CSAT's radar...
Key.Portuguese: Sei que você eliminou o radar da CSAT...
Key.Korean: 네가 CSAT의 레이더를 파괴한 것도 알고 있다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我知道你干掉了 CSAT 的雷达...
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ CSAT ノ "レーダー" ヲ破壊シタノヲ知ッテル...

Container.name: 163_eve_syndikat_end_c
Container.situation: boss reveals he has been monitoring the player's progress and knows about activity at harcourt.

Key.Original: I know you been in Harcourt. I know you been there, to search...
Key.Chinese: 我知道你去過哈爾科特，我知道你去那裡找東西……
Key.French: Je sais que tu étais à Harcourt. Que tu fouillais...
Key.Spanish: Sé que has estado en Harcourt. Sé que has estado allí buscando...
Key.Italian: So che sei stato a Harcourt. So che sei stato lì a fare ricerche...
Key.Polish: Wiem, że byłeś w Harcourt. Wiem, że czegoś szukałeś…
Key.Russian: Я знаю, что ты был в Харкорте. Я знаю, что ты что-то там искал...
Key.German: Ich weiß, dass du in Harcourt warst und dort etwas gesucht hast ...
Key.Czech: Vím, že jsi byl v Harcourt. Vím, že jsi tam něco hledáš.
Key.English: I know you been in Harcourt. I know you been there, to search...
Key.Portuguese: Sei que cê foi em Harcourt. Sei que cê teve lá, pra procurar...
Key.Korean: 하코트에 있었던 것도 알고 있다. 거기서 무언가 찾고 있었다지...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我知道你曾去过哈科特。我知道你去那儿，找东西...
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ "アルクール" ニ行ッタコトヲ知ッテル。アソコニ何カヲ探シニ行ッタノヲ...
Key.Turkish: Bu zamana kadar Harcourt’ta olduğunu biliyorum. Araştırma yapmak için orada olduğunu biliyorum...

Container.name: 162_eve_syndikat_end_b
Container.situation: boss reveals he has been monitoring the player's progress and knows about the death of miller.

Key.Original: I know you assassiné their agent...
Key.Chinese: 我知道你暗殺了他們的特務……
Key.French: Je sais que tu as assassiné agent à eux...
Key.Spanish: Sé que has asssassiné a su agente...
Key.Italian: So che hai assassiné il loro agente...
Key.Polish: Wiem, że ty assassiné ich agenta…
Key.Russian: Я знаю, что ты убил их агента...
Key.German: Ich weiß, dass du ihren Agenten ermordet hast ...
Key.Czech: Vím, že jsi assassiné jejich agenta.
Key.English: I know you assassiné their agent...
Key.Portuguese: Sei que você matou o agente deles...
Key.Korean: 네가 NATO 요원을 죽인 것도 알고 있다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我知道你暗杀了他们的特务...
Key.Japanese: オ前ガヤツラノ工作員ヲ暗殺シタノヲ知ッテル...

Container.name: 161_eve_syndikat_end_a
Container.situation: boss reveals he has been monitoring the player's progress and knows about his work with ctrg.

Key.Original: I know you collaborate with NATO...
Key.Chinese: 我知道你和 NATO 合作……
Key.French: Je sais que tu collabores avec l'OTAN...
Key.Spanish: Sé que colaboras con la OTAN...
Key.Italian: So che collabori con la NATO...
Key.Russian: Я знаю, что ты сотрудничаешь с НАТО...
Key.German: Ich weiß, dass du mit der NATO zusammengearbeitet hast ...
Key.Czech: Vím, že děláš spolu s NATO.
Key.English: I know you collaborate with NATO...
Key.Portuguese: Sei que você colabora com a OTAN...
Key.Korean: NATO와 함께 일한다는 걸 알고 있다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我知道你在和 NATO 合作...
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ NATO ト協力シテイタノヲ知ッテル...

Container.name: 160_eve_syndikat_end_in_unknown
Container.situation: boss contacts player after the destruction of csat's secret weapons lab.

Key.Original: I am Samjo. I fight for L'Ensemble.
Key.French: Je suis Samjo. Je me bats pour l'Ensemble.
Key.Spanish: Soy Samjo y lucho por L'Ensemble.
Key.Italian: Il mio nome è Samjo. Combatto per L’Ensemble.
Key.Russian: Я Самджо. Я сражаюсь за Л'Енсабль.
Key.German: Ich bin Samjo. Ich kämpfe für L'Ensemble.
Key.Czech: Já jsem Samjo. Bojuju pro L'Ensemble.
Key.English: I am Samjo. I fight for L'Ensemble.
Key.Portuguese: Eu sou Samjo. Luto por L'Ensemble.
Key.Japanese: 俺ハ "サムジョ" ダ。"ランサンブル" ノタメニ戦ッテル。
Key.Turkish: Adım Samjo. L'Ensemble için mücadele ediyorum.

Key.Original: You don't know me.
Key.French: Tu me connais pas.
Key.Spanish: Tú no me conoces.
Key.Italian: Tu non mi conosci.
Key.German: Du kennst mich nicht.
Key.English: You don't know me.
Key.Portuguese: Você não me conhece.
Key.Japanese: オ前ハ俺ノコトヲ知ラナイ。

Key.Original: But I, I know you. I know you well.
Key.French: Mais je te connais. Je te connais bien.
Key.Spanish: Pero yo te conozco. Te conozco muy bien.
Key.Italian: Ma io... io ti conosco. Ti conosco molto bene.
Key.Polish: Ale ja ciebie owszem. I to dobrze.
Key.Russian: Зато я тебя знаю. Я знаю тебя очень хорошо.
Key.German: Aber ich kenne dich. Und zwar sehr gut.
Key.Czech: Ale já znám tebe. Dobře tě znám.
Key.English: But I, I know you. I know you well.
Key.Portuguese: Mas eu conheço você. E conheço bem.
Key.Korean: 하지만 난 널 아주 잘 알고 있다.
Key.Japanese: ダガ、俺ハオ前ヲ知ッテル。イロンナコトヲナ。
Key.Turkish: Fakat ben, ben seni tanıyorum... Hem de çok iyi tanıyorum.

Container.name: 159_eve_syndikat_end_in
Container.situation: boss contacts player after the destruction of csat's secret weapons lab.

Key.Original: Listen close, Képi blanc.
Key.French: Écoute bien, Képi blanc.
Key.Spanish: Escúchame bien, Képi blanc.
Key.Italian: Ascoltami bene, Képi blanc.
Key.German: Hör gut zu, Képi blanc.
Key.English: Listen close, Képi blanc.
Key.Portuguese: Escuta com atenção, Képi blanc.
Key.Japanese: ヨク聞ケ、ケピ・ブロン。

Container.name: 158_ta_syndikat_assault_alone
Container.situation: player singehandedly completes the objectives of syndikat's assault.

Key.Original: Bordel de merde !
Key.French: Bordel de merde !
Key.Spanish: ¡Hostia puta!
Key.Italian: Porca puttana!
Key.German: Heilige Scheiße!
Key.English: Holy shit!
Key.Portuguese: Puta merda!
Key.Japanese: ウワッ！

Key.Original: You a proper machine de mort, Képi!
Key.Chinese: 你簡直就是一台戰爭機器，Képi！
Key.French: Tu es une vraie machine de mort, Képi !
Key.Spanish: ¡Eres toda una machine de mort, Képi!
Key.Italian: Sei una vera e propria machine de mort, Képi!
Key.Polish: Prawdziwa z ciebie machine de mort, Képi!
Key.Russian: Да ты просто машин де мор, Кепи!
Key.German: Du bist eine echte machine de mort, Képi!
Key.Czech: Ty jsi vážně machine de mort, Képi!
Key.English: You a proper machine de mort, Képi!
Key.Portuguese: Você é mesmo uma machine de mort, Képi!
Key.Chinesesimp: 你简直就是一台死亡机器，Képi！
Key.Japanese: オ前ハマルデ "マシーン・デ・モー" ダナ、ケピ！
Key.Turkish: Tam bir machine de mort’sun, Képi!

Key.Original: And all alone, like a one man army!
Key.Chinese: 還是單槍匹馬呢，你一個人就能抵一整支軍隊！
Key.French: Tout seul, comme une armée !
Key.Spanish: ¡Y eso que ibas solo! ¡Eres un ejército de un solo hombre!
Key.Italian: E hai fatto tutto da solo, un esercito di un solo uomo!
Key.Polish: I to w pojedynkę, istna jednoosobowa armia!
Key.Russian: Сделал все в одиночку, как универсальный солдат!
Key.German: Und das ganz allein. Wie eine Ein-Mann-Armee!
Key.Czech: A úplně sám! Armáda jednoho člověka!
Key.English: And all alone, like a one man army!
Key.Portuguese: E sozinho! Praticamente exército de um homem só!
Key.Chinesesimp: 而且孤军作战，你一个人能抵上一整支军队！
Key.Japanese: タッタ独リデ、軍隊並ミノ働キヲスルナ！
Key.Turkish: Ve yalnız başına tek adamlık ordu gibisin!

Key.Original: Papa France and your Légion, they'd be well proud, eh?
Key.Chinese: 法國和你的軍團都會感到很驕傲的，對吧？
Key.French: Papa France et la Légion, ils seraient fiers, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Papa France y tu Légion estarían orgullosos, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Papa France e la tua Légion sarebbero fieri di te, eh?
Key.Polish: Papa France i twój Légion byliby dumni, co?
Key.Russian: Папа Франс и твой Легион будут тобой гордиться.
Key.German: Papa Frankreich und deine Légion wären stolz auf dich.
Key.Czech: Papa France a ta vaše Légion jsou na tebe hrdí, co?
Key.English: Papa France and your Légion, they'd be well proud, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Maman France e sua Légion se orgulhariam pra caramba, non?
Key.Korean: 프랑스와 네가 몸담았던 프랑스 외인 부대도 아주 자랑스러워할 거다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 法兰西老爸和你的军团，他们都会感到很骄傲的，嗯？
Key.Japanese: フランス本国モオ前ノ "リージョン" モ、誇リニ思ウダロウ。
Key.Turkish: Fransa Papası ve senin Légion, gurur duyuyordur, değil mi?

Key.Original: Go - get out of there, we are done.
Key.French: Vite, dégage de là, c'est fini.
Key.Spanish: Vamos, lárgate de ahí, hemos terminado.
Key.Italian: Vai, vattene via da qui, abbiamo finito.
Key.German: Los, mach dich aus dem Staub. Wir sind hier fertig.
Key.English: Go - get out of there, we are done.
Key.Portuguese: Anda, dá o fora, nós terminamos.
Key.Korean: 어서 거기서 빠져나와라. 이제 임무는 끝났다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 走 - 离开这里，我们完事了。
Key.Japanese: サア、行クゾ。任務ハ終了ダ。

Container.name: 157_eve_syndikat_assault_charge
Container.situation: boss informs player that an explosive charge has been set.

Key.Original: Charge is set. Better you get clear of it, Képi...
Key.Chinese: 炸藥安裝好了，你最好趕快離開，Képi…
Key.French: Charge amorcée. Tu devrais te tirer, Képi...
Key.Spanish: La carga está puesta. Más te vale alejarte de ella, Képi...
Key.Italian: La carica è pronta. Meglio stare lontano, Képi...
Key.Polish: Ładunek podłożony. Lepiej się nie zbliżaj, Képi...
Key.Russian: Заряд установлен. Лучше тебе отойти подальше, Кепи...
Key.German: Die Ladung ist platziert. Du solltest dich in Sicherheit bringen, Képi ...
Key.Czech: Nálož je položená. Uhni se od ní, Képi.
Key.English: Charge is set. Better you get clear of it, Képi...
Key.Portuguese: A bomba está pronta. É melhor se afastar, Képi...
Key.Korean: 폭약은 설치됐다. 거기서 빠져나오는 게 좋을 거다, 케피...
Key.Chinesesimp: 炸药装好了。你最好躲远点，Képi...
Key.Japanese: 爆弾ヲ仕掛ケタ。コノ場カラ離レルゾ、ケピ...
Key.Turkish: Patlayıcı hazır. Oradan uzaklaşsan iyi olur, Képi...

Container.name: 156_ta_syndikat_assault_success_charge
Container.situation: player successfully participates in syndikat's assault and destroys the main objective.

Key.Original: C'est magnifique.
Key.French: C'est magnifique.
Key.Spanish: Es fantástico.
Key.Italian: Fantastico.
Key.German: Das ist fantastisch.
Key.English: That’s fantastic.
Key.Portuguese: Isso é fantástico.
Key.Japanese: ヨクヤッタ。

Key.Original: CSAT know now, we are not some paysans, hiding in the jungles, eh?
Key.Chinese: 現在 CSAT 知道了吧，我們可不是躲在叢林裡的 paysan，對吧？
Key.French: Le CSAT sait qu'on n'est pas des paysans cachés dans la jungle, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Ahora el CSAT sabe que no somos unos paysans que se esconden en la selva, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ora la CSAT l’ha capito che non siamo dei paysans che si nascondono nella giungla, eh?
Key.Polish: CSAT już wie, że nie jesteśmy paysans kryjącymi się po dżungli, co?
Key.Russian: Теперь CSAT знают, что мы не из тех, кто прячется в джунглях.
Key.German: CSAT weiß jetzt, dass wir nicht bloß ein paar Paysans im Dschungel sind!
Key.Czech: CSAT teď ví, že nejsme žádný balíky, co se schovávají v džungli.
Key.English: CSAT know now, we are not some paysans, hiding in the jungles, eh?
Key.Portuguese: CSAT agora já sabe, non somos paysans escondidos nas selvas, non?
Key.Korean: 이제 CSAT 놈들도 우리가 그냥 정글에 숨어 사는 촌놈이 아니란 걸 깨달았겠지?
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在 CSAT 明白了，我们可不是缩在丛林里的乡巴佬，对吧？
Key.Japanese: CSAT ハコレデ俺達ガタダ "ジャングル" ニ隠レテルダケノ "ペイゾン" ジャナイト思イ知ッタダロウ。
Key.Turkish: CSAT artık ormanlarda saklanan birkaç köylü olmadığımızı biliyor demek?

Key.Original: Go - get out of there, we are done.
Key.French: Vite, dégage de là, c'est fini.
Key.Spanish: Vamos, lárgate de ahí, hemos terminado.
Key.Italian: Vai, vattene via da qui, abbiamo finito.
Key.German: Los, mach dich aus dem Staub. Wir sind hier fertig.
Key.English: Go - get out of there, we are done.
Key.Portuguese: Anda, dá o fora, nós terminamos.
Key.Korean: 어서 거기서 빠져나와라. 이제 임무는 끝났다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 走 - 离开这里，我们完事了。
Key.Japanese: サア、行クゾ。任務ハ終了ダ。

Container.name: 155_am_syndikat_soldier_retreat
Container.situation: soldiera orders his group to withdraw.

Key.Original: Retraite !
Key.French: Retraite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Retirada!
Key.Italian: Ritirata!
Key.German: Rückzug!
Key.English: Retreat!
Key.Portuguese: Retirar!
Key.Japanese: 撤退！

Key.Original: Ils sont trop nombreux !
Key.French: Ils sont trop nombreux !
Key.Spanish: ¡Son demasiados!
Key.Italian: Ce ne sono troppi!
Key.German: Es sind zu viele!
Key.English: There’s too many of them!
Key.Portuguese: Tem inimigos demais!
Key.Japanese: 数ガ多スギル！

Container.name: 154_eve_syndikat_assault_fail
Container.situation: boss gives the order to retreat. the assault has failed.

Key.Original: New plan, Képi. Forget the mission. No way we win this one.
Key.Chinese: 新計畫，Képi。別管任務了，我們必輸無疑。
Key.French: Nouveau plan, Képi. Oublie la mission. On ne gagnera pas.
Key.Spanish: Cambio de planes, Képi. Olvídate de la misión. Esto no hay quien lo gane.
Key.Italian: Cambio di programma, Képi. Dimentica la missione. Non possiamo farcela.
Key.Polish: Nowy plan, Képi. Zapomnij o misji. Jesteśmy bez szans.
Key.Russian: Новый план, Кепи. Забудь про задание. Нам не победить.
Key.German: Neuer Plan, Képi. Vergiss die Mission. Hier haben wir keine Chance.
Key.Czech: Novej plán, Képi. Zapomeň na misi. Tohle nevyhrajeme.
Key.English: New plan, Képi. Forget the mission. No way we win this one.
Key.Portuguese: Novo plano, Képi. Esqueça a missão. Non tem como a gente vencer dessa vez.
Key.Korean: 새 계획이다, 케피. 임무는 잊어라. 이 전투는 승산이 없다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 新计划，Képi。别管这次任务了。这任务我们肯定要失败。
Key.Japanese: 新シイ作戦ダ、ケピ。任務ハ忘レロ。今回ハ勝テナイ。
Key.Turkish: Yeni plan, Képi. Görevi unut. Bunu asla kazanamayız.

Key.Original: Better get off the island. Retreat.
Key.French: Pars de l'île. On se retire.
Key.Spanish: Más nos vale salir de la isla. Retirada.
Key.Italian: Meglio andarsene dall’isola. Ritirata.
Key.Russian: Нам лучше убраться с острова. Отступаем.
Key.German: Verlasse die Insel. Rückzug!
Key.English: Better get off the island. Retreat.
Key.Portuguese: Melhor sair da ilha. Retirada.
Key.Japanese: 島カラ脱出スルゾ。撤退ダ。
Key.Turkish: Adadan çıkmamız daha iyi. Geri çekil.

Container.name: 153_am_syndikat_soldier_attack
Container.situation: soldiera signals the attack.

Key.Original: Allez, bougez, vive les Horizon !
Key.Chinese: 走吧，開始行動，vive les Horizon！
Key.French: Allez, bougez, vive les Horizon !
Key.Spanish: ¡Vamos, adelante, vive les Horizon!
Key.Italian: Andiamo, muoversi, vive les Horizon!
Key.German: Los, Bewegung, vive les Horizon!
Key.English: Let’s go, move, vive les Horizon!
Key.Portuguese: Vamos lá, andem, vive les Horizon!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们走吧，出发，vive les Horizon！
Key.Japanese: サア、行クゾ。ヴィヴ・レゾリゾン！
Key.Turkish: Haydi gidelim; kımılda. Vive les Horizon!

Container.name: 152_eve_syndikat_assault_begins
Container.situation: boss reports that their attack has begun.

Key.Original: That's it, we go!
Key.French: C'est bon, on file !
Key.Spanish: ¡Ya está, vamos!
Key.Italian: Ci siamo, andiamo!
Key.German: Es geht los!
Key.English: That's it, we go!
Key.Portuguese: É isso aí, allons-y!
Key.Japanese: ヨシ、行クゾ！

Container.name: 151_in_syndikat_assault_prepare
Container.situation: player is told to get ready for the attack.

Key.Original: Almost time, get ready - 5 minutes. Then, we attack.
Key.Chinese: 時間快到了，準備好了。我們 5 分鐘後展開攻擊。
Key.French: Presque l'heure, prépare-toi. 5 minutes et on attaque.
Key.Spanish: Será pronto, prepárate. En 5 minutos. Entonces, atacamos.
Key.Italian: È quasi ora. Preparati, hai 5 minuti. Poi attaccheremo.
Key.Polish: Już prawie czas, przygotować się – 5 minut. I atakujemy.
Key.Russian: Мы почти на месте, 5-минутная готовность. Приготовились.
Key.German: Es ist fast soweit. Mach dich bereit – 5 Minuten, dann greifen wir an.
Key.Czech: Už to bude, připrav se. 5 minut. Pak útočíme.
Key.English: Almost time, get ready - 5 minutes. Then, we attack.
Key.Portuguese: Quase na hora, prepare-se, 5 minutos. E então, atacamos.
Key.Korean: 시간이 거의 다 됐어. 준비해. 5분 뒤에 공격을 시작할 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 时候快到了，做好准备 - 5 分钟。然后，展开攻击。
Key.Japanese: ソロソロ時間ダ。準備シロ。5 分経ッタラ攻撃ダ。
Key.Turkish: Neredeyse vakit geldi, hazırlan... 5 dakika. Sonra saldırırız.

Container.name: 150_eve_at_syndikat_en_route
Container.situation: player is given mission details by soldiera.

Key.Original: Okay, vous connaissez tous le plan, sauf lui ?
Key.Chinese: 好了，除了他以外，大家都知道計畫？
Key.French: Okay, vous connaissez tous le plan, sauf lui ?
Key.Spanish: Vale, ¿todo el mundo conoce el plan salvo él?
Key.Italian: Okay, conoscete tutti il piano, tranne lui?
Key.Polish: Dobra, wszyscy poza nim znają plan?
Key.Russian: Так, значит все знают план, кроме него?
Key.German: Okay, alle außer ihm kennen also den Plan?
Key.Czech: Dobře, všichni kromě něj znáte plán?
Key.English: Okay, everyone know the plan, except him?
Key.Portuguese: Ok, todo mundo sabe o plano, menos ele?
Key.Korean: 좋아. 이 녀석 빼고 다들 계획은 알고 있지?
Key.Chinesesimp: 好的，除了他，各位都知道这项计划了吧？
Key.Japanese: ソレデ、作戦ヲ知ラナイノハ彼ダケカ？
Key.Turkish: Tamam, onun dışında herkes planı biliyor mu?

Key.Original: Parfait !
Key.French: Parfait !
Key.Spanish: ¡Perfecto!
Key.Italian: Perfetto!
Key.German: Na toll!
Key.English: Perfect!
Key.Portuguese: Maravilha!
Key.Japanese: ヨシ！

Key.Original: Hé, papi ! Tu connais la mission ?
Key.Chinese: 嘿，夥計！你知道任務是什麼嗎？
Key.French: Hé, patron ! Tu connais la mission ?
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye, patron! ¿Sabes cuál es la misión?
Key.Italian: Ehi, patron! Sai come si svolgerà la missione?
Key.Russian: Эй, патрон! Тебя ввести в курс дела?
Key.German: Hey, patron! Kennst du die Mission?
Key.English: Hey, patron! Y'know the mission?
Key.Portuguese: Ei, patron! Sabe qual a missão?
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，伙计！你知道这次任务是什么吗？
Key.Japanese: オイ、パトロン！任務ノコトハ知ッテルカ？

Key.Original: Our team, it hits the beach, and we move up.
Key.Chinese: 我們的隊伍到達海灘，然後，我們往上走。
Key.French: Avec l'équipe, on arrive sur la plage et on avance.
Key.Spanish: Nuestro equipo llega a la playa y seguimos adelante.
Key.Italian: La nostra squadra attaccherà la spiaggia e noi proseguiremo.
Key.Polish: Nasz zespół dociera do plaży i idziemy.
Key.Russian: Наш отряд атакует с пляжа и продвигается вверх.
Key.German: Unser Team landet am Strand und rückt weiter vor.
Key.Czech: Náš tým… Vylezeme na pláž a půjdeme dál.
Key.English: Our team, it hits the beach, and we move up.
Key.Portuguese: Nossa equipe chega na praia e avançamos.
Key.Korean: 우리 팀은 해변으로 가서 위로 이동할 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们的队伍，到海滩了，我们前进吧。
Key.Japanese: 俺達ノ "チーム" ガ "ビーチ" ニ上ガッテ、ソノママ進軍スル。
Key.Turkish: Bizim takım sahili vuruyor ve biz de ilerliyoruz.

Key.Original: A second team are there, waiting in position.
Key.Chinese: 那裡有第二支隊伍在那待命。
Key.French: La deuxième équipe est déjà en position.
Key.Spanish: Un segundo equipo ya está allí, esperando en posición.
Key.Italian: Una seconda squadra si trova lì, in attesa.
Key.Polish: Na miejscu drugi zespół, czeka na pozycji.
Key.Russian: Второй отряд уже занял свою позицию и ждет.
Key.German: Dort wartet ein zweites Team auf uns.
Key.Czech: Už je tam druhej tým, čeká na místě.
Key.English: A second team are there, waiting in position.
Key.Portuguese: Uma segunda equipe tá lá, aguardando em posição.
Key.Korean: 두 번째 팀은 이미 해당 위치에서 대기 중이지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那儿有第二支队伍，在那等着呢。
Key.Japanese: 2 番目ノ "チーム" ハソコデ配置ニ就キ、待機スル。
Key.Turkish: İkinci bir takım orada, konumunda bekliyor.

Key.Original: Our objective - two silo. Boss-man. He want 'em gone.
Key.Chinese: 我們的目標是兩個穀倉。老大想要摧毀它們。
Key.French: Notre objectif : deux silos. Le Boss, il dit qu'on les détruit.
Key.Spanish: Nuestro objetivo son dos silos. El jefe quiere que los volemos.
Key.Italian: Il nostro obiettivo sono due silo. Il capo li vuole distrutti.
Key.Polish: Nasz cel: dwa zbiorniki. Szef chce je zniszczyć.
Key.Russian: Наша цель – два бункера. Босс хочет, чтобы мы их уничтожили.
Key.German: Unser Ziel sind zwei Silos. Der Boss will sie loswerden.
Key.Czech: Náš cíl – dvě sila. Šéf se jich chce zbavit.
Key.English: Our objective - two silo. Boss-man. He want 'em gone.
Key.Portuguese: Nosso objetivo: dois silos. A chefia quer que sumam do mapa.
Key.Korean: 우리의 목표는 두 개의 곡물 저장고야. 보스가 둘 다 파괴하라고 했거든.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们的目标 - 两个发射井。老大想摧毁它们。
Key.Japanese: 目標は 2 ツノ "サイロ" ダ。"ボス" ハソノ破壊ヲ望ンデル。
Key.Turkish: Hedefimiz, iki silo. Patron... Onların gitmesini istiyor.

Key.Original: Everybody here got some C-4.
Key.French: On a tous du C-4.
Key.Spanish: Todo el mundo tiene algo de C-4.
Key.Italian: Tutti qui hanno della C-4.
Key.Russian: У каждого из нас есть C-4.
Key.German: Jeder hier hat C-4 dabei.
Key.English: Everybody here got some C-4.
Key.Portuguese: Todo mundo aqui tem C-4.
Key.Korean: 여기 모두가 C-4 폭약을 갖고 있어.
Key.Japanese: ココニイルヤツラハ全員 C-4 ヲ持ッテル。

Key.Original: First one in, they prep the charge.
Key.Chinese: 第一批進去的人準備炸藥。
Key.French: Le premier arrivé, il amorce sa charge.
Key.Spanish: El primero que llegue prepara la carga.
Key.Italian: Il primo che arriva prepara la carica.
Key.Polish: Jak będą na miejscu, przygotują ładunki.
Key.Russian: Кто, первый доберется, тот и установит заряд.
Key.German: Wer als Erster rankommt, platziert seine Ladung.
Key.English: First one in, they prep the charge.
Key.Portuguese: Primeiro, eles preparam a carga.
Key.Chinesesimp: 第一批进去的人准备炸药。
Key.Japanese: 最初ニ入ルヤツガ爆弾ヲ仕掛ケル。

Key.Original: On the boom-boom, évaporez. Disappear - make your own way back.
Key.Chinese: 轟炸後，蒸發，消失－－然後你自己回來。
Key.French: Au boum boum, évaporez. Disparaissez. Tu rentres tout seul.
Key.Spanish: Con el bum, on s'évapore. Desaparece y vuelve por tu cuenta.
Key.Italian: All’esplosione, évaporez. Vattene, trova un modo per tornare indietro.
Key.Polish: Po bum-bum, évaporez. Zniknij – wracasz sam.
Key.Russian: Как только услышишь взрыв – эвапорэ. Испарись. А затем возвращайся назад.
Key.German: Wenn es knallt, évaporez. Verschwinde und mach dich auf den Rückweg.
Key.Czech: Jakmile bum bum, évaporez. Zmizíš. Zpátky se vracíš sám.
Key.English: On the boom-boom, évaporez. Disappear - make your own way back.
Key.Portuguese: Com a explosão, évaporez. Suma, dá um jeito de voltar.
Key.Korean: 폭발하는 즉시 빠져나오는 거다. 각자 알아서 돌아오는 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 轰隆一声后，蒸发。消失 - 然后你自己回来。
Key.Japanese: ドッカントイッタラ、イヴァポレ。姿ヲクラマス。脱出ダ。
Key.Turkish: Bum bum sesiyle, évaporez. Kaybol; dönüş yolunu kendin bul.

Key.Original: You got questions - non? Excellent.
Key.French: Des questions ? Non ? Excellent.
Key.Spanish: ¿Alguna pregunta? ¿Non? Excelente.
Key.Italian: Hai domande? No...? Eccellente.
Key.German: Noch Fragen? Non? Hervorragend.
Key.English: You got questions - non? Excellent.
Key.Portuguese: Perguntas? Non? Excelente.
Key.Japanese: 質問ハアルカ？ナイ？ヨシ。

Container.name: 149_eve_at_syndikat_boat
Container.situation: player arrives at the boat for the attack on the depot.

Key.Original: You Samjo's man?
Key.French: T'es le gars de Samjo ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Eres el hombre de Samjo?
Key.Italian: Sei l’uomo mandato da Samjo?
Key.German: Samjo hat dich geschickt?
Key.English: You Samjo's man?
Key.Portuguese: Você é o cara do Samjo?
Key.Japanese: オ前ガ "サムジョ" ノ言ッテタヤツカ？

Key.Original: Putain, you old, mec!
Key.French: Putain, t'es vieux, mec !
Key.Spanish: ¡Putain, sí que eres viejo, mec!
Key.Italian: Putain, sei vecchio, mec!
Key.Polish: Putain, stary z ciebie cap, mec!
Key.German: Putain, du bist ja alt, mec!
Key.English: Putain, you old, mec!
Key.Portuguese: Putain, velhote, mec!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！年寄リジャナイカ！

Key.Original: D'accord. Get in the boat, we gotta cross the water.
Key.Chinese: D'accord，快上船，我們得到對岸去。
Key.French: D'accord. Monte à bord, on traverse.
Key.Spanish: D'accord. Sube a la barca; hay que cruzar.
Key.Italian: D’accord. Sali sulla barca, dobbiamo partire.
Key.Polish: D'accord. Właź do łódki, musimy przepłynąć.
Key.Russian: Д'аккор. Садись в лодку, нам нужно пересечь пролив.
Key.German: D‘accord. Steig ins Boot, wir müssen das Wasser überqueren.
Key.Czech: D'accord. Nalez si do člunu, musíme přes vodu.
Key.English: D'accord. Get in the boat, we gotta cross the water.
Key.Portuguese: D'accord. Entre no barco, temos que atravessar a água.
Key.Korean: 다코르. 배에 타. 물을 건너야 하니까.
Key.Chinesesimp: D'accord，快上船，我们得到对岸去。
Key.Japanese: ダコー。"ボート" ニ乗レ。海ヲ渡ルゾ。
Key.Turkish: D'accord. Tekneye bin, suyun karşı tarafına geçmemiz lazım.

Container.name: 148_ta_syndikat_assault_moved
Container.situation: player arrives for syndikat's operation.

Key.Original: There is change of plan, my men are in Koumac.
Key.Chinese: 計畫有變，我的人在庫馬克。
Key.French: Changement de plan. Mes hommes sont à Koumac.
Key.Spanish: Ha habido un cambio de planes: mis hombres están en Koumac.
Key.Italian: Cambio di programma, i miei uomini sono a Koumac.
Key.Polish: Zmiana planu, moi ludzie są w Koumac.
Key.Russian: У нас поменялись планы. Мои люди в Коумаке.
Key.German: Der Plan hat sich geändert: Meine Leute sind in Koumac.
Key.Czech: Máme změnu plánu. Moji muži jsou v Koumacu.
Key.English: There is change of plan, my men are in Koumac.
Key.Portuguese: O plano mudou, mes gars tão em Koumac.
Key.Korean: 계획이 변경됐다. 내 동지들은 쿠막에 있다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 计划有变，我的人在库马克。
Key.Japanese: 作戦変更ダ。俺ノ部下ハ "コウマック" ニイル。

Key.Original: Small problem with boat.
Key.French: Problème avec le bateau.
Key.Spanish: Ha habido un problemilla con el barco.
Key.Italian: Abbiamo avuto un piccolo problema con l’imbarcazione.
Key.German: Es gab ein Problem mit dem Boot.
Key.English: Small problem with boat.
Key.Portuguese: Probleminha no barco.
Key.Japanese: "ボート" デチョットシタ問題ダ。
Key.Turkish: Tekneyle ilgili ufak bir sorun çıktı.

Key.Original: But no worry, we have a dinghy now.
Key.Chinese: 不過別擔心，我們現在有艘小船。
Key.French: Mais ça va, on a un canot.
Key.Spanish: Pero no pasa nada, tenemos una lancha.
Key.Italian: Ma niente paura, adesso abbiamo un gommone.
Key.Russian: Но не волнуйся, мы нашли небольшую шлюпку.
Key.German: Aber keine Sorge, wir haben ein Schlauchboot besorgt.
Key.Czech: Ale žádný strachy, teď máme člun.
Key.English: But no worry, we have a dinghy now.
Key.Portuguese: Mas non se preocupe, agora temos bote.
Key.Korean: 하지만 걱정 마라. 우리에겐 소형 보트가 있으니까.
Key.Chinesesimp: 但别担心，我们现在有只小划艇。
Key.Japanese: ダガ、心配無用ダ。"ゴムボート" ガアル。
Key.Turkish: Fakat endişelenme, artık bir hücum botumuz var.

Key.Original: I will give you their new location.
Key.Chinese: 我會告訴你他們的新位置。
Key.French: Je te donne l'endroit.
Key.Spanish: Te paso la nueva ubicación.
Key.Italian: Ti dirò dove si trovano adesso.
Key.German: Ich schicke dir die neue Position.
Key.English: I will give you their new location.
Key.Portuguese: Vou te dar nova localização deles.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我会告诉你他们的新位置。
Key.Japanese: アイツラノ新シイ場所ヲ教エル。

Container.name: 147_ta_syndikat_assault_ready
Container.situation: player arrives for syndikat's operation.

Key.Original: Go to the beach, my men are to wait for you there.
Key.Chinese: 到海邊去，我的手下在那裡等你。
Key.French: Va sur la plage, mes hommes t'attendent.
Key.Spanish: Ve a la playa, mis hombres te estarán esperando.
Key.Italian: Vai alla spiaggia, i miei uomini ti aspettano lì.
Key.Polish: Idź na plażę, moi ludzie czekają.
Key.Russian: Отправляйся на пляж. Мои люди ждут тебя там.
Key.German: Geh an den Strand – meine Leute warten dort auf dich.
Key.Czech: Jdi na pláž, moji muži čekají tam na tebe.
Key.English: Go to the beach, my men are to wait for you there.
Key.Portuguese: Vá pra praia, mes gars vão te esperar por lá.
Key.Korean: 해변으로 가면 내 동지들이 널 기다리고 있을 거다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 到海边去，我的手下在那儿等你。
Key.Japanese: "ビーチ" ニ行ケ。俺ノ部下ガソコデオ前ヲ待ッテル。
Key.Turkish: Sahile git, adamlarım orada seni bekliyor.

Container.name: 146_ta_syndikat_assault
Container.situation: player arrives for syndikat's operation.

Key.Original: Bonsoir.
Key.French: Bonsoir.
Key.Spanish: Buenas tardes.
Key.Italian: Buonasera.
Key.German: Guten Abend.
Key.English: Good evening.
Key.Portuguese: Boa noite.
Key.Japanese: コンバンハ。

Key.Original: You are in Cerebu, I hear.
Key.French: Tu es à Cerebu, on m'a dit.
Key.Spanish: Dicen que estás en Cerebu.
Key.Italian: Ho saputo che sei a Cerebu.
Key.German: Ich hab gehört, dass du in Cerebu bist.
Key.Czech: Slyšel jsem, že jsi v Cerebu.
Key.English: You are in Cerebu, I hear.
Key.Portuguese: Soube que você tá em Cerebu.
Key.Japanese: オ前ハ "セレブ" ニイルラシイナ。

Container.name: 145_ta_syndikat_opertaion_success
Container.situation: boss notifies player that their operation was successful, due to them having the needed equipment.

Key.Original: Képi. The night is ours!
Key.Chinese: Képi，夜晚成了我們的主場啦！
Key.French: Képi. La nuit est à nous !
Key.Spanish: ¡Esta noche hemos ganado, Képi!
Key.Italian: Képi. La notte è nostra!
Key.German: Képi, die Nacht gehört uns!
Key.English: Képi. The night is ours!
Key.Portuguese: Képi. A noite é nossa!
Key.Japanese: ケピ。成功ダ！

Key.Original: CSAT just got hit, hard!
Key.French: On a fait mal au CSAT, très mal !
Key.Spanish: ¡El CSAT ha recibido un golpe muy duro!
Key.Italian: La CSAT ha subito una bella batosta!
Key.German: Wir haben CSAT einen schweren Schlag versetzt!
Key.English: CSAT just got hit, hard!
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT acabou de ser atingida, e com força!
Key.Japanese: CSAT ニ大打撃ヲ与エテヤッタ！

Key.Original: They know now, we are not some paysans to hide in the jungles, eh?
Key.Chinese: 現在他們知道了吧，我們可不是躲在叢林裡的 paysan，對吧？
Key.French: Maintenant, ils savent qu'on est pas des paysans cachés dans la jungle, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Ahora saben que no somos unos paysans que se esconden en la selva, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ora hanno capito che non siamo dei paysans che si nascondono nella giungla, eh?
Key.Polish: Już wiedzą, że nie jesteśmy paysans kryjącymi się po dżungli, co?
Key.Russian: Теперь они знают, что мы не из тех, кто прячется в джунглях.
Key.German: Sie wissen jetzt, dass wir nicht bloß ein paar Paysans im Dschungel sind!
Key.Czech: Teď ví, že nejsme žádný balíky, co se schovávají v džungli.
Key.English: They know now, we are not some paysans to hide in the jungles, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Agora eles tão vendo que non somos paysans escondidos nas selvas, non?
Key.Korean: 이제 놈들도 우리가 그냥 정글에 숨어 사는 촌놈이 아니란 걸 깨달았겠지?
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在他们知道了吧，我们可不是躲在丛林里的业余选手，对吧？
Key.Japanese: コレデ俺達ガタダ "ジャングル" ニ隠レテルダケノ "ペイゾン" ジャナイト思イ知ラセテヤレタ。
Key.Turkish: Artık ormanlarda saklanan birkaç köylü olmadığımızı biliyorlar demek?

Container.name: 144_ta_syndikat_operation_fail
Container.situation: boss notifies player that their operation failed, due to them not having the needed equipment.

Key.Original: Képi. The fight is over.
Key.French: Képi. Le combat est fini.
Key.Spanish: El combate ha terminado, Képi.
Key.Italian: Képi. Il combattimento è terminato.
Key.German: Képi, die Schlacht ist vorüber.
Key.English: Képi. The fight is over.
Key.Portuguese: Képi. A luta acabou.
Key.Japanese: ケピ。戦イハ終ワリダ。

Key.Original: No NVG, it cost us. Big. Better you don't disappoint me again...
Key.Chinese: 沒有夜視鏡，我們得付出很大的代價。你最好別再讓我失望了……
Key.French: Sans LVN, on a perdu. Ne me déçois plus...
Key.Spanish: No tener gafas de visión nocturna nos ha salido caro. Muy caro. Más te vale no volver a decepcionarme...
Key.Italian: Non avere visori notturni ci è costato caro. Meglio che tu non mi deluda ancora...
Key.Polish: Zapłaciliśmy za brak noktowizorów. Lepiej nas znów nie zawiedź…
Key.Russian: Без ПНВ нам пришлось заплатить большую цену. Лучше не разочаровывай меня снова...
Key.German: Ohne Nachtsichtgeräte haben wir schwere Verluste erlitten. Enttäusche mich nie wieder ...
Key.Czech: Žádný noční vidění, máme ztráty. Velký. Znova už mě nezklamej.
Key.English: No NVG, it cost us. Big. Better you don't disappoint me again...
Key.Portuguese: Rien de OVN, custou caro demais pra nós. É bom cê non me decepcionar de novo...
Key.Korean: 야간투시경이 없어서 많이 불리했다. 다시는 날 실망시키지 마라...
Key.Chinesesimp: 没有夜视镜，我们得付出代价。很大的代价。你最好别再让我失望了…
Key.Japanese: 暗視 "ゴーグル" ガナイブン苦戦シタ。モウ二度ト失望サセルナ...
Key.Turkish: GGG yok, bu bize çok pahalıya mal olur. Beni yeniden hayal kırıklığına uğratmazsan sevinirim...

Container.name: 143_ta_syndikat_nvgs_done_out
Container.situation: boss reminds player they constantly need weapons.

Key.Original: If you find guns, bring them to us. Equipment too.
Key.Chinese: 如果你找到槍或裝備，把它們通通交給我們。
Key.French: Si tu trouves des armes, apporte-les. L'équipement aussi.
Key.Spanish: Si encuentras armas, tráenoslas. También nos vale equipamiento.
Key.Italian: Se trovi delle armi, portacele. Ed equipaggiamento.
Key.Polish: Jak znajdziesz broń, przynieś nam ją. Sprzęt też.
Key.Russian: Если найдешь оружие, неси его нам. Снаряжение тоже не помешает.
Key.German: Wenn du Waffen oder Ausrüstung findest, bring sie zu uns.
Key.Czech: Když najdeš zbraně, dones nám je. Taky vybavení.
Key.English: If you find guns, bring them to us. Equipment too.
Key.Portuguese: Se encontrar armas, traz pra gente. Equipamentos também.
Key.Korean: 총을 찾으면 우리에게 가져와라. 장비도 마찬가지다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你找到枪支，就给我们送过来。装备也一样。
Key.Japanese: 銃ヲ見ツケタラ、俺達ノトコロニ持ッテコイ。装備モナ。
Key.Turkish: Silah bulursan bize getir. Ekipman da getir tabii.

Key.Original: And remember; you want in, we leave Cerebu after sundown. 8:00 p.m.
Key.Chinese: 記得了，你想要加入我們的話，在太陽下山後，我們會去西盧布，晚上 8:00。
Key.French: Oublie pas : si tu veux venir, on part de Cerebu à la nuit tombée. 20h.
Key.Spanish: Y recuerda: si te apuntas, salimos de Cerebu cuando se haga de noche, a las 8 de la tarde.
Key.Italian: E ricorda: se vuoi unirti a noi, lasceremo Cerebu dopo il tramonto. Alle otto.
Key.Polish: I pamiętaj; jak chcesz pomóc, ruszamy z Cerebu po zachodzie słońca. Dwudziesta.
Key.Russian: И помни: если хочешь с нами, то мы выходим из Серебу после захода солнца. В 8 вечера.
Key.German: Vergiss nicht: Wenn du dabei sein willst, komm um 20:00 Uhr nach Cerebu.
Key.Czech: A pamatuj. Jestli chceš přidat, odcházíme z Cerebu po západu. V osm večer.
Key.English: And remember; you want in, we leave Cerebu after sundown. 8:00 p.m.
Key.Portuguese: E lembra: se quer participar, a gente sai de Cerebu depois do pôr do sol. 20:00.
Key.Korean: 그리고 기억해라. 싸움에 참여하고 싶으면, 우린 해가 지고 밤 8시에 세레부를 떠날 거다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 记住：你想加入，我们日落后离开塞热布。晚上 8:00。
Key.Japanese: ソレカラ、忘レルナ。加ワリタイナラ、日没後ニ "セレブ" ヲ出ル。午後 8 時ダ。
Key.Turkish: Ve unutma; katılmak istiyorsan, güneş battıktan sonra 20.00’da Cerebu’dan ayrılıyoruz.

Container.name: 142_ta_syndikat_nvgs_out
Container.situation: boss reminds player they constantly need weapons.

Key.Original: If you find guns, bring them to us. Equipment too.
Key.Chinese: 如果你找到槍或裝備，把它們通通交給我們。
Key.French: Si tu trouves des armes, apporte-les. L'équipement aussi.
Key.Spanish: Si encuentras armas, tráenoslas. También nos vale equipamiento.
Key.Italian: Se trovi delle armi, portacele. Ed equipaggiamento.
Key.Polish: Jak znajdziesz broń, przynieś nam ją. Sprzęt też.
Key.Russian: Если найдешь оружие, неси его нам. Снаряжение тоже не помешает.
Key.German: Wenn du Waffen oder Ausrüstung findest, bring sie zu uns.
Key.Czech: Když najdeš zbraně, dones nám je. Taky vybavení.
Key.English: If you find guns, bring them to us. Equipment too.
Key.Portuguese: Se encontrar armas, traz pra gente. Equipamentos também.
Key.Korean: 총을 찾으면 우리에게 가져와라. 장비도 마찬가지다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你找到枪支，就给我们送过来。装备也一样。
Key.Japanese: 銃ヲ見ツケタラ、俺達ノトコロニ持ッテコイ。装備モナ。
Key.Turkish: Silah bulursan bize getir. Ekipman da getir tabii.

Key.Original: La lutte continue.
Key.French: La lutte continue.
Key.Spanish: La lutte continue.
Key.Italian: La lutte continue.
Key.German: La lutte continue.
Key.English: La lutte continue.
Key.Portuguese: La lutte continua.
Key.Japanese: ラ・ルート・コンティニュー。

Container.name: 141_ta_syndikat_nvgs_timeout
Container.situation: player fails to bring syndikat the needed equipment in time.

Key.Original: Samjo here.
Key.French: Samjo.
Key.Spanish: Aquí Samjo.
Key.Italian: Qui è Samjo.
Key.German: Samjo hier.
Key.English: Samjo here.
Key.Portuguese: Samjo tá aqui.
Key.Japanese: "サムジョ" ダ。

Key.Original: Time to strike is now, Képi.
Key.French: C'est l'heure de frapper, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Ha llegado la hora de actuar, Képi.
Key.Italian: È arrivato il momento di attaccare, Képi.
Key.German: Es ist an der Zeit zuzuschlagen, Képi.
Key.English: Time to strike is now, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Agora é hora de atacar, Képi.
Key.Japanese: 攻撃スルナラ今ダ、ケピ。

Key.Original: And yet, you fail.
Key.French: Mais tu as échoué.
Key.Spanish: Y has fracasado.
Key.Italian: E tu hai fallito.
Key.German: Und du hast versagt.
Key.English: And yet, you fail.
Key.Portuguese: E ainda assim você falha.
Key.Japanese: ナノニ、オ前ハシクジッタ。

Key.Original: L'Ensemble cannot wait no longer...
Key.French: L'Ensemble ne peut plus attendre...
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble no puede seguir esperando...
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble non può attendere ancora...
Key.German: L'Ensemble kann nicht länger warten ...
Key.English: L'Ensemble cannot wait no longer...
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble não pode esperar mais...
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ハコレ以上待テナイ...

Container.name: 140_ta_syndikat_nvgs_done
Container.situation: player brings some needed equipment to a syndikat weapon cache.

Key.Original: It is Samjo.
Key.French: Ici Samjo.
Key.Spanish: Soy Samjo.
Key.Italian: Qui è Samjo.
Key.German: Hier ist Samjo.
Key.English: It is Samjo.
Key.Portuguese: É o Samjo.
Key.Japanese: "サムジョ" ダ。

Key.Original: Bon travail.
Key.French: Bon travail.
Key.Spanish: Bon travail.
Key.Italian: Bon travail.
Key.German: Bon travail.
Key.English: Bon travail.
Key.Portuguese: Bon travail.
Key.Japanese: ボン・トラヴァイ。

Key.Original: I have word.
Key.French: On m'a dit.
Key.Spanish: Me lo han contado.
Key.Italian: Mi hanno appena riferito.
Key.German: Ich habe Informationen.
Key.English: I have word.
Key.Portuguese: Tenho informação.
Key.Japanese: 情報ガアル。

Key.Original: L'Ensemble not fight blind.
Key.Chinese: L'Ensemble 不用再盲目戰鬥了。
Key.French: L'Ensemble n'est plus aveugle.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble no luchará a ciegas.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble non combatterà alla cieca.
Key.German: L'Ensemble wird nicht blind kämpfen.
Key.English: L'Ensemble not fight blind.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble não luta nas escuras.
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ハ目隠シ状態デハ戦ワナイ。
Key.Turkish: L'Ensemble, yani Syndikat plansız mücadele etmiyor.

Key.Original: The odds are in our favor now, eh?
Key.Chinese: 現在我們占上風啦，對吧？
Key.French: Maintenant, on a une chance, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Ahora tenemos ventaja, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: La situazione volge a nostro favore adesso, eh?
Key.Russian: Теперь шансы в нашу пользу, верно?
Key.German: Die Chancen stehen jetzt gut für uns, was?
Key.Czech: Teď je šance na naší straně, co?
Key.English: The odds are in our favor now, eh?
Key.Portuguese: As chances tão do nosso lado agora, si?
Key.Japanese: コチラニ勝機ガ見エテキタナ。

Container.name: 139_ta_syndikat_nvgs_meeting_out
Container.situation: player is tasked with assiting a syndikat operation.

Key.Original: Be in Cerebu, after sundown - eight o'clock.
Key.Chinese: 太陽下山後，到西盧布－－八點鐘。
Key.French: Va à Cerebu à la nuit tombée, à 20h.
Key.Spanish: Ve a Cerebu cuando se haga de noche... a las ocho en punto.
Key.Italian: Fatti trovare a Cerebu dopo il tramonto. Alle otto.
Key.Polish: Bądź w Cerebu po zachodzie słońca – dwudziesta.
Key.Russian: Будь в Серебу, после заката, в восемь часов.
Key.German: Sei nach Sonnenuntergang in Cerebu – acht Uhr.
Key.Czech: Po západu slunce buď v Cerebu. V osm večer.
Key.English: Be in Cerebu, after sundown - eight o'clock.
Key.Portuguese: Esteja em Cerebu, depois do pôr do sol, oito em ponto.
Key.Chinesesimp: 太阳下山后，到塞热布 - 八点钟。
Key.Japanese: "セレブ" ニ行ケ。日没後、8 時ダ。
Key.Turkish: Güneş battıktan sonra saat 8’de Cerebu’da ol.

Key.Original: À plus tard.
Key.French: À plus tard.
Key.Spanish: Nos vemos.
Key.Italian: Ci vediamo.
Key.German: Bis später.
Key.English: See you later.
Key.Portuguese: Te vejo mais tarde.
Key.Japanese: 後デナ。

Container.name: 138_ta_syndikat_nvgs_tomorrow
Container.situation: player is tasked with assiting a syndikat operation.

Key.Original: If you want to join our attack, our men leave tomorrow.
Key.Chinese: 你若想加入我們的突襲，我們的人馬明天出發。
Key.French: Si tu veux attaquer, nos hommes partent demain.
Key.Spanish: Si quieres unirte a nuestro ataque, nuestros hombres saldrán mañana.
Key.Italian: Se vuoi unirti al nostro attacco, i nostri uomini partiranno domani.
Key.Polish: Jeśli chcesz wziąć udział w ataku, nasi ludzie ruszają jutro.
Key.Russian: Если хочешь присоединиться к нашей атаке, то наши парни выдвигаются завтра.
Key.German: Wenn du uns beim Angriff helfen willst – unsere Leute machen sich morgen auf den Weg.
Key.Czech: Jestli se chceš připojit náš útok, naši muži jdou zítra.
Key.English: If you want to join our attack, our men leave tomorrow.
Key.Portuguese: Se quer se juntar ao nosso ataque, nossos homens partem amanhã.
Key.Korean: 우리 공격에 참여하고 싶으면, 우리 동지들이 내일 떠나니까 같이 가라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你想加入我们的进攻行动，我们的人明天离开。
Key.Japanese: 俺達ノ攻撃ニ加ワリタイナラ、兵士ハ明日出発スル。
Key.Turkish: Saldırımıza katılmak istiyorsan adamlarımız yarın ayrılıyor.

Container.name: 137_ta_syndikat_nvgs_later
Container.situation: player is tasked with assiting a syndikat operation.

Key.Original: If you want to join our attack, our men leave soon.
Key.Chinese: 你若想加入我們的突襲，我們的人馬等下就出發。
Key.French: Si tu veux attaquer, nos hommes partent bientôt.
Key.Spanish: Si quieres unirte a nuestro ataque, nuestros hombres saldrán pronto.
Key.Italian: Se vuoi unirti al nostro attacco, i nostri uomini partiranno presto.
Key.Polish: Jeśli chcesz wziąć udział w ataku, nasi ludzie niedługo ruszają.
Key.Russian: Если хочешь присоединиться к нашей атаке, то наши парни скоро выдвигаются.
Key.German: Wenn du uns beim Angriff helfen willst – unsere Leute machen sich bald auf den Weg.
Key.Czech: Jestli se chceš připojit náš útok, naši muži jdou za chvíli.
Key.English: If you want to join our attack, our men leave soon.
Key.Portuguese: Se quer se juntar ao nosso ataque, nossos homens vão partir em breve.
Key.Korean: 우리 공격에 참여하고 싶으면, 우리 동지들이 곧 떠나니까 같이 가라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你想加入我们的进攻行动，我们的人很快就离开。
Key.Japanese: 俺達ノ攻撃ニ加ワリタイナラ、兵士ガモウスグ出発スルゾ。
Key.Turkish: Saldırımıza katılmak istiyorsan adamlarımız yakında ayrılıyor.

Container.name: 136_ta_syndikat_nvgs
Container.situation: player is tasked with assiting a syndikat operation.

Key.Original: Ah, good, you answer.
Key.French: Ah, tu réponds.
Key.Spanish: Ah, bien, respondes.
Key.Italian: Ah, bene, hai risposto.
Key.German: Gut, dass du rangehst.
Key.English: Ah, good, you answer.
Key.Portuguese: Ah, bom, cê que diz.
Key.Japanese: アア、ヨシ。応答シタナ。

Key.Original: I have a proposition.
Key.French: J'ai une proposition.
Key.Spanish: Tengo una propuesta.
Key.Italian: Ho una proposta.
Key.German: Ich habe einen Vorschlag.
Key.English: I have a proposition.
Key.Portuguese: Tenho uma proposta.
Key.Japanese: 提案ガアル。

Key.Original: L'Ensemble want to see in the dark.
Key.French: L'Ensemble veut voir dans le noir.
Key.Spanish: L'Ensemble quiere ver en la oscuridad.
Key.Italian: L’Ensemble vuole vederci al buio.
Key.Russian: Люди Л'Енсабля хотят видеть в темноте.
Key.German: L'Ensemble möchte im Dunkeln sehen.
Key.English: L'Ensemble want to see in the dark.
Key.Portuguese: L'Ensemble quer olhos no escuro.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大帮会想在黑暗中看清楚点。
Key.Japanese: "ランサンブル" ハ暗イトコロデモ目ヲ効カセタイ。

Key.Original: There big fight to come.
Key.French: Bientôt, un grand combat.
Key.Spanish: Va a haber un gran combate.
Key.Italian: C’è un grosso combattimento in arrivo.
Key.German: Ein großer Kampf steht bevor.
Key.English: There big fight to come.
Key.Portuguese: Tem grande luta a caminho.
Key.Japanese: デカイ争イガ起コル。

Key.Original: Get us night vision and I make sure you well rewarded.
Key.Chinese: 你若給我們找些夜視鏡來，我會給你豐厚的獎勵。
Key.French: Donne la vision nocturne et tu seras récompensé.
Key.Spanish: Consíguenos visión nocturna y tendrás una buena recompensa.
Key.Italian: Trovaci dei visori notturni e farò in modo che tu sia adeguatamente ricompensato.
Key.Polish: Załatw nam noktowizory, a zostaniesz hojnie nagrodzony.
Key.Russian: Достань нам очки ночного видения, и я щедро тебя награжу.
Key.German: Besorge uns Nachtsichtgeräte und ich werde dich reich belohnen.
Key.Czech: Sežeň noční vidění a my ti dáme velikou odměnu.
Key.English: Get us night vision and I make sure you well rewarded.
Key.Portuguese: Arranja visão noturna pra nós, que eu te garanto boa recompensa.
Key.Korean: 야간투시경을 가져다 주면 큰 보상을 주겠다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 给我们夜视镜，我保证不会亏待你的。
Key.Japanese: "ナイトビジョン" ヲ手ニ入レテクレレバ、褒美ヲヤル。
Key.Turkish: Bize gece görüş aletini getir ve ben de seni güzelce ödüllendireyim.

Key.Original: Maybe ambush a patrol or steal from a depot, eh?
Key.Chinese: 或許襲擊巡邏隊，或是從倉庫中偷一些來？
Key.French: Piège une patrouille ou vole dans un dépôt, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Puedes emboscar una patrulla o robar un almacén, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Forse potresti assaltare una pattuglia o derubare un deposito, eh?
Key.Polish: Przygotuj zasadzkę na patrol albo ukradnij jakieś z magazynu, co?
Key.Russian: Можешь устроить засаду на патруль, либо выкрасть их со склада.
Key.German: Du könntest eine Patrouille überfallen oder ein Lager plündern, was meinst du?
Key.Czech: Možná přepadnout hlídku nebo ukrást sklad?
Key.English: Maybe ambush a patrol or steal from a depot, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Peut-être emboscar patrulha ou roubar de depósito, non?
Key.Korean: 정찰병을 습격하거나 창고에서 훔치는 건 어떤가?
Key.Chinesesimp: 也许伏击一支巡逻队或偷仓库，嗯？
Key.Japanese: 哨戒ヲ待チ伏セ攻撃スルトカ、集積所カラ盗ムトカスレバ手ニ入ルダロウ。
Key.Turkish: Belki bir devriyeye pusu kurarsın veya bir depodan çalarsın?

Key.Original: CSAT just supplied la gendarmerie.
Key.Chinese: CSAT 剛剛為國家憲兵提供了補給。
Key.French: Le CSAT a livré à la gendarmerie.
Key.Spanish: El CSAT acaba de equipar a la gendarmerie.
Key.Italian: La CSAT ha appena rifornito la gendarmeria.
Key.Polish: CSAT niedawno przysłało zaopatrzenie dla la gendarmerie.
Key.Russian: CSAT только что прислала свежую партию Жандармерии.
Key.German: CSAT hat la gendarmerie frisch ausgerüstet.
Key.Czech: La gendarmerie má novou techniku od CSAT.
Key.English: CSAT just supplied la gendarmerie.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT acabou de abastecer a gendarmerie.
Key.Korean: CSAT가 얼마 전에 헌병특공대에 물자를 보급했다.
Key.Chinesesimp: CSAT 刚刚为宪兵队运送了补给。
Key.Japanese: CSAT ガタッタ今、国家憲兵隊ニ供給シタ。
Key.Turkish: CSAT, la gendarmerie için ikmal malzemesi sağladı.

Key.Original: I have sent you intel on the place.
Key.Chinese: 我把此地的情報傳給你了。
Key.French: Je t'envoie l'endroit.
Key.Spanish: Te he enviado información sobre el sitio.
Key.Italian: Ti ho inviato informazioni sul posto.
Key.Russian: Я отправил тебе информацию о месте.
Key.German: Ich hab dir Informationen zu diesem Standort geschickt.
Key.Czech: Posílám ti, co o místě vím.
Key.English: I have sent you intel on the place.
Key.Portuguese: Enviei informações sobre local.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我向你发送了有关那地方的情报。
Key.Japanese: ソノ場所ニ関スル情報ヲソッチニ送ッタゾ。

Container.name: 169_eve_doctor_meeting
Container.situation: doctor greets player.

Key.Original: Hey, légio.
Key.French: Hé, Légio.
Key.Spanish: Oye, légio.
Key.Italian: Ehi, légio.
Key.German: Hey, légio.
Key.English: Hey, légio.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, légio.
Key.Japanese: おい、レジョ。

Container.name: 244_ex_virus_upload_fail_new_plan
Container.situation: player fails to upload the virus and miller calls to provide a new approach.

Key.Original: Santiago, we might have a plan B on CSAT's automated weapons.
Key.Chinese: Santiago，我們得用 B 計畫來對付 CSAT 的自動化武器。
Key.French: Santiago, on a un plan B pour les armes autonomes du CSAT.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, puede que tengamos un plan B para las armas autónomas del CSAT.
Key.Italian: Santiago, forse abbiamo un piano B per le armi automatizzate della CSAT.
Key.Polish: Santiago, chyba mamy plan B w kwestii tej broni CSAT.
Key.Russian: Сантьяго, насчет этих автоматизированных орудий CSAT. Кажется, у нас есть план Б.
Key.German: Santiago, wir haben möglicherweise einen Plan B für CSATs automatische Waffensysteme.
Key.Czech: Santiago, možná máme plán B, jak na automatický zbraně CSAT.
Key.English: Santiago, we might have a plan B on CSAT's automated weapons.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, talvez a gente tenha um plano B contra as armas automatizadas da CSAT.
Key.Korean: 산티아고, CSAT의 자동화 무기를 상대할 대안책을 발견한 것 같아.
Key.Chinesesimp: Santiago，我们可以来个计划 B 来对付 CSAT 的自动武器。
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、CSAT の自動武器に関してだが、予備作戦を立てられるかもしれない。
Key.Turkish: Santiago, CSAT’nin otomatik silahlarıyla ilgili bir B planımız olabilir.

Key.Original: Someone, somewhere will be monitoring the security network.
Key.Chinese: 總有人會在監控保全網路。
Key.French: Un de leurs gars surveille forcément leur réseau de sécurité.
Key.Spanish: En algún lugar, alguien estará monitorizando la red de seguridad.
Key.Italian: Qualcuno starà monitorando la rete di sicurezza da qualche parte.
Key.Russian: Наверняка кто-то где-то наблюдает за безопасностью сети.
Key.German: Irgendwo überwacht jemand das Sicherheitsnetzwerk.
Key.Czech: Někdo někde určitě monitoruje bezpečnostní síť.
Key.English: Someone, somewhere will be monitoring the security network.
Key.Portuguese: Alguém, em algum lugar, vai estar monitorando a rede de segurança.
Key.Korean: 어디선가 누군가 보안 네트워크를 모니터링 하게 될 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 有人会在某个地方监听安防网络。
Key.Japanese: 誰かがどこかでセキュリティネットワークを監視しているはずだ。
Key.Turkish: Birisi, bir yerden güvenlik ağını izleyecek.

Key.Original: It's likely they'll be doing so near the lab - and if we find their setup, and get a keycard, we may be able to shut them down, manually...
Key.Chinese: 很可能就在實驗室附近——如果我們能找到他們的設備，然後取得鑰匙卡，或許我們就能手動關掉它們……
Key.French: En toute logique, il doit être près du labo. Trouve l'endroit et une carte d'accès. On pourra peut-être les éteindre manuellement...
Key.Spanish: Es probable que sea cerca del laboratorio. Si averiguamos su configuración y conseguimos una tarjeta de seguridad, podríamos desconectarlas de forma manual...
Key.Italian: Probabilmente vicino al laboratorio... E se scopriamo la loro configurazione e recuperiamo una scheda elettronica, forse potremmo disabilitarle manualmente...
Key.Polish: Pewnie w pobliżu laboratorium. Jeśli znajdziemy to miejsce i zdobędziemy kartę dostępu, może uda się wyłączyć broń ręcznie…
Key.Russian: Вероятно, их пункт наблюдения где-то рядом с лабораторией, так что если мы найдем его и получим доступ к ключ-карте, то сможем отключить их вручную...
Key.German: Es ist wahrscheinlich, dass sich dieser Jemand in der Nähe des Labors befindet. Wenn wir seine Ausrüstung finden und eine Keycard beschaffen, können wir sie vielleicht manuell abschalten ...
Key.Czech: Pravděpodobně někde poblíž laboratoře. Když to stanoviště najdeme a seženeme přístupovou kartu, třeba je budeme moct vyřadit ručně.
Key.English: It's likely they'll be doing so near the lab - and if we find their setup, and get a keycard, we may be able to shut them down, manually...
Key.Portuguese: É provável que façam isso próximo ao laboratório. Se a gente achar a configuração e pegar um cartão, podemos desligar manualmente...
Key.Korean: 아마 실험실에서 멀리 떨어진 곳에서 모니터링을 하고 있겠지. 그리고 우리가 놈들의 네트워크 설정을 찾아내고 키카드만 확보한다면, 보안 네트워크를 수동으로 중단시킬 수 있을지도 몰라...
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们可能会在实验室附近干这事 - 如果我们找到他们的装置，搞到钥匙卡，我们也许就能关闭它们，手动关闭...
Key.Japanese: おそらく研究所の近くでな。その配置を突き止めて、キーカードを手に入れれば、武器をシャットダウンさせられるかもしれない。手動でな...
Key.Turkish: Muhtemelen laboratuvarın yakınında böyle yapacaklar ve onların tertibatını ve bir anahtar kartı bulabilirsek, onları elle kapatma şansımız olur...

Key.Original: It won't be a cakewalk, I know, but access the right computer, and it's job done. No remote guns.
Key.Chinese: 我知道這並不容易，不過你只要存取正確的電腦就行了。我們就可以解決掉遙控槍砲。
Key.French: Ce sera pas facile, je sais, mais si on trouve le bon ordi, c'est bon. Plus de mitrailleuses autonomes.
Key.Spanish: No va a ser pan comido, lo sé; pero, si consigues acceder al ordenador adecuado, es cosa hecha, fuera armas remotas.
Key.Italian: Non sarà una passeggiata, lo so, ma ti basta accedere al computer giusto e il gioco è fatto. Niente armi comandate a distanza.
Key.Polish: Wiem, nie będzie łatwo, ale ogarnij właściwy komputer, a działka wypadną z gry.
Key.Russian: Понимаю, что задача не из легких, но здесь главное - получить доступ к нужному компьютеру, а дальше уже дело техники. Никакого дистанционного оружия.
Key.German: Ich weiß, das wird nicht leicht, aber wenn du den richtigen Computer erwischst, hat sich die Sache erledigt und wir sind die Geschütze los.
Key.Czech: Nebude to žádná sranda, vím. Ale dostaň se ke správnýmu počítači a můžeme vyřadit dálkově ovládaný zbraně.
Key.English: It won't be a cakewalk, I know, but access the right computer, and it's job done. No remote guns.
Key.Portuguese: Não vai ser mole, eu sei, mas acesse o computador certo e já era. Zero armas remotas.
Key.Korean: 쉽지는 않겠지만, 제대로 된 컴퓨터에 접속하기만 하면 쉽게 풀릴지도 몰라. 그럼 원격 포탑은 신경쓰지 않아도 된다고.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这可不是件轻而易举的事情，我知道，但只要进入正确的电脑，就大功告成了。远程炮就歇了。
Key.Japanese: 簡単にできるとは思わないが、関連コンピュータにアクセスできれば、それでオッケーだ。遠隔兵器を使えなくなる。
Key.Turkish: Bunun çocuk oyuncağı olmayacağını biliyorum ama doğru bilgisayara erişirsen iş hallolur. Uzaktan kumandalı silahlar yok.

Key.Original: Just keep it in mind, as an option.
Key.Chinese: 只需要記住，這也是一個辦法。
Key.French: Penses-y, ça reste une option.
Key.Spanish: Tenlo presente como alternativa.
Key.Italian: Tienilo a mente come opzione alternativa.
Key.Russian: Просто имей это в виду, как вариант.
Key.German: Behalte diese Option im Hinterkopf.
Key.Czech: Ber to jako jednu z možností.
Key.English: Just keep it in mind, as an option.
Key.Portuguese: Apenas se lembre disso como uma opção.
Key.Japanese: 選択肢として、考えておいてくれ。
Key.Turkish: Sadece bir seçenek olarak aklında bulunsun.

Container.name: 243_ex_first_aid_not_effective
Container.situation: player tries to heal arthur with first aid kit.

Key.Original: Merci, mec.
Key.French: Merci, mec.
Key.Spanish: Merci, mec.
Key.Italian: Merci, mec.
Key.German: Merci, mec.
Key.English: Merci, mec.
Key.Portuguese: Merci, mec.
Key.Japanese: メルシー。

Key.Original: That - that helps the pain...
Key.French: Ça... Ça soulage la douleur.
Key.Spanish: Eso... Eso alivia el dolor...
Key.Italian: Questo dovrebbe attenuare il dolore...
Key.German: Das ... das hilft gegen den Schmerz ...
Key.English: That - that helps the pain...
Key.Portuguese: I-isso ajuda a dor...
Key.Korean: 통... 통증은 조금 가라앉는 것 같아...
Key.Japanese: 痛ミガ... マシニナッタ...

Container.name: 242_ex_steals_hat
Container.situation: player steals a hat from a sleeping farmer.

Key.Original: Hey!
Key.French: Hé !
Key.Spanish: ¡Eh!
Key.Italian: Ehi!
Key.German: Hey!
Key.English: Hey!
Key.Portuguese: Ei!
Key.Japanese: おい！

Key.Original: Mon chapeau !
Key.French: Mon chapeau !
Key.Spanish: ¡Mi sombrero!
Key.Italian: Il mio cappello!
Key.German: Mein Hut!
Key.English: My hat!
Key.Portuguese: Meu chapéu!
Key.Japanese: 俺ノ帽子ガ！

Container.name: 241_ex_miller_where_are_you_d
Container.situation: miller calls player and asks him where he is. the weapons lab has been destroyed.

Key.Original: Santiago, where are you?
Key.French: Santiago, où tu es ?
Key.Spanish: Santiago, ¿dónde te has metido?
Key.Italian: Santiago, dove sei?
Key.German: Santiago, wo bist du?
Key.English: Santiago, where are you?
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, onde você tá?
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、どこにいる？

Key.Original: Hurry the fuck up, we've got to go!
Key.Chinese: 動作他媽的再快一點，我們得走了！
Key.French: Bouge-toi, on doit y aller !
Key.Spanish: ¡Date prisa, coño, que tenemos que irnos!
Key.Italian: Muovi il culo, dobbiamo andare!
Key.Russian: Быстрее, твою мать, нам пора выдвигаться!
Key.German: Beeil dich, verdammt. Wir müssen los!
Key.Czech: Koukej sebou kurva hodit. Musíme jít!
Key.English: Hurry the fuck up, we've got to go!
Key.Portuguese: Anda logo, temos que partir!
Key.Japanese: 急げ。もう行くぞ！
Key.Turkish: Kaldırın şu lanet popolarınızı; gitmemiz gerek!

Container.name: 240_ex_miller_where_are_you_c
Container.situation: miller calls player and asks him where he is.

Key.Original: Santiago, it's Keystone.
Key.French: Santiago, ici Keystone.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, aquí Keystone.
Key.Italian: Santiago, qui è Keystone.
Key.German: Santiago, hier ist Keystone.
Key.English: Santiago, it's Keystone.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, aqui é Lastro.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ。こちらはキーストーンだ。

Key.Original: I'm waiting at our rendezvous point in the jungle. Hurry up.
Key.Chinese: 我正在叢林裡的會和點，動作快。
Key.French: Je suis au RDV dans la jungle. Fais vite.
Key.Spanish: Te estoy esperando en el punto de encuentro de la selva. Date prisa.
Key.Italian: Ti sto aspettando al punto d’incontro nella giungla. Sbrigati.
Key.Polish: Czekam w umówionym miejscu w dżungli. Pospiesz się.
Key.Russian: Я жду тебя на нашей точке сбора в джунглях. Поторопись.
Key.German: Ich warte an unserem Treffpunkt im Dschungel auf dich. Beeilung.
Key.Czech: Čekám na našem místě setkání v džungli. Dělej.
Key.English: I'm waiting at our rendezvous point in the jungle. Hurry up.
Key.Portuguese: Tô esperando no nosso ponto de encontro na selva. Se apressa.
Key.Korean: 나 지금 정글 속 접선 장소에서 기다리고 있어. 서둘러.
Key.Japanese: ジャングルの合流地点で待っている。急いでくれ。
Key.Turkish: Ormanda, buluşma noktamızda bekliyorum. Acele et.

Container.name: 239_ex_miller_where_are_you_b
Container.situation: miller calls player and asks him where he is.

Key.Original: Santiago? It's me.
Key.French: Santiago, c'est moi.
Key.Spanish: ¿Santiago? Soy yo.
Key.Italian: Santiago? Sono io.
Key.German: Santiago? Ich bin‘s.
Key.English: Santiago? It's me.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago? Sou eu.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ。俺だ。

Key.Original: Remember, we're up against the clock on this. Expedite. Find those Network Structure Plans!
Key.Chinese: 記住了，我們時間緊迫。加快速度，找到那些網路架構圖！
Key.French: N'oublie pas, le temps nous est compté. Bouge-toi. Trouve le plan de leur structure réseau !
Key.Spanish: Recuerda que el tiempo corre en nuestra contra. Date vidilla. ¡Encuentra ese esquema de estructura de red!
Key.Italian: Ricorda, è una corsa contro il tempo. Sbrigati. Trova quei piani strutturali della rete!
Key.Polish: Pamiętaj, to walka z czasem. Spiesz się. Znajdź te plany kompleksu!
Key.Russian: Напоминаю, что время работает против нас. Поторопись. Найди планы архитектуры сети!
Key.German: Vergiss nicht: Die Zeit läuft gegen uns, also beeil dich. Finde diese Netzwerk-Strukturpläne!
Key.Czech: Pamatuj, že závodíme s časem. Urychli to. Najdi nám plány síťový struktury.
Key.English: Remember, we're up against the clock on this. Expedite. Find those Network Structure Plans!
Key.Portuguese: Não esqueça, estamos correndo contra o relógio nisso. Adiante o lado. Encontre esses planos de estrutura de rede!
Key.Korean: 지금 시간이 많이 없어. 그러니까 서둘러. 빨리 네트워크 구조 설계도를 찾으라고!
Key.Chinesesimp: 记住，这件事我们得争分夺秒。加快速度。找到那些网络结构计划！
Key.Japanese: 忘れるな。今回は、俺達は時間と競争してる。ネットワーク構造プランを見つけるんだ！
Key.Turkish: Unutma, bu konuda zamana karşı yarışıyoruz. Acele et. Şu Ağ Yapı Planlarını bul!

Container.name: 238_ex_miller_where_are_you_a
Container.situation: miller calls player and asks him where he is, and encourages him to check his computer.

Key.Original: Santiago, Keystone.
Key.French: Santiago, Keystone.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, aquí Keystone.
Key.Italian: Santiago, qui è Keystone.
Key.German: Santiago, hier ist Keystone.
Key.English: Santiago, Keystone.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, Lastro aqui.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、キーストーンだ。

Key.Original: You want to check your computer...?
Key.French: Tu peux allumer ton ordi ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Quieres echar un vistazo a tu ordenador...?
Key.Italian: Puoi controllare il tuo computer...?
Key.German: Du solltest auf deinen Computer schauen ...
Key.English: You want to check your computer...?
Key.Portuguese: Pode verificar o seu computador...?
Key.Japanese: コンピュータを確認してくれないか...？

Key.Original: This situation's moving fast, we've got to keep up!
Key.Chinese: 情況瞬息萬變，我們得跟上！
Key.French: La situation évolue vite, il faut faire le point !
Key.Spanish: ¡La situación está cambiando muy rápido y no podemos perder comba!
Key.Italian: Le cose procedono con rapidità e dobbiamo stare al passo!
Key.Russian: Ситуация развивается очень быстро, нам нельзя сбавлять темп!
Key.German: Die Lage ist brenzlig und wir müssen uns beeilen!
Key.Czech: Situace se rychle vyvíjí, musíme držet krok.
Key.English: This situation's moving fast, we've got to keep up!
Key.Portuguese: Esta situação está indo bem rápido, precisamos acompanhar!
Key.Korean: 상황이 빠르게 돌아가고 있어서 정신 바짝 차려야 돼!
Key.Chinesesimp: 局势发展很快，我们得跟上！
Key.Japanese: 状況が急展開してる。遅れを取るわけにはいかない！
Key.Turkish: Bu durum hızlı ilerliyor; devam etmemiz gerekiyor!

Key.Original: Go and access the intel I sent you.
Key.Chinese: 去看看我發給你的情報。
Key.French: Regarde les infos que je t'ai envoyées.
Key.Spanish: Mira la información que te he enviado.
Key.Italian: Accedi alle informazioni che ti ho inviato.
Key.Russian: Открой файлы, которые я тебе отправил.
Key.German: Jetzt geh und sieh dir die Informationen an, die ich dir geschickt habe.
Key.Czech: Podívej se na ta data, co jsem ti poslal.
Key.English: Go and access the intel I sent you.
Key.Portuguese: Vá e acesse as informações que te enviei.
Key.Chinesesimp: 去看下我发给你的情报。
Key.Japanese: 行って俺が送った情報にアクセスしろ。
Key.Turkish: Git ve sana gönderdiğim istihbarata eriş.

Container.name: 237_ex_timeout_traitor
Container.situation: player is assigned a task to destroy the traitor's house.

Key.Original: Képi - bad news.
Key.French: Képi. Mauvaise nouvelle.
Key.Spanish: Képi, tengo malas noticias.
Key.Italian: Képi, cattive notizie.
Key.German: Képi – schlechte Neuigkeiten.
Key.English: Képi - bad news.
Key.Portuguese: Képi, más notícias.
Key.Japanese: ケピ、悪い知らせだ。

Key.Original: Gendarmes took our comrade into the mangrove swamps.
Key.Chinese: 國家憲兵把我們的同伴帶到了紅樹林沼澤中。
Key.French: Les gendarmes sont allés dans la mangrove avec notre camarade.
Key.Spanish: Los gendarmes se llevaron a nuestro camarada a los manglares.
Key.Italian: I gendarmi hanno portato il nostro compagno nelle paludi di mangrovie.
Key.Polish: Żandarmi zabrali naszego kompana na namorzyny.
Key.Russian: Жандармы повели нашего товарища на болото в мангровых зарослях.
Key.German: Gendarmes haben unseren Kameraden in die Mangrovensümpfe gebracht.
Key.Czech: Četníci odvlekli našeho člověka do močálu mangrovů.
Key.English: Gendarmes took our comrade into the mangrove swamps.
Key.Portuguese: Os gendarmes levaram nosso camarada pros pântanos.
Key.Korean: 헌병대가 우리의 동지를 잡아서 맹그로브 습지로 끌고 갔다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 宪兵队把我们的同志带到红树林沼泽地里了。
Key.Japanese: 国家憲兵隊が俺達の仲間をマングローブ林の沼地に連れて行った。
Key.Turkish: Jandarmalar silah arkadaşımızı mangrov bataklıklarına götürdüler.

Key.Original: They execute him there.
Key.French: Ils l'ont exécuté sur place.
Key.Spanish: Lo ejecutaron allí mismo.
Key.Italian: Lo giustizieranno lì.
Key.German: Sie wollen ihn dort hinrichten.
Key.English: They execute him there.
Key.Portuguese: Eles executam por lá.
Key.Japanese: そこで処刑するつもりなんだ。

Key.Original: Hit back and destroy his house.
Key.French: Réplique et détruis sa maison.
Key.Spanish: Devuélveles el golpe destruyendo su casa.
Key.Italian: Contrattacca e distruggi la sua casa.
Key.Russian: Нанеси им ответный удар и уничтожь его дом.
Key.German: Schlag zurück und zerstöre sein Haus.
Key.Czech: Oplať to a znič jeho barák, jo?
Key.English: Hit back and destroy his house.
Key.Portuguese: Revida e destrói a casa dele.
Key.Chinesesimp: 还击一下，毁掉他的房子。
Key.Japanese: 襲撃シテ彼ノ家ヲ破壊シロ。

Container.name: 234_ex_location_change_call
Container.situation: doctor informs player that they have relocated camp and that medical supplies are needed.

Key.Original: Hey, it's Drábek.
Key.French: Allô, c'est Drábek.
Key.Spanish: Oye, soy Drábek.
Key.Italian: Ehi, qui è Drábek.
Key.German: Hey, hier ist Drábek.
Key.English: Hey, it's Drábek.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, aqui é Drábek.
Key.Japanese: やあ、ドラレックだ。

Key.Original: Just so you know, we had to relocate - CSAT were patrolling the jungle and, well...
Key.Chinese: 我想告訴你，我們不得不遷移了－－CSAT 在叢林裡巡邏，所以……
Key.French: Je voulais te dire qu'on a déménagé. Le CSAT avait des patrouilles dans la jungle, et bon...
Key.Spanish: Que sepas que hemos tenido que reubicarnos: el CSAT estaba patrullando la selva y, en fin...
Key.Italian: Per la cronaca, ci siamo dovuti spostare. La CSAT stava pattugliando la giungla e, ecco...
Key.Polish: Daję znać, że musieliśmy się przenieść – CSAT patrolowało dżunglę i…
Key.Russian: Нам пришлось переехать, CSAT патрулировали джунгли и...
Key.German: Damit du Bescheid weißt: Wir mussten unser Lager verlassen. CSAT hat den Dschungel patrouilliert und ... na ja ...
Key.Czech: Jen ať to víš – museli jsme se přesunout. CSAT hlídkovali v džungli a… no…
Key.English: Just so you know, we had to relocate - CSAT were patrolling the jungle and, well...
Key.Portuguese: Só para você saber, tivemos que nos reposicionar. A CSAT estava patrulhando a selva e, bom...
Key.Korean: 위치를 옮겼다고 알려주려고요. CSAT이 정글을 순찰하고 있어서...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我想告诉你，我们得转移了 - CSAT在森林里巡逻，所以…
Key.Japanese: 報告しておきたいことがある。俺達は移動した。CSAT がジャングルを哨戒してたんだ。そして...
Key.Turkish: Bildiğin gibi, konumumuzu değiştirmemiz gerekiyor. CSAT ormanda devriye geziyordu ve şey...

Key.Original: Staying put didn't seem like a good idea. I'll send you a message, with our new location.
Key.Chinese: 待在原地似乎不是個好主意。我會給你傳個訊息，告訴你我們的新位置。
Key.French: Ç'aurait été une mauvaise idée de rester. Je t'enverrai un SMS avec notre position.
Key.Spanish: Quedarnos allí no parecía buena idea. Voy a enviarte un mensaje con nuestra nueva localización.
Key.Italian: Stare fermi in un punto non sembrava una buona idea. Ti invierò un messaggio indicandoti dove ci troviamo.
Key.Polish: Tkwienie w miejscu to nie był dobry pomysł. Prześlę ci naszą nową lokalizację.
Key.Russian: Мне показалось, что оставаться на одном месте - не очень хорошая идея. Я отправлю тебе сообщение с нашим новым местоположением.
Key.German: Es war dort einfach nicht mehr sicher. Ich schicke dir eine Nachricht mit unserer neuen Position.
Key.Czech: Zůstávat na místě mi nepřišlo jako dobrý nápad. Pošlu ti zprávu s naší novou polohou.
Key.English: Staying put didn't seem like a good idea. I'll send you a message, with our new location.
Key.Portuguese: Não parecia uma boa ideia ficar parado. Vou te enviar uma mensagem com nossa nova localização.
Key.Korean: 계속 한 자리에 있을 수가 없었어요. 새로 옮긴 장소를 문자 메시지로 보내줄게요.
Key.Chinesesimp: 守在原地似乎不是个好主意。我会给你发消息，告诉我们的新位置。
Key.Japanese: じっとしてるのは良くないだろうと考えた。俺達の新しい場所を示すメッセージを送る。
Key.Turkish: Olduğumuz yerde kalmak pek iyi bir fikir değilmiş. Yeni konumumuzla ilgili size mesaj gönderirim.

Key.Original: Also, don't forget, we're in desperate need of medical supplies!
Key.Chinese: 還有，別忘了，我們急需醫療用品！
Key.French: Et n'oublie pas qu'on a grandement besoin de matériel médical !
Key.Spanish: ¡Y no olvides que necesitamos suministros médicos desesperadamente!
Key.Italian: E non dimenticarti che abbiamo disperatamente bisogno di rifornimenti medici!
Key.Polish: Pamiętaj, że rozpaczliwie potrzebujemy zapasów medycznych!
Key.Russian: Кстати, напоминаю, что нам очень нужны медикаменты!
Key.German: Und vergiss nicht: Wir brauchen dringend Medikamente!
Key.Czech: A nezapomeň, že zoufale potřebujeme zdravotní potřeby!
Key.English: Also, don't forget, we're in desperate need of medical supplies!
Key.Portuguese: Além disso, não se esqueça, estamos precisando desesperadamente de suprimentos médicos!
Key.Korean: 그리고 의약품이 절실하게 필요하다는 사실도 잊지 마세요!
Key.Chinesesimp: 还有，别忘了，我们迫切需要医疗用品！
Key.Japanese: それから、忘れるな。医療物資がこの上なく必要なんだ！
Key.Turkish: Ayrıca unutma; derhal tıbbi ikmal malzemelerine ihtiyacımız var!

Key.Original: I've got nothing to work with here.
Key.French: Je ne peux plus travailler.
Key.Spanish: Aquí no tengo nada con lo que trabajar.
Key.Italian: Non ho niente qui.
Key.Polish: Nie mam tu z czym pracować.
Key.Russian: Мне не с чем здесь работать.
Key.German: Mir gehen so langsam die Vorräte aus.
Key.English: I've got nothing to work with here.
Key.Portuguese: Não tenho nada com o que trabalhar aqui.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我在这里什么也做不了。
Key.Japanese: ここには使えるものが何もない。

Key.Original: One damp rag and my best intentions aren't going to cut it.
Key.Chinese: 我只有一條濕抹布，什麼也幹不了。
Key.French: J'irai pas loin avec juste un torchon et de bonnes intentions.
Key.Spanish: Con un paño húmedo y buenas intenciones no voy a ningún lado.
Key.Italian: Un panno umido e le mie migliori intenzioni non sono sufficienti.
Key.Polish: Mokra szmata i dobre chęci to za mało.
Key.Russian: Одной мокрой тряпки и моих благих намерений недостаточно.
Key.German: Ein feuchter Lappen und meine besten Wünsche werden nicht ausreichen.
Key.Czech: Jeden navlhčený hadr a zbožná přání mi stačit nebudou.
Key.English: One damp rag and my best intentions aren't going to cut it.
Key.Portuguese: Um pano úmido e minhas melhores intenções não serão suficientes.
Key.Korean: 축축한 넝마랑 제 의지만 가지고는 부족하다고요.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我只有一块湿布，都舍不得割破它。
Key.Japanese: 湿ったボロ切れ 1 枚と俺の善意だけじゃどうにもならないんだ。
Key.Turkish: Nemli bir paçavra ve iyi niyetim bunu çözmeyecek.

Container.name: 233_ex_vehicle_destroyed
Container.situation: doctor comments on the destruction of the vehicle.

Key.Original: Kurva!
Key.French: Kurva!
Key.Spanish: ¡Joder!
Key.Italian: Cazzo!
Key.German: Scheiße!
Key.English: Fuck!
Key.Portuguese: Porra!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！

Key.Original: You alright? We heard an explosion!
Key.Chinese: 你沒事吧？我聽見了爆炸聲！
Key.French: Ça va ? On a entendu une explosion !
