Key.Polish: Może z nim porozmawiasz i jakoś się dogadacie?
Key.Russian: Может ты сможешь с ним встретиться и договориться?
Key.German: Wenn du mit ihm redest, können wir vielleicht eine Abmachung treffen.
Key.Czech: Ale ty by sis s ním mohl promluvit a třeba se i dohodnout?
Key.English: If you could talk to him, maybe you can make a deal?
Key.Portuguese: Se você puder falar com ele, talvez role chegar num acordo, né?
Key.Korean: 저 대신 그와 얘기해서 거래를 성사시켜 주시겠어요?
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你能和他谈谈，也许能谈成吧？
Key.Japanese: お前が彼と話をして、取引を成立させてくれないか？
Key.Turkish: Onunla konuşabilirsen belki bir anlaşma yapabilirsin?

Container.name: 176_eve_doctor_medicine_not_home
Container.situation: doctor asks after the medical supplies he needs.

Key.Original: I tried your house, but you weren't at home...
Key.Chinese: 我打到你家，但是你不在家……
Key.French: J'ai essayé chez toi, mais tu n'étais pas là...
Key.Spanish: Fui a verte a casa, pero no estabas.
Key.Italian: Ho provato a passare da casa tua ma non c’eri...
Key.Polish: Byłem u ciebie, ale cię nie zastałem…
Key.Russian: Я приехал к тебе, но тебя не было дома...
Key.German: Ich hab es bei dir zu Hause versucht, aber du warst nicht da ...
Key.Czech: Hledal jsem tě doma, ale nebyl jsi tam.
Key.English: I tried your house, but you weren't at home...
Key.Portuguese: Bati na sua casa, mas você não estava lá...
Key.Japanese: お前の家まで行ったんだが、お前はいなかった...

Container.name: 175_eve_doctor_medicine_in
Container.situation: doctor asks after the medical supplies he needs.

Key.Original: Hey - situation.
Key.French: Hé, problème.
Key.Spanish: Oye, pasa una cosa.
Key.Italian: Ehi, devo parlarti.
Key.German: Hey, es gab einen Vorfall.
Key.English: Hey - situation.
Key.Portuguese: Ei, problema.
Key.Japanese: やあ。問題が発生した。

Container.name: 174_eve_doctor_csat
Container.situation: doctor explains to player that csat activities may be responsible for the malaria outbreak.

Key.Original: I know, don't say it.
Key.French: Ne dis rien, je sais...
Key.Spanish: Lo sé, no hace falta que lo digas.
Key.Italian: Lo so, non dirmelo.
Key.German: Ich weiß schon, sag nichts.
Key.English: I know, don't say it.
Key.Portuguese: Eu sei, nem precisa dizer.
Key.Japanese: 分かってる。何も言うな。

Key.Original: I look like shit, eh?
Key.French: J'ai une sale gueule, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Estoy hecho un asco, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ho un aspetto terribile, eh?
Key.German: Ich sehe schlimm aus, was?
Key.English: I look like shit, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Tô um trapo, não é?
Key.Japanese: 酷い顔してるだろう？

Key.Original: CSAT are treating it like any other outbreak.
Key.Chinese: CSAT 的治療方式跟其他的疫情一樣。
Key.French: Le CSAT traite ça comme une épidémie classique.
Key.Spanish: Que el CSAT lo está tratando como un brote común y corriente.
Key.Italian: La CSAT la sta trattando come una qualsiasi altra epidemia.
Key.Polish: CSAT traktują to jak ognisko zwykłej choroby.
Key.Russian: CSAT ведут себя так, как будто это обычная вспышка.
Key.German: CSAT behandelt es wie einen ganz gewöhnlichen Ausbruch.
Key.Czech: CSAT se k tomu staví jako ke každé jiné epidemii.
Key.English: CSAT are treating it like any other outbreak.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT está tratando isso como qualquer outro surto.
Key.Korean: CSAT가 이걸 다른 전염병과 똑같이 취급하고 있다는 거예요.
Key.Chinesesimp: CSAT 的治疗方式跟其他疫情一样。
Key.Japanese: CSAT は他の感染病の蔓延と同じように対処してるんだ。
Key.Turkish: CSAT, bu sıradan bir salgınmış gibi davranıyor.

Key.Original: I mean, make of that what you will.
Key.French: Tu peux tirer tes propres conclusions.
Key.Spanish: A ver, piensa lo que quieras.
Key.Italian: Insomma, pensa quello che vuoi.
Key.Russian: Даже не знаю, что это все означает.
Key.German: Was soll man davon halten?
Key.English: I mean, make of that what you will.
Key.Portuguese: Quer dizer, interprete como quiser.
Key.Japanese: お前がそれをどう解釈するかは勝手だ。

Key.Original: Yeah, well. No sleep.
Key.French: Je ne dors plus.
Key.Spanish: En fin, falta de sueño.
Key.Italian: Già, beh... Non sto dormendo per niente.
Key.Russian: Само собой, я же совсем не спал.
Key.German: Tja, Schlafmangel eben.
Key.English: Yeah, well. No sleep.
Key.Portuguese: Pois é. É falta de sono.
Key.Japanese: 寝てないんだ。

Key.Original: All the coughing and night runs and deals for artesunate...
Key.Chinese: 整天咳個不停、晚上得跑腿，然後還得去買青蒿琥酯……
Key.French: La toux, ces déplacements de nuit, trouver de l'artésunate...
Key.Spanish: Tanta tos, tanto levantarme por la noche, tanto regatear para conseguir artesunato...
Key.Italian: La tosse dei pazienti, i giri notturni dai farmacisti e le trattative per farci dare l’artesunato...
Key.Polish: Kaszel mnie wykańcza, do tego te nocne wizyty i załatwianie artezunatu…
Key.Russian: Все вокруг кашляют, плюс ночные поездки и поиски артесуната на черном рынке...
Key.German: Das ganze Husten und die nächtlichen Touren und Deals für Artesunat ...
Key.Czech: Všechno to kašlání, noční obchůzky, shánění artesunatu…
Key.English: All the coughing and night runs and deals for artesunate...
Key.Portuguese: Toda essa tosse, operações noturnas e negócios no mercado negro por artesunato...
Key.Korean: 밤새 기침하고 설사하면서 아르테수네이트까지 구하러 다니다 보니까...
Key.Chinesesimp: 咳个不停，晚上得跑腿，还得去买青蒿琥酯...
Key.Japanese: 咳とか夜間の診察とかアルテスネイトの取引とか...
Key.Turkish: Tüm o öksürükler, gece koşuşturmacaları ve artesunate pazarlıkları...

Key.Original: Oh, and the research!
Key.French: Et mes travaux !
Key.Spanish: ¡Ah, y la investigación!
Key.Italian: Oh, e la ricerca!
Key.German: Und die Forschung natürlich!
Key.English: Oh, and the research!
Key.Portuguese: Ah, e as pesquisas!
Key.Japanese: ああ、あと研究もだ！

Key.Original: They talk about malaria - but this?
Key.Chinese: 他們說的是瘧疾，不過這個？
Key.French: Ils parlent de malaria, mais ça...
Key.Spanish: Dicen que es malaria, pero esto...
Key.Italian: Lì si parla di malaria, ma questo...
Key.Polish: Mówią, że to malaria, ale tego…
Key.Russian: Они говорят про малярию, но это?
Key.German: Alle reden von Malaria, aber das hier?
Key.Czech: Mluví se o malárii, ale tohle?
Key.English: They talk about malaria - but this?
Key.Portuguese: Elas abordam malária, mas isso?
Key.Korean: 다들 말라리아라고 하는데, 아무리 봐도 이건 아니에요.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们说的是疟疾 - 但这个呢？
Key.Japanese: マラリアの話はするが、これは...

Key.Original: This is inexplicable.
Key.French: C'est inexplicable.
Key.Spanish: Esto no tiene explicación.
Key.Italian: Questo è inspiegabile.
Key.German: Das ist unerklärlich.
Key.English: This is inexplicable.
Key.Portuguese: Isso é inexplicável.
Key.Japanese: これは全く不可解だ。

Key.Original: There's parasitic protozoans but no plasmodia!
Key.Chinese: 有寄生原生生物，但是沒有瘧原蟲！
Key.French: Je trouve des protozoaires parasites, mais pas de plasmodies !
Key.Spanish: ¡Hay protozoos parasitarios, pero no plasmodios!
Key.Italian: Ci sono protozoi parassiti ma nessuno del genere plasmodium!
Key.Polish: To pasożytnicze pierwotniaki, ale nie zarodźce!
Key.Russian: Там есть простейшие паразиты, но нет плазмодии!
Key.German: Parasitische Protozoen ohne Plasmodien!
Key.Czech: Jsou to parazitičtí prvoci, ne zimničky!
Key.English: There's parasitic protozoans but no plasmodia!
Key.Portuguese: Existem protozoários parasitas, mas não plasmodia!
Key.Chinesesimp: 有寄生原虫，但没有疟原虫！
Key.Japanese: 確かに寄生性原虫はいるが、変形体はいない！
Key.Turkish: Parazitik protozoalar var ama plazmodya yok!

Key.Original: No evidence for a logical mutation!
Key.Chinese: 這樣的突變根本不合邏輯！
Key.French: Rien n'indique une mutation logique !
Key.Spanish: ¡No hay pruebas que apunten a una mutación lógica!
Key.Italian: Non ci sono prove di una mutazione logica!
Key.Polish: To nie może być naturalna mutacja!
Key.German: Keine Hinweise auf eine logische Mutation!
Key.Czech: Nemáme důkazy o žádné logické mutaci.
Key.English: No evidence for a logical mutation!
Key.Portuguese: Zero evidência de uma mutação lógica!
Key.Korean: 돌연변이를 논리적으로 설명할 만한 증거가 없다고요!
Key.Chinesesimp: 这样的突变根本不合逻辑！
Key.Japanese: 論理的な変形を裏付けるものがないんだ！
Key.Turkish: Mantıksal bir mutasyona dair kanıt yok!

Key.Original: And you know what's really strange?
Key.French: Et tu sais ce qui est bizarre ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Pero sabes qué es lo más raro de todo?
Key.Italian: E sai cos’è veramente strano?
Key.Polish: A wiesz, co jest naprawdę dziwne?
Key.German: Und weißt du, was wirklich merkwürdig ist?
Key.Czech: A víš, co je fakt zvláštní?
Key.English: And you know what's really strange?
Key.Portuguese: E você sabe o que é realmente estranho?
Key.Chinesesimp: 而且你知道真正奇怪的事情是什么吗？
Key.Japanese: しかも、本当に奇妙なことが何か知ってるか？
Key.Turkish: Ve gerçekten tuhaf olan ne, biliyor musun?

Key.Original: But me? I'm getting pretty nervous!
Key.French: Mais moi, ça me rend nerveux !
Key.Spanish: ¡Pero yo me estoy poniendo de los nervios!
Key.Italian: Ma a me la cosa agita parecchio!
Key.German: Ich bin jedenfalls ziemlich nervös!
Key.Czech: Ale já? Já začínám být docela nervózní.
Key.English: But me? I'm getting pretty nervous!
Key.Portuguese: Mas eu? Eu tô ficando muito nervoso!
Key.Chinesesimp: 可是我呢？我是坐立不安！
Key.Japanese: だが、俺はかなり不安になってきてる！

Container.name: 173_eve_doctor_knocking_at_door_delay_c_spec
Container.situation: doctor continues to call to player from outside his house.

Key.Original: Come on, we need to talk!
Key.French: Allez, il faut qu'on se parle !
Key.Spanish: ¡Venga, tenemos que hablar!
Key.Italian: Avanti, dobbiamo parlare!
Key.German: Komm schon, wir müssen reden!
Key.English: Come on, we need to talk!
Key.Portuguese: Vamos, precisamos conversar!
Key.Japanese: おい、話があるんだ！

Container.name: 172_eve_doctor_knocking_at_door_delay_b_spec
Container.situation: doctor continues to call to player from outside his house.

Key.Original: Hello? Anybody home?
Key.French: Ohé ? Il y a quelqu'un ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Hola? ¿Hay alguien en casa?
Key.Italian: Ehilà, c’è nessuno in casa?
Key.German: Hallo? Ist jemand zu Hause?
Key.English: Hello? Anybody home?
Key.Portuguese: Olá? Alguém em casa?
Key.Japanese: おーい、誰かいないか？

Container.name: 171_eve_doctor_knocking_at_door_delay_a_spec
Container.situation: doctor continues to call to player from outside his house.

Key.Original: Légio!
Key.French: Légio !
Key.Spanish: ¡Légio!
Key.Italian: Légio!
Key.German: Légio!
Key.English: Légio!
Key.Portuguese: Légio!
Key.Japanese: レジョ！

Container.name: 170_eve_doctor_knocking_at_door_spec
Container.situation: doctor calls to player from outside his house.

Key.Original: Légio!
Key.French: Légio !
Key.Spanish: ¡Légio!
Key.Italian: Légio!
Key.German: Légio!
Key.English: Légio!
Key.Portuguese: Légio!
Key.Japanese: レジョ！

Key.Original: Légionnaire, open up!
Key.French: Légionnaire, ouvre !
Key.Spanish: ¡Abre, légionnaire!
Key.Italian: Légionnaire, apri!
Key.German: Légionnaire, mach auf!
Key.English: Légionnaire, open up!
Key.Portuguese: Légionnaire, abra!
Key.Japanese: レジョネア、開けてくれ！

Key.Original: It's me, Dr. Drábek!
Key.French: C'est moi, le docteur Drábek !
Key.Spanish: ¡Soy yo, el doctor Drábek!
Key.Italian: Sono io, il dottor Drábek!
Key.German: Ich bin‘s, Dr. Drábek!
Key.English: It's me, Dr. Drábek!
Key.Portuguese: Sou eu, Dr. Drábek!
Key.Japanese: 俺だ、ドクター・ドラベックだ。

Container.name: 135_eve_escape_departure
Container.situation: miller leaves tanoa with player.

Key.Original: Okay, we good?
Key.French: C'est bon ?
Key.Spanish: Vale, ¿estamos?
Key.Italian: Okay, tutto a posto?
Key.German: Okay, sind wir soweit?
Key.English: Okay, we good?
Key.Portuguese: Ok, tudo certo?
Key.Japanese: よし、大丈夫か？

Key.Original: Then masks on, let's go. Proteus is pumping dry and on the hover.
Key.Chinese: 把面罩戴上，我們走吧。普羅提斯號正在排水與懸浮。
Key.French: Mets ton masque. Proteus a vidé son sas et nous attend entre deux eaux.
Key.Spanish: Pues venga esas máscaras. Proteus está entre dos aguas y vaciando para que atraquemos en él.
Key.Italian: Su la maschera, si va. Proteus sta pompando via l’acqua ed è in stazionamento.
Key.Polish: Zakładaj maskę i lecimy. Dok Proteusa już na nas czeka.
Key.Russian: Тогда надеваем маски и погнали. Proteus уже готов и ждет нас.
Key.German: Dann zieh die Taucherbrille an und los geht‘s. Proteus wird leergepumpt und wartet.
Key.Czech: Nasadit masky a jde se na to. Proteus vypouští vodu a pluje pod hladinou.
Key.English: Then masks on, let's go. Proteus is pumping dry and on the hover.
Key.Portuguese: Então, hora de botar as máscaras, vamos lá. Proteus está a postos e bombeando água para ficar perto da superfície.
Key.Korean: 그럼 마스크 쓰고 출발하자고. 프로테우스가 물을 배출하면서 부유 중이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 把面罩戴上，我们走吧。普罗提斯号正在排干艇库，在水下悬浮。
Key.Japanese: それなら、マスクを付けろ。行くぞ。プロテウスは水抜きして水中静止中だ。
Key.Turkish: O halde maskeleri takın ve gidelim. Proteus kuru hangardan su boşaltıyor ve denizin içinde bekliyor.

Container.name: 134_eve_escape_on_beach_diving_gear
Container.situation: miller and player reach a beach where a some swimmer delivery vehicles are waiting. player does not have any diving gear.

Key.Original: Santiago, we're going under, grab a rebreather.
Key.Chinese: Santiago，我們要下潛了，準備好呼吸器。
Key.French: Santiago, on plonge. Prends un recycleur.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, vamos a sumergirnos, pilla un reciclador de buceo.
Key.Italian: Santiago, ci immergiamo, prendi un autorespiratore.
Key.Polish: Santiago, zanurzamy się, łap aparat oddechowy.
Key.Russian: Сантьяго, мы опускаемся под воду, надень кислородную маску.
Key.German: Santiago, wir gehen auf Tauchgang. Schnapp dir ein Atemgerät.
Key.Czech: Santiago, ponoříme se. Vezmi si potápěčský přístroj.
Key.English: Santiago, we're going under, grab a rebreather.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, estamos afundando, pegue um respirador.
Key.Korean: 산티아고, 물 속으로 들어갈 테니까 수중 호흡기 챙겨.
Key.Chinesesimp: Santiago，我们下潜了，拿个水下呼吸器。
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、潜るぞ。リブリーザーを取れ。
Key.Turkish: Santiago, suyun dibini boyluyoruz. Bir tane dalış teçhizatı kap.

Container.name: 133_eve_escape_on_beach
Container.situation: miller and player reach a beach where a some swimmer delivery vehicles are waiting. player has diving gear.

Key.Original: Into the mini sub, move!
Key.French: Au mini sous-marin, vite !
Key.Spanish: ¡Vamos, al minisubmarino!
Key.Italian: Entra nel mini-sottomarino, svelto!
Key.German: Los, geh ins Mini-U-Boot!
Key.English: Into the mini sub, move!
Key.Portuguese: Entra no minissubmarino, vai!
Key.Japanese: 小型潜水艦へ、急げ！

Container.name: 132_eve_miller_angry
Container.situation: player does not leave the area after miller tells them they are on their own.

Key.Original: You still got something you want to say, old man?
Key.Chinese: 你難道有什麼意見，老頭？
Key.French: Tu veux encore veux me parler, Old Man ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Tienes algo más que decir, vejestorio?
Key.Italian: Hai ancora qualcosa da dire, vecchio?
Key.German: Hast du mir noch was zu sagen, alter Mann?
Key.Czech: Ještě něco mi chceš říct, dědo?
Key.English: You still got something you want to say, old man?
Key.Portuguese: Ainda quer falar alguma coisa, velhote?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你还有什么话要说吗？老头儿？
Key.Japanese: まだ何か言いたいことがあるのか、おっさんよ？
Key.Turkish: Hâlâ söylemek istediğin bir şey var mı, yaşlı adam?

Container.name: 131_eve_miller_threatened_continued
Container.situation: player puts down his weapon.

Key.Original: Okay. Now leave it there - and fuck off, you're on your own...
Key.Chinese: 好，把它留在那－－給我滾，我不會再幫你了……
Key.French: OK, n'y touche plus. Et dégage, tu te démerdes, maintenant...
Key.Spanish: Vale. Ahora déjala ahí... y vete a tomar por culo, ahora estás solo...
Key.Italian: Okay. Ora lasciala lì, e vai a farti fottere. Sei da solo...
Key.Polish: Dobra. Zostaw ją. I spierdalaj, od teraz radzisz sobie sam…
Key.Russian: Хорошо. А теперь пошел нахер отсюда. Ты теперь сам по себе...
Key.German: Okay, lass sie da liegen und hau ab. Ab jetzt bist du auf dich allein gestellt ...
Key.Czech: Fajn. Teď ji nech ležet a táhni do prdele. Poraď si sám.
Key.English: Okay. Now leave it there - and fuck off, you're on your own...
Key.Portuguese: OK. Deixa aí e vaza, agora você vai se virar por conta própria...
Key.Korean: 좋아. 거기 놔둬. 그리고 꺼져. 넌 이제 볼 일 없으니까...
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吧。现在可以走了 - 滚吧，你自由了...
Key.Japanese: よし。置いたら触るな。それから、失せろ。もうお前なんて知るか...
Key.Turkish: Tamam. Şimdi onu orada bırak ve defol; kendi başının çaresine bakarsın artık...

Container.name: 130_eve_miller_attacks
Container.situation: miller attacks player.

Key.Original: Alright. You know what, old man...?
Key.French: Bon, tu sais quoi, Old Man ?
Key.Spanish: Muy bien. ¿Sabes qué, viejales...?
Key.Italian: Okay. Sai che ti dico, vecchio...?
Key.German: Alles klar, das war‘s, alter Mann ...
Key.English: Alright. You know what, old man...?
Key.Portuguese: Tudo bem. Quer saber, velhote...?
Key.Japanese: なるほど。そういう態度か、おっさんよ...

Container.name: 129_eve_miller_drop_the_gun
Container.situation: miller tells player to drop his weapon.

Key.French: Non ?
Key.German: Tu es nicht ...
Key.Portuguese: Não...?
Key.Japanese: ダメか...？

Key.Original: Put that gun on the ground or I'll drop you where you stand!
Key.Chinese: 把槍放在地上，不然我就把你當場槍斃！
Key.French: Jette ton flingue ou je t'abats sur-le-champ !
Key.Spanish: ¡Tira el arma al suelo o te dejo seco!
Key.Italian: Metti a terra quell’arma o ti faccio fuori!
Key.Russian: Брось оружие на землю или я тебя завалю на месте!
Key.German: Nimm die Waffe runter, oder du lässt mir keine Wahl!
Key.Czech: Polož tu zbraň na zem, nebo tě na místě složím!
Key.English: Put that gun on the ground or I'll drop you where you stand!
Key.Portuguese: Coloca essa arma no chão ou vou te pipocar aí mesmo!
Key.Korean: 그 총 바닥에 내려놓지 않으면 내가 가만두지 않겠어!
Key.Chinesesimp: 把枪放到地上，要不我会就地毙了你！
Key.Japanese: その銃を地面に置け。でないと、俺がお前をその場で撃ち抜くぞ！
Key.Turkish: O silahı yere koy ya da seni olduğun yerde mıhlarım!

Container.name: 128_eve_miller_threatened
Container.situation: player points his weapon at miller.

Key.Original: Hey, lower that gun...
Key.French: Hé, baisse ton flingue...
Key.Spanish: Oye, baja el arma...
Key.Italian: Ehi, abbassa quell’arma...
Key.German: Hey, nimm die Waffe runter ...
Key.English: Hey, lower that gun...
Key.Portuguese: Ei, abaixa essa arma...
Key.Japanese: おい、銃口を下ろせ...

Container.name: 127_ta_escape_rv_a
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab. miller explains his mission.

Key.Original: The mission's over, we were able to find a sample for a cure. But, it's just that: a sample.
Key.Chinese: 任務結束了，我們找到了解藥的樣本，不過這僅僅是樣本而已。
Key.French: La mission est terminée, on a un échantillon d'antidote. Mais c'est qu'un échantillon.
Key.Spanish: La misión ha terminado y hemos conseguido una muestra para elaborar un tratamiento. Pero no es más que eso, una muestra.
Key.Italian: La missione è terminata, siamo riusciti a trovare un campione per una cura. Ma di questo si tratta: di un campione.
Key.Polish: Misja zakończona, zdobyliśmy próbkę antidotum. Ale nic ponadto.
Key.Russian: Миссия выполнена, нам удалось найти образец лекарства. Однако это всего лишь образец.
Key.German: Die Mission ist vorüber und wir konnten eine Probe des Gegenmittels sicherstellen. Aber die Menge ist einfach zu gering.
Key.Czech: Mise je u konce, našli jsme vzorek na vývoj léku. Jenomže je to jenom vzorek.
Key.English: The mission's over, we were able to find a sample for a cure. But, it's just that: a sample.
Key.Portuguese: A missão acabou, conseguimos encontrar uma amostra para a cura. Mas foi só isso: uma amostra.
Key.Korean: 임무는 끝났어. 치료약을 위한 샘플은 찾았는데, 문제는 그게 단순히 샘플이란 거지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 任务完成了，我们设法找到了特效药的样本。不过，只是一份样本。
Key.Japanese: 任務は終わった。治療薬のサンプルを見つけることができた。だが、サンプルはサンプルだ。
Key.Turkish: Görev bitti, tedavi için bir numune bulabildik. Fakat sadece numunemiz var.

Key.Original: Bottom line is, we just can't spare any to help the people here.
Key.Chinese: 底線是，我們不能分配人手來幫助這裡的人。
Key.French: On n'en a pas assez pour soigner les gens du coin.
Key.Spanish: Lo que se traduce en que no podemos prescindir ella para ayudar a la gente de aquí.
Key.Italian: Il nocciolo della questione è che non possiamo usarlo tutto per salvare la gente che vive qui.
Key.Polish: Niestety nie możemy się nią podzielić z miejscowymi.
Key.Russian: Суть в том, что мы не можем пожертвовать им, чтобы помочь людям.
Key.German: Wir können sie nicht nutzen, um den Leuten hier zu helfen.
Key.Czech: Nemůžeme ho postrádat a někoho jím zachraňovat.
Key.English: Bottom line is, we just can't spare any to help the people here.
Key.Portuguese: Resumindo, não temos como poupar nada para ajudar as pessoas daqui.
Key.Korean: 그러니까 여기 있는 사람들을 살리기 위해 샘플을 막 쓸 순 없단 말이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 要命的是，我们不能腾出手来帮这儿的人们了。
Key.Japanese: 結論から言うと、ここにいる人達を助けるために貴重なサンプルを消費するわけにはいかない。
Key.Turkish: Önemli olan şu ki buradaki insanlara yardım etmek için bu numuneyi harcayamayız.

Container.name: 126_ta_escape_rv_resumed
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab. miller explains his mission.

Key.Original: Alright, that's better. So. Anyway.
Key.Chinese: 好了，不管怎麼樣，這樣好多了。
Key.French: OK, voilà qui est mieux. Bon.
Key.Spanish: Vale, mucho mejor. A ver. La cosa está así.
Key.Italian: Okay, così va meglio. Allora. Ad ogni modo...
Key.Polish: Dobra, już wszystko w porządku. W każdym razie…
Key.German: Alles klar, das ist schon besser.
Key.Czech: To už je lepší. Takže… Jak jsem říkal.
Key.English: Alright, that's better. So. Anyway.
Key.Portuguese: Tudo bem, melhor assim, mesmo.
Key.Korean: 좋아, 이제 좀 낫군. 그래서 말이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吗，那样更好。就这样。无论如何。
Key.Japanese: ああ、よかった。さて...
Key.Turkish: Pekâlâ, bu daha iyi. O halde... Neyse.

Container.name: 125_ta_escape_rv_malaria_info_h
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab. miller explains his mission.

Key.Original: Come on. I got you a way out, we've got to go. Now!
Key.Chinese: 走吧。我給你準備了出路。我們必須趕快離開！
Key.French: Allez, je peux t'exfiltrer. Il faut y aller, maintenant !
Key.Spanish: Venga, te he preparado la salida. Tenemos que irnos. ¡Ya!
Key.Italian: Forza, ho trovato una via di fuga, dobbiamo andare. Ora!
Key.Polish: Chodź. Przygotowałem ci drogę ucieczki, musimy ruszać. Szybko!
Key.Russian: Давай, я помогу тебе выбраться отсюда. Ну же!
Key.German: Komm jetzt, ich schaff dich hier raus. Wir müssen los, sofort!
Key.Czech: Pojď. Vím, kudy pryč. Musíme jít. Hned!
Key.English: Come on. I got you a way out, we've got to go. Now!
Key.Portuguese: Vamos. Consegui uma saída pra você, temos que ir. Agora!
Key.Korean: 서둘러. 빠져나갈 길을 확보했으니까 지금 당장 가야 돼!
Key.Chinesesimp: 行了。我给你们找到一条出路，我们得动身了。快！
Key.Japanese: さあ、逃げ道を確保してある。行くぞ。急げ！
Key.Turkish: Haydi ama... Sana bir çıkış buldum, gitmemiz lazım. Hem de hemen!

Container.name: 124_ta_escape_rv_malaria_info_e
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab. miller explains his mission.

Key.Original: The long game's the only thing that matters, we have to have a solution for the future.
Key.Chinese: 重要的是長遠之計，我們必須為未來著想。
Key.French: Ce qui prévaut, c'est le long terme. Il nous faut une solution pour l'avenir.
Key.Spanish: Lo único que importa es lo que ocurra a largo plazo, debemos tener una respuesta para el futuro.
Key.Italian: Quello che conta è come ce la caveremo a lungo termine, dobbiamo avere una soluzione per il futuro.
Key.Polish: Liczy się w tej chwili tylko główny cel, musimy znaleźć rozwiązanie na przyszłość.
Key.Russian: Нам нужно думать о будущем – это куда важнее.
Key.German: Wir müssen langfristig denken, damit wir auf zukünftige Krisen besser reagieren können.
Key.Czech: Hlavní je dlouhodobý úspěch. Musíme mít řešení do budoucnosti.
Key.English: The long game's the only thing that matters, we have to have a solution for the future.
Key.Portuguese: A única coisa que importa é o longo prazo, precisamos ter uma solução para o futuro.
Key.Korean: 지금 중요한 건 장기적인 계획이야. 미래를 위한 해결책을 마련해야 한다고.
Key.Chinesesimp: 长远打算是关键，我们要为未来找到解决办法。
Key.Japanese: もっと長い目で見ないとだめだ。未来のために解決策を見つけないとだめなんだ。
Key.Turkish: Asıl mesele uzun vadedeki oyun; gelecek için bir çözüm bulmalıyız.

Container.name: 123_ta_escape_rv_malaria_info_d
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab. miller explains his mission.

Key.Original: There is no point giving up what we have to save so few.
Key.Chinese: 我們怎麼能為了就這區區幾個人而放棄這一切。
Key.French: On ne peut pas gâcher le peu qu'on a pour sauver quelques vies.
Key.Spanish: No tiene sentido renunciar a lo que tenemos para salvar a unos pocos.
Key.Italian: Non ha senso rinunciare a quello che abbiamo per salvarne così pochi.
Key.Polish: Nie ma sensu pozbywać się efektu naszej pracy, żeby uratować parę osób.
Key.Russian: Нет смысла отказываться от того, что у нас есть, чтобы спасти пару человек.
Key.German: Es macht keinen Sinn, die geringe Menge an Gegenmittel zu vergeuden, um ein paar wenigen zu helfen.
Key.Czech: Nemá smysl vzdávat se toho, co máme, jen abysme zachránili tak málo lidí.
Key.English: There is no point giving up what we have to save so few.
Key.Portuguese: Não faz sentido desistir do que temos para salvar tão poucos.
Key.Korean: 얼마 안 되는 사람들 살리자고 다 써버릴 순 없잖아.
Key.Chinesesimp: 眼下救不了几个人就放弃可不好。
Key.Japanese: 少数の人間だけを救うためにやっても何にもならない。
Key.Turkish: Azınlığı kurtarmak için sahip olduklarımızdan vazgeçmenin bir anlamı yok.

Container.name: 122_ta_escape_rv_malaria_info_c
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab. miller explains his mission.

Key.Original: Try to focus on the bigger picture!
Key.French: N'oublie pas l'enjeu global !
Key.Spanish: ¡Piensa en qué es más importante!
Key.Italian: Ma cerca di guardare la situazione in prospettiva!
Key.Polish: Spójrz na to z szerszej perspektywy!
Key.German: Du musst die gesamte Situation bedenken!
Key.English: Try to focus on the bigger picture!
Key.Portuguese: Tenta pensar no cenário como um todo!
Key.Korean: 진짜 중요한 게 뭔지 생각해 봐!
Key.Japanese: もっと大局に集中するんだ！

Container.name: 121_ta_escape_rv_malaria_info_b
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab. miller explains his mission.

Key.Original: You disagree.
Key.French: Tu n'es pas d'accord.
Key.Spanish: Así que no estás de acuerdo.
Key.Italian: Non sei d’accordo, capisco.
Key.German: Du bist anderer Meinung.
Key.English: You disagree.
Key.Portuguese: Você discorda.
Key.Japanese: お前はそう思ってないみたいだな。

Container.name: 120_ta_escape_rv_malaria_info_a
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab. miller explains his mission.

Key.Original: There isn't any time to explain...
Key.French: Je n'ai pas le temps de tout expliquer...
Key.Spanish: No tengo tiempo para explicarlo...
Key.Italian: Non abbiamo tempo per le spiegazioni...
Key.German: Ich hab keine Zeit für Erklärungen ...
Key.English: There isn't any time to explain...
Key.Portuguese: Não dá tempo pra explicar...
Key.Japanese: 説明してる時間はない...

Key.Original: CSAT are responsible for the malaria epidemic. It's part of a covert, biogenetic weapons program.
Key.Chinese: CSAT 是瘧疾爆發的幕後黑手，他們正在進行一次機密的生物基因武器計畫。
Key.French: La division d'armement biogénétique du CSAT a développé en secret cette souche de malaria.
Key.Spanish: El CSAT es el responsable de la epidemia de malaria. Es parte de un programa encubierto de armas biogenéticas.
Key.Italian: La CSAT è responsabile dell’epidemia di malaria. Fa tutto parte di un programma di armi biogenetiche segreto.
Key.Polish: CSAT stoi za epidemią malarii. To część tajnego programu rozwoju broni biologicznej.
Key.Russian: CSAT ответственны за эпидемию малярии. Это часть секретной программы по разработке биогенетического оружия.
Key.German: CSAT ist für die Malaria-Epidemie verantwortlich. Das Ganze ist Teil eines verdeckten, biogenetischen Waffenprogramms.
Key.Czech: Za epidemii malárie je zodpovědnej CSAT. Je to součást utajenýho programu biogenetických braní.
Key.English: CSAT are responsible for the malaria epidemic. It's part of a covert, biogenetic weapons program.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT é a responsável pela epidemia de malária. Faz parte de um programa secreto de armas biogenéticas.
Key.Korean: CSAT가 말라리아 확산을 주도했어. 은밀한 생물 무기 프로그램의 일부분인 모양이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 是 CSAT 制造了虐疾疫情。它是一项秘密生物基因武器项目的一部分。
Key.Japanese: CSAT はマラリアを蔓延させた。隠密の生物兵器プログラムの一環だ。
Key.Turkish: Sıtma salgınından CSAT sorumlu. Bu, gizli biyogenetik silah programının bir parçası.

Key.Original: Good news is, we got a sample for a counteragent.
Key.Chinese: 好消息是，我們取得了解藥的樣本。
Key.French: La bonne nouvelle, c'est que j'ai un échantillon d'antidote.
Key.Spanish: La buena noticia es que tenemos una muestra de anticuerpos para combatirla.
Key.Italian: La buona notizia è che abbiamo un campione per un antidoto.
Key.Polish: Dobra wiadomość jest taka, że zdobyliśmy próbkę antidotum.
Key.Russian: Хорошо, что мы получили образец противоядия.
Key.German: Die gute Nachricht ist, dass wir eine Probe des Gegenmittels haben.
Key.Czech: Dobrá zpráva je, že máme vzorek protilátky.
Key.English: Good news is, we got a sample for a counteragent.
Key.Portuguese: A boa notícia é que conseguimos uma amostra para gerar um antígeno.
Key.Korean: 좋은 소식은 우리가 중화제 샘플을 확보했다는 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好消息是，我们搞到了解药的样本。
Key.Japanese: いい知らせは、反作用剤のサンプルを手に入れたということだ。
Key.Turkish: İyi haber şu ki karşı etken madde için numunemiz var.

Key.Original: But, it's just that: a sample. It's not enough to help the people here.
Key.Chinese: 不過，問題是，這只是樣本而已，它並不足以幫助這裡的人。
Key.French: Mais c'est qu'un échantillon. On ne peut pas sauver les gens du coin.
Key.Spanish: Pero no es más que una muestra, no es suficiente para ayudar a la población local.
Key.Italian: Ma di questo si tratta: di un campione. Non è abbastanza per aiutare la gente che vive qui.
Key.Polish: Ale nic ponadto. To nie wystarczy, żeby pomóc miejscowym.
Key.Russian: Однако это всего лишь образец. Этого недостаточно, чтобы помочь людям.
Key.German: Aber diese allein reicht nicht, um der Bevölkerung hier zu helfen.
Key.Czech: Jenomže je to jenom vzorek. Což místním moc nepomůže.
Key.English: But, it's just that: a sample. It's not enough to help the people here.
Key.Portuguese: Mas foi só isso: uma amostra. Não é o suficiente pra ajudar as pessoas daqui.
Key.Korean: 하지만 말 그래도 샘플뿐이야. 이곳 사람들에게 사용하기에는 턱없이 부족한 양이지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过，也只是一份样本。这不足以帮这儿的人们解决问题。
Key.Japanese: だが、サンプルはサンプルだ。ここにいる全員を助けるには足りない。
Key.Turkish: Ama sadece numune var; buradaki insanlara yardım etmek için yeterli değil.

Container.name: 119_ta_escape_rv_in
Container.situation: player meets miller after the destruction of csat's weapons lab.

Key.Original: Santiago, good.
Key.French: Bien, Santiago.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, bien.
Key.Italian: Santiago, bene.
Key.German: Sehr gut, Santiago.
Key.English: Santiago, good.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, beleza.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、よくやった。

Container.name: 118_ta_lab_destroyed_call
Container.situation: miller contacts player and responds to the destruction of the weapon's lab.

Key.Original: That was one hell of a distraction!
Key.Chinese: 那真是一場非常不錯的干擾！
Key.French: Belle diversion !
Key.Spanish: ¡Menuda barbaridad de distracción!
Key.Italian: Quella sì che è stata una distrazione con i controcazzi!
Key.German: Das nenne ich mal eine Ablenkung!
Key.English: That was one hell of a distraction!
Key.Portuguese: Isso foi uma puta distração!
Key.Korean: 그 자식들 아마 혼이 나갔을 거야!
Key.Japanese: 今のはいい爆発だった！

Key.Original: My team are moving in, we'll try to get the counteragent.
Key.Chinese: 我的隊伍正在進軍，我們會試圖取得解藥。
Key.French: Mon équipe avance pour s'emparer de l'antidote.
Key.Spanish: Mi equipo está avanzando, vamos a intentar hacernos con los anticuerpos.
Key.Italian: La mia squadra sta avanzando, cercheremo di prendere l’antidoto.
Key.Polish: Mój zespół jest w drodze, spróbujemy zdobyć antidotum.
Key.Russian: Мой отряд выдвигается. Мы постараемся вывезти противоядие.
Key.German: Mein Team rückt jetzt vor. Wir holen uns das Gegenmittel.
Key.Czech: Můj tým jde do akce. Zkusíme najít protilátku.
Key.English: My team are moving in, we'll try to get the counteragent.
Key.Portuguese: Minha equipe tá avançando, tentaremos obter o antígeno.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我的队伍正在行进，我们会设法搞到解药。
Key.Japanese: 俺のチームが接近している。反作用剤をなんとか回収する。
Key.Turkish: Takımım içeri ilerliyor, karşı etken maddeyi almaya çalışacağız.

Key.Original: Head for the island of Sainte-Marie. I'll link-up with you there.
Key.Chinese: 前往聖瑪莉島。我會在那裡與你聯繫。
Key.French: Va sur l'Île Sainte-Marie. Je te rejoins là-bas.
Key.Spanish: Ve a la isla de Sainte-Marie. Allí me pondré en contacto contigo.
Key.Italian: Dirigiti all’isola di Sainte-Marie. Ci incontreremo quando sarai arrivato.
Key.Polish: Udaj się na wyspę Sainte-Marie. Dołączę do ciebie.
Key.Russian: Отправляйся на остров Сент-Мари. Я свяжусь с тобой там.
Key.German: Fahr zur Insel Sainte-Marie. Wir sprechen uns dort.
Key.Czech: Zamiř na ostrov Sainte-Marie. Potkáme se tam.
Key.English: Head for the island of Sainte-Marie. I'll link-up with you there.
Key.Portuguese: Vá para a ilha de Sainte Marie. Vou me encontrar com você lá.
Key.Korean: 생트마리 섬으로 이동해. 그곳에서 다시 교신할 테니까.
Key.Chinesesimp: 前往圣玛丽岛。我会在那儿与你会合。
Key.Japanese: サント・マリー島へ向かえ。そこでまた連絡する。
Key.Turkish: Sainte-Marie adasına ilerle. Seninle orada buluşacağım.

Container.name: 117_ta_lab_destroyed_not_known_call
Container.situation: miller contacts player and responds to the destruction of the weapon's lab. miller is unaware of it.

Key.Original: Things just kicked off on Tuvanaka! That anything to do with you?
Key.Chinese: 土萬納卡出事了！那是你幹的嗎？
Key.French: Ça chauffe sur Tuvanaka ! C'est toi ?
Key.Spanish: ¡La cosa se ha puesto calentita en Tuvanaka! ¿Has tenido algo que ver?
Key.Italian: La situazione comincia a scaldarsi su Tuvanaka! C’entri qualcosa?
Key.Polish: Na Tuvanaka zrobiło się gorąco! Maczałeś w tym palce?
Key.Russian: Тут какой-то переполох на Туванаке! Твоих рук дело?
Key.German: Auf Tuvanaka ist die Hölle los! Hast du etwas damit zu tun?
Key.Czech: Na Tuvanace se to začíná mlít. Nemáš s tím něco společnýho?
Key.English: Things just kicked off on Tuvanaka! That anything to do with you?
Key.Portuguese: O bicho tá pegando em Tuvanaka! Isso é coisa sua?
Key.Korean: 투바나카에서 뭔가 일이 벌어진 것 같아! 혹시 네가 그런 거야?
Key.Chinesesimp: 突瓦纳加的行动开始了！那和你有什么关系吗？
Key.Japanese: トゥバナカで進展ありだ！お前がやったのか？
Key.Turkish: İşler Tuvanaka’da sarpa sardı! Seninle ilgili bir gelişme var mı?

Key.Original: My team's moving in, using the chaos as a distraction. Our mission here is almost done.
Key.Chinese: 我的隊伍正用混亂當作掩護逐步在逼近。我們的任務就快完成了。
Key.French: Avec ce chaos, mon équipe peut avancer. On touche au but.
Key.Spanish: Mi equipo está avanzando, aprovechando el caos como distracción. Ya casi hemos terminado la misión.
Key.Italian: La mia squadra sta avanzando e usa il caos come distrazione. La nostra missione qui è quasi terminata.
Key.Polish: Mój zespół wykorzysta zamieszanie, żeby się tam dostać. To już prawie koniec naszej misji.
Key.Russian: Мой отряд выдвигается, хаос – отличное прикрытие. Наша работа здесь почти закончена.
Key.German: Mein Team rückt jetzt vor und versucht, das Chaos als Ablenkung zu nutzen. Unsere Mission hier ist fast erledigt.
Key.Czech: Můj tým jde do akce. Ten chaos rozptýlí jejich pozornost. Naše mise je skoro u konce.
Key.English: My team's moving in, using the chaos as a distraction. Our mission here is almost done.
Key.Portuguese: Minha equipe tá avançando através da distração do caos. Nossa missão aqui tá quase no fim.
Key.Korean: 우리 팀이 혼란을 틈타서 이동 중이야. 여기의 우리 임무는 거의 끝났어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我的队伍在行进，利用混乱分散注意力。我们这儿的任务就要完成了。
Key.Japanese: 俺のチームが混乱に紛れて接近している。今回の任務はもう少しで完了だ。
Key.Turkish: Takımım, dikkat dağıtmak için karmaşa yaratarak ilerliyor. Buradaki görevimiz bitti sayılır.

Key.Original: Head for the island of Sainte-Marie. I'll link-up with you there!
Key.Chinese: 前往聖瑪莉島。我會在那裡與你聯繫！
Key.French: Va sur l'Île Sainte-Marie. Je te rejoins là-bas !
Key.Spanish: Ve a la isla de Sainte-Marie. ¡Allí me pondré en contacto contigo!
Key.Italian: Dirigiti all’isola di Sainte-Marie. Ci incontreremo quando sarai arrivato!
Key.Polish: Udaj się na wyspę Sainte-Marie. Dołączę do ciebie!
Key.Russian: Отправляйся на остров Сент-Мари. Я свяжусь с тобой там!
Key.German: Fahr zur Insel Sainte-Marie. Wir sprechen uns dort!
Key.Czech: Zamiř na ostrov Sainte-Marie. Potkáme se tam.
Key.English: Head for the island of Sainte-Marie. I'll link-up with you there!
Key.Portuguese: Vá para a ilha de Sainte Marie. Vou me encontrar com você lá!
Key.Korean: 생트마리 섬으로 이동해. 그곳에서 다시 교신할 테니까!
Key.Chinesesimp: 前往圣玛丽岛。我会在那儿与你会合！
Key.Japanese: サント・マリー島へ向かえ。そこでまた連絡する！
Key.Turkish: Sainte-Marie adasına ilerle. Seninle orada buluşacağım!

Container.name: 116_ta_lab_destroyed_in_call
Container.situation: miller contacts player and responds to the destruction of the weapon's lab.

Key.Original: Santiago - update!
Key.French: Santiago, du nouveau !
Key.Spanish: ¡Santiago, novedades!
Key.Italian: Santiago, aggiornamento!
Key.German: Santiago, Update!
Key.English: Santiago - update!
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, atualização!
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、報告しろ！

Container.name: 115_ta_all_radar_sites_destroyed_call
Container.situation: miller confirms that all radar sites have been destroyed.

Key.Original: Santiago, we're picking up a lot of chatter over here!
Key.Chinese: Santiago，我們在那裡收到了很多訊號！
Key.French: Santiago, on a un pic d'échanges radio !
Key.Spanish: ¡Santiago, estamos recibiendo un montón de comunicaciones!
Key.Italian: Santiago, stiamo rilevando un sacco di brusio da queste parti!
Key.Polish: Santiago, odbieramy więcej meldunków na łączach!
Key.German: Santiago, wir haben einige Funkmeldungen abgefangen.
Key.English: Santiago, we're picking up a lot of chatter over here!
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, estamos captando várias mensagens aqui!
Key.Korean: 산티아고, 이쪽에서 적의 교신이 엄청나게 잡히고 있어!
Key.Chinesesimp: Santiago，我们这截获了大量通话！
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、通信が騒がしくなってるぞ！
Key.Turkish: Santiago, burada birçok konuşma tespit ediyoruz!

Key.Original: Enemy radar's out.
Key.French: Le radar ennemi est neutralisé.
Key.Spanish: El radar enemigo está fuera de combate.
Key.Italian: Il radar nemico è fuori uso.
Key.German: Der feindliche Radar wurde lahmgelegt.
Key.English: Enemy radar's out.
Key.Portuguese: O radar inimigo foi desativado.
Key.Japanese: 敵のレーダーが破壊された。

Key.Original: Those missile sites aren't going to be a problem anymore.
Key.Chinese: 那些導彈不會再構成威脅。
Key.French: Ces lanceurs ne posent plus problème.
Key.Spanish: Esos misiles ya no supondrán un problema.
Key.Italian: Quei siti missilistici non costituiranno più un problema.
Key.Polish: Wyrzutnie rakiet nie będą już sprawiały problemu.
Key.Russian: Эти ракетные установки больше не проблема.
Key.German: Die Raketenstationen sind jetzt kein Problem mehr.
Key.Czech: Raketomety už nám nebudou dělat problémy.
Key.English: Those missile sites aren't going to be a problem anymore.
Key.Portuguese: Esses pontos de mísseis não serão mais um problema.
Key.Korean: 이제 미사일 발사기는 더 이상 문제가 되지 않을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那些导弹阵地不再算个事了。
Key.Japanese: あのミサイルサイトはもう脅威にはならないだろう。
Key.Turkish: O füze bölgeleri artık sorun yaratmayacak.

Key.Original: Just, keep in mind, we're running a cloak and dagger op here.
Key.Chinese: 記住了，我們這可是機密任務。
Key.French: Mais n'oublie pas qu'on opère en secret.
Key.Spanish: Eso sí, ten presente que esta es una operación de infiltración sigilosa.
Key.Italian: Ricorda solo che questa è un’operazione in incognito.
Key.Polish: Pamiętaj tylko, że to tajna operacja.
Key.Russian: Главное помни, что это секретная операция.
Key.German: Aber vergiss nicht, dass wir es hier mit einer verdeckten Operation zu tun haben.
Key.Czech: Jenom pamatuj na to, že se snažíme být utajená operace.
Key.English: Just, keep in mind, we're running a cloak and dagger op here.
Key.Portuguese: Mas não se esqueça: estamos realizando uma operação secreta.
Key.Korean: 우린 지금 비밀 작전을 수행 중이란 것만 잊지 마.
Key.Chinesesimp: 只是，要记住，我们在这儿进行一场秘密行动。
Key.Japanese: だが、忘れるな。俺達がスパイ工作を実行中だってことをな。
Key.Turkish: Şunu sakın unutma; burada bir casusluk operasyonu yürütüyoruz.

Key.Original: Even if we had a clear run, I can't go calling in airstrikes.
Key.Chinese: 即便沒有防禦，我也不能夠呼叫空襲。
Key.French: Quoi qu'il arrive, on peut pas demander de frappes aériennes.
Key.Spanish: Incluso aunque tengamos un blanco fácil, no puedo solicitar un ataque aéreo.
Key.Italian: Anche in mancanza di complicazioni, non potrei richiedere un attacco aereo.
Key.Polish: Nawet gdybyśmy mieli czyste podejście, nie mógłbym wezwać uderzenia z powietrza.
Key.Russian: Так что, даже если бы я и хотел, я не смогу нанести авиаудар.
Key.German: Auch wenn die Luft rein ist, kann ich nicht einfach einen Luftschlag anfordern.
Key.Czech: I kdyby šlo všechno jak na drátkách, nemůžu si přivolat leteckej nálet.
Key.English: Even if we had a clear run, I can't go calling in airstrikes.
Key.Portuguese: Mesmo se fosse permitido, não posso convocar ataques aéreos à toa.
Key.Korean: 목표물이 정확히 확보된다고 해도 공습은 요청할 수가 없단 말이지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 即使我们做得到，我也不能呼叫空袭。
Key.Japanese: どんなにうまくいってても、空爆を要請することはできない。
Key.Turkish: Temiz bir operasyon yürütsek bile hava saldırıları çağıramam.

Key.Original: Though, options are always welcome.
Key.Chinese: 不過，有得選擇當然是好事。
Key.French: Mais on reste ouverts à toute proposition.
Key.Spanish: Aunque nunca está de más tener opciones.
Key.Italian: Tuttavia, eventuali alternative sono ben accette.
Key.Polish: Ale dodatkowe możliwości zawsze się przydadzą.
Key.German: Vielleicht fällt dir ja was ein ...
Key.English: Though, options are always welcome.
Key.Portuguese: Mesmo assim, opções sempre são bem-vindas.
Key.Korean: 물론 그렇게 할 수만 있다면 나야 좋지만.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过，有选择总是不错的。
Key.Japanese: だが、オプションはいつでも歓迎だ。

Container.name: 114_eve_radar_station_out_call
Container.situation: miller responds to player's destruction of a radar site.

Key.Original: I guess that's your handiwork?
Key.French: Grâce à toi, j'imagine ?
Key.Spanish: Supongo que es cosa tuya, ¿no?
Key.Italian: Immagino che sia opera tua?
Key.Russian: Я полагаю, это твоих рук дело?
Key.German: Warst du das?
Key.Czech: Hádám, že to bude tvoje práce?
Key.English: I guess that's your handiwork?
Key.Portuguese: Imagino que isso seja obra sua, não?
Key.Japanese: お前がやってくれたんだよな？
Key.Turkish: Sanırım bu senin eserin, değil mi?

Key.Original: I'm impressed! Keep it up. The more chaos we can make, the better.
Key.Chinese: 了不起！再接再厲，我們造成越多混亂越好。
Key.French: Impressionnant, continue comme ça. Plus on alimente le chaos, mieux c'est.
Key.Spanish: ¡Me dejas de piedra! Que no decaiga. Cuanto más caos provoquemos, mejor.
Key.Italian: Sono sbalordito! Continua così. Più scompiglio creiamo, meglio sarà.
Key.Polish: Jestem pod wrażeniem! Tak trzymaj. Im większy zasiejemy zamęt, tym lepiej.
Key.Russian: Впечатляет! Так держать. Чем больше хаоса мы можем создать, тем лучше.
Key.German: Ich bin beeindruckt, weiter so! Je mehr Verwirrung wir stiften können, desto besser.
Key.Czech: Klobouk dolů! A jen tak dál. Čím větší chaos způsobíme, tím líp.
Key.English: I'm impressed! Keep it up. The more chaos we can make, the better.
Key.Portuguese: Tô impressionado! Continue assim. Quanto mais caos a gente criar, melhor.
Key.Korean: 정말 대단해! 계속 그렇게만 해줘. 더 큰 혼란을 일으킬 수록 우리에게 유리하니까.
Key.Chinesesimp: 佩服！继续努力。制造的乱子越多越好。
Key.Japanese: すごいじゃないか！その調子だ。混乱をもっと引き起こせば、それだけ上手を取りやすくなる。
Key.Turkish: Etkilendim! Aynen devam. Ne kadar karmaşa yaratırsak o kadar iyi.

Container.name: 113_eve_second_radar_destroyed_call
Container.situation: miller responds to player's destruction of a secondary radar site.

Key.Original: One of my guys just confirmed CSAT's mobile radar station's down!
Key.Chinese: 我的人剛剛確認了 CSAT 的機動雷達站關閉了！
Key.French: On me confirme que le radar mobile du CSAT est neutralisé !
Key.Spanish: ¡Uno de mis hombres acaba de confirmar que la estación de radar móvil del CSAT está fuera!
Key.Italian: Uno dei miei ha confermato che la stazione radar mobile della CSAT è fuori uso!
Key.Polish: Jeden z moich ludzi potwierdził, że mobilna stacja radarowa CSAT nie działa!
Key.Russian: Один из моих парней только что подтвердил, что мобильная радиолокационная станция CSAT выведена из строя!
Key.German: Wir konnten soeben bestätigen, dass CSATs mobile Radarstation lahmgelegt wurde!
Key.Czech: Jeden z mých lidí právě potvrdil, že mobilní radar CSAT je zneškodněnej!
Key.English: One of my guys just confirmed CSAT's mobile radar station's down!
Key.Portuguese: Um dos meus camaradas acabou de confirmar que a principal estação de radar móvel da CSAT já era!
Key.Korean: 우리 부대원들 중 한 명이 CSAT의 이동 레이더 기지가 파괴된 것을 확인했어!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我的一个伙计刚刚确认 CSAT 的移动雷达站挂了！
Key.Japanese: 俺の隊員が今 CSAT の可動性のレーダー基地の破壊を確認した！
Key.Turkish: Adamlarımdan biri CSAT’nin bir mobil radar istasyonunun düştüğünü doğruladı!

Container.name: 112_eve_main_radar_destroyed_call
Container.situation: miller responds to player's destruction of a key radar site, at the inactive volcano.

Key.Original: One of my guys just confirmed CSAT's main radar station's down!
Key.Chinese: 我的人剛剛確認了 CSAT 的主雷達站關閉了！
Key.French: On me confirme que le radar principal du CSAT est neutralisé !
Key.Spanish: ¡Uno de mis hombres acaba de confirmar que la estación de radar principal del CSAT está fuera!
Key.Italian: Uno dei miei ha confermato che la stazione radar principale della CSAT è fuori uso!
Key.Polish: Jeden z moich ludzi potwierdził, że główna stacja radarowa CSAT nie działa!
Key.Russian: Один из моих парней только что подтвердил, что главная радиолокационная станция CSAT выведена из строя!
Key.German: Wir konnten soeben bestätigen, dass CSATs Hauptradarstation lahmgelegt wurde!
Key.Czech: Jeden z mých lidí právě potvrdil, že hlavní radar CSAT je zneškodněnej!
Key.English: One of my guys just confirmed CSAT's main radar station's down!
Key.Portuguese: Um dos meus camaradas acabou de confirmar que a principal estação de radar da CSAT já era!
Key.Korean: 우리 부대원들 중 한 명이 CSAT의 주요 레이더 기지가 파괴된 것을 확인했어!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我的一个伙计刚刚确认 CSAT 的主雷达站挂了！
Key.Japanese: 俺の隊員が今 CSAT のメインのレーダー基地の破壊を確認した！
Key.Turkish: Adamlarımdan biri CSAT’nin bir ana radar istasyonunun düştüğünü doğruladı!

Container.name: 111_eve_radar_destroyed_in_call
Container.situation: miller responds to player's destruction of a radar site.

Key.Original: Santiago, Keystone.
Key.French: Santiago, Keystone.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, aquí Keystone.
Key.Italian: Santiago, qui è Keystone.
Key.German: Santiago, hier ist Keystone.
Key.English: Santiago, Keystone.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, Lastro aqui.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、キーストーンだ。

Container.name: 110_ta_second_radar_found_main_call
Container.situation: player sees secondary radar site and sends an sms to miller. miller explains to player the threat of aa on the island and asks him to help take down the radar. there is also a primary radar site, miller warns.

Key.Original: But don't get too excited. It's an auxiliary station.
Key.Chinese: 不過別太興奮了，這不過是輔助站。
Key.French: Mais ne t'enflamme pas, c'est une station auxiliaire.
Key.Spanish: Pero no te me vengas arriba, que es una estación auxiliar.
Key.Italian: Ma non esaltarti troppo, si tratta di una stazione ausiliaria.
Key.Polish: Nie ciesz się za bardzo. To stacja pomocnicza.
Key.Russian: Но нам еще рано радоваться. Это всего лишь вспомогательная станция.
Key.German: Aber freuen wir uns nicht zu früh ... das ist nicht die Hauptstation.
Key.Czech: Ale moc se neraduj. Je to jen vedlejší stanice.
Key.English: But don't get too excited. It's an auxiliary station.
Key.Portuguese: Mas não se anime demais. É uma estação auxiliar.
Key.Korean: 하지만 너무 흥분할 건 없어. 그건 보조 기지니까 말이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过别太激动，这只是个辅助雷达站。
Key.Japanese: あんまり浮かれるな。あくまで補助的な基地なんだからな。
Key.Turkish: Fakat fazla heyecanlanma. Bu tali bir istasyon.

Key.Original: The main one's over on Mont Tanoa.
Key.French: La principale se trouve sur le Mont Tanoa.
Key.Spanish: La principal está en Mont Tanoa.
Key.Italian: Quella principale è sul Mont Tanoa.
Key.German: Die steht drüben auf Mont Tanoa.
Key.Czech: Ta hlavní je na Mont Tanoa.
Key.English: The main one's over on Mont Tanoa.
Key.Portuguese: O principal tá no Mont Tanoa.
Key.Korean: 주요 기지는 타노아 산 위에 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 主站在那边的他诺亚山上。
Key.Japanese: メインのやつはモン・タノアにある。

Key.Original: Both would have to go to take those launchers offline.
Key.Chinese: 解決掉這兩個後，發射器就會關閉。
Key.French: Il faut neutraliser les deux pour désactiver les lanceurs.
Key.Spanish: Hay que cargarse las dos para desconectar esos lanzamisiles.
Key.Italian: Entrambe devono essere distrutte per mettere fuori gioco quei lanciatori.
Key.Polish: Żeby wyłączyć wyrzutnie, będzie trzeba wyeliminować obie.
Key.Russian: Чтобы избавиться от этих ракетных установок, нам придется отключить обе станции.
Key.German: Wir müssen beide ausschalten, um die Luftabwehr lahmzulegen.
Key.Czech: Abysme se raketometů zbavili, musíme zničit oba.
Key.English: Both would have to go to take those launchers offline.
Key.Portuguese: É preciso acabar com ambos pra desativar esses lançadores.
Key.Korean: 미사일 발사기를 작동 불능 상태로 만들려면 둘 다 파괴해야 돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 得把两个站都干掉才能让那些发射器失灵。
Key.Japanese: あのランチャーをオフラインにするには、両方とも破壊する必要がある。
Key.Turkish: İkiniz gidip o fırlatıcıları devre dışı bırakmalısınız.

Container.name: 109_ta_second_radar_found_main_known_call
Container.situation: player sees secondary radar site and sends an sms to miller. miller explains to player the threat of aa on the island and asks him to help take down the radar. there is also a primary radar site, miller warns.

Key.Original: It must be the back-up I mentioned.
Key.Chinese: 那肯定就是我提到的備用雷達。
Key.French: Ce doit être l'appui dont je parlais.
Key.Spanish: Debe de ser el radar secundario que te dije.
Key.Italian: Deve essere il supporto di cui ti parlavo.
Key.Polish: To pewnie stacja zapasowa, o której mówiłem.
Key.Russian: Должно быть, это и есть та вспомогательная станция, про которую я говорил.
Key.German: Das muss die Sekundärstation sein, von der ich gesprochen habe.
Key.Czech: Musí to být ten záložní, jak jsem říkal.
Key.English: It must be the back-up I mentioned.
Key.Portuguese: Ele deve ser o backup que mencionei.
Key.Korean: 내가 얘기했던 그 백업 레이더인 것 같아.
Key.Chinesesimp: 它肯定就是我说过的备用雷达。
Key.Japanese: 俺がさっき言った予備のやつだ。

Container.name: 108_ta_second_radar_found_in_call
Container.situation: player sees primary radar site and sends an sms to miller. miller explains to player the threat of aa on the island and asks him to help take down the radar. there is also a secondary radar site, miller warns.

Key.Original: Heya - it's me.
Key.French: Hé, c'est moi.
Key.Spanish: Hola, soy yo.
Key.Italian: Ehilà, sono io.
Key.German: Hey, ich bin‘s.
Key.English: Heya - it's me.
Key.Portuguese: Opa, sou eu.
Key.Japanese: やあ、俺だ。

Key.Original: That radar's providing target acquisition for CSAT's SAM sites...
Key.Chinese: 那個雷達正在為 CSAT 的地對空武器提供瞄準輔助……
Key.French: Ce radar transmet des données d'acquisition aux lanceurs AA du CSAT.
Key.Spanish: Ese radar marca los objetivos de los misiles tierra-aire del CSAT...
Key.Italian: Quel radar sta fornendo l’acquisizione dei bersagli per i siti SAM della CSAT...
Key.Polish: Ten radar namierza cele dla wyrzutni CSAT…
Key.Russian: Эта РЛС помогает ПЗРК CSAT с обнаружением целей...
Key.German: Der Radar fungiert als Zielerfassung für CSATs SAM-Stationen ...
Key.Czech: Tenhle radar poskytuje zaměřovací data protivzdušným raketometům CSAT.
Key.English: That radar's providing target acquisition for CSAT's SAM sites...
Key.Portuguese: Aquele radar está gerando a aquisição de alvo para os pontos de mísseis terra-ar da CSAT...
Key.Korean: 그 레이더는 CSAT의 지대공 미사일 발사기를 위한 표적 제원을 제공하고 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那个雷达在为 CSAT 的 SAM 导弹阵地截获目标...
Key.Japanese: あのレーダーは CSAT の SAM サイトのために目標捕捉をしている...
Key.Turkish: O radar CSAT’nin karadan havaya füze bölgeleri için hedef yakalama sağlıyor...

Container.name: 107_ta_destroy_radar_main_intel_call
Container.situation: player discovers primary radar station and sends an sms to miller. miller explains to player the threat of aa on the island and asks him to help take down the radar.

Key.Original: Santiago - great going.
Key.French: Santiago, super boulot.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, te has portado.
Key.Italian: Santiago, bene così.
Key.German: Santiago, gute Arbeit.
Key.English: Santiago - great going.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, muito bom.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、よくやった。

Key.Original: CSAT rely on two radar stations for coverage.
Key.Chinese: CSAT 僅靠兩台雷達站來進行監測。
Key.French: Le CSAT s'appuie sur deux stations radars pour sa protection.
Key.Spanish: Dos estaciones de radar proporcionan cobertura al CSAT.
Key.Italian: La CSAT dipende da due stazioni radar per la copertura.
Key.Polish: CSAT polega na dwóch stacjach radarowych.
Key.German: CSAT benötigt zwei Radarstationen, um den gesamten Bereich abzudecken.
Key.Czech: CSAT spoléhá na data ze dvou radarů.
Key.English: CSAT rely on two radar stations for coverage.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT conta com duas estações de radar para cobertura.
Key.Korean: CSAT는 지역을 커버하기 위해 두 개의 레이더 기지에 의존하고 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: CSAT 依赖两个雷达站提供制导。
Key.Japanese: CSAT は広い範囲を確保するために 2 つのレーダー基地を使っている。
Key.Turkish: CSAT, kapsama alanı için iki radar istasyonu kullanıyor.

Key.Original: The main one we now know about. The other, an auxiliary, we haven't got a fix on yet.
Key.Chinese: 主站位置我們已知道，而另一個輔助站的確切位置仍然不詳。
Key.French: On connaît la principale. On n'a pas encore localisé la station auxiliaire.
Key.Spanish: Ahora sabemos dónde está la principal. La otra, una auxiliar, todavía no la tenemos localizada.
Key.Italian: Quella principale è ora nota. L’altra, ausiliaria, non sappiamo ancora dove si trovi.
Key.Polish: Ważniejszą już mamy. Drugiej, pomocniczej, jeszcze nie zlokalizowaliśmy.
Key.Russian: Где главная, мы уже знаем. Однако мы еще не смогли найти вторую, вспомогательную.
Key.German: Die Hauptstation ist uns bekannt. Die andere ist eine Sekundärstation, die wir noch aufspüren müssen.
Key.Czech: O tom hlavním už víme. Ten druhej, vedlejší, jsme zatím nenašli.
Key.English: The main one we now know about. The other, an auxiliary, we haven't got a fix on yet.
Key.Portuguese: A principal sabemos onde está agora. A outra, que é auxiliar, ainda não temos a localização exata.
Key.Korean: 주요 레이더 기지의 위치는 이미 알고 있어. 또 다른 보조 레이더 기지는 아직 위치를 파악하지 못했어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 目前我们知道主雷达站的情况。另一处，辅助雷达站，我们还不确定。
Key.Japanese: メインの基地の場所は分かった。もう 1 つは補助的な基地で、まだ場所は特定できていない。
Key.Turkish: Ana radar istasyonunu biliyoruz. Diğeri ise tali bir istasyon ve yerini henüz saptayamadık.

Key.Original: But if we destroy both, all their SAM sites would be useless, leaving only lesser AA threats.
Key.Chinese: 若我們能摧毀它們，那些地對空武器就跟廢鐵沒兩樣。這樣的話就只剩下威脅較小的防空武器。
Key.French: En neutralisant les deux bases, les batteries seront inutilisables, et la menace AA restera limitée.
Key.Spanish: Pero, si destruimos ambas, todos sus misiles tierra-aire serán inútiles y solo habrá amenazas antiaéreas de menor importancia.
Key.Italian: Tuttavia, se le distruggiamo entrambe, tutti i loro siti SAM saranno inutili e diminuiremo le minacce antiaeree.
Key.Polish: Jeśli zniszczymy obydwie, wyeliminujemy wszystkie wyrzutnie, trzon ich obrony przeciwlotniczej.
Key.Russian: Если мы сможем уничтожить их обе, то их ПЗРК будут бесполезны, а нам останется лишь разобраться с более мелкими зенитными орудиями.
Key.German: Aber wenn wir beide zerstören, schalten wir damit die SAM-Stationen aus. Dann wären nur noch ein paar geringere Luftabwehr-Bedrohungen vor Ort.
Key.Czech: Ale když je zničíme oba, budou jim raketomety k ničemu a zůstanou jenom slabší protiletecký zbraně.
Key.English: But if we destroy both, all their SAM sites would be useless, leaving only lesser AA threats.
Key.Portuguese: Mas se destruirmos as duas, todos os pontos de mísseis terra-ar seriam inutilizados, restando apenas ameaças AA menores.
Key.Korean: 하지만 레이더 두 개를 모두 파괴하면, 모든 지대공 미사일 발사기는 무용지물이 돼서 덜 위협적인 대공 방어 시설만 남게 될 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过如果我们把两个雷达站都摧毁，所有 SAM 发射场都会失去作用，只剩下威力较小的 AA 构成威胁了。
Key.Japanese: だが、両方とも破壊すれば、SAM サイトは使い物にならなくなる。威力の比較的弱い対空兵力が残るだけだ。
Key.Turkish: İkisini birden yok edersek tüm karadan havaya füze bölgeleri işlevini yitirir ve böylece daha az hava savunma tehdidiyle karşı karşıya kalırız.

Container.name: 106_ta_destroy_radar_a_call
Container.situation: player discovers intel on aa and sends an sms to miller. miller explains to player the threat of aa on the island and asks him to help take down the radar.

Key.Original: Santiago - great going on that last bit of intel.
Key.Chinese: Santiago－－你找到情報真是太好了。
Key.French: Santiago, super boulot avec ces infos.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, esa última información ha sido canela fina.
Key.Italian: Santiago, ottimo lavoro con le ultime informazioni.
Key.Polish: Santiago, świetna robota z tymi danymi.
Key.Russian: Сантьяго, последние разведданные – то, что надо.
Key.German: Santiago, das war gute Arbeit mit den letzten Informationen.
Key.Czech: Santiago, skvělá práce se získáním těch informací.
Key.English: Santiago - great going on that last bit of intel.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, bom trabalho com essa última informação.
Key.Korean: 산티아고. 마지막으로 전달한 정보는 큰 도움이 됐어.
Key.Chinesesimp: Santiago - 最后那份情报干得好。
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、さっきの情報はよかったぞ。
Key.Turkish: Santiago, son istihbaratla ilgili harika iş çıkarıyorsun.

Key.Original: Now we have the positions of CSAT's air defenses.
Key.Chinese: 現在我們知道了 CSAT 防空系統的位置。
Key.French: On connaît la position des défenses aériennes du CSAT.
Key.Spanish: Ahora tenemos las posiciones de las defensas aéreas del CSAT.
Key.Italian: Ora abbiamo le posizioni delle difese aeree della CSAT.
Key.Polish: Wiemy, jak CSAT rozmieściło obronę przeciwlotniczą.
Key.Russian: Теперь у нас есть позиции противовоздушной обороны CSAT.
Key.German: Wir kennen jetzt die Position von CSATs Luftabwehr.
Key.Czech: Teď známe pozice protivzdušné obrany CSAT.
Key.English: Now we have the positions of CSAT's air defenses.
Key.Portuguese: Agora temos as posições das defesas aéreas do CSAT.
Key.Korean: 이제 CSAT의 대공 방어 장비의 위치를 확보했거든.
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在我们知道了 CSAT 防空系统的方位。
Key.Japanese: これで CSAT の防空システムの場所が分かった。
Key.Turkish: Artık CSAT’nin hava savunma sistemlerinin konumları elimizde.

Key.Original: The mobile SAM sites...
Key.Chinese: 機動地對空導彈的位置……
Key.French: Ces batteries mobiles...
Key.Spanish: Las ubicaciones de los misiles tierra-aire móviles...
Key.Italian: I siti SAM mobili...
Key.German: Mobile SAM-Stationen ...
Key.English: The mobile SAM sites...
Key.Portuguese: Os pontos móveis dos mísseis terra-ar...
Key.Japanese: 可動性の SAM サイト...

Key.Original: They rely on two radar stations for coverage.
Key.Chinese: 他們僅靠兩台雷達站來進行監測。
Key.French: Elles s'appuient sur deux stations radars.
Key.Spanish: Dos estaciones de radar les proporcionan cobertura.
Key.Italian: Dipendono da due stazioni radar per la copertura.
Key.German: Sie benötigen zwei Radarstationen, um den gesamten Bereich abzudecken.
Key.Czech: spoléhají na data ze dvou radarů.
Key.English: They rely on two radar stations for coverage.
Key.Portuguese: Eles possuem duas estações de radar para cobertura.
Key.Korean: 놈들은 그 지역을 커버하기 위해서 두 개의 레이더 기지에 의존하고 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们依赖两个雷达站提供制导。
Key.Japanese: 広い範囲を確保するために 2 つのレーダー基地を使っている。
Key.Turkish: Kapsama alanı için iki radar istasyonu kullanıyorlar.

Key.Original: The main one is on Mont Tanoa. The other, an auxiliary, we haven't got a fix on yet.
Key.Chinese: 主雷達站位於塔諾雅山，另一個輔助雷達站的確切位置仍然不詳。
Key.French: La principale se trouve sur le Mont Tanoa. On n'a pas encore localisé la station auxiliaire.
Key.Spanish: La principal está en Mont Tanoa. La otra, una auxiliar, todavía no la tenemos localizada.
Key.Italian: Quella principale è sul Mont Tanoa. L’altra, ausiliaria, non sappiamo ancora dove si trovi.
Key.Polish: Ważniejsza znajduje się na Mont Tanoa. Drugiej, pomocniczej, jeszcze nie zlokalizowaliśmy.
Key.Russian: Главная станция находится на Монт Таноа. Однако мы еще не смогли найти вторую, вспомогательную.
Key.German: Eine davon ist auf Mont Tanoa. Die andere ist eine Sekundärstation, die wir noch aufspüren müssen.
Key.Czech: Ten hlavní je na Mont Tanoa. Ten druhej, vedlejší, jsme zatím nenašli.
Key.English: The main one is on Mont Tanoa. The other, an auxiliary, we haven't got a fix on yet.
Key.Portuguese: A principal delas é no Mont Tanoa. A outra, que é auxiliar, ainda não conseguimos confirmação.
Key.Korean: 주요 레이더 기지는 타노아 산에 있어. 보조 레이더 기지는 아직 위치를 파악하지 못했어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 主雷达站位于蒙特塔诺阿。至于辅助雷达站的位置，我们还不确定。
Key.Japanese: メインの基地はモン・タノアにある。もう 1 つは補助的な基地で、まだ場所は特定できていない。
Key.Turkish: Ana radar istasyonu Mont Tanoa’da. Diğeri ise tali bir istasyon ve yerini henüz saptayamadık.

Key.Original: But if we destroy both, those launchers would be useless, leaving only lesser AA threats.
Key.Chinese: 但是，如果我們能摧毀這兩個雷達站，那些發射器就跟廢鐵沒兩樣。這樣的話就只剩下威脅較小的防空武器。
Key.French: En neutralisant les deux bases, les lanceurs seront inutilisables, et la couverture AA restera limitée.
Key.Spanish: Pero, si destruimos ambas, esos lanzamisiles serán inútiles y solo habrá amenazas antiaéreas de menor importancia.
Key.Italian: Tuttavia, se le distruggiamo entrambe, quei lanciatori saranno inutili e diminuiremo le minacce antiaeree.
Key.Polish: Jeśli zniszczymy obydwie, wyeliminujemy trzon ich obrony przeciwlotniczej.
Key.Russian: Если мы сможем уничтожить их обе, то их ПЗРК будут бесполезны, а нам останется лишь разобраться с более мелкими зенитными орудиями.
Key.German: Aber wenn wir beide zerstören, schalten wir damit die Luftabwehrstationen aus. Dann wären nur noch ein paar geringere Luftabwehr-Bedrohungen vor Ort.
Key.Czech: Ale když je zničíme oba, budou jim raketomety k ničemu a zůstanou jenom slabší protiletecký zbraně.
Key.English: But if we destroy both, those launchers would be useless, leaving only lesser AA threats.
Key.Portuguese: Mas se destruirmos as duas, esses lançadores se tornariam inúteis, restando apenas ameaças AA menores.
Key.Korean: 하지만 레이더 두 개를 모두 파괴하면, 지대공 미사일 발사기는 무용지물이 돼서 덜 위협적인 대공 방어 시설만 남게 될 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过如果我们把两个雷达站都摧毁，那些发射器就会失去作用，只剩下威力较小的 AA 构成威胁了。
Key.Japanese: だが、両方とも破壊すれば、ランチャーは使い物にならなくなる。威力の比較的弱い対空兵力が残るだけだ。
Key.Turkish: İkisini birden yok edersek fırlatıcılar işlevini yitirir ve böylece hava savunma tehdidimiz azalır.

Container.name: 105_ta_reboot_fail
Container.situation: miller alerts player that the system reboot has been interrupted and that their plan failed.

Key.Original: Ah, fuck!
Key.French: Ah, putain !
Key.Spanish: ¡Ay, joder!
Key.Italian: Ah, merda!
Key.German: Ach, Scheiße!
Key.English: Ah, fuck!
Key.Portuguese: Ah, caralho!
Key.Japanese: クソッ！

Key.Original: Go! Move!
Key.French: Vas-y ! Tire-toi !
Key.Spanish: ¡Vamos, adelante!
Key.Italian: Vai! Muoviti!
Key.German: Los! Bewegung!
Key.English: Go! Move!
Key.Portuguese: Vai! Anda!
Key.Japanese: 行け！急げ！

Key.Original: The upload didn't complete, someone must have stopped it!
Key.Chinese: 上傳沒有完成，一定是被人中斷了！
Key.French: Le virus n'est pas prêt, le processus a été interrompu !
Key.Spanish: El virus no ha terminado de cargarse. ¡Alguien lo ha interrumpido!
Key.Italian: Il caricamento non è stato completato, qualcuno deve averlo interrotto!
Key.Polish: Nie załadowaliśmy wirusa, ktoś nam przeszkodził!
Key.Russian: Загрузка не завершена, похоже, что кто-то прервал ее!
Key.German: Der Upload wurde nicht beendet. Jemand muss ihn abgebrochen haben!
Key.Czech: Nahrávání se nedokončilo, někdo ho musel zastavit.
Key.English: The upload didn't complete, someone must have stopped it!
Key.Portuguese: O upload não foi concluído, alguém deve ter impedido!
Key.Korean: 업로드가 중단됐어. 누군가 방해한 게 분명해!
Key.Chinesesimp: 上传没完成，肯定有人终止了它！
Key.Japanese: アップロードを完了できなかった。誰かに止められたんだ！

Container.name: 104_ta_reboot_complete_urgent
Container.situation: miller notifies player that the reboot is complete.

Key.Original: Alright, that's it - we're in - go!
Key.French: OK, on est connectés. Tire-toi !
Key.Spanish: Vale, ya está. Estamos dentro. ¡Adelante!
Key.Italian: Okay, siamo dentro! Vattene!
Key.Russian: Отлично, у нас есть доступ. Вали!
Key.German: Alles klar, das war‘s. Wir sind drin. Los!
Key.Czech: Výborně, to je ono. Jsme tam! Utíkej!
Key.English: Alright, that's it - we're in - go!
Key.Portuguese: Tudo certo, já foi. Entramos. Sai daí!
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吧，就这样了 - 我们进来了 - 快走！
Key.Japanese: よし、それでいい。アクセスできた。行け！
Key.Turkish: Pekâlâ, işte bu kadar; erişim sağladık. Koş!

Container.name: 103_ta_reboot_complete

Key.Japanese: よし、アクセスできたぞ。脱出しろ。

Key.Spanish: ¡Ay, coño!
Key.Italian: Ah, merda!
Key.German: Ach, Scheiße.
Key.English: Ah, shit!
Key.Portuguese: Ah, merda!
Key.Japanese: ああ、くそっ！

Key.Original: Okay, listen - we can't gain access before the OS kicks in.
Key.Chinese: 好了，聽著－－作業系統啟動前，我們無法存取電腦。
Key.French: OK, écoute. On n'aura pas accès tant que l'OS n'aura pas redémarré.

Key.Original: Stay put.
Key.French: Bouge pas.
Key.Spanish: Mantente a la espera.
Key.Italian: Non muoverti.
Key.German: Halte durch.
Key.English: Stay put.
Key.Portuguese: Fica aí.
Key.Japanese: そこから動くな。

Key.Original: Don't let CSAT pull the plug!
Key.French: Empêche le CSAT de le débrancher !
Key.Spanish: ¡Que no lo apaguen los del CSAT!
Key.Italian: Non lasciare che la CSAT mandi tutto all’aria!
Key.German: Lass CSAT nicht den Stecker ziehen!
Key.English: Don't let CSAT pull the plug!
Key.Portuguese: Não deixa a CSAT puxar a tomada!
Key.Korean: CSAT 놈들이 컴퓨터를 끄게 놔두면 안 돼!
Key.Chinesesimp: 别让 CSAT 把插头拔掉！
Key.Japanese: CSAT に邪魔させるなよ！

Container.name: 094_eve_reboot_starts_call
Container.situation: player starts the reboot of csat's computer.

Key.Original: The second the OS kicks in, get out of there, we'll have access.
Key.Chinese: 作業系統啟動後趕快離開，這樣我們就能存取它了。
Key.French: Une fois l'OS en route, tire-toi. On aura accès.
Key.Spanish: Tan pronto arranque el sistema operativo, sal de ahí, porque ya tendremos acceso.
Key.Italian: Quando parte il sistema operativo vai via da lì, da quel momento avremo accesso al computer.
Key.Polish: Jak tylko system zaskoczy, zmiataj stamtąd – będziemy mieć dostęp.
Key.Russian: Вали оттуда, как только загрузится операционка – к этому моменту у нас уже будет доступ.
Key.German: Sobald das zweite Betriebssystem startet, sind wir drin, und du kannst dich aus dem Staub machen.
Key.Czech: Jakmile naskočí operační systém, vypadni. Přístup už budeme mít.
Key.English: The second the OS kicks in, get out of there, we'll have access.
Key.Portuguese: Assim que o sistema operacional entrar, dá o fora daí, vamos estar com acesso.
Key.Korean: 운영체제가 실행되면 즉시 그곳에서 나와. 그럼 우리쪽에서 접근할 수 있을 테니까.
Key.Chinesesimp: 操作系统一启动，马上离开那儿，我们就能访问了。
Key.Japanese: OS が立ち上がったら、すぐにそこから逃げろ。立ち上がりさえすればアクセスできるからな。
Key.Turkish: İşletim sistemi devreye girer girmez oradan çık; artık erişim sağlayabiliriz.

Container.name: 093_eve_flashdrive_inserted_call
Container.situation: miller contacts player and reminds him to reboot the system.

Key.Original: Santiago. Connection's good.
Key.French: Santiago. La connexion est bonne.
Key.Spanish: Santiago. La conexión es buena.
Key.Italian: Santiago. La connessione è buona.
Key.German: Santiago, die Verbindung steht.
Key.English: Santiago. Connection's good.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago. A conexão tá boa.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ。接続は良好だ。

Key.Original: Close down that computer then start it up again.
Key.Chinese: 關閉那台電腦，然後重新啟動。
Key.French: Éteins l'ordi puis redémarre-le.
Key.Spanish: Apaga ese ordenador y reinícialo.
Key.Italian: Arresta il computer e poi avvialo di nuovo.
Key.Polish: Wyłącz komputer i odpal go jeszcze raz.
Key.German: Fahr den Computer runter und starte ihn neu.
Key.Czech: Vypni ten počítač a potom ho znova zapni.
Key.English: Close down that computer then start it up again.
Key.Portuguese: Fecha o computador e inicia ele de novo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 关掉那台电脑，再启动它。
Key.Japanese: そのコンピュータをシャットダウンして、再起動させるんだ。

Container.name: 092_eve_miller_focus_on_task_angry_call
Container.situation: miller calls player and urges him to focus on the task he has assigned.

Key.Original: Santiago, get your arse in gear. Install that virus!
Key.Chinese: Santiago，快準備好，然後去安裝病毒！
Key.French: Santiago, bouge ton cul. Installe le virus !
Key.Spanish: Santiago, que no tenga que ponerte un cohete en el culo. ¡Instala ese virus ya!
Key.Italian: Santiago, muovi il culo. Installa quel virus!
Key.Russian: Сантьяго, шевели копытами. Установи этот вирус!
Key.German: Santiago, beweg deinen Arsch und installiere diesen Virus!
Key.Czech: Santiago, koukej se sebrat. A nainstaluj ten virus!
Key.English: Santiago, get your arse in gear. Install that virus!
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, pode começar a se mexer. É hora de instalar esse vírus!
Key.Korean: 산티아고, 빨리 움직여. 바이러스를 설치하란 말이야!
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、さっさとしろ。そのウィルスをインストールするんだ！
Key.Turkish: Santiago, kıçını kaldır. Yükle şu virüsü!

Key.Original: Once those defenses are offline, we can make a move on the weapon's lab and end this thing.
Key.Chinese: 一旦防禦系統關閉，我們就能攻擊武器實驗室並摧毀那個東西。
Key.French: Une fois les défenses désactivées, on pourra avancer sur le labo et en finir.
Key.Spanish: Cuando las defensas estén desconectadas, podremos atacar el laboratorio armamentístico y acabar con todo esto.
Key.Italian: Una volta disabilitate quelle difese, potremo passare al laboratorio e porre fine a questa storia.
Key.Polish: Kiedy zabezpieczenia padną, będziemy mogli wkroczyć do laboratorium i ukręcić temu łeb.
Key.Russian: Как только система защиты будет отключена, мы сможем взять лабораторию штурмом и положить этому конец.
Key.German: Sobald die Verteidigungsanlagen ausgeschaltet sind, können wir das Waffenlabor stürmen und diese Sache beenden.
Key.Czech: Až bude obrana offline, můžeme se přesunout do laboratoře na vývoj zbraní a skoncovat s tím.
Key.English: Once those defenses are offline, we can make a move on the weapon's lab and end this thing.
Key.Portuguese: Quando as defesas estiverem desativadas, podemos avançar contra o laboratório de armas e dar cabo disso.
Key.Korean: 방어 시스템이 꺼지면 무기 실험실로 가서 이 모든 걸 끝낼 수 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一旦防守系统离线，我们就能进入实验室，把这事了结掉。
Key.Japanese: 防御システムがオフラインになったら、武器の研究所へ移動して全てを終わらせるぞ。
Key.Turkish: Savunma sistemleri devre dışı kaldığında silah laboratuvarına gidip bu işi bitirebiliriz.

Container.name: 091_eve_miller_focus_on_task_call
Container.situation: miller calls player and urges him to focus on the task he has assigned.

Key.Original: It's Keystone.
Key.French: Ici Keystone.
Key.Spanish: Aquí Keystone.
Key.Italian: Qui è Keystone.
Key.German: Hier ist Keystone.
Key.English: It's Keystone.
Key.Portuguese: Aqui é Lastro.
Key.Japanese: キーストーンだ。

Key.Original: How's our upload looking?
Key.French: Comment ça se présente avec le virus ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Qué tal pinta lo de cargar el virus?
Key.Italian: Come procede l’operazione?
Key.Russian: Ну что, как там с загрузкой?
Key.German: Wie sieht es mit dem Upload aus?
Key.Czech: Jak to vypadá s tím nahráváním?
Key.English: How's our upload looking?
Key.Portuguese: Como está nosso upload?
Key.Chinesesimp: 上传任务完成得怎么样了？
Key.Japanese: アップロードはどうなってる？

Key.Original: Remember, you'll have to get inside a restricted area.
Key.Chinese: 記得了，你必須進入禁區。
Key.French: Tu dois te rendre dans un secteur protégé.
Key.Spanish: Recuerda que tienes que acceder a una zona restringida.
Key.Italian: Ricorda, dovrai accedere a un’area riservata.
Key.Polish: Pamiętaj, musisz dostać się na obszar strzeżony.
Key.Russian: Напоминаю, что тебе нужно проникнуть в запретную зону.
Key.German: Vergiss nicht: Du musst in einen abgesperrten Bereich gelangen.
Key.Czech: Pamatuj, že se musíš dostat do vyhrazený oblasti.
Key.English: Remember, you'll have to get inside a restricted area.
Key.Portuguese: Não se esqueça, você vai ter que entrar numa área restrita.
Key.Korean: 제한구역 안으로 진입해야 한다는 사실을 잊지 마.
Key.Chinesesimp: 记住，你得进入一个禁区。
Key.Japanese: 忘れるな。制限エリアの中に入る必要があるからな。
Key.Turkish: Unutma, yasak bir bölgeye girmen gerekecek.

Key.Original: There's no way around it.
Key.French: Tu n'y échapperas pas.
Key.Spanish: No queda otra.
Key.Italian: Non c’è altro modo.
Key.German: Da führt kein Weg dran vorbei.
Key.English: There's no way around it.
Key.Portuguese: Não tem como evitar isso.
Key.Japanese: それだけは変えられない。

Key.Original: Once you're in, locating a computer should be easy.
Key.Chinese: 進去後，應該不難找到電腦。
Key.French: Une fois entré, ce sera facile de trouver un ordinateur.
Key.Spanish: Una vez dentro, no te costará encontrar un ordenador.
Key.Italian: Una volta entrato, non dovresti aver problemi a localizzare un computer.
Key.Russian: Как только окажешься там, найти компьютер не составит труда.
Key.German: Wenn du erstmal drin bist, solltest du schnell einen Computer finden.
Key.Czech: Až budeš vevnitř, najít počítač by měla být hračka.
Key.English: Once you're in, locating a computer should be easy.
Key.Portuguese: Depois de entrar, deve ser fácil achar um computador.
Key.Korean: 진입하면 컴퓨터는 쉽게 찾을 수 있을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 进去后，应该很容易找到一台电脑。
Key.Japanese: 中に入ってしまえば、コンピュータをすぐに見つけられるはずだ。
Key.Turkish: İçeri girdiğinde bilgisayar bulmak kolay olacaktır.

Key.Original: I'm sending you some information on a viable target site now.
Key.Chinese: 我現在給你傳一些可行的目標位置資料。
Key.French: Je t'envoie des infos au sujet d'un site potentiel.
Key.Spanish: Te mando información de una ubicación que podría ser un objetivo viable.
Key.Italian: Ti invio alcune informazioni su un sito di destinazione fattibile.
Key.Polish: Przesyłam ci informację na temat odpowiedniego miejsca.
Key.German: Ich schicke dir ein paar Infos zu einem möglichen Zielort.
Key.Czech: Posílám pár informací na vhodný cílový místo.
Key.English: I'm sending you some information on a viable target site now.
Key.Portuguese: Tô te enviando as informações de um local que é um alvo viável agora.
Key.Korean: 지금 공략 가능한 목표 지점에 대한 정보를 전송 중이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我现在给你发送一些关于合适目标地点的消息。
Key.Japanese: めぼしい目標サイトに関する情報を今すぐ送る。
Key.Turkish: Şimdi sana uygun bir hedef bölgesiyle ilgili bazı bilgiler gönderiyorum.

Container.name: 090_ta_virus_collected
Container.situation: player collects the flash drive.

Key.Original: All you have to do is stick it into one of CSAT's computers.
Key.Chinese: 你只需要把它插入 CSAT 的一台電腦就行了。
Key.French: Tu n'as qu'à la mettre dans un ordinateur du CSAT.
Key.Spanish: Tan solo tienes que enchufarlo en uno de los ordenadores del CSAT.
Key.Italian: Dovrai semplicemente inserirla in uno dei computer della CSAT.
Key.Polish: Wystarczy, że wetkniesz ją w jakiś komputer CSAT.
Key.Russian: Все, что тебе нужно сделать - это воткнуть ее в один из компьютеров CSAT.
Key.German: Du musst ihn bloß in einen von CSATs Computern stecken ...
Key.Czech: Stačí ji strčit do některýho z počítačů CSAT.
Key.English: All you have to do is stick it into one of CSAT's computers.
Key.Portuguese: Tudo o que você precisa fazer é enfiá-lo em um dos computadores da CSAT.
Key.Korean: 그걸 CSAT의 컴퓨터에 꽂기만 하면 돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你只需要把它插入 CSAT 的一台电脑就行了。
Key.Japanese: それを CSAT のコンピュータに差し込めばいいだけだ。
Key.Turkish: Tek yapman gereken, onu CSAT’nin bilgisayarlarından birine takmak.

Key.Original: And then, force a hard reboot. Just be aware - an isolated restart will set off the alarm.
Key.Chinese: 然後，強制重啟。不過小心了，獨立重啟會觸發警報。
Key.French: Ensuite, tu rebootes. Mais attention, un redémarrage isolé déclenchera l'alarme.
Key.Spanish: Y luego forzar un reinicio. Pero ojo, que un reinicio aislado disparará las alarmas.
Key.Italian: E poi forzare un riavvio a freddo. Fai attenzione: un riavvio isolato farà partire l’allarme.
Key.Polish: Potem zrób twardy reset. Tylko pamiętaj – taki odrębny restart uruchomi alarm.
Key.Russian: Затем нужно принудительно перезагрузить компьютер. Имей в виду, что при такой перезагрузке сработает тревога.
Key.German: ... und dann einen Neustart erzwingen. Aber pass auf, ein isolierter Neustart wird den Alarm auslösen.
Key.Czech: A potom ho vynuceně restartovat. Ale pozor – izolovanej restart aktivuje poplach.
Key.English: And then, force a hard reboot. Just be aware - an isolated restart will set off the alarm.
Key.Portuguese: E, daí, forçar uma reinicialização completa. Mas não se esqueça: o alarme aciona se você provocar uma reinicialização isolada.
Key.Korean: 그리고 나서, 강제 재시동을 시도해. 그냥 재시작을 하면 경보가 울리니까 조심해야 돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 然后强行重启。只是要注意 - 单独重启将触发警报。
Key.Japanese: その後、強制的に再起動させろ。だが、気を付けろ。1 台だけ再起動させることで警報を発動させてしまうからな。
Key.Turkish: Sonra da sistemi zorla yeniden başlatacaksın. Dikkatli ol; bağımsız yeniden başlatma işlemi alarmı çalıştıracaktır.

Key.Original: And it may take several minutes for our man to do his thing.
Key.Chinese: 而且，我們的人需要幾分鐘的時間完成入侵。
Key.French: Et notre technicien aura besoin de plusieurs minutes.
Key.Spanish: Y el informático puede tardar unos minutos en hacer su magia.
Key.Italian: E potrebbero essere necessari svariati minuti prima che il nostro uomo possa agire.
Key.Polish: A nasz człowiek może potrzebować paru minut.
Key.Russian: Нашему технарю может понадобиться несколько минут.
Key.German: Und unser Techniker braucht wahrscheinlich ein paar Minuten.
Key.Czech: A možná pár minut potrvá, než to náš člověk zvládne.
Key.English: And it may take several minutes for our man to do his thing.
Key.Portuguese: E pode levar uns minutos pra que nosso agente faça o que é necessário.
Key.Korean: 우리 팀원이 일을 마무리지으려면 몇 분 정도 걸릴 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 而且我们的人可能需要几分钟才能完成他要做的事。
Key.Japanese: こっちのやつが作業を終えるのにも数分かかるかもしれない。
Key.Turkish: Adamlarımızın işlerini halletmesi de birkaç dakika sürebilir.

Key.Original: You'll need an officer's keycard if you want to keep things quiet...
Key.Chinese: 如果你想要偷偷進行，你就得找到軍官的鑰匙卡……
Key.French: Il te faut une carte d'accès d'officier pour rester discret...
Key.Spanish: Te va a hacer falta la tarjeta de seguridad de un oficial para hacerlo con discreción...
Key.Italian: Avrai bisogno della chiave elettronica di un ufficiale per fare tutto con discrezione...
Key.Polish: Jeśli chcesz to zrobić po cichu, potrzebna będzie karta oficera…
Key.Russian: Тебе нужно раздобыть карточку офицера, если хочешь, чтобы всё прошло тихо...
Key.German: Wenn du die Sache leise durchziehen willst, brauchst du die Keycard eines Offiziers.
Key.Czech: Jestli nechceš vzbudit pozornost, budeš potřebovat přístupovou kartu důstojníka.
Key.English: You'll need an officer's keycard if you want to keep things quiet...
Key.Portuguese: Você vai precisar do cartão de um oficial se quiser manter as coisas silenciosas...
Key.Korean: 임무를 조용히 수행하려면 장교의 키카드가 필요해...
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你想偷偷进行，你就得找到军官的钥匙卡…
Key.Japanese: 警戒されたくないなら、士官のキーカードが必要だろう...
Key.Turkish: Bunu sessiz bir şekilde halletmek istiyorsan bir görevlinin anahtar kartına ihtiyacın olacak...

Container.name: 089_eve_upload_virus
Container.situation: player receives instructions from miller on disabling the autonomous turrets.

Key.Original: So, er, we've put together a virus.
Key.Chinese: 這，嗯，我們準備好了一個病毒。
Key.French: Bon, on a créé un virus.
Key.Spanish: El caso es que... hemos programado un virus.
Key.Italian: Allora... abbiamo creato un virus.
Key.German: Wir ... ähm ... haben einen Virus programmiert.
Key.English: So, er, we've put together a virus.
Key.Portuguese: Então, ahn, criamos um vírus.
Key.Chinesesimp: 是这样的，呃，我们制造了一种病毒。
Key.Japanese: それでだ、その、ウィルスを作った。

Key.Original: It's old school, I know, but we can make it work.
Key.Chinese: 雖然說有些古板，但是，我們可以做到的。
Key.French: C'est pas très original, mais ça peut marcher.
Key.Spanish: Es bastante clasicote, pero podemos hacer que funcione.
Key.Italian: Lo so, è un piano alla vecchia maniera, ma possiamo farlo funzionare.
Key.Polish: Tak, wiem, stara szkoła, ale zda egzamin.
Key.Russian: Дубовый подход, но он должен сработать.
Key.German: Ich weiß, das ist ein wenig antiquiert, aber es dient unserem Zweck.
Key.Czech: Dost staromódní věc, já vím. Ale měl by fungovat.
Key.English: It's old school, I know, but we can make it work.
Key.Portuguese: É coisa da velha guarda, eu sei, mas podemos fazer isso funcionar.
Key.Korean: 오래된 방법이긴 하지만, 효과는 있을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我知道这办法很老套，不过能奏效。
Key.Japanese: 古臭い手なのは分かってるが、きっとうまくいく。
Key.Turkish: Biliyorum, eski tarz bir iş ama işe yarayabilir.

Key.Original: Of course, doing a manual upload...
Key.Chinese: 當然了，這還需要手動上傳……
Key.French: Évidemment, infecter manuellement...
Key.Spanish: Claro que habrá que cargarlo de forma manual...
Key.Italian: Naturalmente, caricare il virus manualmente...
Key.Russian: Конечно же, вирус придется загружать вручную...
Key.German: Natürlich müssen wir ihn manuell hochladen ...
Key.English: Of course, doing a manual upload...
Key.Portuguese: Mas, claro, fazendo um upload manual...
Key.Japanese: もちろん、手動でのアップロードだ...
Key.Turkish: Tabii ki manuel yükleme yapmamız gerekecek...

Key.Original: That's not going to be easy - we'll need an insider.
Key.Chinese: 這不會太輕鬆的，我們需要有人在裡面接應。
Key.French: C'est pas facile. Il nous faut un infiltré.
Key.Spanish: Y no va a ser fácil, nos va a hacer falta alguien dentro.
Key.Italian: ... non sarà un gioco da ragazzi. Avremo bisogno di un infiltrato.
Key.Polish: Nie będzie łatwe, musimy mieć tam kogoś.
