Key.Italian: Dallo a Solé. Ha un’officina vicino alle rovine del tempio.
Key.Polish: Daj to Solé. Ma warsztat obok ruin świątyni.
Key.Russian: Отдай это Соле. У него есть гараж, рядом с развалинами старого храма.
Key.German: Gib die Sachen Solé. Er hat eine Garage in der Nähe der Tempelruinen.
Key.Czech: Dej to Solému. Má garáž kousek od trosek chrámu.
Key.English: Give it to Solé. He's got a garage, near the temple ruins.
Key.Portuguese: Entrega pro Solé. Ele tem um desmanche, perto das ruínas do templo.
Key.Korean: 솔레에게 줘. 사원 폐허 근처에 차고를 갖고 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 把它们交给 Solé。他在寺院废墟那边有个车库。
Key.Japanese: "ソレ" ニ渡シテクレ。彼ハ寺院ノ廃虚ノ近クニ "ガレージ" ヲ所有シテル。
Key.Turkish: Onu Solé’ye ver. Tapınak kalıntılarının yakınında bir tamirhanesi var.

Key.Original: Or - or leave it at our stash, near Lakatoro.
Key.Chinese: 或是把它放在拉卡托羅附近的存放點。
Key.French: Ou alors, laisse-les dans notre planque, près de Lakatoro.
Key.Spanish: O... déjala en nuestro alijo, cerca de Lakatoro.
Key.Italian: Oppure... oppure lascialo nel nostro nascondiglio segreto vicino a Lakatoro.
Key.Polish: Albo… zostaw w schowku, przy Lakatoro.
Key.Russian: Либо можешь оставить их в нашем схроне рядом с Лакаторо.
Key.German: Oder ... oder lass sie in unserem Versteck bei Lakatoro.
Key.Czech: Nebo… Nebo to nech v naší skrýši poblíž Lakatora.
Key.English: Or - or leave it at our stash, near Lakatoro.
Key.Portuguese: Ou deixa no nosso esconderijo, perto de Lakatoro.
Key.Korean: 아니면, 라카토로 근처에 잇는 우리 물자 은닉처에 같이 놔둬.
Key.Chinesesimp: 或者 - 或者把它留在我们在拉卡托罗附近的藏身处。
Key.Japanese: ソレカ、"ラカトロ" ノ近クニアル俺達ノ隠シ場所ニ置イテキテクレ。
Key.Turkish: Ya da Lakatoro yakınındaki zulamıza bırak.

Container.name: 057_eve_traitor_untied_no_guards
Container.situation: player unties traitor. traitor warns player about the guards outside.

Key.Original: But, er...
Key.French: Mais...
Key.Spanish: Pero, esto...
Key.Italian: Ma, ehm...
Key.German: Aber ... ähm ...
Key.English: But, er...
Key.Portuguese: Mas, er...
Key.Japanese: ダガ、ソノ...

Container.name: 056_eve_traitor_untied_guards
Container.situation: player unties traitor. traitor warns player about the guards outside.

Key.Original: But I'm not movin' with them guards outside, mec!
Key.Chinese: 不過外頭有警衛的話，我可不會行動，夥計！
Key.French: Mais je bouge pas avec ces gardes dehors, mec !
Key.Spanish: ¡Pero no pienso moverme con esos guardias fuera, mec!
Key.Italian: Ma non andrò da nessuna parte con quelle guardie là fuori, mec!
Key.Polish: Ale nie pójdę, póki tam są strażnicy, mec!
Key.Russian: Но я никуда не пойду, пока снаружи стоят охранники, мэк!
Key.German: Aber mit den Wachen da draußen bewege ich mich nicht vom Fleck, mec!
Key.Czech: Ale dokud budou venku stráže, nikam nejdu, mec.
Key.English: But I'm not movin' with them guards outside, mec!
Key.Portuguese: Mas não vou sair com guardas lá fora, mec!
Key.Korean: 하지만 밖에 경비병들이 있다구. 난 꼼짝도 안 할거야, 멕!
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过，外面有警卫，我可不会乱动，伙计！
Key.Japanese: ダガ、外ニ見張リガイル間ハ俺ハ動カナイゾ！
Key.Turkish: Ama dışarıda muhafızlar varken hiçbir yere gitmiyorum, mec!

Container.name: 055_eve_traitor_untied
Container.situation: player unties traitor.

Key.Original: Alright.
Key.French: OK.
Key.Spanish: Vale.
Key.Italian: Molto bene.
Key.German: Alles klar.
Key.English: Alright.
Key.Portuguese: Ok.
Key.Japanese: ヨシ。

Container.name: 054_eve_traitor_found
Container.situation: player locates the captive traitor.

Key.Original: So, they send you, eh?
Key.French: C'est eux qui t'envoient, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Así que te han enviado a ti, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: E così hanno mandato te, eh?
Key.German: Dich hat man also geschickt ...
Key.English: So, they send you, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Então, eles mandaram você, si?
Key.Japanese: オ前ヲ送リ込ンダノカ。

Container.name: 053_ta_photo_taken
Container.situation: player sends an image to syndikat_boss speaker.

Key.Original: Salut, Képi.
Key.French: Salut, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Salut, Képi.
Key.Italian: Salut, Képi.
Key.German: Salut, Képi.
Key.English: Salut, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Salut, Képi.
Key.Japanese: サリュー、ケピ。

Key.Original: Too bad about our man, he big loss.
Key.Chinese: 失去了他真是可惜，這損失真慘重。
Key.French: Dommage pour notre homme. Grosse perte.
Key.Spanish: Lástima lo de nuestro hombre, es una gran pérdida.
Key.Italian: Peccato per il nostro uomo, una grande perdita.
Key.Russian: Прискорбно слышать о нашем товарище. Это большая потеря.
Key.German: Schade um unseren Mann. Das ist ein großer Verlust.
Key.Czech: Škoda náš člověk. Je velká ztráta.
Key.English: Too bad about our man, he big loss.
Key.Portuguese: Muita pena pelo nosso camarada, ele foi grande perda.
Key.Korean: 우리 동지의 소식은 유감이다. 큰 손실이다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 失去了他真是可惜，损失惨重啊。
Key.Japanese: アイツガ死ンダノハ残念ダ。イイ戦力ダッタノニナ。
Key.Turkish: Adamımızı yitirmek kötü oldu; büyük bir kayıp.

Key.Original: I will be in touch.
Key.French: Je te rappellerai.
Key.Spanish: Estaremos en contacto.
Key.Italian: Mi farò risentire.
Key.German: Ich melde mich.
Key.English: I will be in touch.
Key.Portuguese: Vou manter contato.
Key.Japanese: マタ連絡スル。

Container.name: 052_in_black_market_prices
Container.situation: player is given information about the black market.

Key.Original: Ah, I almost forget, Képi, we gotta room for you.
Key.Chinese: 啊，我差點忘了，Képi，我們給你準備了個房間。
Key.French: J'oubliais, Képi, on a une chambre pour toi.
Key.Spanish: Ah, casi se me olvida: Képi, tenemos un sitio para ti.
Key.Italian: Ah, quasi dimenticavo, Képi, abbiamo una stanza per te.
Key.Polish: Prawie zapomniałem, Képi, mamy dla ciebie miejsce.
Key.Russian: Чуть не забыл, Кепи, у нас есть для тебя комната.
Key.German: Ah, das hätte ich fast vergessen, Képi. Wir haben ein Zimmer für dich.
Key.Czech: Málem zapomínám, Képi, máme pro tebe pokoj.
Key.English: Ah, I almost forget, Képi, we gotta room for you.
Key.Portuguese: Ah, quase esqueci, Képi, temos espaço pra você.
Key.Korean: 아, 깜빡할 뻔했다, 케피. 네 거처를 준비했다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 啊，我差点忘了，Képi，我们给你准备了一个房间。
Key.Japanese: アア、忘レルトコロダッタ、ケピ。オ前ノタメニ部屋ヲ用意シタ。
Key.Turkish: Ah, neredeyse unutuyordum, Képi. Senin için bir odamız var.

Key.Original: In a safehouse, near Vagalala.
Key.Chinese: 就在瓦加拉拉附近的密屋中。
Key.French: Dans une planque, près de Vagalala.
Key.Spanish: Es una casa franca, cerca de Vagalala.
Key.Italian: In un rifugio, vicino Vagalala.
Key.German: Es ist in einem Unterschlupf in der Nähe von Vagalala.
Key.English: In a safehouse, near Vagalala.
Key.Portuguese: Dans um esconderijo, perto de Vagalala.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在瓦加拉拉附近的一间密屋里。
Key.Japanese: バガララ周辺ノ隠レ家ガ。

Key.Original: Sometimes good to lay low, eh?
Key.Chinese: 有時候避避風頭也不錯，是吧？
Key.French: Des fois, il faut se cacher, hein ?
Key.Spanish: A veces es mejor no llamar la atención, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: A volte è meglio non dare nell’occhio, eh?
Key.Russian: Отличное место, когда надо залечь на дно.
Key.German: Manchmal muss man einfach untertauchen, oder?
Key.Czech: Občas je dobrý nebýt vidět, jo?
Key.English: Sometimes good to lay low, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Vez em quando é bom ficar entocado, non?
Key.Korean: 때론 조용히 숨죽이고 있는 게 나을 때도 있으니까.
Key.Chinesesimp: 有时做做缩头乌龟也不错，嗯？
Key.Japanese: タマニハ身ヲ潜メルノモ大事ダロウ？
Key.Turkish: Bazen dikkat çekmemek iyidir, değil mi?

Key.Original: House is green color, to the south.
Key.Chinese: 是一棟綠色的房子，就在南邊。
Key.French: La maison verte, au sud.
Key.Spanish: Es una casa verde que está al sur.
Key.Italian: Si tratta di una casa verde, a sud.
Key.Polish: Dom ma kolor zielony, na południe.
Key.German: Das Haus ist grün und liegt im Süden.
Key.Czech: Dům je zelená barva, na jih.
Key.English: House is green color, to the south.
Key.Portuguese: A casa é cor verde, no sul.
Key.Chinesesimp: 是一栋绿色的房子，就在南边。
Key.Japanese: 南ニアル緑色ノ家ダ。

Key.Original: There is also weapon for you there.
Key.Chinese: 那裡還給你準備了一把武器。
Key.French: Il y a aussi une arme là-bas.
Key.Spanish: Allí encontrarás un arma.
Key.Italian: Troverai anche un’arma.
Key.Polish: Jest tam też broń dla ciebie.
Key.Russian: Там для тебя найдется и оружие.
Key.German: Dort liegt auch eine Waffe für dich.
Key.Czech: Máš tam pro tebe i zbraň.
Key.English: There is also weapon for you there.
Key.Portuguese: Tem arma lá pra você também.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那儿还给你准备了一件武器。
Key.Japanese: ソコニハ武器モアル。
Key.Turkish: Orada senin için silah da var.

Key.Original: If you to want more, we control the black market.
Key.Chinese: 如果你需要更多東西，我們還掌控著黑市。
Key.French: Si tu veux plus, on contrôle le marché noir.
Key.Spanish: Si quieres más, controlamos el mercado negro.
Key.Italian: Se ne vuoi ancora, noi controlliamo il mercato nero.
Key.Polish: Jeśli chcesz więcej, kontrolujemy czarny rynek.
Key.Russian: Если нужно что-то еще, знай, что мы контролируем черный рынок.
Key.German: Wenn du mehr brauchst – wir kontrollieren den Schwarzmarkt.
Key.Czech: Jestli chceš víc, černý trh je celý náš.
Key.English: If you to want more, we control the black market.
Key.Portuguese: Se cê quiser mais, a gente controla mercado negro.
Key.Korean: 더 많은 게 필요하다면, 우리가 장악하고 있는 암시장을 이용해라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你需要更多东西，我们控制着黑市呢。
Key.Japanese: モット欲シケレバ、俺達ハ闇市場ヲ牛耳ッテルカラ遠慮ナク言エ。
Key.Turkish: Daha fazlasını istersen karaborsa da bizim kontrolümüzde.

Container.name: 051_ta_house_destroyed
Container.situation: player successfully completes a task.

Key.Original: Salut, Képi.
Key.French: Salut, Képi.
Key.Spanish: Salut, Képi.
Key.Italian: Salut, Képi.
Key.German: Salut, Képi.
Key.English: Salut, Képi.
Key.Portuguese: Salut, Képi.
Key.Japanese: サリュー、ケピ。

Key.Original: You do good, eh?
Key.French: Bon travail, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Todo bien, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ce l’hai fatta, eh?
Key.German: Läuft bei dir, was?
Key.English: You do good, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Cê se saiu bem, non?
Key.Japanese: ヨクヤッタナ。

Key.Original: Time government learn no-one beyond our reach.
Key.Chinese: 現在該讓政府知道誰也無法逃出我們的手掌心。
Key.French: Le gouvernement doit comprendre qu'on touche qui on veut.
Key.Spanish: Es hora de que el gobierno sepa que nadie está fuera de nuestro alcance.
Key.Italian: È ora che il governo impari che nessuno è fuori dalla nostra portata.
Key.Polish: Czas, by rząd się dowiedział, że możemy dorwać każdego.
Key.Russian: Пора бы правительству узнать, что мы можем достать любого.
Key.German: Die Regierung muss verstehen, dass niemand sicher ist.
Key.Czech: Vláda má na čase dozvědět se, že nikdo nám neunikne.
Key.English: Time government learn no-one beyond our reach.
Key.Portuguese: Tá na hora do governo ficar sabeno que ninguém tá além do nosso alcance
Key.Korean: 우리가 손대지 못하는 사람은 없다는 걸 정부도 이제 깨달았을 거다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 是时候让政府明白，没人能逃脱我们的掌心。
Key.Japanese: 政府ニ俺達ニデキナイコトハ何モナイト知ラシメラレタ。
Key.Turkish: Hükûmetin kendisine erişebileceğimizi öğrenme vakti geldi.

Key.Original: I will be in touch. L'Ensemble need a soldier-man like you.
Key.Chinese: 我們再聯絡，L'Ensemble 需要像你這樣的士兵。
Key.French: Je te rappellerai. L'Ensemble a besoin d'un soldat comme toi.
Key.Spanish: Estaremos en contacto. L'Ensemble necesita a un soldado como tú.
Key.Italian: Mi farò risentire. L’Ensemble ha bisogno di un soldato come te.
Key.Polish: Odezwę się. L’Ensemble potrzebuje kogoś takiego jak ty.
Key.Russian: Я буду на связи. Л'Енсаблю нужен солдат вроде тебя.
Key.German: Ich melde mich. L'Ensemble kann Soldaten wie dich gebrauchen.
Key.Czech: Budu v kontaktu. Voják jako ty je pro L'Ensemble potřebný.
Key.English: I will be in touch. L'Ensemble need a soldier-man like you.
Key.Portuguese: Vou manter contato. L'Ensemble precisa de soldado como você.
Key.Korean: 또 연락하겠다. '앙상블'에는 너 같은 군인이 필요하다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们再联络，大帮会需要像你这样的士兵。
Key.Japanese: マタ連絡スル。"ランサンブル" ニハオ前ノヨウナ兵士ガ必要ダ。
Key.Turkish: Tekrar iletişime geçeceğim. L'Ensemble’nin senin gibi bir askere ihtiyacı var.

Container.name: 049_eve_syndikat_webcam_q_out
Container.situation: player is told by unkown speaker that they will be in touch.

Key.Original: My name is Samjo.
Key.French: Je m'appelle Samjo.
Key.Spanish: Me llamo Samjo.
Key.Italian: Il mio nome è Samjo.
Key.German: Mein Name ist Samjo.
Key.English: My name is Samjo.
Key.Portuguese: Meu nome é Samjo.
Key.Japanese: 俺ノ名前ハ "サムジョ" ダ。

Key.Original: I will send you the location, attends.
Key.Chinese: 我會把地點傳給你，注意查收。
Key.French: Je t'envoie l'endroit, attends.
Key.Spanish: Attends, te paso la ubicación.
Key.Italian: Ti invierò la posizione, attends.
Key.German: Attends, ich schicke dir die Koordinaten.
Key.English: I will send you the location, attends.
Key.Portuguese: Vou enviar a localização, attends.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我会把位置发给你，稍等。
Key.Japanese: 場所ヲ送ル。アトン。

Container.name: 048_eve_syndikat_webcam_p
Container.situation: player is told to go to a nearby camp and collect the medicine.

Key.Original: There is médecine at a camp nearby.
Key.French: Il y a médecine dans un camp à côté.
Key.Spanish: Hay médecine en un campamento próximo.
Key.Italian: Troverai le médecine in un accampamento qui vicino.
Key.Russian: Лекарства должны быть в лагере неподалеку.
Key.German: Die médecine ist in einem Lager in der Nähe.
Key.English: There is médecine at a camp nearby.
Key.Portuguese: Tem médecine em acampamento pertinho.
Key.Chinesesimp: 附近的一个营地有些药品。
Key.Japanese: 近クノ "キャンプ" ニ "メディシン" ガアル。

Container.name: 047_eve_syndikat_webcam_o_out
Container.situation: player is told to notify unknown speaker when the task is complete.

Key.Original: Save this number and send a message once you're done.
Key.Chinese: 儲存這個號碼，完成後給他傳個訊息。
Key.French: Garde mon numéro et envoie un message quand tu as fini.
Key.Spanish: Guarda este número y manda un mensaje cuando hayas acabado.
Key.Italian: Memorizza questo numero e manda un messaggio quando hai finito.
Key.Polish: Zapisz numer i wyślij wiadomość, jak skończysz.
Key.Russian: Сохрани этот номер и отправь на него сообщение, как только все будет готово.
Key.German: Speichere diese Nummer und schick mir eine Nachricht, wenn du fertig bist.
Key.Czech: Ulož si tohle číslo, a až bude konec, zavolej ho.
Key.English: Save this number and send a message once you're done.
Key.Portuguese: Salva esse número e envia uma mensagem quando terminar.
Key.Korean: 이 번호 저장해놨다가 일이 끝나면 메시지 보내라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 保存这个号码，一完事就发个消息。
Key.Japanese: コノ番号ヲ保存シテ、終ワッタラ "メッセージ" ヲ送レ。
Key.Turkish: Bu numarayı kaydet ve işi bitirdiğinde mesaj gönder.

Container.name: 046_eve_syndikat_webcam_n_out
Container.situation: player is promised medicinal support once the assigned task is complete.

Key.Original: Save this number and send a message once you're done.
Key.Chinese: 儲存這個號碼，完成後給他傳個訊息。
Key.French: Garde mon numéro et envoie un message quand tu as fini.
Key.Spanish: Guarda este número y manda un mensaje cuando hayas acabado.
Key.Italian: Memorizza questo numero e manda un messaggio quando hai finito.
Key.Polish: Zapisz numer i wyślij wiadomość, jak skończysz.
Key.Russian: Сохрани этот номер и отправь на него сообщение, как только все будет готово.
Key.German: Speichere diese Nummer und schick mir eine Nachricht, wenn du fertig bist.
Key.Czech: Ulož si tohle číslo, a až bude konec, zavolej ho.
Key.English: Save this number and send a message once you're done.
Key.Portuguese: Salva esse número e envia uma mensagem quando terminar.
Key.Korean: 이 번호 저장해놨다가 일이 끝나면 메시지 보내라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 保存这个号码，一完事就发个消息。
Key.Japanese: コノ番号ヲ保存シテ、終ワッタラ "メッセージ" ヲ送レ。
Key.Turkish: Bu numarayı kaydet ve işi bitirdiğinde mesaj gönder.

Key.Original: I will arrange for your médicament.
Key.Chinese: 我會為你安排你要的 médicament。
Key.French: Je te donnerai tes médicaments.
Key.Spanish: Me haré cargo de tus médicaments.
Key.Italian: Mi occuperò del tuo médicament.
Key.German: Ich werde mich dann um deine Medizin kümmern.
Key.English: I will arrange for your médicament.
Key.Portuguese: Vou arranjar seu médicament.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我会安排好你要的药品。
Key.Japanese: オ前ノ "メディカモン" ヲ手配シテオイテヤル。

Container.name: 045_eve_syndikat_webcam_m
Container.situation: player is told to check a laptop for further information about the tasks he's been assigned.

Key.Original: The laptop on the table has more information.
Key.Chinese: 桌上的筆記型電腦裡有更多資訊。
Key.French: Dans l'ordi sur la table, il y a plus d'informations.
Key.Spanish: Hay más information en el portátil de la mesa.
Key.Italian: Nel computer portatile sul tavolo troverai più informazioni.
Key.Polish: Laptop na stole zawiera więcej informacji.
Key.Russian: Вся дополнительная информация – в ноутбуке на столе.
Key.German: Auf dem Laptop da vorne findest du weitere Informationen.
Key.Czech: Laptop na stole má víc informací.
Key.English: The laptop on the table has more information.
Key.Portuguese: O laptop na mesa tem mais informações.
Key.Korean: 테이블 위에 있는 노트북에 더 자세한 정보가 들어있다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 桌上的手提电脑里有更多信息。
Key.Japanese: テーブルニ置カレテル "ラップトップ" デモット情報ヲ確認デキル。
Key.Turkish: Masadaki dizüstü bilgisayarda daha fazla bilgi var.

Container.name: 044_eve_syndikat_webcam_l
Container.situation: player is accepted by unknown speaker.

Key.Original: Ah, well...
Key.French: Ah, c'est vrai.
Key.Spanish: En fin...
Key.Italian: Ah, bene...
Key.German: Ah, ja ...
Key.English: Ah, well...
Key.Portuguese: Ah, bom...
Key.Japanese: アア...

Key.Original: You already a friend to L'Ensemble!
Key.Chinese: 你本來就是 L'Ensemble 的朋友！
Key.French: Tu es déjà ami de l'Ensemble !
Key.Spanish: ¡Ya eres amigo de L'Ensemble!
Key.Italian: Sei già un amico de L’Ensemble!
Key.German: Du bist schon ein Freund von L'Ensemble!
Key.Czech: Ty už jsi kamarád s L'Ensemble.
Key.English: You already a friend to L'Ensemble!
Key.Portuguese: Você já é amigo de L'Ensemble!
Key.Chinesesimp: 你本来就是大帮会的朋友！
Key.Japanese: オ前ハモウ "ランサンブル" ノ仲間ダ！

Key.Original: How'd you know we want a house gone in Vagalala?
Key.Chinese: 你怎麼知道我們要摧毀瓦加拉拉的一棟房子？
Key.French: Comment tu savais qu'on voulait détruire la maison à Vagalala ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Cómo es que sabes que queremos eliminar una casa de Vagalala?
Key.Italian: Come sai che volevamo liberarci di una casa a Vagalala?
Key.Polish: Jak wiedziałeś, że chcemy zniszczyć dom w Vagalala?
Key.Russian: Как ты узнал, что мы хотим избавиться от дома в Вагалале?
Key.German: Woher wusstest du, dass wir das Haus in Vagalala loswerden wollten?
Key.Czech: Jak víš, že chceme ničit dům ve Vagalala?
Key.English: How'd you know we want a house gone in Vagalala?
Key.Portuguese: Como cê descobriu que a gente queria acabar com casa em Vagalala?
Key.Korean: 우리가 바갈라라의 집을 파괴하려고 한 걸 어떻게 알았나?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你怎么知道我们想摧毁瓦加拉拉的一幢房子？
Key.Japanese: 俺達ガ "バガララ" ノ家ヲ始末シタイノヲドウシテ知ッテイル？
Key.Turkish: Vagalala’da bir eve gidilmesini istediğimizi nereden bildin?

Container.name: 043_eve_syndikat_webcam_k
Container.situation: player is tasked with rescuing the traitor and is given a description of the situation.

Key.Original: And if you can, rescue our comrade.
Key.Chinese: 如果你有辦法，請救出我們的同伴。
Key.French: Et si tu peux, sauve notre camarade.
Key.Spanish: Y, si puedes, rescata a nuestro camarada.
Key.Italian: E se riesci, salva il nostro compagno.
Key.German: Und rette unseren Mann, wenn du kannst.
Key.English: And if you can, rescue our comrade.
Key.Portuguese: E se puder, salve nosso camarada.
Key.Korean: 할 수만 있다면 우리 동지를 구출해라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你有办法，去救救我们的同志吧。
Key.Japanese: ソレカラ、デキルナラ俺達ノ仲間ヲ救ッテクレ。

Container.name: 042_ta_syndikat_webcam_j
Container.situation: player is tasked with rescuing the traitor, after having been sent by miller.

Key.Original: But, L'Ensemble, it don't know you.
Key.French: Mais l'Ensemble, il ne te connaît pas.
Key.Spanish: Pero L'Ensemble no te conoce.
Key.Italian: Ma L’Ensemble non sa chi sei.
Key.German: Aber L'Ensemble kennt dich nicht.
Key.Czech: Jenomže L'Ensemble neví, kdo ty jsi.
Key.English: But, L'Ensemble, it don't know you.
Key.Portuguese: Mas L'Ensemble, ele non te conhece.
Key.Korean: 하지만 '앙상블'은 너에 대해 아는 게 없다.
Key.Japanese: ダガ、ランサンブル、オ前ノコトハ何モ知シラナイ。

Key.Original: And I don't trust strangers. Not without an act of good faith...
Key.Chinese: 而且，除非對方向我們示好，否則，我不會輕易相信陌生人…
Key.French: Et les étrangers doivent montrer qu'ils sont amis...
Key.Spanish: Y no me fío de los extraños si no me demuestran su buena fe...
Key.Italian: E io non mi fido degli sconosciuti. Non senza che abbiano compiuto un atto di buona fede...
Key.Polish: A ja nie ufam obcym. O ile nie okazali dobrej woli…
Key.Russian: И я не доверяю незнакомцам, пока они не проявят акт доброй воли...
Key.German: Und ich traue keinen Fremden, die sich nicht nützlich gemacht haben ...
Key.Czech: A já nevěřím cizí lidi, když pro mě nejdřív nic neudělají.
Key.English: And I don't trust strangers. Not without an act of good faith...
Key.Portuguese: E não confio em estranhos. Não sem prova de boa-fé...
Key.Korean: 게다가 테스트 없이 낯선 사람을 믿을 순 없다...
Key.Chinesesimp: 而且，我不会轻易相信陌生人。除非他们先向我们示好...
Key.Japanese: 信用デキルト行動デ示サナイ限リ、他人ヲ信用スルコトハデキナイ...

Container.name: 041_ta_syndikat_webcam_i
Container.situation: player is tasked with rescuing the traitor, after having been sent by doctor.

Key.Original: That is good - L'Ensemble can help.
Key.Chinese: 這樣很好－－L'Ensemble 能幫得上忙。
Key.French: C'est très bien. L'Ensemble peut aider.
Key.Spanish: Está bien, L'Ensemble puede ayudar.
Key.Italian: Bene, L’Ensemble può aiutarti.
Key.German: Das ist gut ... L'Ensemble kann dir helfen.
Key.English: That is good - L'Ensemble can help.
Key.Portuguese: Isso é bom, L'Ensemble pode ajudar.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这样很好 - 大帮会能帮上忙。
Key.Japanese: ヨシ。"ランサンブル" ガ手ヲ貸シテヤル。

Key.Original: But, we must be helped as well, eh?
Key.Chinese: 不過，我們也需要幫助，知道吧？
Key.French: Mais il faut aussi nous aider, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Pero también nos tienen que ayudar, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ma devi restituirci il favore, eh?
Key.Polish: Ale nam też trzeba pomóc, co?
Key.Russian: Но и нам нужно помогать, верно?
Key.German: Aber dafür musst du uns auch helfen, nicht wahr?
Key.English: But, we must be helped as well, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Só que também precisamo de ajuda, non?
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过，我们也需要帮助，对吧？
Key.Japanese: ダガ、ソッチニモ手ヲ貸シテモラウノガ条件ダ。
Key.Turkish: Ama bizim de yardıma ihtiyacımız var, tamam mı?

Container.name: 040_ta_syndikat_webcam_h
Container.situation: player is tasked with destroying the traitor's house.

Key.Original: So you must go - blow up the house.
Key.French: Alors tu dois aller exploser la maison.
Key.Spanish: Así que tienes que ir y reventar la casa.
Key.Italian: Devi far saltare la casa in aria.
Key.German: Also musst du dieses Haus jetzt in die Luft jagen.
Key.Czech: Takže musíš jít. Vyhodit dům do vzduchu.
Key.English: So you must go - blow up the house.
Key.Portuguese: Então, você vai lá. Explode casa.
Key.Chinesesimp: 所以你必须去 - 炸掉那所房子。
Key.Japanese: ダカラ、行ケ。家ヲ爆破シロ。
Key.Turkish: Bu nedenle gidip evi havaya uçurmalısın.

Key.Original: See the government get our message.
Key.Chinese: 讓政府知道我們的想法。
Key.French: Le gouvernement doit comprendre le message.
Key.Spanish: Para hacer llegar nuestro mensaje al gobierno.
Key.Italian: Il governo deve recepire il nostro messaggio.
Key.Russian: Чтобы наше сообщение дошло до правительства.
Key.German: Damit die Regierung unsere Position versteht.
Key.Czech: Ať vláda chápe, co jí chceme říkat.
Key.English: See the government get our message.
Key.Portuguese: Faz governo receber nossa mensagem.
Key.Chinesesimp: 让政府明白我们的意思。
Key.Japanese: 政府ニ俺達ノ意図ヲ知ラシメルンダ。

Container.name: 039_ta_syndikat_webcam_g
Container.situation: the traitor is alive and the unknown speaker tells this to the player.

Key.Original: La gendarmerie, they take our man.
Key.Chinese: 國家憲兵抓了我們的人。
Key.French: La gendarmerie a pris notre homme.
Key.Spanish: La gendarmerie se llevó a uno de los nuestros.
Key.Italian: La gendarmeria si è presa il nostro uomo.
Key.Russian: Жандармерия взяла нашего товарища в плен.
Key.German: La gendarmerie hat einen unserer Männer gefangengenommen.
Key.English: La gendarmerie, they take our man.
Key.Portuguese: A Gendarmerie, eles pega nosso cara.
Key.Chinesesimp: 宪兵队带走了我们的人。
Key.Japanese: 国家憲兵隊ハ俺達ノ同胞ヲ奪ウ。

Key.Original: And then raid his home in Vagalala.
Key.Chinese: 然後襲擊他在瓦加拉拉的家。
Key.French: Et ils ont attaqué sa maison, à Vagalala.
Key.Spanish: Y registró su casa de Vagalala.
Key.Italian: E poi ha fatto irruzione in casa sua a Vagalala.
Key.Polish: I przetrząsnęli jego dom w Vagalala.
Key.Russian: И они перерыли всё у него дома в Вагалале.
Key.German: Und dann haben sie sein Haus in Vagalala geplündert.
Key.Czech: A dělají razie na jeho dům ve Vagalala.
Key.English: And then raid his home in Vagalala.
Key.Portuguese: E aí invade casa dele em Vagalala.
Key.Korean: 그리고 바갈라라에 있는 그의 집을 급습했다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 之后还袭击了他在瓦加拉拉的家。
Key.Japanese: ソシテ、"バガララ" ノ彼ノ家ヲ襲ウ。
Key.Turkish: Ve sonra onun Vagalala’daki evini yağmaladı.

Container.name: 038_ta_syndikat_webcam_f
Container.situation: the traitor is dead and the unknown speaker tells this to the player.

Key.Original: La gendarmerie, they kill our man.
Key.Chinese: 國家憲兵殺了我們的人。
Key.French: La gendarmerie a tué notre homme.
Key.Spanish: La gendarmerie mató a uno de los nuestros.
Key.Italian: La gendarmeria ha ammazzato il nostro uomo.
Key.German: La gendarmerie hat einen unserer Männer getötet.
Key.English: La gendarmerie, they kill our man.
Key.Portuguese: A Gendarmerie, eles mata nosso cara.
Key.Japanese: 国家憲兵隊ハ俺達ノ同胞ヲ殺ス。

Key.Original: And take away his home in Vagalala.
Key.Chinese: 然後奪走了他在瓦加拉拉的家。
Key.French: Et ils ont pris sa maison, à Vagalala.
Key.Spanish: Y limpió su casa de Vagalala.
Key.Italian: E si è presa casa sua a Vagalala.
Key.Polish: I odebrali jego dom w Vagalala.
Key.Russian: И они захватили его дом в Вагалале.
Key.German: Und dann haben sie sein Haus in Vagalala übernommen.
Key.Czech: A berou jeho dům ve Vagalala.
Key.English: And take away his home in Vagalala.
Key.Portuguese: E toma casa dele em Vagalala.
Key.Korean: 그리고 바갈라라에 있는 그의 집도 파괴했다.
Key.Chinesesimp: 还夺走了他在瓦加拉拉的家。
Key.Japanese: ソシテ、"バガララ" ノ彼ノ家ヲ奪ウ。
Key.Turkish: Ve onun Vagalala’daki evini ortadan kaldırdı.

Container.name: 037_eve_syndikat_webcam_e
Container.situation: player has arrived late. the traitor is dead and player only receives the task to destroy the house.

Key.Original: That is good - L'Ensemble can help.
Key.Chinese: 這樣很好－－L'Ensemble 能幫得上忙。
Key.French: C'est très bien. L'Ensemble peut aider.
Key.Spanish: Está bien, L'Ensemble puede ayudar.
Key.Italian: Bene, L’Ensemble può aiutarti.
Key.German: Das ist gut ... L'Ensemble kann dir helfen.

Key.Chinesesimp: 这样很好 - 大帮会能帮上忙。
Key.Japanese: ヨシ。"ランサンブル" ガ手ヲ貸シテヤル。

Key.Spanish: Pero también nos tienen que ayudar, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ma devi restituirci il favore, eh?

Key.English: But, we must be helped as well, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Só que também precisamo de ajuda, non?
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过，我们也需要帮助，对吧？
Key.Japanese: ダガ、ソッチニモ手ヲ貸シテモラウノガ条件ダ。
Key.Turkish: Ama bizim de yardıma ihtiyacımız var, tamam mı?

Container.name: 036_eve_syndikat_webcam_d
Container.situation: player has already completed the intended objective.

Key.Original: Ah, well...
Key.French: Ah, c'est vrai.
Key.Spanish: En fin...
Key.Italian: Ah, bene...
Key.German: Ah, ja ...
Key.English: Ah, well...
Key.Portuguese: Ah, bom...
Key.Japanese: アア...

Key.Chinese: 你本來就是 L'Ensemble 的朋友！
Key.French: Tu es déjà ami de l'Ensemble !
Key.Spanish: ¡Ya eres amigo de L'Ensemble!
Key.Italian: Sei già un amico de L’Ensemble!

Key.Czech: Ty už jsi kamarád s L'Ensemble.

Key.Portuguese: Você já é amigo de L'Ensemble!

Key.Japanese: オ前ハモウ "ランサンブル" ノ仲間ダ！

Key.Original: How'd you know we want a house gone in Vagalala?
Key.Chinese: 你怎麼知道我們要摧毀瓦加拉拉的一棟房子？
Key.French: Comment tu savais qu'on voulait détruire la maison à Vagalala ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Cómo es que sabes que queremos eliminar una casa de Vagalala?
Key.Italian: Come sai che volevamo liberarci di una casa a Vagalala?
Key.Polish: Jak wiedziałeś, że chcemy zniszczyć dom w Vagalala?
Key.Russian: Как ты узнал, что мы хотим избавиться от дома в Вагалале?
Key.German: Woher wusstest du, dass wir das Haus in Vagalala loswerden wollten?
Key.Czech: Jak víš, že chceme ničit dům ve Vagalala?
Key.English: How'd you know we want a house gone in Vagalala?
Key.Portuguese: Como cê descobriu que a gente queria acabar com casa em Vagalala?
Key.Korean: 우리가 바갈라라의 집을 파괴하려고 한 걸 어떻게 알았나?
Key.Chinesesimp: 你怎么知道我们想摧毁瓦加拉拉的一幢房子？
Key.Japanese: 俺達ガ "バガララ" ノ家ヲ始末シタイノヲドウシテ知ッテイル？
Key.Turkish: Vagalala’da bir eve gidilmesini istediğimizi nereden bildin?

Container.name: 035_eve_syndikat_webcam_c
Container.situation: player has been sent by miller.

Key.Original: Now you want us to talk things, eh?
Key.French: Maintenant tu veux qu'on parle, hein ?
Key.Spanish: Ahora quieres que hablemos, ¿eh?
Key.Italian: Ora vuoi parlare con noi, eh?
Key.German: Jetzt willst du mit uns reden, was?
Key.English: Now you want us to talk things, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Agora cê quer conversa, si?
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在你想和我们谈谈了，嗯？
Key.Japanese: 俺達カラ情報ヲ聞キ出シタイダト？

Container.name: 034_eve_syndikat_webcam_b
Container.situation: player has been sent by doctor.

Key.Original: Now you want médecine. End all that Jungle Fever.
Key.Chinese: 現在你要藥物來解決瘧疾的問題。
Key.French: Maintenant, tu veux médecine. Arrêter la fièvre de la jungle.
Key.Spanish: Y ahora quieres médecine para acabar con esas fiebres de la selva.
Key.Italian: Ora vuoi le médecine. Porre fine alla malaria.
Key.Polish: Teraz chcesz médecine. Zwalczyć gorączkę z dżungli.
Key.Russian: А теперь ты хочешь лекарства. Чтобы избавиться от этой тропической лихорадки.
Key.German: Jetzt brauchst du médecine, um das Dschungelfieber zu heilen.
Key.Czech: Teď ty chceš médecine. Proti horečka z džungle.
Key.English: Now you want médecine. End all that Jungle Fever.
Key.Portuguese: Agora cê quer médecine. Acabar com toda essa febre da selva.
Key.Korean: 이제 정글 열병을 잡으려고 치료약을 구하고 있는 건가.
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在你想搞到药品。终结这种丛林热。
Key.Japanese: 薬ガホシイカ。ジャングル熱ヲ終ワラセルタメカ。
Key.Turkish: Şimdi médecine istiyorsun. Şiddetli Sıtmaya son vermek için.

Container.name: 033_eve_syndikat_webcam_a_in
Container.situation: player enters a warehouse, observed by a webcam. unknown addresses him from computer.

Key.Original: I see you, Képi blanc.
Key.French: Je te vois, Képi blanc.
Key.Spanish: Nos vemos, képi blanc.
Key.Italian: Ti vedo, Képi blanc.
Key.German: Ich sehe dich, Képi blanc.
Key.English: I see you, Képi blanc.
Key.Portuguese: Tô de olho em você, Képi blanc.
Key.Japanese: 丸見エダゾ、ケピ・ブロン。

Key.Original: Yes, there.
Key.French: Oui, là.
Key.Spanish: Si, ahí.
Key.Italian: Sì, lì.
Key.German: Genau da.
Key.English: Yes, there.
Key.Portuguese: Sim, ali.
Key.Japanese: アア、ソコダ。

Key.Original: The laptop.
Key.French: L'ordi portable.
Key.Spanish: El portátil.
Key.Italian: Il computer portatile.
Key.German: Der Laptop.
Key.English: The laptop.
Key.Portuguese: O laptop.
Key.Japanese: ラップトップダ。

Key.Original: You big man one time, dans La Légion.
Key.Chinese: 你在 La Légion 時曾經是了不起的人物。
Key.French: Tu étais important avant, dans la Légion.
Key.Spanish: Fuiste un tío importante dans la Légion.
Key.Italian: Una volta eri un grande uomo, dans La Légion.
Key.Polish: Byłeś kiedyś szycha, dans La Légion.
Key.Russian: Ты когда-то был большой шишкой в Ла Легионе.
Key.German: Du warst mal ein großer Mann dans La Légion.
Key.Czech: Ty, chlape, ty jsi byl dans la Légion!
Key.English: You big man one time, dans La Légion.
Key.Portuguese: Cê já foi um grande homem, dans La Légion.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在军团物时候，你可是个大人物。
Key.Japanese: "ラ・レジョン" デハ偉ソウニシテクレタナ。
Key.Turkish: Bir zamanlar büyük adamdın; dans La Légion.

Container.name: 032_ta_sleeping_bag_found
Container.situation: player locates miller's sleeping bag.

Key.Original: You got it?
Key.French: Tu as trouvé ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Lo tienes?
Key.Italian: Preso?
Key.German: Hast du es?
Key.English: You got it?
Key.Portuguese: Pegou?
Key.Japanese: 終わりか？

Key.Original: There's a cache too.
Key.French: Il y a aussi une cache.
Key.Spanish: También hay un alijo.
Key.Italian: C’è anche un nascondiglio.
Key.German: Es gibt noch ein weiteres Versteck.
Key.English: There's a cache too.
Key.Portuguese: Tem uma provisão também.
Key.Japanese: 物資もあるんだ。

Key.Original: South. Near the old sawmill.
Key.Chinese: 南邊，就在老鋸木廠附近。
Key.French: Au sud. Près de la vieille scierie.
Key.Spanish: Al sur, cerca del antiguo aserradero.
Key.Italian: A sud, nei pressi della vecchia segheria.
Key.Russian: Чуть южнее, рядом со старой лесопилкой.
Key.German: Südlich, in der Nähe des alten Sägewerks.
Key.English: South. Near the old sawmill.
Key.Portuguese: Ao sul. Perto da antiga serraria.
Key.Japanese: 南だ。古い製材所の周辺だ。

Container.name: 031_ex_download_reminder
Container.situation: miller reminds player that they need to download the geo-finder from the laptop.

Key.Original: Santiago...
Key.French: Santiago...
Key.Spanish: Santiago...
Key.Italian: Santiago...
Key.German: Santiago ...
Key.English: Santiago...
Key.Portuguese: Santiago...
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ...

Key.Original: The laptop?
Key.French: L'ordi portable ?
Key.Spanish: ¿El portátil?
Key.Italian: Il computer portatile?
Key.German: Was ist mit dem Laptop?
Key.English: The laptop?
Key.Portuguese: O laptop?
Key.Japanese: ラップトップは見えるか？

Container.name: 030_ex_app_reminder
Container.situation: miller reminds player that they need to turn on the geo-finder using their phone.

Key.Original: Yeah, and, er, like I said. You'll need to switch it on first.
Key.Chinese: 是啊，還有……這，就像我說的那樣，你得先開啟設備。
Key.French: Comme je te l'ai dit, tu dois d'abord l'activer.
Key.Spanish: Sí, y, esto... como ya te dije, primero hay que encenderlo.
Key.Italian: Già, e... come ti dicevo. Devi prima attivarlo.
Key.Polish: Tak i… jak mówiłem. Najpierw trzeba włączyć.
Key.Russian: И, эээ, как я уже сказал, сначала его нужно включить.
Key.German: Wie gesagt: Du musst erst den Tracker einschalten.
Key.Czech: Jo, jak jsem říkal… Musíš si ho napřed zapnout.
Key.English: Yeah, and, er, like I said. You'll need to switch it on first.
Key.Portuguese: Sim, e, como eu disse. Você tem que ativar ele primeiro.
Key.Korean: 그러니까 내가 말했던 것처럼 먼저 전원을 켜야돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 是啊，还有，呃，我之前说过。你得先把它打开。
Key.Japanese: ああ、さっきも言ったが、まずはスイッチをオンにする必要がある。
Key.Turkish: Evet, ayrıca, şey, dediğim gibi. Önce açık konuma getirmen gerekecek.

Key.Original: Just click the icon on your mobile.
Key.Chinese: 按下手機上的圖標就行了。
Key.French: Touche l'icône, sur ton portable.
Key.Spanish: Pulsa el icono en tu móvil.
Key.Italian: Ti basta cliccare sull’icona sul tuo cellulare.
Key.Russian: Просто нажми на значок в своем мобильнике.
Key.German: Klicke einfach auf das Symbol auf deinem Handy.
Key.English: Just click the icon on your mobile.
Key.Portuguese: É só clicar no ícone no seu celular.
Key.Chinesesimp: 点击你手机上的图标就行。
Key.Japanese: お前の携帯電話でアイコンをクリックするんだ。

Container.name: 029_ex_app_downloaded_pack_found
Container.situation: player has already located miller's backpack and the sleeping bag.

Key.Original: Okay, so you're all set. I'd say we could do a dry run...
Key.Chinese: 好了，準備就緒。我覺得，我們要測試一下……
Key.French: OK, tu es prêt. J'avais prévu un petit test...
Key.Spanish: Vale, todo listo. Te diría de hacer una prueba...
Key.Italian: Okay, è tutto pronto. Direi che potremmo fare una prova...
Key.Polish: Okej, jesteś gotowy. Sądzę, że możemy przeprowadzić test…
Key.Russian: Так, у тебя все готово. Стоит для начала проверить, как всё работает...
Key.German: Okay, das müsse alles sein. Wir sollten einen Probelauf machen ...
Key.Czech: Aha, ty už ho máš. Já myslel, že si uděláme zkoušku.
Key.English: Okay, so you're all set. I'd say we could do a dry run...
Key.Portuguese: Ok, tudo pronto, então. Pensei na gente fazer uma experiência prática...
Key.Korean: 좋아. 이제 준비는 다 됐어. 그럼 예행 연습을 해보는 게 좋을 것 같은데...
Key.Chinesesimp: 好的，你都准备好了。我觉得我们要测试一下...
Key.Japanese: よし。準備はいいようだな。まずはテストしてみよう、と言いたいところだが...
Key.Turkish: Tamam, hazırsın. Sanırım bir deneme yapabiliriz...

Key.Original: But, er, it seems you already found my pack and your sleeping bag.
Key.Chinese: 不過，嗯，看來你已經找到了我的包包和你的睡袋。
Key.French: Mais on dirait que tu as déjà trouvé le sac de couchage dans mes affaires.
Key.Spanish: Pero, en fin, ya has encontrado mi mochila y tu saco de dormir.
Key.Italian: Ma... sembra che tu abbia già trovato il mio zaino e il tuo sacco a pelo.
Key.Polish: Ale… chyba znalazłeś już plecak ze śpiworem dla ciebie.
Key.Russian: Но, эээ, похоже, что ты уже нашел мой рюкзак и свой спальный мешок.
Key.German: Aber anscheinend hast du meinen Rucksack und deinen Schlafsack schon gefunden.
Key.Czech: No, můj batoh i spacák už jsi evidentně našel.
Key.English: But, er, it seems you already found my pack and your sleeping bag.
Key.Portuguese: Mas parece que você já encontrou minha mochila e seu saco de dormir.
Key.Korean: 그런데 이미 내 배낭과 침낭을 찾은 모양이군.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不过，呃，看来你已经找到了我的背包和你的睡袋。
Key.Japanese: 俺のバッグとお前の寝袋を既に見つけたようだな。
Key.Turkish: Yalnız, şey... Görünüşe bakılırsa zaten çantamı ve uyku tulumunu bulmuşsun.

Key.Original: Just switch on the tracker and home in on the beeps.
Key.Chinese: 切換到追蹤器並追蹤嗶嗶聲。
Key.French: Active le traqueur et suis les bips.
Key.Spanish: Enciende el rastreador y ve siguiendo los pitidos.
Key.Italian: Attiva il localizzatore e segui il segnale.
Key.Polish: Włącz lokalizator i kieruj się sygnałami dźwiękowymi.
Key.Russian: Просто включи трекер и иди на звуковой сигнал.
Key.German: Schalte einfach den Tracker an und folge den Signaltönen.
Key.Czech: Zapni si ho na lokátoru a jdi podle pípání.
Key.English: Just switch on the tracker and home in on the beeps.
Key.Portuguese: É só ligar o rastreador e seguir os bipes.
Key.Chinesesimp: 只要打开追踪器，跟着哔哔声走就好。
Key.Japanese: トラッカーをオンにしてビープ音が強くなる方へ移動するんだ。
Key.Turkish: İzleyiciyi aç ve bip seslerine dikkat et.

Container.name: 028_ta_app_downloaded
Container.situation: player downloads geo-finder app from miller's laptop, as instructed.

Key.Original: Okay, so you're all set. Let's do a dry run.
Key.Chinese: 好了，準備就緒。我們來測試一下吧。
Key.French: OK, tu es prêt. On fait un petit test.
Key.Spanish: Vale, todo listo. Vamos a hacer una prueba.
Key.Italian: Okay, è tutto pronto. Facciamo una prova.
Key.Polish: Okej, jesteś gotowy. Pora na test.
Key.Russian: Так, у тебя все готово. Давай-ка сначала проверим, как работает.
Key.German: Okay, das müsste alles sein. Lass uns mal einen Probelauf machen.
Key.Czech: Výborně, už máš všechno. Zkusíme si to nanečisto.
Key.English: Okay, so you're all set. Let's do a dry run.
Key.Portuguese: Ok, então tá tudo pronto. Vamos fazer uma experiência prática.
Key.Korean: 좋아. 이제 준비는 다 됐어. 그럼 예행 연습을 해보자.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好的，你都准备好了。我们来演练一下。
Key.Japanese: よし。準備はいいようだな。まずはテストしてみよう。
Key.Turkish: Tamam, hazırsın. Haydi bir deneme yapalım.

Key.Original: I've got a sleeping bag for you, in my pack.
Key.Chinese: 我這裡有個睡袋給你，就在我的包包裡。
Key.French: Dans mes affaires, j'ai un sac de couchage pour toi.
Key.Spanish: Tengo un saco de dormir para ti en mi mochila.
Key.Italian: Ho un sacco a pelo per te nel mio zaino.
Key.Polish: Mam dla ciebie śpiwór, jest w moim plecaku.
Key.Russian: У меня в рюкзаке есть для тебя спальный мешок.
Key.German: In meinem Rucksack liegt ein Schlafsack für dich.
Key.Czech: Mám pro tebe spacák. U sebe v batohu.
Key.English: I've got a sleeping bag for you, in my pack.
Key.Portuguese: Eu tenho um saco de dormir para você, lá na minha mochila.
Key.Korean: 내 배낭 안에 침낭이 있을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我带了个睡袋给你，就在我的背包里。
Key.Japanese: 俺のバッグにお前の寝袋が入ってる。
Key.Turkish: Çantamda senin için bir uyku tulumu var.

Key.Original: Just switch on the tracker and home in on the beeps.
Key.Chinese: 切換到追蹤器並追蹤嗶嗶聲。
Key.French: Active le traqueur et suis les bips.
Key.Spanish: Enciende el rastreador y ve siguiendo los pitidos.
Key.Italian: Attiva il localizzatore e segui il segnale.
Key.Polish: Włącz lokalizator i kieruj się sygnałami dźwiękowymi.
Key.Russian: Просто включи трекер и иди на звуковой сигнал.
Key.German: Schalte einfach den Tracker an und folge den Signaltönen.
Key.Czech: Zapni si ho na lokátoru a jdi podle pípání.
Key.English: Just switch on the tracker and home in on the beeps.
Key.Portuguese: É só ligar o rastreador e seguir os bipes.
Key.Chinesesimp: 只要打开追踪器，跟着哔哔声走就好。
Key.Japanese: トラッカーをオンにしてビープ音が強くなる方へ移動するんだ。
Key.Turkish: İzleyiciyi aç ve bip seslerine dikkat et.

Container.name: 027_in_app_tutorial_in
Container.situation: miller tells player to download the geo-finder app from his laptop.

Key.Original: Download the app from my laptop and activate it with your phone.
Key.Chinese: 在我的筆記型電腦上下載應用程式，然後用手機啟動。
Key.French: Télécharge l'appli depuis mon ordi, puis active-la sur ton portable.
Key.Spanish: Descarga la app de mi portátil y actívala con tu teléfono.
Key.Italian: Scarica l’app dal mio computer portatile e attivalo con il tuo cellulare.
Key.Polish: Pobierz aplikację z mojego laptopa i aktywuj ją na telefonie.
Key.Russian: Загрузи приложение с моего ноутбука и активируй его с помощью своего телефона.
Key.German: Lad dir die App von meinem Laptop herunter und aktiviere sie mit deinem Smartphone.
Key.Czech: Stáhni si aplikaci ode mě z počítače a aktivuj si ji na telefonu.
Key.English: Download the app from my laptop and activate it with your phone.
Key.Portuguese: Baixe o aplicativo do meu laptop e ative no seu telefone.
Key.Korean: 내 노트북에서 앱을 다운로드하고 네 휴대폰으로 활성화시키면 돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 从我的手提电脑下载应用，用你的手机激活它。
Key.Japanese: 俺のラップトップからアプリをダウンロードして、お前の電話で作動させろ。
Key.Turkish: Uygulamayı dizüstü bilgisayarımdan indir ve telefonunla etkinleştir.

Container.name: 026_ta_at_rv_location
Container.situation: player arrives at the rv with miller.

Key.Original: CSAT have just abandoned their camp in Ouméré.
Key.Chinese: CSAT 剛剛拋棄了他們在 Ouméré 的基地。
Key.French: Le CSAT a abandonné son campement d'Ouméré.
Key.Spanish: El CSAT acaba de evacuar su campamento de Ouméré.
Key.Italian: La CSAT ha appena abbandonato l’accampamento ad Ouméré.
Key.Russian: CSAT только что покинули свой лагерь в Умери.
Key.German: CSAT hat gerade sein Lager in Ouméré verlassen.
Key.Czech: CSAT právě opustili svůj tábor v Ouméré.
Key.English: CSAT have just abandoned their camp in Ouméré.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT acabou de abandonar o acampamento em Ouméré.
Key.Korean: CSAT가 방금 우메이레이에 있는 자신들 기지를 버리고 떠났어.
Key.Chinesesimp: CSAT 刚抛弃了他们在奥默里的营地。
Key.Japanese: CSAT が最近、オーメレのキャンプを放棄したんだ。
Key.Turkish: CSAT az önce Ouméré’deki kampını terk etti.

Key.Original: I guess they heard about L'Ensemble planning an attack.
Key.Chinese: 我看他們收到了 L'Ensemble 正計畫展開攻擊的消息。
Key.French: Ils auront été prévenus de l'attaque prévue par l'Ensemble.
Key.Spanish: Supongo que se han enterado de que L'Ensemble planeaba un ataque.
Key.Italian: Immagino abbiano sentito che L’Ensemble sta pianificando un attacco.
Key.Polish: Chyba dowiedzieli się, że L’Ensemble planuje atak.
Key.Russian: Думаю, что они узнали о том, что Л'Енсабль планирует атаку.
Key.German: Ich schätze, sie haben von L'Ensembles geplantem Angriff gehört.
Key.Czech: Nejspíš se doslechli, že L'Ensemble chystá útok.
Key.English: I guess they heard about L'Ensemble planning an attack.
Key.Portuguese: Acho que eles ouviram sobre o ataque planejado por L'Ensemble.
Key.Korean: 아무래도 '앙상블'이 공격을 계획하고 있다는 소식을 들은 것 같아.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我猜他们听说了大帮会计划发起攻击。
Key.Japanese: ランサンブルが襲撃を計画していることを聞きつけたんだろう。

Key.Original: If you want any extra kit we have a few hidden caches.
Key.Chinese: 你要是想多帶些裝備，我們有些秘密存放點。
Key.French: Si tu as besoin de matos, j'ai quelques caches.
Key.Spanish: Si necesitáis material extra, tenemos unos cuantos alijos ocultos.
Key.Italian: Se ti serve un po’ di equipaggiamento in più abbiamo dei nascondigli segreti.
Key.Polish: Jeśli potrzebujesz sprzętu, mamy kilka skrytek.
Key.Russian: Если тебе нужно дополнительное снаряжение, у нас есть несколько схронов.
Key.German: Falls du noch Ausrüstung brauchst, haben wir ein paar Dinge versteckt.
Key.Czech: Kdybys potřeboval další lékárničku, máme pár skrýší.
Key.English: If you want any extra kit we have a few hidden caches.
Key.Portuguese: Se você quiser um kit extra, temos algumas provisões ocultas.
Key.Korean: 추가 장비가 필요하면 숨겨둔 물자를 사용해 봐.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你需要任何额外的装备，我们有一些秘密仓库。
Key.Japanese: 余分の道具が必要なら、隠し物資がいくつかある。
Key.Turkish: Ekstradan kit gerekirse, birkaç gizli zulamız var.

Key.Original: You can locate them with a standard geo-finder.
Key.Chinese: 你可以使用標準的地型態測器找到它們。
Key.French: Tu peux les trouver avec un traqueur basique.
Key.Spanish: Podéis encontrarlos con un geolocalizador estándar.
Key.Italian: Puoi trovarli con un localizzatore.
Key.Russian: Ты можешь найти их с помощью стандартного гео-поиска.
Key.German: Die kannst du mit einem einfachen Geofinder orten.
Key.English: You can locate them with a standard geo-finder.
Key.Portuguese: Você pode encontrá-las com um localizador padrão.
Key.Korean: 일반 지형탐색기로 찾을 수 있을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你可以用标准的地理位置查找软件找到它们。
Key.Japanese: 標準の地理探知機で見つけられるはずだ。
Key.Turkish: Onları standart bir konum bulucuyla bulabilirsin.

Key.Original: Anyway, lucky break for us.
Key.Chinese: 反正，這對我們來說是好消息。
Key.French: On a une carte à jouer.
Key.Spanish: En cualquier caso, es una suerte para nosotros.
Key.Italian: In ogni caso, per noi si è rivelato un colpo di fortuna.
Key.Polish: Tak czy siak, przyfarciło się nam.
Key.Russian: Как бы там ни было, это нам на руку.
Key.German: Wie auch immer – das spielt uns in die Karten.
Key.English: Anyway, lucky break for us.
Key.Portuguese: De qualquer forma, sorte nossa.
Key.Chinesesimp: 反正，我们能歇口气了，这挺好。
Key.Japanese: とにかく、俺達には幸運だ。
Key.Turkish: Neyse, bu mola bizim için iyi oldu.

Key.Original: Those guys left in a hurry.
Key.French: Ils sont partis en vitesse.
Key.Spanish: Se largaron a toda prisa.
Key.Italian: Quei tizi se ne sono andati via in fretta.
Key.German: Die Jungs hatten es eilig.
Key.English: Those guys left in a hurry.
Key.Portuguese: Aqueles caras se mandaram apressados.
Key.Japanese: 急いで立ち去ったらしい。

Key.Original: Might still be something there that can help us trace them.
Key.Chinese: 或許，他們留下的東西能幫我們追蹤他們。
Key.French: On y trouvera peut-être de quoi remonter leur piste.
Key.Spanish: Puede que se hayan dejado algo que nos ayude a seguirles el rastro.
Key.Italian: Da quelle parti potrebbe esserci ancora qualcosa che ci aiuti a rintracciarli.
Key.Polish: Może zostawili tam coś, co pomoże nam ich namierzyć.
Key.Russian: Возможно, мы сможем найти что-то, что поможет нам выследить их.
Key.German: Vielleicht haben sie etwas zurückgelassen, womit wir sie orten können.
Key.Czech: Možná tam nechali něco, co nám je pomůže vystopovat.
Key.English: Might still be something there that can help us trace them.
Key.Portuguese: Ainda deve ter algo lá que pode nos ajudar a rastrear eles.
Key.Korean: 놈들을 추적하는 데 도움이 될 만한 것들이 아직 있을지도 몰라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那儿也许还有些东西能帮我们追踪他们。
Key.Japanese: やつらを追跡するのに役立つものがまだ残ってるかもしれない。
Key.Turkish: Belki hâlâ izlerini sürmemize yardımcı olabilecek bir şeyler vardır.

Key.Original: I need you to go and investigate...
Key.French: Il faut que tu enquêtes sur place.
Key.Spanish: Quiero que vayáis a investigar...
Key.Italian: Ho bisogno che tu vada a dare un’occhiata...
Key.Polish: Musisz udać się na miejsce i je przeszukać…
Key.German: Ich möchte, dass du dich dort mal umsiehst ...
Key.Czech: Potřebuju, abys to tam zašel prošetřit.
Key.English: I need you to go and investigate...
Key.Portuguese: Preciso que você vá investigar...
Key.Japanese: 調べてきてくれ...

Key.Original: A truck drove off in the night, carrying boxes marked with the same suspicious symbol we spoke about...
Key.Chinese: 一輛卡車晚上開走了，裡面裝的箱子上標有我們先前提到的可疑標誌……
Key.French: Un camion est parti dans la nuit, chargé de cartons avec ce logo louche dont on parlait...
Key.Spanish: Un camión salió por la noche cargado de cajas marcadas con el mismo símbolo sospechoso del que hablamos...
Key.Italian: Un autocarro è partito di notte trasportando scatoloni contrassegnati dallo stesso simbolo sospetto di cui abbiamo parlato...
Key.Polish: W nocy odjechała ciężarówka ze skrzyniami oznaczonymi podejrzanym symbolem, o którym rozmawialiśmy…
Key.Russian: Ночью уехал грузовик с коробками, помеченными тем же подозрительным символом, о котором мы говорили...
Key.German: Letzte Nacht ist dort ein Transporter weggefahren, dessen Ladung dieselbe verdächtige Markierung hatte.
Key.Czech: V noci odtamtud odjelo nákladní auto s krabicema označenýma stejným podezřelým symbolem, o kterým jsme se bavili.
Key.English: A truck drove off in the night, carrying boxes marked with the same suspicious symbol we spoke about...
Key.Portuguese: Um caminhão partiu no meio da noite carregando caixas marcadas com o mesmo símbolo suspeito que a gente comentou...
Key.Korean: 그날 밤에 트럭 한 대가 우리가 얘기했던 수상한 문양으로 표시된 상자를 싣고 떠났어...
Key.Chinesesimp: 一辆卡车夜里开走了，运走的箱子上标着我们提到过的可疑标记...
Key.Japanese: さっき話した怪しい記号が書かれた箱を積んで、夜間にトラックが走り去った...
Key.Turkish: Gece, daha önce konuştuğumuz aynı şüpheli sembolle işaretli kutuları taşıyan bir kamyon ayrıldı...

Key.Original: It arrived at Luganville and, hours later, people started getting sick.
Key.Chinese: 它到了盧甘村，而幾個小時後，那裡的人便開始發病。
Key.French: Il est arrivé à Luganville, et quelques heures plus tard, les habitants tombaient malades.
Key.Spanish: Llegó a Luganville y, al cabo de unas horas, la gente empezó a ponerse enferma.
Key.Italian: È arrivato a Luganville e, qualche ora dopo, la gente ha cominciato a sentirsi male.
Key.Polish: Przyjechała do Luganville i parę godzin później ludzie zaczęli chorować.
Key.Russian: Он прибыл в Луганвилль, и через несколько часов люди там начали плохо себя чувствовать.
Key.German: Er kam in Luganville an und nach ein paar Stunden wurden die Leute dort krank.
Key.Czech: Dorazilo do Luganvillu a pár hodin nato se objevili první nemocní.
Key.English: It arrived at Luganville and, hours later, people started getting sick.
Key.Portuguese: Chegou a Luganville e, horas depois, as pessoas começaram a ficar doentes.
Key.Korean: 트럭은 루간빌에 도착했는데, 그 후 몇 시간 뒤부터 사람들이 병에 걸리기 시작했어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 它到了卢甘威尔，几小时之后，人们开始生病。
Key.Japanese: トラックはルーガンビルに到着し、その何時間か後に人々が体調を崩し始めた。
Key.Turkish: Luganville’ye geldi ve saatler sonra insanlar hasta olmaya başladı.

Key.Original: You see what I'm getting at here...
Key.French: Tu vois où je veux en venir...
Key.Spanish: Ya veis adónde quiero llegar...
Key.Italian: Capisci dov’è che voglio arrivare...
Key.German: Du weißt, worauf ich hinaus will?
Key.English: You see what I'm getting at here...
Key.Portuguese: Você entende onde quero chegar...
Key.Korean: 무슨 얘기를 하려는지 대충 감을 잡았을 거야...
Key.Japanese: 俺が言いたいことは分かるな...

Key.Original: This situation may be worse than we imagined. We've got to act.
Key.Chinese: 這情況比我們想像的還要糟糕。我們必須立即行動。
Key.French: La situation est peut-être plus grave qu'on pensait. On doit agir.
Key.Spanish: La situación podría ser peor de lo que creíamos. Tenemos que actuar.
Key.Italian: Questa situazione potrebbe rivelarsi peggiore di quel che immaginavamo. Dobbiamo agire.
Key.Polish: Sytuacja może być gorsza, niż podejrzewaliśmy. Musimy działać.
Key.Russian: Может оказаться, что ситуация хуже, чем мы себе представляли. Мы должны действовать.
Key.German: Die Situation könnten schlimmer sein als erwartet. Wir müssen aktiv werden.
Key.Czech: Situace je možná horší, než jsme mysleli. Musíme jednat.
Key.English: This situation may be worse than we imagined. We've got to act.
Key.Portuguese: Esta situação pode ser pior do que imaginávamos. Temos que agir.
Key.Korean: 상황은 우리가 생각했던 것보다 더 안 좋을 지도 몰라. 그러니까 빨리 움직여야 돼.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里的情况也许比我们预想的还要糟糕。我们得采取行动。
Key.Japanese: この状況は想像していたよりも最悪かもしれない。なんとかしないと。
Key.Turkish: Bu durum düşündüğümüzden de kötü olabilir. Harekete geçmek zorundayız.

Key.Original: Good morning, sunshine...
Key.French: Tu as fait de beaux rêves, j'espère...
Key.Spanish: Buenos días, cariño...
Key.Italian: Buongiorno, raggio di sole...
Key.German: Guten Morgen, Schlafmütze ...
Key.English: Good morning, sunshine...
Key.Portuguese: Bom dia, estrelinha...
Key.Japanese: そんな眠気眼でよく来てくれた...

Container.name: 024_eve_at_rv_greeting
Container.situation: miller greets player on first meeting.

Key.Original: Ah, good - you're here.
Key.French: Ah, te voilà.
Key.Spanish: Ah, bien... Ya estás aquí.
Key.Italian: Ah, bene, eccoti qui.
Key.German: Ah, gut, du bist da.
Key.English: Ah, good - you're here.
Key.Portuguese: Ah, ótimo. Você tá aqui.
Key.Japanese: よし。来たな。

Container.name: 023_eve_jungle_rv
Container.situation: miller contacts player and explains they must meet in person.

Key.Original: Santiago, change of plan.
Key.French: Santiago, changement de plan.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, cambio de planes.
Key.Italian: Santiago, cambio di programma.
Key.German: Santiago, Planänderung.
Key.English: Santiago, change of plan.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago, mudança de plano.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ、計画変更だ。

Key.Original: Meet me in 4 hours. I'm sending you coordinates...
Key.Chinese: 4 個小時後跟我碰面，我把座標傳給你……
Key.French: Retrouve-moi dans 4 heures. Je t'envoie les coordonnées.
Key.Spanish: Reúnete conmigo dentro de 4 horas. Te envío las coordenadas...
Key.Italian: Incontriamoci tra quattro ore. Ti invio le coordinate...
Key.Polish: Spotkanie za 4 godziny. Wysyłam ci współrzędne…
Key.German: Wir treffen uns in 4 Stunden. Ich schicke dir die Koordinaten ...
Key.Czech: Potkáme se za čtyři hodiny. Posílám ti souřadnice…
Key.English: Meet me in 4 hours. I'm sending you coordinates...
Key.Portuguese: Me encontra em 4 horas. Vou enviar as coordenadas...
Key.Korean: 4시간 뒤에 직접 만나서 얘기해. 지금 좌표를 보내고 있어...
Key.Chinesesimp: 4 小时后和我碰面。我会把坐标发给你...
Key.Japanese: 4 時間後に合流しよう。座標を送る...

Container.name: 022_eve_computer_accessed_call
Container.situation: miller provides player with information.

Key.Original: Okay, Santiago, it seems you're in.
Key.French: OK, Santiago, tu es connecté.
Key.Spanish: Vale, Santiago, parece que ya estás.
Key.Italian: Okay, Santiago, sembra che tu sia collegato.
Key.Russian: Так, Сантьяго, похоже, что ты на связи.
Key.German: Okay, Santiago, du bist drin.
Key.Czech: Dobrá, Santiago. Koukám, že ses připojil.
Key.English: Okay, Santiago, it seems you're in.
Key.Portuguese: Certo, Santiago, parece que você tá dentro.
Key.Korean: 좋아, 산티아고. 링크에 접속한 것 같군.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吧，Santiago，看来你已经连上了。
Key.Japanese: よし、サンティアゴ。つながったようだな。

Key.Original: This picture appeared one month ago in the News Today.
Key.Chinese: 這張照片一個月前刊登在《News Today》上。
Key.French: Cette photo est apparue il y a un mois dans News Today.
Key.Spanish: Esta foto apareció hace un mes en el News Today.
Key.Italian: Questa foto è comparsa un mese fa su News Today.
Key.Polish: To zdjęcie ukazało się miesiąc temu w News Today.
Key.Russian: Эта фотография появилась месяц назад в News Today.
Key.German: Dieses Bild ist vor einem Monat in der News Today aufgetaucht.
Key.Czech: Tenhle obrázek se objevil minulej měsíc v News Today.
Key.English: This picture appeared one month ago in the News Today.
Key.Portuguese: Esta foto apareceu um mês atrás no Notícias do Dia.
Key.Korean: 이 사진은 한 달 전에 뉴스 투데이에서 공개된 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这张照片一个月前刊登在《今日新闻》上。
Key.Japanese: この写真はニュース・トゥデイで 1 か月前に公開されたものだ。
Key.Turkish: Bu görüntü, bir ay önce News Today’de gösterildi.

Key.Original: In the light of the current crisis, you can see why we're so concerned.
Key.Chinese: 在最近發生的事後，你能理解我們為什麼會這麼擔心吧。
Key.French: Vu la crise actuelle, tu imagines qu'on s'inquiète.
Key.Spanish: En vista de la actual crisis, comprenderás por qué estamos tan preocupados.
Key.Italian: Alla luce della crisi attuale, puoi comprendere il motivo per cui siamo così preoccupati.
Key.Polish: Biorąc pod uwagę obecny kryzys, rozumiesz chyba, czemu nas to bardzo niepokoi.
Key.Russian: В свете нынешнего кризиса вы можете понять, почему мы так обеспокоены.
Key.German: Im Angesicht der aktuellen Krise kannst du dir vorstellen, warum wir so besorgt sind.
Key.Czech: Vzhledem k současný krizi asi chápeš, proč nám to dělá starosti.
Key.English: In the light of the current crisis, you can see why we're so concerned.
Key.Portuguese: Em vista da crise atual, você consegue entender por que estamos tão preocupados.
Key.Korean: 최근 국면을 생각하면, 우리가 왜 이렇게 걱정하고 있는지도 이해할 수 있을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 鉴于当前的危机，你应该明白我们为什么这么担心。
Key.Japanese: 現在の危機状況を考えれば、我々がどうしてここまで懸念しているか分かるだろう。
Key.Turkish: Mevcut krizi göz önüne alırsan neden bu kadar endişelendiğimizi anlayabilirsin.

Key.Original: Anyway, rest up.
Key.French: Bon, repose-toi un peu.
Key.Spanish: En fin, descansa un poco.
Key.Italian: Ad ogni modo, riposati un po’.
Key.Russian: Как бы там ни было, ты пока отдыхай.
Key.German: Wie auch immer, ruh dich aus.
Key.English: Anyway, rest up.
Key.Portuguese: De qualquer forma, descanse.
Key.Japanese: とにかく、今は休んでくれ。

Key.Original: It's Tobakoro.
Key.French: C'est Tobakoro.
Key.Spanish: Es Tobakoro.
Key.Italian: È Tobakoro.
Key.German: Das ist Tobakoro.
Key.English: It's Tobakoro.
Key.Portuguese: É Tobakoro.
Key.Japanese: トバコロだ。

Key.Original: A village no-one ever heard of 'til malaria wiped it off the map.
Key.Chinese: 在被瘧疾從地圖上抹去之前，這個村子一直默默無聞。
Key.French: Un village inconnu jusqu'à ce que la malaria le raye de la carte.
Key.Spanish: Una aldea de la que nadie había oído hablar hasta que la malaria la borró del mapa.
Key.Italian: Un villaggio di cui nessuno ha mai sentito parlare fino a quando la malaria non l’ha spazzato via.
Key.Polish: Wiocha, o której nikt nie słyszał, dopóki nie wybiła jej malaria.
Key.Russian: Деревня, о которой никто никогда не слышал, пока малярия не стерла ее с лица земли.
Key.German: Ein Dorf, von dem niemand gehört hatte, bis es von der Malaria ausgelöscht wurde.
Key.Czech: Vesnice, o který nikdo neslyšel, dokud ji malárie nevymazala z mapy.
Key.English: A village no-one ever heard of 'til malaria wiped it off the map.
Key.Portuguese: Uma vila que ninguém tinha ouvido falar até que a malária a eliminou do mapa.
Key.Korean: 말라리아로 인해 거주민들이 전멸당하기 전까지는 전혀 알려져 있지 않던 마을이야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在被疟疾从地图上抹去之前，这个村子一直默默无闻。
Key.Japanese: マラリアによって住人が全員亡くなるまで誰もその存在を知らなかった小さな村だ。
Key.Turkish: Sıtma yüzünden haritadan silinmeden önce adı hiç duyulmamış olan bir köy.

Key.Original: Here is the same photo, only enhanced.
Key.Chinese: 這是同一張照片，不過放大了一些。
Key.French: Ça, c'est la même photo, mais agrandie.
Key.Spanish: Esta es la misma foto, pero ampliada.
Key.Italian: Questa è la stessa foto, solo migliorata e ingrandita.
Key.Polish: Tu masz to samo zdjęcie, tyle że powiększone.
Key.Russian: А вот та же фотография, только качество получше.
Key.German: Hier ist dasselbe Foto, nur vergrößert.
Key.Czech: Tady je ta samá fotka, jenom zvětšená.
Key.English: Here is the same photo, only enhanced.
Key.Portuguese: Aqui está a mesma foto, só que aprimorada.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这是同一张照片，只是更清晰一些。
Key.Japanese: これは同じ写真を拡大したものだ。
Key.Turkish: Bu da aynı fotoğrafın daha büyük ve kaliteli hali.

Key.Original: Note the stencil on the side of the container.
Key.French: Tu as vu le logo sur ce conteneur ?
Key.Spanish: Fíjate en el stencil que hay en el lateral del contenedor.
Key.Italian: Guarda l’adesivo sul lato del container.
Key.Polish: Zwróć uwagę na symbol na kontenerze.
Key.Russian: Обрати внимание на надпись на контейнере.
Key.German: Sieh dir mal das Symbol auf dem Behälter an.
Key.Czech: Všimni si toho obrázku na boku kontejneru.
Key.English: Note the stencil on the side of the container.
Key.Portuguese: Observe a gravura na lateral do contêiner.
Key.Chinesesimp: 注意集装箱侧面的图案。
Key.Japanese: コンテナの横のステンシルを見てくれ。

Key.Original: Look familiar?
Key.French: Ça te rappelle rien ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Te resulta familiar?
Key.Italian: Ti ricorda qualcosa?
Key.German: Kommt dir das bekannt vor?
Key.English: Look familiar?
Key.Portuguese: Parece familiar?
Key.Japanese: 見覚えがないか？

Key.Original: That symbol was on a cargo truck we caught with our surveillance.
Key.Chinese: 我們監控時在貨車上看見了同一個標誌。
Key.French: Il y a le même logo sur le camion qu'on a repéré avec ta caméra.
Key.Spanish: Un camión de carga que captamos con las cámaras llevaba ese símbolo.
Key.Italian: Quel simbolo era su un autocarro che abbiamo sorpreso sulla telecamera di sorveglianza.
Key.Polish: Taki sam był na ciężarówce, którą zarejestrowaliśmy.
Key.Russian: Этот же символ был на грузовике, который засекла наша камера.
Key.German: Dasselbe Symbol war auf einem Transporter, den wir aufgenommen haben.
Key.Czech: Stejnej symbol byl na nákladním autě, který jsme viděli na kameře.
Key.English: That symbol was on a cargo truck we caught with our surveillance.
Key.Portuguese: Esse símbolo estava em um caminhão de carga que pegamos com nossa vigilância.
Key.Korean: 우리 감시팀이 잡은 화물 트럭에도 그 문양이 있었어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们的监控捕捉到的一辆货运卡车上也有那个标记。
Key.Japanese: あの記号は監視カメラで捉えた貨物トラックにもあった。
Key.Turkish: Bu sembol, gözetimde yakaladığımız bir kargo kamyonunun üzerinde vardı.

Key.Original: Alright. Last image. You see?
Key.Chinese: 好了，最後一個圖像，看見了嗎？
Key.French: Bien. Tu vois cette dernière photo ?
Key.Spanish: Vale, la última imagen. ¿Lo ves?
Key.Italian: Okay. L’ultima immagine. Vedi?
Key.German: Jetzt kommt das letzte Bild. Siehst du es?
Key.Czech: Tak a teď poslední fotka. Vidíš?
Key.English: Alright. Last image. You see?
Key.Portuguese: Tudo bem. Última imagem. Tá vendo?
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吧，最后一张图。你看到了吗？
Key.Japanese: さて、最後の写真だ。見てくれ。

Key.Original: Our analysts believe it's linked to a biogenetic weapons program.
Key.Chinese: 我們的分析師認為，這跟某種生物遺傳武器計畫有關。
Key.French: Selon mon analyste, c'est lié à de l'armement biogénétique.
Key.Spanish: Nuestros analistas creen que tiene que ver con un programa de armas biogenéticas.
Key.Italian: I nostri analisti ritengono che abbia a che fare con un programma di armi biogenetiche.
Key.Polish: Według analityków to ma związek z programem rozwoju broni biologicznej.
Key.Russian: Наши аналитики считают, что это связано с программой биогенетического оружия.
Key.German: Unsere Analysten glauben, dass es mit einem biogenetischen Waffenprogramm in Verbindung steht.
Key.Czech: Naši analytici si myslí, že to souvisí s vývojem biogenetických zbraní.
Key.English: Our analysts believe it's linked to a biogenetic weapons program.
Key.Portuguese: Nossos analistas acreditam que isso tá vinculado a um programa de armas biogenéticas.
Key.Korean: 우리 분석팀은 그 문양이 생물무기 프로그램과 연관이 있다고 보고 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们的分析师认为，这跟某种生物基因武器计划有关。
Key.Japanese: こちらの分析者は生物兵器プログラムと関係があると考えている。
Key.Turkish: Analiz uzmanlarımız bunun biyogenetik silah programıyla bağlantısı olduğuna inanıyor.

Key.Original: More information's still coming in.
Key.Chinese: 我們還會收到更多資訊。
Key.French: Je reçois encore des infos.
Key.Spanish: Seguimos recibiendo información.
Key.Italian: Stanno arrivando altre informazioni.
Key.German: Weitere Informationen sind unterwegs.
Key.Czech: Pořád nám ještě chodí další informace.
Key.English: More information's still coming in.
Key.Portuguese: Tem mais informações chegando.
Key.Korean: 더 많은 정보가 또 들어올 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们还会收到更多消息。
Key.Japanese: 追加情報がまだ入ってきているんだ。
Key.Turkish: Daha fazla bilgi gelmeye devam ediyor.

Key.Original: I'll call at 06:30. Maybe we'll get some answers.
Key.Chinese: 我會在 06:30 再打給你，或許我們會有些答案。
Key.French: Je t'appelle à 6h30. On aura peut-être des réponses.
Key.Spanish: Te llamaré a las 06:30. A ver si conseguimos respuestas.
Key.Italian: Ti chiamerò alle 06:30. Forse avremo delle risposte.
Key.Polish: Zadzwonię o 6:30. Może czegoś się dowiemy.
Key.Russian: Я позвоню в 6:30. Может, мы получим кое-какие ответы.
Key.German: Ich rufe um 06:30 Uhr an. Vielleicht gibt es dann ein paar Antworten.
Key.Czech: Zavolám v 6:30. Možná už budeme znát pár odpovědí.
Key.English: I'll call at 06:30. Maybe we'll get some answers.
Key.Portuguese: Te ligo às 6h30. Talvez a gente tenha algumas respostas.
Key.Korean: 06:30에 전화할게. 그때가 되면 뭔가 답이 나올 수도 있겠지.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我会在 06:30 再打电话给你。也许我们能找到一些答案。
Key.Japanese: 06:30 にまた電話する。その時には何か答えが出ているかもしれない。

Container.name: 021_ta_miller_intel_available_call
Container.situation: miller informs player he has sent files, with intel from the surveillance camera.

Key.Original: Santiago. This is Keystone. Listen.
Key.French: Santiago. Ici Keystone. Écoute ça.
Key.Spanish: Santiago, aquí Keystone. Oye.
Key.Italian: Santiago. Qui è Keystone. Ascolta.
Key.German: Santiago, hier ist Keystone. Hör zu.
Key.English: Santiago. This is Keystone. Listen.
Key.Portuguese: Santiago. Aqui é Lastro. Na escuta.
Key.Japanese: サンティアゴ。こちらはキーストーンだ。聞いてくれ。

Key.Original: Intel from our remote surveillance.
Key.Chinese: 我們遠端監控取得的情資。
Key.French: J'ai eu des infos avec la caméra.
Key.Spanish: Tenemos información de la vigilancia remota.
Key.Italian: Abbiamo ottenuto dei dati dalla nostra telecamera di sorveglianza.
Key.Polish: Są materiały z naszej zdalnej kamery.
Key.German: Es gibt Neuigkeiten von unserer Fernüberwachung.
Key.English: Intel from our remote surveillance.
Key.Portuguese: Informação da nossa vigilância remota.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们的远程监控传来情报。
Key.Japanese: 遠隔監視システムから情報が入った。

Key.Original: Looks like we got a hit. Good work.
Key.French: On a fait mouche. Bon boulot.
Key.Spanish: Parece que hemos dado en el clavo. Buen trabajo.
Key.Italian: A quanto pare abbiamo una traccia. Ottimo lavoro.
Key.Russian: Кажется, у нас есть зацепка. Отличная работа.
Key.German: Scheint ein Treffer zu sein. Gute Arbeit.
Key.Czech: Zdá se, že jsme se trefili. Dobrá práce.
Key.English: Looks like we got a hit. Good work.
Key.Portuguese: Parece que temos algo. Bom trabalho.
Key.Korean: 연결 고리를 찾은 것 같아. 수고했어.
Key.Chinesesimp: 看来有成果了，干得漂亮。
Key.Japanese: 目標を捉えられたようだ。よくやった。

Key.Original: I'm going to send you the data now.
Key.French: Je t'envoie ça tout de suite
Key.Spanish: Te paso los datos ahora mismo.
Key.Italian: Te li invio subito.
Key.German: Ich schicke dir jetzt die Daten.
Key.English: I'm going to send you the data now.
Key.Portuguese: Vou enviar os dados agora.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我现在就把数据传给你。
Key.Japanese: 今そちらにデータを送る。

Key.Original: If you're at home, check it on your secure connection.
Key.Chinese: 你要是在家，記得在安全的網路上查看。
Key.French: Si tu es chez toi, jette un œil avec la connexion sécurisée.
Key.Spanish: Si estás en casa, usa la conexión segura.
Key.Italian: Se sei a casa, guardali sulla tua connessione sicura.
Key.Polish: Jeśli jesteś w domu, sprawdź przez bezpieczne połączenie.
Key.Russian: Если ты дома, посмотри через безопасное соединение.
Key.German: Wenn du zu Hause bist, nutze eine sichere Verbindung.
Key.Czech: Jestli jsi doma, koukni na to přes zabezpečený spojení.
Key.English: If you're at home, check it on your secure connection.
Key.Portuguese: Se estiver em casa, verifique na sua conexão segura.
Key.Korean: 지금 집에 있으면 보안 접속으로 확인해봐.
Key.Chinesesimp: 如果你在家，用安全连接查看。
Key.Japanese: 家にいるなら、安全な接続を使って確認してくれ。
Key.Turkish: Evdeysen güvenli bağlantın üzerinden kontrol et.

Key.Original: I'll call, as soon as I can see the one-time link is active.
Key.Chinese: 如果我看到這個一次性連結啟動後，我就撥電話。
Key.French: Je t'appelle dès que tu ouvres le lien à usage unique.
Key.Spanish: Te llamaré en cuanto vea que se activa en enlace de un solo uso.
Key.Italian: Ti chiamerò non appena vedo che il collegamento unico è attivo.
Key.Polish: Dam znać, jak tylko jednorazowe łącze będzie aktywne.
Key.Russian: Я позвоню, как только увижу, что разовая ссылка активна.
Key.German: Ich rufe an, sobald der einmalige Link aktiv ist.
Key.Czech: Až uvidím, že jednorázovej odkaz je aktivní, zavolám ti.
Key.English: I'll call, as soon as I can see the one-time link is active.
Key.Portuguese: Vou ligar assim que conferir que o link exclusivo tá ativado.
Key.Korean: 일회용 링크가 활성화된 게 확인되면 내가 즉시 전화할게.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我一看到这个一次性链接激活，就拨电话。
Key.Japanese: 1 回きりのリンクが有効になったらすぐに電話する。
Key.Turkish: Tek seferlik bağlantı aktif olur olmaz arayacağım.

Container.name: 020_ta_explosives_taken
Container.situation: arthur thanks player for his help and offers him a sum of money.

Key.Original: You got it?
Key.French: Tu as trouvé ?
Key.Spanish: ¿Lo tienes?
Key.Italian: Preso?
Key.German: Hast du es?
Key.English: You got it?
Key.Portuguese: Pegou?
Key.Japanese: 終わりか？

Key.Original: Good going.
Key.French: Bon boulot.
Key.Spanish: Perita.
Key.Italian: Ottimo lavoro.
Key.German: Gut.
Key.English: Good going.
Key.Portuguese: Muito bom.
Key.Japanese: ヨカッタ。

Key.Original: And, I just transferred your money.
Key.Chinese: 還有，我剛剛把你的錢匯過去了。
Key.French: Et je t'ai remboursé ma dette.
Key.Spanish: Y ya te he transferido el dinero.
Key.Italian: E ho appena trasferito i tuoi soldi.
Key.Russian: Я только что отправил тебе деньги.
Key.German: Ich habe dir auch gerade das Geld überwiesen.
Key.Czech: Peníze jsem ti převedl na účet.
Key.English: And, I just transferred your money.
Key.Portuguese: E acabei de transferir seu dinheiro também.
Key.Chinesesimp: 另外，我刚才给你转账了。
Key.Japanese: 今オ前ノ口座ニ金ヲ振リ込ンダ。

Key.Original: It's there, with interest. Consider it housekeeping, eh?
Key.Chinese: 都在這裡，利息也算進去了。就當作清理費吧？
Key.French: J'ai fait le transfert, avec intérêts pour avoir fait le ménage.
Key.Spanish: Va con intereses. Considéralos gastos de gestión, ¿vale?
Key.Italian: Sono lì, con gli interessi. Una ricompensa per avermi ripulito il capanno, eh?
Key.Polish: Jest wszystko, z odsetkami. Powiedzmy, że to za porządki domowe.
Key.Russian: Всю сумму с процентами. Будем считать, что это плата за уборку в доме, да?
Key.German: Es ist da, inklusive Zinsen. Sieh das Ganze einfach als Frühjahrsputz, okay?
Key.Czech: Máš je tam i s úrokem. Ber to jako platbu za úklid.
Key.English: It's there, with interest. Consider it housekeeping, eh?
Key.Portuguese: Tá pago, e com juros. Pense nisso como um extra pras despesas de casa, tá?
Key.Korean: 이자까지 쳐서 보냈어. 청소비라고 생각해, 알겠지?
Key.Chinesesimp: 已经到帐了，包括利息。就把它当作清理费吧，嗯？
Key.Japanese: 利息モ含メテ支払ッテアル。面倒ヲカケタカラナ。
Key.Turkish: Faiziyle birlikte yatırdım. Temizlik işinin karşılığı olarak düşün, tamam mı?

Key.Original: And, er, best you don't risk CSAT's checkpoint.
Key.Chinese: 還有，這個嘛，你最好別去 CSAT 的哨站冒險。
Key.French: Tu devrais éviter le checkpoint du CSAT.
Key.Spanish: Y, esto... mejor no te la juegues con el punto de control del CSAT.
Key.Italian: E... sarà meglio non passare per il punto di controllo della CSAT.
Key.Polish: I… lepiej nie ryzykuj z punktem kontrolnym CSAT.
Key.Russian: Кстати, тебе лучше не соваться на КПП CSAT.
Key.German: Und ... ähm ... fahr besser nicht durch CSATs Kontrollpunkt.
Key.Czech: Jo a cestu přes kontrolu CSAT bych radši neriskoval.
Key.English: And, er, best you don't risk CSAT's checkpoint.
Key.Portuguese: E, ahn, é melhor você não se arriscar no ponto de verificação da CSAT.
Key.Korean: 그리고 CSAT의 검문소는 피하는 게 좋을 거야.
Key.Chinesesimp: 还有，呃，你最好别冒险通过 CSAT 的关卡。
Key.Japanese: ソレカラ、CSAT ノ検問所ハモウ通ラナイ方ガイイダロウ。
Key.Turkish: Ayrıca, şey, CSAT’ın kontrol noktasını tehlikeye atmasan iyi olur.

Key.Original: Not now you got something on you...
Key.Chinese: 現在不行，你那還有些麻煩……
Key.French: Maintenant que tu as le matos...
Key.Spanish: No ahora que te pueden pillar con algo...
Key.Italian: Non ora che non sei a mani vuote...
Key.German: Jetzt hast du etwas dabei, was sie finden könnten ...
Key.Czech: Teď, když u sebe něco máš…
Key.English: Not now you got something on you...
Key.Portuguese: Não agora que você tem algo com você...
Key.Korean: 이렇게 폭약까지 갖고 있는 상황에선 더 더욱 피해야지...
Key.Chinesesimp: 现在不行，你那还有一些麻烦...
Key.Japanese: ソレヲ持ッテチャマズイカラナ...
Key.Turkish: Şimdi değil, üzerinde taşıdıkların varken olmaz...

Container.name: 019_eve_at_shed
Container.situation: arthur arrives at the shed and points out the explosives to player.

Key.Original: It's just in there.
Key.French: C'est là-dedans.
Key.Spanish: Está ahí mismo.
Key.Italian: È lì dentro.
Key.German: Es ist da drinnen.
Key.English: It's just in there.
Key.Portuguese: Lá está.
Key.Japanese: コノ中ダ。

Container.name: 018_ta_walking_to_the_shed
Container.situation: arthur leads player to the shed where an explosive charge has been hidden.

Key.Original: Come on, I'll take you to the shed.
Key.French: Viens, je vais te montrer la remise.
Key.Spanish: Ven, que te llevo a mi choza.
Key.Italian: Avanti, ti faccio vedere dov’è il capanno.
Key.German: Komm, ich zeig dir die Hütte.
Key.English: Come on, I'll take you to the shed.
Key.Portuguese: Vamos, vou te levar até o galpão.
Key.Japanese: コッチダ。小屋マデ案内スル。

Container.name: 017_fil_arrival
Container.situation: the player arrives at the village with arthur.

Key.Original: C'est bien. Bon. So, here we are, mec.
Key.Chinese: 很好。我們這就到了，夥計。
Key.French: Bon. C'est bien. On y est, mec.
Key.Spanish: C'est bien. Bon. Pues aquí estamos, mec.
Key.Italian: C’est bien. Bon. Okay, ci siamo, mec.
Key.Polish: C'est bien. Bon. No to jesteśmy, mec.
Key.Russian: Сэ бье'н. Бон. Мы приехали, мэк.
Key.German: C'est bien. Bon. Da sind wir, mec.
Key.Czech: C'est bien. Bon. Tak jsme tady, mec.
Key.English: C'est bien. Bon. So, here we are, mec.
Key.Portuguese: C'est bien. Bon. Cá estamos, mec.
Key.Japanese: セ・ビアン。ボン。着イタゾ。到着ダ。
Key.Turkish: C'est bien. Bon. İşte geldik, mec.

Container.name: 016_fil_driving_tractor
Container.situation: arthur comments on a tractor that has broken down on the road ahead, recommending the player turns left.

Key.Original: Ah. Tractor's broken again!
Key.French: Ah, son tracteur est encore en panne !
Key.Spanish: Ah. ¡El tractor ha vuelto a estropearse!
Key.Italian: Ah. Il trattore si è rotto di nuovo!
Key.German: Ah, der Traktor ist wieder ausgefallen!
Key.English: Ah. Tractor's broken again!
Key.Portuguese: Ah! O trator quebrou de novo!
Key.Japanese: アア。トラクターガマタ壊レテル！

Key.Original: Okay, take a left and go between the cane fields.
Key.Chinese: 好了，左轉，到甘蔗田裡去。
Key.French: Passe à gauche entre les champs de canne à sucre.
Key.Spanish: Vale, tira por la izquierda y ve por los cañaverales.
Key.Italian: Okay, gira a sinistra e vai in mezzo ai canneti.
Key.Polish: Dobra, skręć w lewo i pojedź między uprawami trzciny cukrowej.
Key.Russian: Так, здесь сверни налево, через тростниковые поля.
Key.German: Bieg links ab und fahr durch die Zuckerrohrfelder.
Key.Czech: Fajn, teď odboč doleva a vezmi to mezi třtinovými poli.
Key.English: Okay, take a left and go between the cane fields.
Key.Portuguese: Beleza, vira à esquerda e vai por entre os campos de cana.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好的，左转，从甘蔗地里穿过去。
Key.Japanese: オッケー。左折シテ、サトウキビ畑ノ間ヲ走レ。
Key.Turkish: Pekâlâ, sola dön ve şeker kamışı tarlalarının arasından git.

Container.name: 015_fil_driving_idap
Container.situation: arthur begins speaking about idap and the good work they are doing, with regards to a devastating malaria outbreak.

Key.Original: IDAP's keeping busy.
Key.French: L'IDAP est bien occupé.
Key.Spanish: El IDAP ha estado haciendo de las suyas.
Key.Italian: L’IDAP si sta dando molto da fare.
Key.German: IDAP hat alle Hände voll zu tun.
Key.English: IDAP's keeping busy.
Key.Portuguese: A IDAP está na ativa.
Key.Japanese: IDAP ハ多忙ミタイダナ。

Key.Original: Rumor is they all getting sick too.
Key.French: Apparemment, eux aussi ils tombent malades.
Key.Spanish: Se rumorea que también se están contagiando.
Key.Italian: Sembrerebbe che si stiano ammalando tutti.
Key.Russian: Ходят слухи, что они тоже все заразились.
Key.German: Man sagt, dass sie auch alle krank werden.
Key.Czech: Říká se, že i oni mají dost nemocných.
Key.English: Rumor is they all getting sick too.
Key.Portuguese: Diz os boato que tá todo mundo ficando doente tamém.
Key.Korean: 들리는 소문에는 그쪽 사람들도 전부 감염됐대.
Key.Japanese: 噂デハ、アイツラ全員、体調ヲ崩シテキテルラシイ。
Key.Turkish: Duyduğuma göre onların da hepsi hasta oluyormuş.

Key.Original: Even with the shots.
Key.French: Même avec leurs vaccins.
Key.Spanish: Incluso con las vacunas.
Key.Italian: Nonostante le iniezioni di antimalarica.
Key.German: Trotz der Impfungen.
Key.English: Even with the shots.
Key.Portuguese: Mesmo com as injeções.
Key.Japanese: 注射ヲシテテモナ。

Key.Original: You remember Dr. Drábek? He says he ain't seen nothing like it.
Key.Chinese: 你記得德拉貝克醫生嗎？他說他沒見過這樣的東西。
Key.French: Tu te souviens du docteur Drábek ? Il a jamais vu ça.
Key.Spanish: ¿Te acuerdas del Dr. Drábek? Dice que nunca había visto nada igual.
Key.Italian: Ricordi il dottor Drábek? Dice di non aver mai visto nulla del genere prima d’ora.
Key.Polish: Pamiętasz doktora Drábka? Mówi, że z czymś takim się jeszcze nie spotkał.
Key.Russian: Помнишь доктора Драбека? Он говорит, что ничего подобного не видел.
Key.German: Erinnerst du dich noch an Dr. Drábek? Er sagt, dass er so etwas noch nie gesehen hat.
Key.Czech: Pamatuješ na doktora Drábka? Říká, že něco takovýho ještě neviděl.
Key.English: You remember Dr. Drábek? He says he ain't seen nothing like it.
Key.Portuguese: Você lembra do Dr. Drábek? Ele diz que nunca viu nada parecido.
Key.Korean: 드라벡 박사 기억해? 그 사람이 그러는데, 자기도 이런 건 처음이래.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你记得 Drábek 医生吗？他说他没见过那样的病。
Key.Japanese: "ドクター・ドラベク" ヲ覚エテルカ？コンナ状況ハ見タコトガナイト言ッテタ。
Key.Turkish: Dr. Drábek’i hatırlıyor musun? Daha önce hiç böyle bir şey görmemiş.

Key.Original: The malaria, I mean.
Key.French: Cette malaria...
Key.Spanish: A la malaria, digo.
Key.Italian: Parlo della malaria.
Key.German: Die Malaria, meine ich.
Key.English: The malaria, I mean.
Key.Portuguese: A malária, quero dizer.
Key.Japanese: マラリアニ関シテナ。

Key.Original: It's some kinda super-strain. Kills in hours, instead of weeks...
Key.Chinese: 這是某種超級突變，被感染後都不用幾週，幾個小時就足以致命……
Key.French: Une souche fatale. Ça se joue pas en semaines, mais en heures...
Key.Spanish: Es una especie de supercepa que mata en horas en vez de en semanas...
Key.Italian: È un ceppo incredibilmente forte. Uccide nell’arco di ore, invece che di settimane...
Key.Polish: To jakaś superodmiana. Zabija w kilka godzin, a nie tygodni…
Key.Russian: Говорит это какой-то супер-штамм. Убивает за считанные часы, а не за недели...
Key.German: Das ist eine Art Super-Erreger. Man stirbt schon nach ein paar Stunden, nicht nach mehreren Wochen ...
Key.Czech: Je to nějakej superkmen. Zabíjí v řádu hodin místo týdnů.
Key.English: It's some kinda super-strain. Kills in hours, instead of weeks...
Key.Portuguese: É algum tipo de supervírus. Mata em horas, em vez de semanas...
Key.Korean: 엄청나게 강력한 변종인가봐. 몇 주가 아니라 단 몇 시간만에 죽음에 이른다는군...
Key.Chinesesimp: 它像是某种超级变种，染病后不用几周，几小时就身亡...
Key.Japanese: スゴイ重病ナンダ。数週間ト言ワズ、数時間デ感染者ヲ殺ス...
Key.Turkish: Süper bir suş gibi. Haftalar değil, saatler içinde öldürüyor.

Key.Original: CSAT's gotta medical division doing research on Tuvanaka.
Key.Chinese: CSAT 派了一支醫療部門來土萬納卡進行研究。
Key.French: La division médicale du CSAT étudie ça sur Tuvanaka.
Key.Spanish: El CSAT tiene una división médica investigando en Tuvanaka.
Key.Italian: La CSAT ha convogliato la divisione medica a fare ricerca su Tuvanaka.
Key.Polish: Jednostka medyczna CSAT bada ją na Tuvanace.
Key.Russian: У CSAT целое медицинское подразделение занимается исследованием Туванаки.
Key.German: CSAT hat eine ganze medizinische Abteilung mit der Forschung auf Tuvanaka beauftragt.
Key.Czech: CSAT má na Tuvanace zdravotnickou divizi. Zkoumají to.
Key.English: CSAT's gotta medical division doing research on Tuvanaka.
Key.Portuguese: A CSAT tem uma divisão médica fazendo pesquisas em Tuvanaka.
Key.Korean: CSAT는 투바나카에 의료 연구소를 운영하고 있어.
Key.Chinesesimp: CSAT 派遣了医疗部门在突瓦纳加做研究。
Key.Japanese: CSAT ハ衛生課ニ "トゥバナカ" ノ研究ヲサセテル。
Key.Turkish: CSAT’nin Tuvanaka ile ilgili araştırma yapan bir sıhhiye tümeni var.

Key.Original: But no-one's giving us any answers.
Key.Chinese: 但誰也沒有給我們確切的答案。
Key.French: Mais on nous dit rien.
Key.Spanish: Pero nadie nos da respuestas.
Key.Italian: Ma nessuno ci dà risposte.
Key.Polish: Ale nikt nie potrafi nic stwierdzić.
Key.Russian: Но нам никто ничего не говорит.
Key.German: Aber niemand liefert uns Antworten.
Key.Czech: Ale nám nikdo žádnou odpověď nedá.
Key.English: But no-one's giving us any answers.
Key.Portuguese: Mas ninguém está nos dando respostas.
Key.Korean: 하지만 그 부서의 진짜 정체는 아무도 몰라.
Key.Chinesesimp: 但谁也没有给我们确切的答复。
Key.Japanese: ダガ、誰モ答エヲ出セナイデイル。

Container.name: 014_ex_driving_escape
Container.situation: arthur expresses his alarm as player acts unexpectedly and bundles instructions given at the checkpoint.

Key.Original: Merde alors, what you doing? Drive! Go! Get us outta here!
Key.Chinese: Merde alors，你在幹嘛？快開車，快！帶我們離開這裡！
Key.French: Merde alors, qu'est-ce que tu fous ? Avance ! Tire-nous de là !
Key.Spanish: Merde alors, ¿pero qué haces? ¡Písale! ¡Vamos! ¡Hay que largarse!
Key.Italian: Merde, alors, che fai? Guida! Vai! Via da qui!
Key.Polish: Merde alors, co ty robisz? Jedź! Szybko! Zabieraj nas stąd!
Key.Russian: Мьерде алор, ты что творишь? Поехали! Давай! Выбираемся отсюда!
Key.German: Merde alors, was machst du? Fahr schon, schaff uns hier weg!
Key.Czech: Merde alors, co děláš? Jeď! Dělej! Ať už jsme odtud pryč!
Key.English: Merde alors, what you doing? Drive! Go! Get us outta here!
Key.Portuguese: Merde alors, o que você tá fazendo? Acelera! Vai! Tira a gente daqui!
Key.Korean: 메르드 알로르, 뭐하는 거야? 어서 출발해! 여기서 빠져나가자고!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我的天哪，你在做什么？开车！快走！我们快离开这儿！
Key.Japanese: メルド・アロー。何ヲシテル？車ヲ走ラセロ！行ケ！ココカラ立チ去ルゾ！
Key.Turkish: Merde alors, ne yapıyorsun? Sür! Haydi! Bizi buradan götür!

Container.name: 013_in_driving_csat_situation
